reviews.text: The staff was not very courteous and only provided good service when bribed. The quality of the food was not good. reviews.author: momwadvm
reviews.title: Nice hotel but don't reserve the Kanna Beach Club or Bali Bed Experience!
reviews.text:
The hotel is lovely, the beach was great. Food was good but make sure to make reservations as far ahead of time as possible for availability. There were fun daytime activities (yoga, pilates, dancing, hat making, Dominican doll painting, etc). Nighttime entertainment was mediocre (mostly music and dance shows- one night had a circus-like performance)- seating is not great for watching the shows and quality of the performances were just ok.
The biggest negative I had is that I paid for the Kana Beach Club Experience, that was supposed to include reserved Bali Beds and food and beverage service. However, no one at the hotel was ever able to help me use this service I paid for. There was never anyone at the kiosk where they told me to check in for the service and find out what day I could use the service (apparently I wouldn't get to choose for myself). I spoke with the concierge and the front desk a few times during my stay and was not able to make any progress in using this service. Everyone was very kind and seemed like they wanted to help, but never did actually help.
In the end, it was not a big deal and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. But I would like a refund of the money I spent on a service I did not receive. I was told by the concierge and again at check-out that I would be refunded but have not heard back. 
Pro-tip: Bring an insulated water bottle!!! You can get it filled with ice once or twice a day and keep cold water on hand all day.

reviews.text: La belleza de sus playas, los restaurantes y alimentos son increíbles, sus instalaciones y las albercas son espectaculares y el personal muy atento, amable y respetuoso, me hicieron sentir especial el día de mi cumpleaños.

reviews.author: Lauren G
reviews.title: I’ve never been so underwhelmed
reviews.text: Property was beautiful- that is where the compliments stop. The property is extremely spaced out, which in theory is great because you aren’t tripping on other people. That said, there are zero food options outside the main building (so no poolside or beachside service) so if you are staying in a room farther from the main area, or are on the beach and hungry, you have to pack up and walk 10min to the buffet, which was lackluster at best and gross at worst. I was seriously concerned about food poisoning given how tepid most of the hot food options were. I also watched the omelet chef drop his mixing spoon, quickly rinse it off with water only and the go right back to using it. I regularly witnessed flies hanging out on the buffet food and the first time we ate there, my utensils came wrapped in a dirty/used napkin. Towel huts were scarce and not apparent. Given that there were like 20 pools, this wasn’t great. None of phones in our room worked so I couldn’t call the desk about the hairdryer that didn’t work.  There are so many other, smaller things that happened, but these are the big ones. 100% not worth the money.

reviews.author: AuthenticHorizons
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The resort is absolutely stunning; very luxurious. I booked an oceanfront suite that was more than I would have imagined. The buffet had numerous options to choose from; however, with dietary restrictions and food allergies, I found it difficult to find something to eat, and when I did, it was subpar. Their dining reservations process was disappointing for a someone visiting for the first time. My recommendation: IMMEDIATELY after checkin (if before 5pm), go book your reservations for the restaurants you want to try. Otherwise you’ll be stuck with the buffet for dinner.

reviews.author: frankofrancesco1900
reviews.title: Fabelhafte Zimmer und Anlage - unterirdische Kulinarik
reviews.text:
Das Hotel verfügt über fabelhafte Zimmer und eine gepflegte Anlage. Die Zimmerreinigung war auch tadellos.

Da man aber bei all-inclusive nirgendwo anders essen kann wiegen die Mängel bei der Kulinarik leider schwer.

Themen:
- Hygiene mit Wasser, Eis und Speisen mangelhaft. 
- Viele Magen-Darm-Erkrankungen. Ich schätze dass 20% unserer (sehr großen) Gruppe krank waren
- Standard Wein und Perlwein sehr schlecht
- Speisen fast immer kalt serviert, am Buffet aber auch im Service-Restaurant
- fertige Speisen und Zutaten (Fleisch, Fisch, Patties, ...) liegen stundenlang ungekühlt am Buffet
- Gläser, Teller u. Besteck nie richtig sauber

reviews.author: tanyamurtland
reviews.title: The worst resort I have ever been at
reviews.text: The food was so terrible we lived off of lays chips in the mini bar.  Many in our group got sick with stomach issues. The trip was so bad, we came back early and will never go back to the DR!

reviews.author: Christian P
reviews.title: Schönes Hotel wird aber seinem Anspruch nicht gerecht
reviews.text:
Sehr schöne Anlage mit vielen schönen Pools und traumhaftem Strand.

Leider ist das Personal schlecht geschult und wird dem Anspruch des Hotels nicht gerecht. 
Die Zimmer sind in unterschiedlichen Zustand, manche top renoviert andere etwas in die Tage gekommen aber dennoch großzügig und bequem.

Umweltaspekte werden komplett vernachlässigt. Handtücher werden jeden Tag getauscht, ob man es wünscht oder nicht. Die Klimaanlage läuft den ganzen Tag auch wenn keiner da ist. Warm Wasser wird mit Strom gemacht, es gibt nicht ein einziges Solarpanel.
Viele Einwegbecher.

Das Buffet hat eine gute Auswahl aber leider liegen viele Speisen zu lange und sind nicht mehr frisch. Weniger wäre mehr! 
Löffel, Tassen Suppenschüsseln sind Mangelware. 

Die allabendliche, laute Life Musik kann störend wirken.

Alles Klagen auf hohem Niveau angesichts des Preises von $700 pro Nacht.

I stayed there for 4 nights and put all my valuables, money, credit cards, passport in the safe. Still a bottle of cologne was stolen from my room during cleaning. This is not normal as in case I would've left other valuables open, the hotel staff would've stolen that too.

Food is below average, unless you pay for the VIP rooms, where they serve better quality food. 
Later they found who stole that and offered me concession on the next day stay, which I accepted and regretted later coz they didn't live up their commitment on Concierge and other services.

reviews.title: We had a wonderful time, great resort, ok food
reviews.text:
Overall the resort and the service is wonderful.  It seemed to be catered to conferences, 1 was there and it was quiet and then they left and another came in and that group was more fun.
Rooms are very clean, resort is clean, service is a 5/5 the staff is super friendly and accommodating.  Beach and pools are perfect.  Only downside is thought was the food wasnt wonderful, it was good but not great.  Not many choices at restaurants and everything tasted bland.  Also no real night life or activities.  Casino is basically a room with some machines and tables. Beach has lots of seats and cabanas. Great liquor choices!

reviews.author: Stephanie R
reviews.title: Beautiful setting
reviews.text: Beautiful setting. Most of the staff friendly. We didn’t like the tier system of where you can or can’t go on the beach. Attention to detail needs to be looked at. Like the furniture on our balcony was ripped and not maintained, daily cleaning of outside areas not carried out to our standard.  Mostly around the pool areas. A lot of money spent so we expected standard to be higher. We had a little trouble with air conditioning (our fault, we didn’t realise we had to close the door completely for it to work) however the maintenance chap came in closed the door and was very unfriendly. No explanation just    Stormed off. We felt like it left a bad taste in our mouth. Started off as corporate and booked extra days at our expense. As English and not used to the tipping system we did feel if we didn’t tip enough we didn’t get that customer service we like. It was like we offended them. $5 for bringing us a drink or cleaning our room each day or filling our mini bar. Perhaps we just don’t understand the way it is.

The room was clean and well taken care of during our stay.  The staff were nice and helpful when needed.

reviews.author: RanyDanny
reviews.title: Not what you fully expect
reviews.text:
With properties like this the expectations are high. There could be many pluses but one minus is enough to muddle the experience. 
I stayed three nights while attending a congress on premise. 
The hotel is not overly luxurious but you definitely feel you have stepped into something special. The common areas are open and spacious, with plenty of space to feel unique even on a busy event. 
The restaurants are awesome and you definitely need more than 3 nights to sample them all. One thing that annoys me is that as part of the regular buffet you don’t have access to any drinks, even in dispensers. You need to ask (and wait, sometimes longer than expected) for anything to drink, even water. 
It is also annoying that due to the layout of the hotel, you sometimes have to switch multiple times from closed walkways to open spaces. That doesn’t feel like much except when you are in the middle of a literal tropical storm and rains profusely for 4 straight days. 
The high note are the rooms. Spacious and full of details. 
However, the light system is extremely weird with multiple switches in strange spaces that turn on and off not the lights you would expect. 
The noise isolation is non-existent to the interior hallways. Any kind of noise gets into the room and amplifies. 
Finally, the service is not 5 stars, with some workers not looking happy or willing to serve. 
Overall a good stay but the cost/benefit relation can make me look elsewhere for another experience

reviews.author: Golf_Mom79
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, absolutely stunning resort. The open lobby area overlooks the main pool and you can see the ocean behind it. Very clean and spectacular from the entry. As we arrived in a very large group, the check in was easy and our bags would be brought to our room. Only problem at check in was that we didn't actually know how to get to our room, so a very kind gentleman, Robindson, helped us on our way. It's a very large resort, with the family area rooms on one side and the adults only area on the other. In the center are all the restaurants, the courtyard overlooking the pool (which is where the shows are at night).

The rooms in the adult side aren't huge but spacious enough that you can put away most of your clothes. The bathroom is large and enclosed with sheer curtains, with an open tub (it was lovely!), glass shower, and a separate area for the toilet. The room was clean and our cleaning lady was awesome. There is a mini fridge stocked with water, pop, and beer and snacks are replenished daily as well. We were in building 6 overlooking the back of the property (which actually looks over another resort). There was a roadway behind us that was constantly being used by resort trucks and the other resort but it wasn't too loud.

The adult pool is very large and quiet. It's located beside the spa (which is outdoors?) so it's pretty quiet music playing. The pool is deep-- I'm 5'8" and had to walk on my toes to be comfortable. Suggest bringing or buying a floatie to relax better (I sat on the stairs often). Not a ton of shade, but lots of chairs all with umbrellas surrounding the pool. The bar at the adult only pool wasn't great. It was often understaffed and most of the times they didn't know how to make simple drinks and there wasn't a great variety. Little to no poolside service. Drinks served in paper cups and paper straws, so bring a tumbler to put your drinks in (really helps as the pool is so deep). There are absolutely no activities at this pool, so if you like quiet and unbothered (other than the occasional spa worker) this is a great spot. I just wished the bartenders were a bit more energetic and knowledgeable.

The main pool is huge. Lots of umbrellas and tikis. There's an area for whole family and an area for just adults (again this part is really deep!!) Really appreciated all the spots to sit and talk with people in the pool--ie sunken loungers in the water and little sitting booths in the water. Higher energy and this where the aerobics and all the activities get done. I saw a really cool activity on paddle boards in the pool where they were dancing or doing a workout on the boards that I wish I had gotten there earlier for. The bar is well staffed and busy. The drinks were really good. When I asked for something and they didn't have the ingredients, Jonathan was quick to come up with something else for me. Lots of energy of the bartenders, lots of smiles.

Beach area had lots of Tikis and loungers. There is a separate area on the beach for the Adults Only as well as the reserve--these chairs have soft mattresses on the loungers so a bit more comfortable. The water was pretty wavy, lots of wind comes up in the afternoon, but the water was lovely. There's  a quick drop off at shoulder height but nothing too bad. The beach is nice sand, raked daily.

I did the Lunch Box for Buffet breakfast most days. Lots of selection. 3 omelette stations, lots of fruit, a self serve juice/mimosa station. Foods from different areas of the world. If it was made in front of you it was delicious. If you chose precooked pancakes, eggs, avocado toast, it didn't taste anything spectacular. It was ok, just not anything I'd grab the next day. This is also one of the only places open for lunch. Burgers, nachos, pizza, salad, pasta, fish, and world cuisine all available. One day we had lunch in Malva, the Adults only buffet. It was much smaller and very little options which was disappointing.

For dinner you will need to make a reservation, and they seemed to go quickly. I tried the Malcazone (Italien) twice and was underwhelmed with my meal both times. The spinach salad on the other hand was delicious (and my boyfriend loved the caprese salad and the pizza).

The Mexican restaurant (name is excaping me) was ok. I"m having trouble remembering what I had to eat but I remember it being not bad, just not great. Atmosphere was nice though.

Flora, the Dominican restaurant, was my favourite. Lots of interesting appetizers that were quite tasty. I had the gnocchi for dinner and was less impressed. But the atmosphere was great and the service was great.

We didn't eat at the steakhouse or the Tepanaki restaurants. We heard good things about the menu at the Sports Bar and tried to go there for lunch but they don't serve food until 3 or 3:30 pm.

Took me 2 days to find it, but the GinGer lounge is a terrific spot in the lobby upstairs for coffees in the morning or smoothies. Also for a night cap at the end of the day. They had great bartenders and great selection of booze. At night there was often live music which was wonderful. Lots of cozy little spots to sit at. Which I had found it earlier on in the trip.

Gym was nice, but busy. Lots of treadmills, bikes, machines in the middle. Not a ton of room for free weights or laying down to do abs but able to make do. Water, fruits, towels all supplied in the gym. Friendly gentleman (I wish I knew his name) that oversees the gym and helps you out as needed.

Overall, I had a great trip with the company I was with. For the most part I had an amazing time. I've been to several resorts in Dominican, Cuba, and Mexico, and seemed underwhelmed by the service and the food for the most part at this resort. It was clean, but dated and needed some work: there were many missing tiles in the main pool; the server's station outside for the servers in the buffet looked like it was being held together with zip ties. Many people we were with had a good time, but the common complaint was the service and lack of knowledge of the adult pool bar staff and that the food wasn't as good as they were hoping. We also had a good number of people in our group who had stomach issues for a day or two.

reviews.title: Great Stay, But the Food Was a Disappointment
reviews.text:
I had an overall pleasant stay at. The rooms were comfortable though noisy/bright, the staff was mostly friendly, and the amenities were well-maintained. However, the food experience left much to be desired.

Unfortunately, the food was consistently served cold or, at best, lukewarm. Whether it was breakfast, room service, or dinner at the restaurant, I found myself wishing for a hot meal but was repeatedly disappointed. This was particularly frustrating given the otherwise high standards of the hotel.

If the kitchen could improve on this, it would make a huge difference. Until then, I’d recommend the hotel for its accommodations but suggest looking elsewhere for meals.

reviews.author: Francklyn V
reviews.title: Superaron mi expectiva
reviews.text:
personal del hotel mostró una disposición impecable. Los salones estaban en óptimas condiciones, el equipo audiovisual ofreció un servicio sobresaliente (gracias especiales a Yohan Tremols), y la coordinación liderada por Germania Esther Castro y Yakelin Reyes, directora de Grupos y Eventos, fue impecable. El equipo de recepción, los maleteros y el personal de transporte, en especial Leninson, también se destacaron por su eficiencia y amabilidad. En cuanto al equipo del bar Ginyer: Anthony, Luis, Ismael y Lucía, estuvieron siempre atentos a nuestras necesidades, ofreciendo un servicio excepcional.

Quiero resaltar la transformación en la gastronomía del hotel, liderada por el Sr. Miguel Astudillo, quien ha logrado una mejora notable. La calidad, el sabor, la preparación y la variedad de los alimentos han alcanzado un nivel que merece un 8/10, estando muy cerca de la perfección. Además, el equipo del buffet ofreció una atención destacada que dejó a todos los clientes satisfechos. Finalmente, agradezco al equipo del Hotel Zel Punta Cana por su apoyo con parte de nuestros clientes, mostrando instalaciones y servicios de excelente calidad. En conclusión, Paradisus Palma Real no solo cumplió, sino que superó todas las expectativas, convirtiéndose en un referente para futuros eventos.

reviews.author: ub b
reviews.title: Stay Away - Absolute Nightmare of a "Resort"
reviews.text:
If you value your money, time, and sanity, STAY AWAY from Paradisus Palma Real Resort. This is not a hotel; it's a backstreet circus run by prison guards. From the moment you check in, you are treated like you owe them something. The staff, especially at check-in, act like they're doing you a favor just by acknowledging your existence. Smiles? Nonexistent. Courtesy? Forget about it. Every employee wears an angry scowl as if they're ready to punch you for daring to approach them.

The rooms are tiny and depressing, with barely any amenities. Don't expect a luxurious escape here—this feels more like a poorly maintained back street student hostel. The beach chairs? Covered in towels at all times, but nobody is ever around to claim them, meaning you can't use them. It's an absolute joke.

The food? Utterly disgusting. Always cold, clearly reused leftovers from previous meals. You won't find a single fresh bite of food during your stay. It's appalling and downright unsanitary.

And if you're unlucky enough to stay in their so-called Reserve section, prepare for the absolute worst. The "concierge" (mine was Gustavo) is beyond horrible—rude, nasty, and completely clueless. They openly expect "tips," so you're essentially paying them to mistreat and torture you. I asked Gustavo to book the sauna for me, and he said, "Okay, okay, I booked the sauna." Next thing I know, I’m at the steam room, where the sauna doesn’t even exist. It’s as if no one at this hotel has any ''human'' in them. To make matters worse, no one speaks English. If you don’t speak Spanish, good luck trying to communicate with anyone. It’s a complete disaster from start to finish.

Need to speak to a manager? Good luck. They're invisible, and no one will bother returning your calls. You can spend all day trying to reach someone from your in-room phone, only to be met with silence.

A back street abortion place would provide you with much better service than this place from hell, Save yourself the pain and frustration. Avoid this disaster of a resort at all costs.

reviews.author: MARTHA IRENE E
reviews.title: Cuidado con la camarista Melani del Bloque 6, piso 3 Hab 15
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia inicio muy bien me recibió un ángel de nombre ADrian de pueblo lindo , hizo lo imposible por colocarme junto a las amigas con las que andaba.

Dificultad para reservar restaurantes y la chica de reservas no muy sociable específicamente la joven que me asistió en el turno de la mañana del sábado 31 sept , parecía que pedía un favor y al final me negó la reserva.

Señore pagando mi hospedaje para disfrutar y descansar. 

El señor que ,domingo 1sept ,en buffer hace parrillada , molesto y agotado se quejaba de preparar las carnes y no quería hacerla hasta que lo preparo obligado por su supervisor que vio la fila de personas demandando el servicio. 

Un supervisor peleaba feo con los camareros encima de todos y el camarero avergonzado bajaba la mirada , me quito las ganas de comer ver el pobre hombre siendo regañado  feo públicamente.
y para poner la cereza al pastel en bloque 6 Hab 6315 encuentro la hab bloqueada a las 12 en punto como es la regla y por mis culpa , pudo de manera amable a dos empleadas que estaban haciendo supervisión de las camaristas y sin siquiera detenerse ni explicar u orientar , remitió al lobby.
Desesperada con altas temperatura y en un tercer piso sin ascensor buscó asistencia en otra joven que limpiaba piso tres hab 6310 y cuando se disponía ayudar para abrir han y poder sacar las maletas , la señora se percata y evita sea asistida .

Fue muy feo momento en medio del calor y si era una regla no era la forma , quedé muy indignada del trato indiferente , frío y mal intencionado de la señora de nombre Melani y su compañera supervisora q le acompañaba.

Muy linda instalaciones y muy atentas las camareras todas del buffet 
El maletero fue la atención hecha persona y ni se diga del señor del parqueo que nos recibió.

Creo que debe orientar al personal y educar sobre atención al usuario aunque seamos Doninicano.

reviews.author: ondina
reviews.title: Mi experiencia 😵‍💫
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el Congreso de Cardio Metabólica de la Sociedad de Medicina Interna de la República Dominicana , la llegada una experiencia agradable , muchísimas gracias Adrián ( un chico amable y preocupado por complacer el cliente en la recepción con el verdadero sentido de atención al cliente  👏👏)  por ser la primera impresión del hotel🙌🙌
La comida normal pero de manera general buena , la locación es muy bonita , el hotel no tiene ascensor y es un poco lejos el área de los restaurantes y el centro de actividad del bloque que ocupamos #6  , imagínate subir 3 planta escalón por escalón con la maleta en mano 😵‍💫😵‍💫.
 Algo que nos llamó la atención la discusión de los empleados y el jefe o supervisor  en el área del bufet general (sábado en la tarde )  , de repente estaban con una ocupación mayor de lo usual tomando tiempo extra de trabajo pero eso no implica que como usuarios oigamos el disgusto de los empleados,  seamos mal tratados como huésped  y las reclamaciones del supervisor😵‍💫. 
Las amenidades buenas  : los chicos que tocan saxo geniales , el grupo que toca muy bueno , los tragos buenos, los chicos de los bares y camareros buenos  ; pero ojalá no te toque quedarte en el bloque 6 y que te atienda una camarista en el arreglo de tu habitación de nombre madeline , pienso que probablemente extranjera , porque creo hablaba creole con una compañera , que poco tacto que maltrato a los huéspedes del hotel que poca atención al cliente , la gotita que rebosa la copa, su actitud en la tarde de hoy  y como una persona puede contribuir más de manera negativa con tu experiencia en el hotel . 
Creo que deben de dar un mejor entrenamiento de cómo tratar los clientes y entender que por nosotros su hotel funciona y  vive …… y como nosotros los usuarios somos su mejor promoción. 
 Si me preguntaras si vuelvo ?? …. te diría que no , y si tienes la opción de algo más por el mismo precio tal vez te convenga experimentar otro lugar ….. es una pena que una locación tan bella le falte atención al cliente , calidez, humanismo, cortesía y amabilidad . 
Recordar que hay muchos hoteles que ofrecen lo mismo por el mismo precio con locaciones bellísimas también , pero es el trato al huésped lo que hace la diferencia 🙏🙏

reviews.author: x0x0
reviews.title: Rough Start but Decent Stay
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, great size. Walkable but not small.
We were there for a conference in March 2024. 
Food was good and rooms were very clean and new. We were in the Reserve section and loved Santé, as well as enjoyed the beds around the pool and on the beach. Beach was sometimes wavy and had some seaweed, but it is swimmable. 

Couple of notes: 
- Checkin was a disaster. We were not told we have a special section and thus waited in the regular lobby for 40 mins, only to be told to go wait on the other side. Then, we were told they need to see the credit card we booked with, which we did not have, since we were not advised we need it. Apparently, when booking on the Melia website, you get that notification. We booked through the conference and did not know this, which created a huge issue. 
- We were not advised we have a concierge until 48 hours after arrival. We were on business and only had a certain amount of free time -- this meant we did not get to experience the included half-day trip nor some of the perks from the beginning. We were only there for 4 days, so that really sucked, given how expensive the hotel is. However, once assigned, our concierge was great. 
- Didn't see any sort of entertainment during the day. At night, we only saw live bands. While they were actually very good, a variety/change would be great. 

Would most likely return. Not for a week, since I think we'd be bored, very fast, given the lack of activities. However, it was one of the smaller, cleaner, and nicer resorts I've been to in Punta Cana. If I had to go back to Punta Cana, I would consider Melia for a short stay.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Not good - awful food
reviews.text:
You don’t have to worry about vacation weight. The food was absolutely awful. I don’t think I can ever eat at a Buffet ever again.  I took one bite into a taco and there was something in it that should have been. I immediately had to spit it out and run to the toilet. I have a celiac kid and they said they could accommodate. But they could not. The first day we were there I asked about gluten free and they showed me the vegetarian stuff. I knew we were in trouble then.  We had an even by the pool and there was food that was sitting in the sun for hours, including seafood. This food was served at the buffet the next day. 
The hotel is nice and the pool is great.

reviews.author: D J
reviews.title: Not a Five Star Resort - Overpriced - avoid
reviews.text: 1. Refund policy was used as a shield to charge us an extra night for 2 rooms booked. We attempted to change the room booking almost 2 months in advance and was unsuccessful in having the charge reversed. Still working to have this situation rectified. 2. Upon check-in we were given a smaller room (with 2 twin beds) than the one we booked that was supposed to have a king bed. This also happened to the other suite we booked for another conference delegate. The front desk was not very helpful in addressing the issue until some extra money was paid under the table. 3. While beautiful, the hotel room had the A/C break. This happened on three separate occasions and always in the evening. Subsequently, we had to sleep 3 out of 7 nights uncomfortably without A/C. Furthermore, it required us to call the front desk at least 3-4 times every time it broke as we were repeatedly told it would be fixed "right away". It usually took over 12-14 hours to have the issue addressed and only after multiple requests to do so. 4. We were extremely disappointed to see that the only option for breakfast and lunch was the Lunch Box. As a supposed five star resort, having options for a la carte dining is expected - at the very least, we expected to have more than one choice of restaurant. 5. The A/C in the Lunch Box was not consistent nor were the cooling trays holding perishable food, leading us to believe that food safety was not a priority. This was further evidenced by the fact that over 12 people attending the sponsored pool party became ill with a couple ending up in the hospital. 6. No waiter based food or drink service was available at any of the lounge chairs in the pool areas. Again, this is an expectation from a five star resort. 7. Dinner reservations - on our first night, we attempted to book a reservation for dinner at 4PM due to our arrival time and was told that the reservation system closes at 4 and our only option was to eat at the buffet. 4PM? I find it hard to believe that you can't make a dinner reservation at this time of day, secondly, we went to the reservation table the next day and a sign was posted clearly showing the hours of closing of 5PM. We were also told that we could only book reservations for the evening, not for subsequent days however, the reservation desk moved to the conference area and delegates were being told they could then book multiple days in advance. It seems like the rules change all the time without any notice.  Consequently, we were only able to secure reservations past 9PM and for the restaurant we had already been to. During our whole trip, we only visited 3 different restaurants. 8. While we did experience some good service from a few people, in general, we felt like there were plenty of staff, none of whom were interested in serving anyone. We had to constantly get up to request things like more water or other beverages and when we did so, the impression that we got was that we were an inconvenience for the workers who are supposed to be there for the guests. Ultimately, we will never return to any hotel owned by Melia nor would I ever recommend anyone to go there.  I've stayed at other resorts both in the Dominican Republic and in the Caribbean and I can say that this was by far the worst experience I've had in over 20 years.

reviews.author: Journey24060828812

reviews.title: 90 degrees is the place to be
reviews.text: Visit the pool bar 90 degrees. Fantastic services. Rosanna is the best bartender. Friendly, attentive and I watched her easily remember people's drinks. Drinks were delicious and we wanted to go every day. Stop in to say hi to Rosanna and you'll feel the same positive energy and receive the same great service.

reviews.author: Saunders2024
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation
reviews.text: A great place to stay.  Staff great, facilities excellent. The bell hops were excellent (helpful and informative) and the Spa was amazing..  Lots of dining choices and good food. Location was ideal, and the weather was always amazing, although quite humid. We will definitely recommend this resort to all our friends. We felt very safe here. We were well looked after, and all our needs were met.

reviews.author: ilineelectricltd18
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Many areas to improve, very poor I would rate at a 3 star at best, I am an experienced traveler and this location is on the bottom of my list . Cockroaches in room, multiple insect bites on my body, extra charges on all inclusive and they kept saying all not included. Playing with included and inclusive

reviews.author: Tony D
reviews.title: Go big or lower your expectations.
reviews.text: The can't resort.    To begin, the staff worked hard.  However, if you don't do the reserve...your enjoyment is limited.  Can't eat everywhere, only  a breakfast buffet, can't get drink everywhere, unless privileged, can't, can't access restaurant close to your room, canr get iron.  The most upsetting can't was getting change at front desk...the staff deserving of tip after 3rd day here...can't get tips because the did not gave change at front desk....go ask the bell men...was their solution...  staff works hard, managers need to work harder to help staff.  Food overall where we could eat was good.

reviews.author: holaco11
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: It all started at check in when I booked a King bed and when I got to my room it was two double beds. When I went to the front desk to try and rectify it I was basically told too bad thats all we have. When I explained that I had booked a king bed the guy waked away from me. It all went downhill from there.

reviews.author: billblack2024
reviews.title: Great location and wonderful resort - food not great
reviews.text:
The buffet food was poor - restaurants were generally better but had to book and plan ahead - room service food was best

Pools are great - adult area is very nice with fun atmosphere

Staff are very attentive and friendly

A relaxed pace helps you wind down and the evenings are really nice with plenty of options

reviews.author: jeffshantz
reviews.title: Confernece at Hotel
reviews.text:
Overall the resort is very nice, well maintained , clean and the pools are fantastic.
The food is okay for the most part and staff is very friendly.   Do your homework on the available restaurants and off site restaurants and you will ensure your experience is great.

reviews.author: Adrine A
reviews.title: terrible check im experinece
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, clean ..there on a conference  which was well organized . 
Checkin was a nightmare as we first were directed to the main lobby for which we waited 35 minutes for our turn only to be told our reservation  could not be found and were told to go to the adult s only checkin . Once there, waited 10 minutes to be served. Once paperwork was under way they asked to see the credit card for which it was reserved with and we did not have with us . They asked for us to pay the entire reservation to be able to have our room. Apparently on the confirmation  there is a clause that says we must physically bring credit card . We showed the confirmation which does not have that. Employee called manager who continued to insist we pay another $4500 and they will refund later .very very insisting for more money!  We even showed the charge on our credit card statement. Long story short and 2;15 hours later and us suggesting Apple Pay ( for which they still argued because when you  use that the confirmation comes with an Apple Pay id number and not the credit card number 🙄. ) 
Found out next day we have a butler to answer all our questions but  we were never told. I travel often and  the worse checkin experience ! 
Food is  good, haven’t seen entertainers yet but last night’s band was great . Would I return ? Only if I do not have to go through that check in process  again!  

The hotel should stop asking people to review on the spot and ask for guests to review when they are finished their stay!

reviews.author: DayTrip787618
reviews.title: Think twice before going...
reviews.text:
I rarely submit reviews unless I've had an amazing or an abysmal experience. In this case...it's sadly the latter. A business award trip brought us to Paradisus along with 300+ colleagues. To start, the check in was excruciatingly inefficient. We ended up waiting well over 3 hours to get to our room. We were later told by a colleague that we should have utilized the hospitality suite where we could have changed into more comfortable clothing. Wish we had known but we were never told about that. There was nobody in manaagement capacity to talk to trouble shoot the dismal check in experience...red flag! Upon finally arriving in our room, we were given twin beds room instead of a king room. Then we checked out the bathroom which has absolutely no privacy as it is separated by gauzy see through curtains, and we were  greeted by a disgustingly rusted out garbage can (please see posted picture). The simple fact that this "supposedly" 5 star resort thinks it's perfectly ok to display such a trash can left us speechless! 

The food at this resort was sub par. Like others have said, the buffet selection never changed and the food tasted like glorified cafeteria food. I tried a waffle at breakfast and I, literally, could not cut through it as it had been sitting out for so long. The restaurant reservation system is archaic and a total joke. Meat was consistently over cooked, including our formal sit down company dinner where our surf n turf lobster tail was so tough, it was hard to chew. I'm feeling lucky that we didn't suffer food poisoning like another reviewer did.

Next up...pool area ran out of towels several times during our stay and were not replenished in a timely manner. Not a good sign. Empty plates and drinks were not cleared away for hours which meant we had to clean up if we wanted to sit down by the pool. The adults only areas were not monitored so we ended up having noisy kids in those areas. Why bother if it's not going to be enforced.

i think the locals are inherently nice people  but lack the proper management training.   Management has to step up their game if this is going to be worthy of a 5 star rating. One employee couldn't even tell us where one of the restaurants was located since "he just started working there last week" (as he said in his own words)
And NO, I can't blame it on language barrier as I've stayed in plenty of 5 star resorts in Asia and other international places with consistently good and gracious service.  It's absolutely on managment to do better! Simply put...the rusty trashcan says it ALL!

reviews.author: Elly
reviews.title: Relaxing Paradise!
reviews.text:
We had a great time! Loved our room and view. The pools were great and the beach was very nice. Lots of spaces to sit and relax. 

Eriol was incredible!! He was very helpful and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was enjoyable. 

Entertainment was good too on the plaza at night. This is a large resort and was able to walk around a lot. Plenty of bars around to get drinks thru day.

reviews.author: O6258JJangeloc
reviews.title: The Winery lo mejor
reviews.text:
Muy buen hotel

Lo mejor la atención y experiencia en el Winery  

Buenos vinos te dan la comida de todos los restaurantes, lo que pidas y se disfruta con un buen maridaje

El servicio de Jonatan Samaniego 👏👏👏🍷 muy buenas recomendaciones para el maridaje

reviews.author: Marlene F
reviews.title: Excelente Estadía!
reviews.text: Me encantó mucho el servicio del hotel y de el staff, completamente agradecida con todo, muchas gracias al equipo de relaciones públicas por darme asistencia cuando se necesitaba y a todo el equipo de room service, muchas gracias, pronto estaremos por aquí, Jendry no le bajes sigue así. BUEN SERVICIO

reviews.author: Freedom33588441487
reviews.title: Excellent Concierge Service from Wolfan
reviews.text: The resort was clean and well-maintained, but the best part of our stay was Wolfan, our concierge. He made a point to text daily info each morning and physically came to find us and make sure we had everything we needed. He was knowledgeable and quick to respond to any questions or needs.

reviews.author: A B
reviews.title: 1 star is being generous.
reviews.text: This property is not 5 star and is not all inclusive of anything. Not inclusive of good food, good service, good amenities, nada. There are a few redeeming employees who went above and beyond for us - Luis, Carolin, Wanda. There isn’t enough room on this review page for me to outline the failing of Paradisus Palma Real.  As a group of approx 100 ppl on our group - we couldn’t get reservations to the restaurants, we couldn’t get washcloths, rooms were hot, food mediocre at best, no beach towels two days in a row (sat & sun!).  Steer clear, folks.

reviews.author: Alian
reviews.title: Business trip with the wife
reviews.text: The breakfast staff was very kind at the buffet. Rosanna, Yorgeis and Fanny were very generous and friendly. The resort is very high-end and very peaceful. The adults-only section was very laid back. The beds were comfortable and the beach is beautiful

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.title: Vacation!
reviews.text:
Rosanna edito Yorgelys Georgi Felix 
Was a wonderful and pleasant with their services and a delightful place to visit! 
Glad we stopped in for a few days and enjoyed the weather and company. Should stop by and enjoy yourselves and relax by the beach and pools!

reviews.author: Tiffany D
reviews.title: Lunch Box Review
reviews.text: Rosanna , Yorgelys, and Felix were amazing to have around every morning!! They were so helpful and kind. We loved seeing them each day! They were very attentive to our needs and brought us any request that we had each day. They help make our stay so enjoyable!! If you come you should definitely come see them at the lunch box!!!

reviews.author: KNic
reviews.title: Beautiful resort. Request Ariel for concierge and look for Raphael on the beach!!!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time. Raphael by the beach cabanas was truly unbelievable. It may have actually been the best service I’ve ever had on a trip in my life. He literally read our minds and helped bring food and snacks to our 2 year old as well as champagne, cold beer, water and ice for the adults. We went on a small work trip with about 16 adults plus our baby and everyone agreed that Raphael was the highlight of the trip. We were treated like royalty. 

We upgraded to Nikte concierge service and had Ariel for all of our guests. He was AMAZING. He took care of us as personal friends. Was caring and compassionate. Took care of reservations and activities for all. We just can’t speak highly enough of Ariel.

reviews.author: Tina K
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Rosanna, Felix and Gorgio made my first morning special. I had no idea where anything was but they made me feel welcome and showed me around. The breakfast was delicious and the bloody Mary’s were fantastic! The restaurant was clean and the service was top notch.

reviews.author: Christopher P
reviews.title: Come to Las Palmas in Lunch Box
reviews.text:
Maria Mercede, Yafreisy and Yanira were fantastic! They did a great job taking care of us. Get yourself a margarita on Dia de las Margaritas. Now I’m just typing to hit 200 characters. 

I need to add more here. They are great. You should just come here and enjoy it.

reviews.author: kimtom103
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Ricki and frank were wonderful!!  Very helpful! Always available for anything we need. We looked for them at the buffet every day. Everyone else was also helpful. If you need anything just ask. We ate all day long!  Would definitely go back.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Beth C
reviews.title: Great bartenders, beautiful resort and friendly staff
reviews.text: Rosanna, Carolin and Eddie are wonderful bartenders ~ highly recommend going to the poolside bar and getting to know them. They’ll take great care of you! Restaurants are great, and definitely better food than the buffet, although the buffet food is similar to cruise buffets.

reviews.author: Joel JZ
reviews.title: Lovely place ok food
reviews.text:
As an avid traveler and lives to go to all-inclusives in Mexico, Dominica Republic, and throughout the Caribbean. this place had the view, the nice rooms swim up pools bars etc. but what it was lacking was fun activities, heated pools, and better quality food. The food was edible but lacked the quality you would expect in such a nice place like a Miele property. The best thing was the fresh made breakfast omelets, the Asian and the Italian was just ok and the best meal was the items we recommended the chef to make for us at the Mexican restaurant. One of the other items was the number of people trying to sell us add ons or excursions at the pool and beach or food upgrades in the restaurants. my favorite person was this big, tall man with a chef's hat. He was so nice and was able to get us ice cream when the ice cream section was closed. 
Also, the chef at the Mexican restaurant is working, making the tacos. he was terrific! Sunrise views were amazing.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: A Perfect Vacation
reviews.text: We came for a conference and my birthday and found a perfect vacation getaway. Paradisus is gorgeous down to every detail. The atmosphere is friendly because of the spectacular staff who take care of everything with a smile. More than once I heard “anything is possible here.” So true! Staff member, Brendol, with activities was not only personable, he made daily activities fun. I highly recommend this beautiful location and resort. Thank you

reviews.author: Marla M
reviews.title: Work Trip Turned Family Vacay
reviews.text: Amenities are amazing and the resort is breathtaking. Staff are phenomenal & very helpful. Favorite spots are the spa and The Winery/El Catador, Jendry and Jordania, Juan and Carlo were super cool! My kids loved the Kidsdom and we were even able to have a nanny. Would love to come back on a non-work trip to really relax.

reviews.author: Graham J
reviews.title: Beautiful tropical getaway
reviews.text: Excellent friendly staff, great food selection. Great facilities! Jordania and Jendry stood out in particular, making sure I had everything I need and that i was happy with my stay. I would highly recommend paradisius to anyone who was considering it!

reviews.author: Michelle A
reviews.title: A must try!
reviews.text: We had the best time! The staff is so friendly and attentive.  Milton at Lunchbox is amazing. He ensure your visit is 100% from start to finish. 5 stars! Definitely would recommend for all. The hotel is family friendly, but has adult only areas as well. It has child care if needed. So much to do and see!

reviews.author: Gonzalo M
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: I was in the Blue Agave. Sandra was and amazing host. I liked the service a lot, she was smiling all the time, food was excelent.Tequila was offered which I enjoyed,I am coming back tomorrrow. if you have watched the white lotus this is the place

reviews.author: Marcela T
reviews.title: Increíble estancia
reviews.text: Increíble atención del personal, todos fueron muy amables. Las instalaciones muy limpias y muy lindas. La comida muy rica. El personal del hotel siempre tiene excelente disposición para apoyarte en tus solicitudes. La vista desde mi habitación es espectacular

reviews.author: Denis Ramiro P
reviews.title: Recuperando fuerzas en Malva
reviews.text: Expectacular sabor, y la atencion de Ebony Yedy  sin comparacion, amena, recomendo cada platillo, cada bebida, eso sumado al ambiente tropical es una experiencia para no olvidar y que se debe repetir, hasta ahorita Malva del hotel es lo mejor

reviews.author: Rudy L
reviews.title: Malvas at peridus
reviews.text: This is a great service i enjoy it,  thanks great food, great service of Ebony Yedy. The wine the food, the drinks its all about Republica Dominicana Pridus Palma Real resort encantado de volver a este mágico lugar en el Caribe 100% recomendado

reviews.author: Marty G
reviews.title: Try a different hotel, maybe a different island.
reviews.text: Hotel facilities are decent, nothing wrong there and the place is clean.   The employees are not very friendly, nor accommodating.  They ‘lost’ my suitcase I gave them waiting on my room…..after 4 calls, I finally went down and got the bag myself.  After dinner one night, I came back to salamanders or lizards in my room and called to ask for help removing them.  Called 2 more times, no one ever came so I did what I could and slept that night wondering where they were running.  The food was horrible, and I mean horrible.  The only thing eatable were some of the rolls and a couple of the deserts, the rest was terrible, mind bogglingly bad.  They couldn’t even make a good omelet or pancakes!   The employees walk right by you, never say hello, and many of them stand around on their phones.  I will never go back there and not a big fan of the D.R., I think there are better places to go where you can be around friendly employees who are glad you are there spending money.  One bright spot was the transportation service that hauled me in and back to PUJ, Amstar was their name and they were excellent.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: It’s been great!
reviews.text: Food is okay. Everything else has been wonderful—service, pool, beach, room. The room is beautiful and has constant room service re-supplying the mini bar. The beach and pool are beautiful. There is a more relaxed pool and a party one. The Italian restaurant is the best.

reviews.author: MS26733
reviews.title: Food is horrific
reviews.text: The hotel itself is nice - rooms are nice and the beach is nice, but the food is horrendous. I am truly shocked at how bad it was. Service is good and overall if you don't care at all about food quality, then I guess staying here is ok.

reviews.author: marciejmuen
reviews.title: Would Return / Room for Improvement / Staff Incredible
reviews.text:
Eriol was our favorite. He is our concierge and made all our dining reservation daily. He also set up our Bali bed, made sure we were ok each day and was extremely intuitive to our needs. 

We enjoyed the property overall. The food was hit and miss. We enjoyed blue agave the best. We asked to sit at the bar and eat one night and they accommodated. We did tip her a few dollars. Melvin served us at the bar as a server and he was awesome bringing us all the chips! Our food was piping hot here. 

You don’t need to tip a lot but please tip everyone. They work their butts off. They are lovely. Ask them about their families. Enjoy the convo. 

We had Rafael on the beach for Bali bed. When one guest threw a fit about us being on “her” bed he graciously asked us to move and we did while she was ridiculous entitled. It was only one move over but we made it even tho we were settled for two hours. 

He was so grateful and kind! He worked so hard all day adding towels for people and making sure we had our favorite beverages. He went to the wine shop for a specific champagne and made sure we had the latest lobsters. It was our favorite meal. 

I had two services at the spa. One with Dorka and one with Fior. Both were insane. Loooooved my hibiscus scrub and wrap. Like the best service ever. Dorka was so good I fell asleep. Fior was so sweet and helped me with my Spanish. You CAN add a tip to your bill. 20% is the standard. Francis at the front desk was awesome. 

Sante our food was cold and steakhouse our steak was way overdone. We couldn’t finish either meal. Room service took about an hour but was ok. Buffet lunch was so nice and good. 

The beach, the people, the entertainment, our work private function all rocked. We loved meeting the vendors both on the beach and around the property. 

I was disappointed they allowed another group to overtake the entire sports bar both nights of the playoffs. We thought it was incredibly short sighted of the resort to allow this considering there were so many other people who want to use what is INCLUDED. We had to watch those games in our room which was lame. So I think do better next year. 

We would definitely come back. Thank you to everyone who made our stay amazing. 

PS. Bring TIP MONEY!

reviews.author: Wendell H
reviews.title: The staff at Paradisus are top notch
reviews.text: The staff was wonderful at the resort.Ricki and frank at the buffet were fantastic, never missing a moment to help us or take care of group. The rooms were always clean and the fridge restocked early everyday. The beaches and pools were beautiful. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Amanda B
reviews.title: Fun in paradise
reviews.text: Amazing and very beautiful facility. Maria Ortiz is wonderful with children and greeting guests . Yafreizey was very attentive. Thank you so much for a great experience. They both have wonderful customer service hearts.

reviews.author: Sherpa21248275589
reviews.title: Great property not run right.
reviews.text: The property is absolutely beautiful. The waitstaff is mostly rude. The food is not good. The restaurants are always full and you can’t get a reservation. You can only eat the nasty buffet. They keep the ac units from being adjusted. The room thermostat must stay at 74. You have to beg the staff to lower the temperature and they lie about it.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Good views, good food, good times.
reviews.text: Such a beautiful place with great food, great views, and an unbelievably soft white sand beach.  Staff is all happy to help, very friendly, and attentive.  We had dinner at mazcalzone and it was all delicious.   Great calzones, fluffy yummy bread to start with, perfect pasta.  The Panna cotta was excellent.

reviews.author: Antonio R
reviews.title: 100% satisfaction
reviews.text:
Beautiful place Malva restaurant was so delightful and have at lot of variery very clean and seem the staff have a blast while working
DARLING you rock keep it up the great and excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Tiana P
reviews.title: Malva
reviews.text: Yensen at malva was wonderful and the food was delicious! The restaurant was very clean and the service was great. It also is by the beach and pill with a great view. We will definitely be back here again on our trip

reviews.author: Kandy C
reviews.title: Una semana para repetir
reviews.text: Una semana llena de emociones y experiencias: culinarias, gastronómicas, sensaciones más allá de lo esperado , pero la gente, que decir de la gente. Nuestro conserje Dalmis, el mejor de los mejores, un servicio profesional y dedicado, al tanto de cada detalle. Gracias, gracias a todos por una semana inolvidable. No podemos dejar de mencionar a Rafael y Pedro en la playa, espectaculares los jugos de Chinola, vieron, me acordé, Hostel el señor de la parrilla del bufet, Milton que se aparece en cualquier restaurante con una sonrisa grande. Pero el abrazo más lindo para Alejandro, el chef pastelero, sin él, la experiencia no hubiese sido completa, gracias por compartir con nosotros parte de su historia, su cultura, por permitirnos conocer su país del que quedamos encantados. Dominicana nos enamoro con su encanto y Paradisus Palma Real hizo nuestros sueños realidad. Un lugar maravilloso donde su arquitecto sensorial (no me acuerdo del nombre) logra que te sientas en armonía con sus paisajes, la naturaleza y el entorno.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Es necesario supervisar a todo el personal desde la alta gerencia hasta el maletero.
reviews.text:
Es desagradable que el personal sin excepción sea grosera y no tenga vocación para el servicio y ni si quiera intente aparentar tenerlo, en su gran mayoría hacen caras, contestan de mala manera, o te ignoran. Se necesita supervisión física y constante en todo el hotel, utilicen el recurso del clientes fantasmas local y extranjero así se darán cuenta como sus colaboradores tratan a los clientes o huéspedes sobre todo si el huésped es local.

Fue totalmente una experiencia desagradable, otra cuestión son los recursos disponibles se supone que si el hotel está abierto para 400 personas debe estar capacitado al menos para 410 personas los recursos siempre son insuficientes, deben darle las herramientas necesarias al empleado para que desempeñe su función de la mejor manera, nunca hay carritos nunca hay góndolas, nunca hay nada cuando lo necesitas.

reviews.author: jpeurrung
reviews.title: Worst All Inclusive I have ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
This place is an absolute dump. You will get harrased at the pool or beach from the drug dealers, excursion people, or the people trying to sell you other items. The food is terrible, the air in the bedrooms do not work very good. Do not even get me started on the attitude of the staff here. 

do yourself a favor and go someone else.

reviews.author: Julio C J
reviews.title: Gracias Delvin y Engel por el excelente trato.
reviews.text: Un servicio excelente por todo el personal del hotel. Muy buena comida y un trato muy amable de las personas que nos atendieron en el restaurante Mexicano. Gracias a Delvin and Engel. Mi deseo es de regresar pronto.

reviews.author: Misael D
reviews.title: Mejor experiencia en República Dominicana.
reviews.text:
Una de las mejores experiencias que he tenido en muchos años.  Paradisus Palma Real nos brindó atenciones que realmente excedieron expectativas. 

En especial quiero reconocer a Delvin y Engel en el restaurante Mexicano, ambos son unas súper estrellas.  De verdad que no quisiera irme de este paraíso. 

Gracias por todas las atenciones.  Definitivamente recomiendo el hotel.

reviews.author: Albert pichardo
reviews.title: The Best Great Experience
reviews.text: Waoooo tremenda experiencia en este hotel y sobre todo les recomiendo el restaurant Blue Agave, un Excellente trato y un servicio muy profesional. A la Excelencia 🙌💪. Gracias a Delvin por ser tan profesional y El chef Ángel por la excelente atención y calidad de la comida. 101% recomendado

reviews.author: daniela lizbeth r
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel!!!!
reviews.text:
Hotel lindisimo! Varias opciones de restaurantes y bares, hotel a orilla de playa, servicio inigualable. 100% recomendable. 
Cuenta con área de solo adultos y atributo the reserve (exclusividad) donde hay servicio de mayordomo. Te atienden excelentemente, un agradecimiento especial a Edgar quien fue siempre atento.

reviews.author: Almudena C
reviews.title: Una magnífica atención en un gran hotel
reviews.text: Una gran experiencia, todo en la habitación perfecto, al igual que las piscinas, la playa ...Y ello gracias en gran parte a Héctor, el concierge, que me ayudó en cualquier cosa que pudiera necesitar, reservando en restaurantes, ocupándose del check-in, localizando taxis...en todo. Gracias!

reviews.author: Sorivel lassis
reviews.title: Super
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y buena comida buena servicio a la habitación con buena y atención 
Nos atendió Frankiln bautista en el italiano muy servicial y atento y siempre todo el equipo con una sonrisa y en todo momento atentos a nuestro mesa

reviews.author: Vileysi E
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente sus instalaciones y el servicio es de muy buena calidad. Las atenciones de nuestro concierge Héctor Rodriguez fue fenomenal, atento a que cada detalle para que nuestra estancia sea la mejor.

reviews.author: Mauricio Lopez ...
reviews.title: Excelencia y calidez
reviews.text: Quiero halar de Sante , restaurant de Palma Real Reserve , excente , lo mejor del complejo y todo, por fuera de la comida lo logran su increíble personal . Su capitan: Milton,  conduce su barco estupendamente para que sus marineros , Esteban, Franklin, Sunirda, Luz, Nojandro, Frankeli,  hagan de tu viaje por los sabores una experiencia única. Mi reconocimiento y felicitación a ellos que hacen que Palma Real Reserve sea el mejor lugar del mundo para estar ! Gracias infinitas de un amigo de Buenos Aires, porque para mi ustedes son mís amigos 💕.  Gracias por tanto

reviews.author: Monica Rosario
reviews.title: Bien, pero puede mejorar!
reviews.text: La habitación y el área es un 10 . Pero la calidad de la comida ha disminuido sustancialmente año tras año. Personal que no habla español es otra cosa en  contra en  contra. El resto del personal bien

reviews.author: melvin e
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Súper bien buen  café Angie Báez buenas atenciones y servicio. Las habitaciones modernas y cómodas. La comida y restaurantes súper. Aquí limitar el uso de los documentos caracteres entiendo se puede dar una opinión

reviews.author: jmac386
reviews.title: Service at Paradisius Palma Real is great.
reviews.text: The service at Paradisius was exceptional across the board. Jhonathan and Quintana and Marielisa at Celsius Pool Bar set the bar. Thank you for making us feel at home. I look forward to my next visit to Paradisius Palma and the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: YENNI A
reviews.title: Una experiencia maravillosa.
reviews.text: Excelente Servicio,  muy agradecida con las atenciones de los colabores: Katherine Mota, Marcos Benjamin, Ivelisse y Stephanie del Depto. De reservas. Gracias mil por todo el apoyo. Excelente gastronomía en todo el hotel, buen show y buen espectáculo.

reviews.author: Juan I
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Buen servicio. Rápido y amables, las instalaciones son muy modernas. Y buen servicio del personal. El ambiente agradable y ameno.  Muy amplias las habitaciones   Definitivamente regresaría.  Un hotel de calidad

reviews.author: Lady L

reviews.title: Good and not so good
reviews.text:
Although the staff are super friendly (in particular Miquel and Lennison, 2 of the valets/bellmen) communication was difficult as most did not speak English.  the food was average/not great.  The facilities were nice and clean but this time of year due to the lack of a dehumidifier or heat pumps everything in your room felt a bit damp.

The pools were awesome and the beach setup was nice.  Again-staff very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: TKVun
reviews.title: A nicely fully refurbished property
reviews.text: I was here from 21-26 May 2023. This property had just gotten a full refurbishment late 2022 so everything was new and clean. A very firm bed which is to my liking and the room was great. Several pools available and I like the 'Adult Pool' the most. Food was ok, more towards Caribbean cuisine most of the time so would be better if they have serve different cuisine on rotation. Clean, clear sandy beaches too. Staff are friendly as they do speak and check with you from time-to-time to ensure your stay was up to expectation. Overall was great experience.

reviews.author: Carlo C
reviews.title: Amazing experience

Superb pool areas and even better beach space. Special mention to Dalmis Rodriguez and Francisco Vilorio who went above and beyond in making my stay an unforgettable one. Will recommend to all my friends and family.

reviews.author: Sophie G

Frappuccino was out of this world and I can’t wait to come back to this stunningly beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: Nina f
reviews.title: Oasis para alejarse unos días de todo.
reviews.text: Excelente hotel para convenciones. Las habitaciones super limpias, amplias, muy cómodas. Excelente servicio y atención en todas las áreas. Bebidas con mucho sabor. Muy buena playa, camas y camastros. Mucha tranquilidad. 10 de 10.

reviews.author: Mary W
reviews.title: Paradises paradise
reviews.text: Amazing resort and staff. Rooms were beautiful with lots of amenities.  I would definitely come back. Bar tenders were very attentive and the activity staff was fun. Make sure you bring bug spray if you are on the beach at night.

reviews.author: Rachel W
reviews.title: Impeccable Service
reviews.text:
I can not express how grateful I am for the above and beyond service at the Paradisus Palme Real. 

My company booked an incentive trip at this property and I almost didn’t accept the trip due to severe food allergies. I had a lot of anxiety before the trip,  but after I checked in I received a text from a private concierge, Nicholas, who was assigned to me. After meeting Nicholas, all my anxiety went away. 

Nicholas translated to the wait staff and chef and ensure my food would be safe. To my surprised when I mentioned I love mangos, he found a whole mango for me, his availability and always checking if I needed anything, not even food related, added an extra special touch to this trip.

Thank you to Nicholas, chefs, and wait staff, especially Andino who waited on my most meals and remembered my allergies and added to making my time in Punta Cana magical.

If you have severe cross contact allergies, I highly recommend this property. I look forward to returning for a personal trip in the future.

reviews.author: Mariela M
reviews.title: Recomendado!
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia. Muy buenas instalaciones y servicio al cliente. La comida igualmente muy buena y los servicios del hotel. Muy contenta con la experiencia, en especial gracias a Josias Espinosa y Jose de los Santos por su servicio!

Whenever we needed something, Felix took care of it for us. He is the best!

Loved the pool and the beach areas. Common areas were lovely. We also had a gorgeous suite that was spacious and felt like our own apartment. Thank you for a lovely long weekend!

reviews.author: Anthony M

reviews.text: Hospitality of each worker is the very best. Welcome was wonderful with Ferdinando. Luis is our concierge and it’s going to be great to get to know him and his help will be very valuable. MarieLisa in Guest Services came out and answered all our questions. Very kind and sweet. We love it all. The beauty is magnificent.

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.title: Beautiful paradise!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful! We went with a networking business event where we had some planned dinners and some days/evenings to ourselves and the resort was perfect for that. The Japanese hibachi restaurant was the best food we had and the buffets were plentiful. 
We had a Consierge named Dalmis Rodriguez and he was very helpful! He sent us the daily activities, made our reservations, and even helped us get more M&Ms (lol). Very nice staff.

reviews.author: Melwin M
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text:
The hotel was amazing! They gave us the most incredible Concierge who went out of his way to make sure our stay was incredible. Shout out to Felix Garcia! 

The restaurants at the hotel were a bit slow, but maybe that's just because I'm used to faster service in Europe. They often forgot orders but that might've been a language barrier. Though, it felt like there was a disconnect between the kitchen and staff.

Make sure you reserve either through one of the awesome Concierges or by yourself, even if the restaurant isn't full, they will tell you it's full. We went up to one of the restaurants and we got the message that it was full and they couldn't serve us, even though we clearly saw that there were 4 people sitting in the restaurant. But because they had a reservation at 9PM (It was 6:30 at the time) they couldn't serve us because it would be too busy.

reviews.author: Michele B
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant service
reviews.text: Amazing service at the resort and especially Nikte restaurant, Jose del Rosario, Feliz, Andino,   Laicho, Saudys, and Alex Marthur were all attentive, professional, and helpful. And, very delicious food!

reviews.author: Yuting P
reviews.title: Dream vacation
reviews.text: The resort is absolutely beautiful! Lovely staff, delicious food, fun activities and stunning beach! The resort has a daily activity schedule for guests to participate, including dance classes, exercises by/in the pool, cigar workshop and so on. Our concierge Eriol is very helpful and kind. I couldn’t have a better vacation!

reviews.author: mickweeks
reviews.title: Wonderful time, thoughtful host!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay as part of a sales club for my company. Our concierge Dalmis was thoughtful, attentive, and a great help. He made sure we were well cared for during our stay. The amenities were great - from the food to the accommodations. We especially enjoyed the grill outside of Cana where they had fresh sliced sushi grade tuna, a seafood bar, and amazing grilled meats. The other restaurants were great as well. Looking forward to returning, hopefully soon!

reviews.author: Cruiser48826973044
reviews.title: Exceptional experience
reviews.text:
Gorgeous hotel with luxurious rooms. The territory is huge, a lot of swimming pools. The staff is very friendly, especially I want to point out my concierge Felix. He was extremely helpful and friendly, he organised everything for us and managed to get us spots in the fully booked out restaurants as well.
Regarding the food, try buffet. It’s the best for breakfast and lunch. The steakhouse is also incredible.
At the beach make sure to ask for Pina colada, they bring you the cocktail in a real pineapple

reviews.author: Dream62902590336
reviews.title: Great steak restaurant

reviews.text: What a wonderful 3 days in Dominican Republic.  You can find many places to relax, but I am really grateful for the service that was given. Maria Peguera was a wonderful server and knew what we needed before we asked.

reviews.author: Jon H
reviews.title: Wonderful place and wonderful people
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning resort. It exceeded all exceptions and was exactly what we hoped for. Relaxing, quiet, beautiful and fun. Estefania helped us out with so much and Yiri at bar ginger was absolutely wonderful. Thanks to both of them. We will be back.

reviews.author: Leticia G
reviews.title: Beach Service
reviews.text: Although I found the service mediocre for my standards, Pedro & Martin at the beach made it up for the rest!!!! They were greeting us before we had even seen them, prepared and remembered our favorite beach bed from the previous day and immediately offered the beverages we had the day before. A+ service team.

reviews.author: chrisD4595WA
reviews.title: Food is not good
reviews.text: Nice location and facility but the resort lost me with the food quality.  Restaurants were either closed or had limited hours…always trying to steer you to the buffet. Room service was awful and took one hour and forty mins.

reviews.author: Jess J
reviews.title: 5 Star Services
reviews.text:
The Lunch Box buffet was awesome, food great & Alexander Santos & Myra Vil provided excellent service! 
Thank you for a great time, I will return again in the near future
Very enjoyable experience!!!

reviews.author: Jessica H
reviews.title: Corporate Trip
reviews.text: We hosted an event at Paradisus and our guests loved it! Lenison Montero was especially helpful and handled our nightly room drops for all of our guests and was a huge help! He was on time and followed instructions exactly. We also received pictures of all of the room drops so we knew they were done properly! If you are hosting an event at Paradisus, be sure to request help for your group from Lenison!

reviews.text:
Finest hotel facilities I have ever visited; beach, pools, lounge chairs, golf course, bars, restaurants, free nightly entertainment 

Personal concierge FELIX and WANDA @ poolside bar were superb and provided exceptional customer service every day

reviews.author: Lindsay V
reviews.title: Take us back to paradise! A magical stay at the Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text:
The resort was clean and so beautiful. 
The service was excellent. 
Miguelito Cuevas was our concierge. He was professional, helpful, kind and made our trip true perfection!  Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: rogerlabranche
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: This resort is very beautiful and relaxing. Employees are very helpful and always happy. Food could have been better but everything else was amazing. I plan on telling anyone interested in visiting Punta Cana to check this place out.

reviews.author: Honey B
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: This place was really cool, our concierge Jose Simeon was the best, he was attentive and a huge help making sure everything was just perfect the only thing that I would have liked was a casino on site other than that everything was awesome

reviews.author: Pioneer03146576085

reviews.author: GWH
reviews.title: Wonderful Property
