reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Exceptional concierge service and beautiful scenery
reviews.text: Our concierge ERIOL was magnificent.  He helped secure dinner reservations and checked on us daily.  We had a minor issue with our room safe and he made sure it was fixed promptly.  The rooms clean.  The views were exceptional.  We had a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Donna Marie
reviews.title: Beautiful Property! Excellent Service!
reviews.text: Won this trip with 100 others as a reward with my job! It’s on the beach and gorgeous! My personal concierge, Luis, was the best! I forgot to ID one of my luggage, I texted him and he had it delivered! He made dinner reservations, and was truly at my service! Some guests were members of this property and I can see why! The people in Punta Cana are super friendly and helpful! I definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: BILLB1234
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text: Room was great. Good location and access to main lobby. New renovations were amazing. Very nice! Our concierge Nicolas was awesome. He was very helpful and super efficient. Made our stay that much better.

reviews.author: Roam62371341862
reviews.title: Relaxation and Golf
reviews.text: Another great vacation with golf and beach. All the renovations to the rooms and new pool/bars are spectacular. Nicolas took great care of all 9 of us and our every need from the moment of our arrival to our departure. Restaurants were all very tasty and accommodating. Looking forward to next year.

reviews.author: san2728
reviews.title: Beautiful resort let down badly by the food
reviews.text: Beautiful resort on the beach, rooms were very clean and comfortable, surroundings of the hotel clean and nice and then it ends here; food is below average quality with everything  tasting the same. There 9s something wrong with the cooking and I couldn’t pin point exactly what was it. The booking system is very confusing and almost all the times either restaurants were closed or closed for booking. After 4 days I felt nauseated by the food.

reviews.author: angeloB3621YB
reviews.title: Fully Renovated Resort (Reserve)
reviews.text: Nicolas Maracallo makes the experience of the resort amazing for setting up all our reservations at the restaurants, check in, check out and any room requests and issues. The renovation at the adults only side is spectacular

reviews.author: Tony G
reviews.title: GREAT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Went on a work trip and the resort is great. New remodeled room great location. Felix our concierge was the best concierge we’ve had at any resort on our vacations. He went above and beyond and is the main reason why I’m leaving this review. He deserves to be recognized.

reviews.author: Tim C
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text:
Frank Feliz was great.  Server.
Marielisa, the concierge was on it the whole time.  Took great care of me.
Jose and Luis , outside wait staff, very good.  Soranyi, the bar tender outside remembered me EVERY time and had my drink waiting for me.  The bar keepers at Ginger and Blue Agave were very attentive and kept my drinks coming.  I recommend the Con Paz and The Merenghuey

reviews.author: Nicholas E
reviews.title: Phenomenal time in Punta Cana!
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic time in Punta Cana!!! Luis at the buffet took phenomenal care of my wife and I the entire trip and make us feel like family! Jose Simeon made our departure a breeze and made us not want to leave. 10/10 recommend making the trip!

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful and we particularly loved the Mediterranean restaurant  there were a few issues with the electrical in our room which was a little annoying. The beach was be lovely and our concierge Jose Simeon was the best. Very helpful in making dinner reservations and just a great person.

reviews.author: Jon R
reviews.title: Great winter getaway
reviews.text:
Ariol was introduced to us on day one and he was incredibly helpful to my wife and I all through the week with planning excursions, dinner plans and whatever else we needed 
Highly recommend him to any future guests

reviews.author: Manisha S
reviews.title: Customer service , check in process, overbooking
reviews.text: We booked our stay from Feb 12thto 20th. But the hotel put us in Garden Suites despite of our booking at palma real. We were with 3 small children but they did nothing to honour our booking . We waited 3 hours but palma real was overbooked. Not coming here again. Very poor customer service. Staff ineffective and keeps passing customer from one person to other. After a lot of persuasion they gave us only 3 night stay at palma real . No compensation for charging us full price at palma real and having us stay at Garden suites ( lower quaity) hotel for 5 nights has been offered so far. We are very very disappointed. Beautiful location but very poor customer service. Managers don't want to face customers and help.

reviews.author: Reiff S
reviews.title: Employees who helped greatly
reviews.text: Eriol was a wonderful concierge who took great care of us. Alajandro, Yaleidi,Lewis we’re also great and took good care of us. We got stuck on the golf course and eriol sent someone to help. Over all I had a great experience and the service of these people were amazing.

reviews.author: Equipos Medicos D
reviews.title: Corta  Estadia, Mala Experiencia
reviews.text: Las habitaciones no representan el costo/valor que ofrecen, Internet totalmente inexistente en la habitacion, sin jabon en el baño y despues de tres llamadas nunca fueron a colocarlo, sin tazas para tomar el cafe del minimbar, en general no representa el costo de la habitacion, los acabados de la misma bastante mediocres y el excusado estaba sucio, no fue mi eleccion ya que asisti a una convencion coorporativa, pero lo pensaria para hospedarme alli nuevamente.

reviews.author: Ryan M
reviews.title: Would go back just for kids club if nothing else
reviews.text: Hotel was great. Kids club was excellent as they did crafts by the ocean or play games by the pool. Kids club staff would even come encourage our kids to join the fun throughout the day giving us privacy. Food was a bit slow as they just reopened but that should be corrected soon.

reviews.author: Sita H
reviews.title: Nice stay and wonderful support from our concierge, Luis!
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days and enjoyed great weather, music, spa services and many options to lounge in the sun. Luis helped us during our time there and was incredibly supportive, had great attention to detail and is a genuinely wonderful human being. Thankful to him and the staff for making this stay a positive experience!

reviews.author: Jessica K
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Jose Emilio (manager) was great, hostess Sunirda was so accommodating and the food was wonderful! The resort is beautiful and so well taken care of. Great waterfront location. I strongly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Sixto Camacho
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text:
I am a frequent guest and the main reason is the staff. The bellmen (Emmanuel, Omar, Pedro, Jimmy, José Arismendy, Miguel, Luciano etc) they are awesome and always willing to help. The people at Tokimeku and Flora are great specially Fanni, Greysi, Dayhani, Frank and Ana.

I always recomend this hotel and like I said the big difference is the service. Best staff ever.

reviews.author: heidi j
reviews.title: Nice resort and amenities. Super friendly service. Eddy at the 90° pool bar is fantastic! Thanks to Eddy and everyone!
reviews.text: Super fun, friendly and safe! The facility and views are amazing! Food and drinks are great. A special thank you to Eddy at the 90° swim up bar. He kept us well “hydrated”. Entertainment in the plaza was a surprise and very cool. We will be back!

reviews.author: Luanne C
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. People very nice. Had one hiccup with room service but otherwise a great time!!  Good entertainment!  Japanese restaurant is the best !  Jorge Ben was a great help and good personality!!

reviews.author: Holly L
reviews.title: Felix is the best
reviews.text: Felix was an amazing butler! The property was gorgeous. The staff was very friendly and very accommodating. The spa was really great. Easy to make appointments and flexible with your schedule. I loved all of the pools!

reviews.author: Manuel M
reviews.title: Best host, Mackenson Cesar.
reviews.text: Our stay was exceptional. We were there for a business trip with a big group including spouses. I had the pleasure of having the best host in the resort, Mackenson Cesar. Since the time we stepped out of the airport van to the minute we left, he took care of us everyday, helping us with anything we needed. Great host, very professional and cordial. Highly recommended. The resort was also great. The food was amazing and the location perfect. We will be back and hope to see Mack again.

reviews.author: Reenie M
reviews.title: Super relaxing and paradise fir sure.
reviews.text: Bed was uncomfortable the middle was sunken in and difficult to sleep. The weed Wacking outside went on all week because a weed Wacker was used to cut the grass. A small mower would be much quicker.... the noise from the weed Wacker was super loud. We were in building 4 room 4208. Our concierge Cesar was great and very attentive to all needs. The staff were all super kind and helpful. We would visit again. A truly great trip.

reviews.author: Elizabeth T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with the BEST staff
reviews.text: This resort was beautiful and the people working there were incredible. Jorge the activities guy at the pool was so much fun and so upbeat and our concierge Lewis was so attentive and was always around to help with reservations, spa, etc. He was amazing. The guys working the main pool bar were the nicest. Everything was perfect

reviews.author: Quest39531709830
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text:
Beautiful place! We enjoyed the beach, pools and nice quiet walks.  
 Mack Cesar was our concierge and did a great job making sure our stay was the best.
Both buffets are fantastic. Both the food and staff phenomenal!
The restaurant's need some fine tuning, 
Special shoutout to Antonio at Ginger and Edikson at 36 degrees.  Both are phenomenal bartenders!

reviews.author: Getaway49892127680
reviews.title: Una experiencia formidable
reviews.text:
Ha sido una experiencia muy agradable, el hotel tiene unas habitaciones espectaculares es tranquilo y cuenta con suficientes zonas para variar cada día.

La comida tanto en el buffet como en los restaurantes es realmente buena y variada.

Especialmente destacará Mina por la gran calidad de las carnes servidas.

Todo el staff desde que llegas hasta que te vas es super amable especial atención para Alex y su asistente en la parte comercial que nos atendieron de forma espectacular. Asi como a mi concierge asignado Miguel que me hizo sentir como en casa.

Muchas gracias a todos nos vemos pro to de nuevo.

reviews.author: Tina H
reviews.title: I had a very good experience.
reviews.text:
A vacation with the company… it was a relaxing vacation where I enjoyed, spend time with friends and had some fun. I’ve meet Lewis, he was great !!

Good staff, good restaurants and everybody was friendly. 

I recommend the hotel!!

The only thing was.. we paid for an upgraded room for $2800 and didn’t feel as though we got any amenities more than the group we were with, unhappy with paying the extra money but Lewis made it special.

reviews.author: Kayleigh C
reviews.title: Lovely trip!
reviews.text:
Fabulous resort and fabulous service! Felix was our favorite concierge- always kind, smiling, and happy to lend a hand. Would go back!
The pools and drinks were perfectly chilly for the warm weather and the service was exceptional.

reviews.author: Kelsey H
reviews.title: Good experience!
reviews.text: The resort was clearly updated and in process of being updated further.  Room was spacious, updated, clean and had a good view.  The resort amenities were great, we experienced the spa (highly recommend!), several pools, and every restaurant on site.  Lots of choices for dining, included wine list was less extensive, but there is a wine bar on site.  Staff was all very pleasant, our butler Luis was incredible!  He reached out every morning to ensure we had what we needed, give us the agenda for the day at the resort, and was able to promptly answer any need we requested.  The beach was great with plenty of places to relax, although walking around made the seaweed very visible off resort (very thick some places on the beach and in the water).  Overall I would recommend the resort and Luis!

reviews.author: Christina N
reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: Excellent service! Jose Miguel was amazing!!! Super friendly people and very sweet! They offered us a few great drinks we wouldn’t have known about. We really enjoyed our stay at their bar and would recommend coming again for sure!

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: Friendly staff, gorgeous esthetic
reviews.text:
The property is gorgeous. The staff is so so kind.  Miguelito was our host and he took great care of us.   Always recognized us and asked what we needed.  He made us feel right at home.

The only thing I will say wasn’t so great was the food.  Again the staff was great but the food quality was eh.  Though, being gluten free, I was always taken care of which made me feel safe.  

Thank you!

reviews.author: Justin S
reviews.title: A true all inclusive experience
reviews.text: A truly all inclusive experience with everything you could want only a few steps away. Beautiful property, expansive pools, and the softest sandy beach. Our personal concierge, Luis, was incredibly attentive and truly felt like a friend

reviews.author: AxPh
reviews.title: A nice experience in Punta Cana
reviews.text: The hotel is really beautiful with when you arrive a stunning view on the ocean.  Rooms were spacious and comfortable.  Sadly the place is still under construction.  A few things still need to be corrected.  Food is quiet good but not exceptional (sometimes cold or dried ).

reviews.author: Todd N
reviews.title: Great Time at Paradisus!
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip to this resort with many good memories made.  From the meals staff, to the hotel staff the service was excellent.  Our butler Felix went out of his way any way he could to make our trip easy, and kept in constant contact every day of our stay. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Niki L
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful property. The staff was very polite from beginning to end.
reviews.text: The entire staff especially Miguelito Cuevas was amazing and helpful! Miguelito was always asking if we needed anything. He had attention  to detail. The room was always clean and he even left some extra special snacks and water.

reviews.author: ashley f
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text: This has the most beautiful view upon arrival and the property overall is gorgeous. The staff is all extremely kind. If you are able to have a butler, Nicolas (Cage) Maracallo is fantastic and ensure you have anything you need.  I highly recommend this resort over the many others I have been to across the world.

reviews.author: avk2023
reviews.title: Not a luxury experience
reviews.text:
My stay was less than enjoyable. 

On the first day, after I unpacked my bags, I went to leave my room and the door would not latch. I called the front desk and a security person was sent to fix the door about half hour later. It look him almost an hour to get the door to latch. Later that night when I was ready to go to bed I went back to my room and the deadbolt did not work. It took over 2 hours and 3 trips to the front desk (and my room was not close to the front desk) to get maintenance out. They eventually fix it but the door still looks not completely secure. After an hour the second time I asked to be moved to a different room but was denied. 

For the first 3 days I did not have any chairs on my balcony. I finally came back to my room one afternoon and there were 2 chairs as there should be. The next morning I was excited to wake up and sit on my balcony. As soon as I sat down on the chair, it broke and I fell through the chair. I notified staff the chair was broken but if was never replaced. 

The power went out multiple times. On my second last day it went out while I was in the shower and the water stopped as well. I stood in the shower for 10 mins covered in soap and shivering while I waited for the water to come back. Eventually I got enough cold water to rinse off. 

At least one day my room was not cleaned. 

The elevator to the side that I was on was in an area of the hotel that is being renovated. I had to use the stairs every time I left or came to my room on the 3rd floor. Because of the construction there was also no way to get to my room without getting rained on when the weather was wet. 

The food was not good. Everything was cold at the buffets. It was impossible to get food anywhere between the breakfast and lunch swap over.

reviews.author: Maria A
reviews.title: Manuel was fab
reviews.text: I met Manuel on the first day, and he was perfect. I had a few issues with my room and he helped me get into a new room right away, even helping me move my stuff into the new room. He also checked in on me and helped me make dinner reservations, and would send me the daily agenda each am. The resort staff are amazing at this resort (though English was not widely spoken); keep up the great hiring, Melia.

reviews.author: Rafael E
reviews.title: Aun no están listos
reviews.text: En lo personal una experiencia muy decepcionante con el hotel, veo en la prensa todos los anuncios sobre la inversión que han hecho en remodelar el hotel, pero la realidad es que abrieron sin aun estar listos. En los pasillos están llenos de constructores, lodo, cemento, todavía están sembrando. Restaurantes y bares cerrados, no hay actividades nocturnas, habitaciones incompletas, con articulos básicos faltantes para un hotel de esta categoría. Servicio al cliente deficiente, desde el checkin experiencia horrible (4 visitas al lobby SOLO para lograr que me entregaran una tarjeta para abrir la habitacion, la pulsera nunca funcionó). En fin, tienen todo un trayecto que recorrer aun. En estos momentos no me siento en condición de recomendarlos. Quizá con el tiempo cuando logren engranar todo mejoren, pero aún están lejos de la experiencia que ofertan

reviews.author: ANGELES A
reviews.title: Apenas y te atienden si das propina todo el tiempo
reviews.text: Necesitas dar propina cada que pide una soda para intentar que te hagan caso, lo mismo en la limpieza de la habitacion, la mucama busca diario propina. Te dicen que puedes reservar en otros restaurantes del complejo pero no son especificos en cuales, resulto que en uno no podiamos y son descorteses al explicarlo

reviews.author: Brandon Santiago
reviews.title: Always more than expected!
reviews.text: LOVE STAYING HERE. I travel a lot and this is one of my favorite places. The resort is packed with stuff to do and plenty of restaurants. The real reason I love it here is the amazing staff. So many to mention but my concierge Jessica is the best. I request her services every time I stay. She truly goes above and beyond for me and my family and it does not go unnoticed. She remembers little details, what we like and don't like and always makes our stay that much more enjoyable. She assists with tours and outings outside of the resort and basically everything at the resort for us. The resort is exactly what you would expect and what you see on the website is exactly what you see when you visit.

reviews.author: Ct P
reviews.title: Excellent all inclusive resort. We will definitely visit again soon.
reviews.text: Excellent stay. All inclusive food and drinks. Staff are all very nice and provide great customer service. Rooms are cleaned every day. Snacks and drinks are supplied in the rooms. The swim up bar was the best. Bartenders Victor Felis and Luis are very polite and provide great drinks. They made us feel very comfortable and it was nice to be able to swim up to the bar and enjoy our drinks. Overall it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Beth Romano
reviews.title: Ismael that works at the lobby bar is AMAZING!
reviews.text: Ismael that works at the lobby bar is AMAZING! I visited this hotel back in Nov 2021 and again in April 2022 and he remembered me. I was blown away that he remembered that I was there. He knew everyone's name and remembered our coffee order. He is so personable and so friendly, he truly made my experience there. I would go back to see him.

reviews.author: Giselle K
reviews.title: Restaurant Naos
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio de Roandel Acosta y de José Batista . Estuvimos disfrutando de la playa . Nuestro servicio de habitación , excelente y merecen un reconocimiento por alta atención .

Atte. Giselle KOPP, habitación 3018

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: Amazing service at Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Altagracia Cruz, Victor, Ruby, Ulisse at Gabi beach we’re incredible!!! Amazing drinks and incredible service!!! Loved it!! They provided the best service and some of the best services at a all inclusive and I’ve been to many in my life. a+++++

reviews.author: ammie_11
reviews.title: Beach bar on adult side
reviews.text: Wanda and martin are the best! Martin Had our beach spot set up everyday and Wanda always had great drinks! Ruby at the Gabi Beach bar was super every night! Simeon was great getting our dinners set up! Enjoy a great trip business and personal!

reviews.author: Carrie B
reviews.title: Service Manager Town & Country Services
reviews.text:
Very excellent service. Friendly staff. Glenny was an excellent waitress and Jose the service manager was always pleasant and accommodating.  Fresh food and quick service. Portions are perfect. 5 stars
.

reviews.author: Rodney N
reviews.title: Poolside Service
reviews.text:
When vacationing, customer service is priority #1.  Raul is provided exceptional service for our group everyday.  He locked down the cabanas, had the buckets of beer on ice (and kept them full), as well as made sure our entire team felt like VIPs.

Thank you Raul!

reviews.author: Andres G
reviews.title: Restaurante Sal
reviews.text:
Muy rica la comida y buena atención

Estuvimos visitando el hotel y en el restaurante fuimos muy bien recibidos por todo el personal y la comida fue muy buena

Recomendado el restaurante para almuerzo y cenA

reviews.author: Silvana S
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text:
Quiero v destacar la excelente atención y cordialidad del
Sr Lexington Alcantara y Delgis Castillo ambos hicieron lo posible para que nuestra estadía sea mejor
El staff supervisado por la srta Mayte Vázquez verdaderamente hace la diferencia , por su profesionalismo

reviews.author: koukla69
reviews.title: Friend vacation
reviews.text: Virtudes went above and beyond my expectations we asked her to order for us as if we were visiting her in her home and we ate every last bit the service was unbelievable and I can be on our expectations we highly recommend Cielo at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana even the manager came up to visit us Jose to make sure everything was up to par

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: Amazing dinner at Ceilo
reviews.text: Our dinner was perfect! I came here w my girlfriend and the service was amazing we had the tacos al pastor and golden chicken and octopus toast appetizers  which were very tasty! along w the chicken enchiladas and fish for main course! Jose Bautista was the main chef and manager and he personally came over to our table to ensure that we were having the most amazing experience. They even made a custom skinny Margarita for me and my girlfriend per our request. Cant recommend this place enough 100/10!! Mui bien!!

reviews.author: Camila P
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel con la mejor atención
reviews.text:
Paradisus tiene el mejor personal, todos son muy amables. 
Hicimos un gran evento gracias a las instalaciones. La comida es muy buena, con gran variedad de opciones, el salón para los eventos excelente. 
10 puntos para la limpieza.

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.title: Prolonged Stay - Covid Issues
reviews.text:
I was staying at the resort for a work kick-off. Unfortunately before my flight back to the United States, I tested positive for Covid and was there for an additional 3 days (I am vaxxed, boosted, and never had a single Covid symptom). The reason I am including this detail is that the staff (especially Delgis Castillo) did a terrific job with brining room service, daily covid testing, and making a discomforting situation as comforting as possible.

Pros on resort: Staff (Delgis and others), beautiful beaches and pools.

Cons: The food is, ummm, not my favorite. Not sure what to pinpoint exactly but just wish the food from room service and buffet was better.

reviews.author: Fred A
reviews.title: A wonderful peace oasis
reviews.text: Great time on the beach or in the swimming pool. All the places are very very clean and convenient. The bar waiters are really cool and smiling. A special message to the TOKIMEKU's chef who is just an absolutely wonderful guy!

reviews.author: Andrea B
reviews.title: Lovely facilities
reviews.text: Very friendly and clean resort. The pools are amazing and the staff are very helpful. The Spa has a wide range of services and it is easily booked and accessed.  The conference facilities were excellent and the standards of CV19 precautions very high. English is spoken by most staff, some fluently but mostly good enough if not perfect.  Restaurant booking is a little bit and miss but that will probably smooth out as the season continues.

reviews.author: Olivier N
reviews.title: See you soon
reviews.text:
Great resort, amazing food choice, fantastic team, a real 5 stars resort in Punta Cana which is not so obvious as many resorts are fake 5-star level.
Adriane Romero is the best General Manager I have seen to support us over all the week taking care of our 53 invites! Yorbelis and Alejandro on a daily basis were so amazing as well.

Thank you Paradisus Palma Real team!
See you soon

reviews.author: tsmservice
reviews.title: Good But could be better
reviews.text: Staff was friendly, in room service was poor (aka towels, mini bar, toiletries) all were not restocked. Bars, Restaurants, food and service were 5 stars, grounds were clean & secure, All staff was friendly

reviews.author: BigPapaDave
reviews.title: Great place, food could use some help.
reviews.text: The people make this place.  The staff was absolutely wonderful.  The rooms/suites were enormous and elegant. The beach was nice. The bars were well manned and stocked. The food sucked! I can't overstate how wonderful the people that work here are. every last one of them were amazing and bent over backwards to accommodate our every wish.  Reynaldo is the man to see!

reviews.author: Sposadny003
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: Ruby and Joel Valdez at the bar are hands down the best. Made great drinks on a memorable trip. Cant say enough about these two! Overall the room could have been a little nicer as some of the dresser drawers were broken and TV got horrible reception. But who wants to spend time in their room?

reviews.author: mjgonzales8
reviews.title: Amazing Time!
reviews.text: The team at this hotel was absolutely amazing! There is a bar directly across from where you check in on the second story. I believe it's called the 'Lobby Bar'. That’s the only place that you'll want to spend your entire trip. There are multiple amazing bartenders and cocktail servers...Ismael, Criseida & Raysa, thank you!!!

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.title: Crap food, crap service all around, nobody speaks English- Terrible disappointment
reviews.text: The title says it all.  Don't waste your time or money.   Nobody that works there actually cares about what  you want they just do whatever they feel like doing.  Highly disappointed and will never go back.

reviews.author: Rosmi Almamzar
reviews.title: La mas chevere
reviews.text:
Me encanto el servicio de Stephanie Beltre del bar Aveniue🤩 Super simpática y si colocarán anuncios hasta eso bailaría 😂 quede encantada.

Toda una semana de gran servicio y siempre muy cortes.

Así también del lobby bar Lucia nos estuvo asistiendo ☺️

reviews.author: Gaetano Nigro
reviews.title: Caraibi da vivere e visitare!!
reviews.text: Fantastica esperienza grazie non solo alla location davvero magica ma anche grazie al personale che lavora in questa struttura. In particolare Altagracia Cruz di Avenue Bar è stata davvero molto professionale con il nostro gruppo. Da ripeter l’esperienza.

reviews.author: Erica R
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: Really pretty hotel and friendly people. Good vibes and atmosphere right on the beach. Concierge service was top notch! We had a gentleman by the name of Yoiner Josè and he was great! So attentive, helped with everything we needed. He was always there for any questions we had, very responsive to our messages. We had a late dinner reservation one night and he came up to our room and brought us up a big plate of fruit. We didn’t ask he just took the extra step! Ask for him when you go!!

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Vacation at the Palma Reale
reviews.text: Family vacation all the employees and workers were extremely nice and helpful. Especially are butler Zenovia Nova, and our beach attendant Martine.  Everything was clean and the pools were wonderful. We enjoyed all the evening shows and the beautiful beach.

reviews.author: estellamercedes
reviews.title: Site Survey of Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Love this resort.  Gave them a glowing review with my company and we are looking forward to hosting our Circle of Excellence Incentive Trip.  Everything was pristine and the services was spot on.  Everyone was very helpful and accommodating.

reviews.author: Tereza
reviews.title: Comentario
reviews.text: Mis amigos y yo estamos muy feliz de estar en parádisus Palma real . Gracias a los chicos del ( avente bar ) en especial Altagracias cruz, lucia Dias , yisaury Contreras, yiri silvestre gracias por sus atención .

reviews.author: Luis Andres T
reviews.title: Convención
reviews.text: Buen una experiencia inolvidable. La mejor atención que he recibido en mi vida. Lo recomiendo para que visiten el resort Paradiso Palma Real. En el aveneu bar. El mejor servicio. La mejor atención de Lucia Yisauri Altagracia Yiri son un amor.

reviews.author: Alberto P
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Hotel Paradisus palma real encantando con el servicio en especial al bar avenue con la atención de Lucia, Altagracia, Yisairi y la supervisora Yiri Silvestre. Gracias por toda su atención personalizada.....

reviews.author: Ramon M
reviews.title: Todo excelente
reviews.text: Excelente, todo el hotel. Parece que al abrir y la pandemia deben reaolver algunas cosas que son detalles. Pero, la atencion fue excelente y muy humilde el personal. Deben realizar una investigacion de campo. Pero decir que todo fue eatupendo.

reviews.author: Yury
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text:
Lúcia, yisauri, Letícia, happy boy are just awesome! Thank you guys! ❤️❤️✌🏽
Staff super friendly, we had a good time with you guys! 

13 Cuba libre con ron escuro, por favor!

(Avenue bar and animation )

reviews.author: Ludwig P
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time in this resort, serviced by an incredible staff that is reactive and caring. Thank you Lucia!!
reviews.text: Incredible service, amazing place, incredible staff, the bar is absolutely wonderful, the amazing music and everything else makes for a one in a lifetime. Avenue bar, Lucia, Yisauri, Luis Rosiaro and Laëtitia and all incredible staff people who made our experience unforgettable.

reviews.author: Juan C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Amy Young
reviews.title: A Fantastic Resort with Amazing Employees
reviews.text:
I am a Corporate Events Manager in the Automotive Industry who is a HUGE FAN of the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  I hosted an incentive program from 8/2 - 8/8/21 for 75 people....and every single one of my attendees was extremely complimentary about their stay at this resort.  I did not receive any negative feedback other than they wished they could stay longer!

Personally, my favorite part was the wonderful staff that made our stay magical.  Specifically:

Edgar Mejia - If you have the occasion to plan a group trip to the Paradisus Palma Real, please request Edgar.  In the 15 years I have been planning trips, he was hands down the best Group Coordinator I have ever had.  

Karolina Encarnacion - Karolina is the Spa and Wellness Manager.  She took incredible care with my guests and ensured that they had the most wonderful experience at the Spa on property.  Her staff is very friendly and the spa offers top notch treatments in a beautiful, clean, and relaxing environment.

Thalia - Thalia was present at every gathering for my group, making sure it went off without a hitch.  During down time, she stopped by to see if I needed anything and to make sure that all of my guests were happy AND HEALTHY!  Thalia personally escorted one of my guests to the clinic when he was in need of antibiotics after realizing he left his back at home!

Martin Tineo - Martin was our pool & beach concierge at the Adults Only Pool.  The lengths he went to for our group's happiness absolutely need to be called out.  Martin worked tirelessly filling all of the special requests from our attendees.  He did a fantastic job.  Please go see Martin if you are on property!

Wanda - Wanda was our bartender at the Adult's Only Pool.  I wish that I could have bottled Wanda's personality, sense of humor, and work ethic to bring home with me.  She got to know our guests quickly over the 5 days they spent at the Paradisus Palma Real and proactively made sure they were happy and taken care of.  I have had 7 of my attendees email me about how great Wanda was since we returned to the United States!

I am 100% happy and grateful for this beautiful property and the caring people that are employed at this resort.

From the clean rooms, to the wonderful food and restaurants, to the soft sandy beach....I could not have asked for a more perfect experience.

I absolutely recommend the Paradisus Palma Real for a group business or personal / family stay.

reviews.author: gotkelb
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We had a great stay in February. The weather was a mix of everything really. The room was sub par but very clean. The bathroom supplies are good but you may want your own shampoo and cond. The cleaning staff was great. The balcony was nice and spacious. The room was very spacious overall as well. We had a Jr Suite. Mini living area, bed, large bathroom with jet tub for 2. The bed was very comfy but firm.  The shower water temps were difficult to master (one morning we had no water at all actually). Our butler was very average also. However, the staff overall was amazing and over the top helpful if you needed anything. The food was good. The buffet was great! The beach was amazing, very easy to walk on and we did miles every morning. They provide nice big lounging beds on the beach (we had gold bands) and that was so comfortable. Service on the beach was great too. The casino is small but fun. The resort is very beautiful all round. The store prices are extremely high. Sun lotion is $30USD. I also needed some earbuds since mine broke, there was one box, it was previously used, yikes. I also got some cocoa butter lotion, got to the room, and it was as hard as a rock. So much so that the sun couldn't even melt it. So just be aware of what you may need. The sun is very strong here. I tan easily and rarely burn, but I did here using 30 spf all day long.

reviews.author: sjp3003
reviews.title: Expansive All-Inclusive with Great Beach, Mediocre Service and Convenience
reviews.text:
I am attending a three day Conference at this property.  This was one of the first large scale all-inclusive hotels in Bavaro.  

The good:

Conference facilities are very good, better than the Hard Rock for conferences 
Beach is beautiful
Rooms are nice, nicer than many newer properties although a bit dated.  I was right by the beach in a unit with a kitchenette, living room, bedroom, two TVs, large in-room jacuzzi and comfortable bathroom.

The not so good:
The property is huge, over 1000 rooms with other related hotels spread out throughout the complex.  Moving among these to meet other attendees is cumbersome and uncomfortable given the heat.  It can be confusing as well give them labyrinth of rooms and buildings. 

Service is mediocre: very slow check in, so-so service in restaurants.

Food was mediocre, and despite the all-inclusive moniker we paid $50 per person to dine at the Mina steak restaurant where the food was better than average but the ambiance was loud and less polished than an Olive Garden.

Granted, I am here for a conference which requires business oriented efficiency.  The negatives are less important for a leisure traveler staying one week without deadlines and scheduled meetings.  Nonetheless I would not come here to spend personal time simply because the property is unwieldy, massive, impersonal and service is mediocre....I’d opt for a smaller property.

reviews.author: mqfreeman63
reviews.title: Fantastic sales person and excellent Royal Service butler!
reviews.text:
I was thrilled to return to Paradisus Palma Real for trhe second time in about three years.  These last two times I was able to experience the Royal Service treatment.  

Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real is an exclusive enclave for adults only, Royal Service is the epitome of elegance and personalized service. Located on the amazing blue flag Bavaro Beach, one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, in Punta Cana (Dominican Republic) The Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real is a luxurious all-inclusive resort, ideal for couples and adults.

I spent two nights 9/27-9/29 and can say that it was a highly memorable time and it was spent in the most blissful solitude I ahev experienced in a very long time.What dtyood out top me the most and so worthy of mention aer the butler service, the service in both of the restaurants in which I dined, and a couple of very fine customer service experiences with in-room dining.

So I would like to first give the highest praise to my personal Royal Service butler, Miguel. He was on top of everything and made it easier for us to communicate through What's App.  He was very hands-on and ministered to my every request personally.  He is one of the greatest assets of the property and a large part of why I would return ...for business or leisure.  He was absolutely fantastic.  I would also like to mention these fine staffers who helped me to enjoy my stay:

DAVID- My server at Rare steakhouse was inimitable, as well as FREDY (sp?).  He kept me engaged even as the restaurant got busier into the evening.  Thank you both!

JULIO-My server at Palazzo, the Italian, Royal Service only restaurant.  He did a stellar job and made sure my wine glass stayed full!  Thanks, Julio!

WANDA-The bartender at the Royal Service pool bar was fantastic, funny, and helped me out when the private pool got a little loud and super-chatty. :-)  Thanks for the rescue, Wanda and loved the drinks!

KELVIN (In-Room Dining Server)
RICHARD (In-Room Dining Manager PM)
Though I experienced a few nerve-racking moments with the communication and delivery of my in-room meals, they were made much better by both KELVIN and RICHARD.  They were both highly professional and extremely focused on doing what was necessary to make things better during these moments.  Thanks very much to you both!

Finally, my visit to Paradisus Palma Real was rooted in business.  I was doing a site visit for a prosective spring 2020 incentivce program for a financial services company.  The undertaking would have been nearly impossible without the indefatigable REYES GOMEZ, my sales representative.  REYES arranged my stay, conducted sites to both Paradisus Palma Real, Melia Punta Cana Beach, and Melia Caribe Beach.  We did them all in the first day...nearly as soon as I arrived! :-)  She drove me in the golf cart from property to property after a delightful lunch at Palazzo.  I cannot say how much of an impression REYES made and how detailed our sites were.

If you are considering Punta Cana as a destination for business or leisre , I highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real...Oh!  And a marvelous (Destination Management Company (DMC)---CONNECT DMC---ANDRES, BIANCA ...Thanks so much for everything!!!!

he service was ok, but the relation cost gastronomic offer very poor, every day offered the same menu practically in the days that I was hosted. also attended a conference and to our surprise the reservation staff of the restaurants did not want to take the reservation for them, I imagine that by order of the administration because we happened to several of the attendees, they forgot that although we attended a conference also We were guests of the hotel.

reviews.author: jemery619
reviews.title: We had a great time with a few snafus
reviews.text:
The resort itself is beautiful. My husband and I stayed there this past week for his company trip and really had a great time. The food was pretty good, everyone was very polite, the spa was relaxing, and the beach is beautiful.

My only complaints were that our lights and water kept randomly going out in our room, and also on a night that appetizers were served- they were served with some type of leaf skewer. Unfortunately the skewer separated in the appetizer that I ate- resulting in me swallowing part of the skewer, and 6 days later it is still lodged in my throat (I will be seeing a doctor). 
Our butler Angelo was always courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.title: Division Vice President
reviews.text: Our personal butler was Juan Suarez and he did a fantastic job all week!!! Very attentive and always had a smile on his face. The entire trip was awesome and the service was phenomenal! Great job by all!!!

reviews.author: Malemelendez
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene el tamaño perfecto para sentirte relajado y con la privacidad adecuada. Tuve el privilegio de recibir los beneficios de royal service. Outstanding. Richard como Butler es fenomenal y nos ayudó en todo lo que necesitábamos. El servicio en la playa con Omar también fue excelente.
La variedad de comida y restaurantes estuvo muy bien. Nos encanto todo!!!

reviews.author: Stroh92
reviews.title: Large Group Working Team
reviews.text: Just left Paradisus Palma Real today at noon.  Throughout the last week, the bartenders in the Lobby Bar  (Lilian and Edison) were absolutely wonderful. Always friendly and smiling, great senses of humor, quick and tasty drinks.  I was taken great care of!  Thank you!

reviews.author: sk0913
reviews.title: Corporate Group Experience
reviews.text: I am a corporate event planner and brought a group to Paradisus Palma Real in February. The convention team, especially Alain and Juan, did an incredible job of taking care of our group and making sure every detail went smoothly! This group meets annually in many different locations, but they are always excited when we bring them back to Paradisus. It’s been their favorite location for many years, and I see why! From the butlers to the spa staff to the bartenders and everyone in between, the staff at Paradisus goes above and beyond to provide each guest with excellent service. Thank you, Paradisus!

reviews.author: Amber H
reviews.title: Best host ever... fun never stops!!
reviews.text: This resort is my first trip to a tropical place. There are not enough words to express how fantastic and superior the Paradisus Palma Real staff has been for this trip. The activities were phenomenal and Reynaldo Monegro was an incredible entertainer who hosted our entire week with 600 plus people, always smiling and showing us the best time! Anyone who is fortunate enough to meet him will experience the best vacation.

reviews.author: Justin H
reviews.title: Bridgestone presidents trip
reviews.text: What a phenomenal place to come visit and spend a trip!!! Everyone here is so professional and kind. Reynaldo Monegro always took his time to make my wife and my experience over the top. He took us for the back of the house tour and showed us around everywhere. Having someone so kind and willing to share is so special to have. I would love to have him in the United States working for me anyway. Thank you Reynaldo!!!!!

reviews.author: Passport597469
reviews.title: Best staff at Paradisus
reviews.text: My husband and I had an amazing trip in the Dominican. We were greeted with a friendly smile and had the best time at the Paradisus! The food was great, the staff was very friendly and helpful. Nixon, Easy, Nina, Kilyi, Rosanna, Louise Coldero were our favorites! Overall a great experience at a fabulous hotel!

reviews.author: Zoegirl117
reviews.title: Wonderful Club trip!!
reviews.text: We just returned from an all-inclusive trip to this resort.  My BF company planned an incredibly pain-free relaxing and fun time at the Paradisus.  We were Royal Service level, which meant we had access to exclusive areas and also the butler service.    Ariel Benzo was our assigned butler and did not disappoint.  Ariel was fully engaged with us- ensuring we had everything we wanted immediately.   He also did extras such as a lovely bubble bath with a bottle of wine and candles in the room.   Loved the entire stay - highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: Nicely done!
reviews.text:
This was our first visit to this resort and my wife and I had an excellent time. The grounds are beautifully maintained, lots of amenities, and the beach is great. Our butler, Darleni, was phenomenal!

We only have a few minor suggestions. The beach could have been groomed a bit better, service at some of the standard restaurants could have been better, and our dinner reservations got screwed up at check-in somehow. Darleni took care of us though! So it’s all good.

Excellent resort! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: John D
reviews.title: Sales award trip for exceeding yearly goal
reviews.text: Our first time in DR. This resort is really amazing. Our experience from begining to end has been excellent. Francis Newton,our Butler, has taken care of every need. Very prompt and very helpful from check-in to check-out. Five stars!!! The resort has many dining options for all tastes. Our yearly sales award was held here. The ocean front is clean, and there are many pool options from secluded adults only area, to large main pool and swim up bar. Plenty for everyone. Our Company purchased the Royal Experience, which allowed us full access to drinks, special areas, and personal butler service. All the staff has been great. Keep up the great work, and I look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Dmhollie
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text:
We’ve been here for a week and have had the most wonderful trip. The service is incredible. The hotel
Is beautiful. And, the food is great. Our Royal Service butlers, Alberto Vargus, and Manuel, have been nothing short of professional, courteous, knowledgeable and friendly. They have both been on top of everything we may need before we even know we are in need. Our highest compliments to both of them. The Paradisus Palma Real, as well as the brand company, Meliá, are blessed to have them on board representing them. Alberto, is especially deserving of an additional compliment. He should go very far within this company. He knows how to provide visitors with a stay they will never forget. It will be hard for someone else to live up to the impression he has left on my husband, myself and our friends/coworkers. Thanks Paradisus Palma Real for a vacation we won’t soon forget. A beautiful stay and incredible time was had by all.

reviews.author: Michele Hardin
reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text:
My husband and I were there on for a rewards trip.  Upon arrival everything looked great!  The view of the ocean when you walked in was gorgeous!  Every place you looked was spotless.

We got to our room and it was very nice with a separate sitting room which included a mini kitchen.  The AC was set to 24 celsius (75 farenheit)  so it was just semi-cool.  I turned it down and went about my day.

That evening we had a group event.  The food was awful.  Either the food was overcooked, under-cooked or just didn't have any flavor.  That seemed to sum up the food for the week.  The buffet during breakfast and lunch was not good at all.  We never ate the buffet for dinner, so I cannot comment on that.  I did eat a bunch of salads during the trip, even though their dressing was extremely watery.

The next day I went down to the front desk to complain about the AC, and they said they would look into it.  This same conversation happened all week with nothing being done to fix it.  I truly don't think they even ever looked at it because I never heard anything said about it when I asked day after day. Two days before we were leaving, the AC shut off.  Nothing.  We had to open windows and the sliders to the patio to get the fresh air to circulate.  

Colleagues told us that they did not have hot water in their room, another told us their room was very musty and smelled, and another told us that their light fixture in their room was hanging with wires sticking out.

We went to one of the specialty restaurants, hibachi.  While sitting there waiting for the cook to start, a mouse ran across the floor.  Needless to say, we were a bit grossed out and left.

The pool area, spa, beach were very nice, and of course the swim up bar.

For the amount of money they charge, they can upkeep their guest rooms much better.  I would not recommend this resort with so many others in that area.

reviews.author: Connector760154
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Love this resort. Stayed in the royal service where they provide you a butler. Our butler, Faustino, was excellente!! Very attentive and helpful with anything we needed.  Rooms were clean.  Bartenders and people working the beach and pool couldn’t have been more friendly and helpful. Made us feel like family! Can’t wait to go back! Loved it!

reviews.author: Marie B
reviews.title: Beautiful property, clean most employees were extremely pleasant.
reviews.text:
I haven't been out of the country or to an all-inclusive in over 25 years. Not much to grade on, but here goes.  The lobby is gorgeous, and check in was fast and friendly. Please keep in mind when reserving, there are no elevators. If you are not 1st floors, you gotta take the stairs.  That being said, we had a garden side room on 1st floor. Short walk to beach from Villa 5.  It was fairly quiet but there are lots of work trucks that go by. The workers on them are not so quiet in the morning, but did not wake me up. I really enjoyed sitting on the  patio early.  One worker came by with a fresh coconut, cut off the top and offered me  the water. It was good, and then he cut off the husk and I got to enjoy fresh coconut. 
     We had (I think, company trip) a deluxe garden suite. 2 doubles which were comfortable and the room was very spacious. It was spotlessly clean, not at all musty. The fridge really could have been colder but was bearable. It contained 2 lite beers, 2 regular beers, a few waters and a few sodas. We checked in on Wednesday and housekeeeping did not come back until Friday. When she did (wish I got her name) I thanked her for everything and gave her a nice tip ($5) She was sweet. Appeared every day with extra beers, bottles of tonic (because I had my own vodka), glasses, extra waters and sodas. Never lacked for anything in the housekeeping dept. our room was perfect.  I saw some people have complaints about showers, but we did not. However, we did have issues controlling the lights. Take a few minutes and practice. There is an iron and board in the room, which was handy. 
     Food was ok.  Breakfast at the buffet was nice the 1st 2 days, then ordered the fruit, toast, juice and coffee from room service. Keep in mind, the food is free, but there is a $5 delivery fee. No problem with that and pay at check out. They poured fresh OJ, poured the coffee and unwrapped everything. The toast was not so good. (No mamn, just dry white toast.)We went to the teppanyaki place, which was extremely entertaining, but my meal was meh. The rice was crispy, one of the appetizers was edemame, which I like but a few beans on a plate was just odd. I got the sushi appetizer, of which I ate one and gave the others away. Someone said the pistachio ice cream was good. 
     I don't like the fact that people throw their old  nasty towels under the palapas at night to reserve, then either show up at 2 to sit on the beach or don't show up at all. Maybe they could have a beach attendant to deal with that in the morning. However, we managed to get one daily, although had to walk on our knees to get under it and one was several rows from the water. The vendors were polite. Never annoying. Just remember to haggle. Be firm. Not interested, no thanks works. 
     The beach was lovely, perfect weather.  The seaweed pickerupper machine was quiet. I didn't understand how it woke people up. It's not perfect but it helped. For our 1st 2 days, there was seaweed in the water. That's where it come from. Yes, not reually pleasant but we got over it. Just go out a bit. On the 3rd day, there was less. Servers on the beach were hard working, came back quickly and never got an order wrong. Small tip for each one. 
    Last tips, try to make dinner reservations early. There is a separate area to make these, employees were  polite but uninspired.  The lower lobby area is fairly loud, at least on the weekend.  It would be nice if the lobby could post daily activities, like shows, dance parties,etc. They do have them, so if interested find someone and ask. 
     I would go back, if only because the grounds were so lovely, most of the employees were pleasant and helpful ( it helps if you know a bit of Spanish) and I'm easy to get along with.

reviews.author: Tourist22966973874

reviews.text:
We enjoyed the resort everything was beautiful. The beach was so clean and blue.Made our Awards event memorable.
Our Butler Juan Carlos was amazing and made my Bday special he is one of a kind. Royal service was everything and more.

reviews.author: Dream25900556200
reviews.title: Paradisus Review
reviews.text: Beautiful place with good facilities.  It is a solid get away from mid western winters.  The only issue is that making dinner reservations is a huge pain in the ass.  They will have open seats in the restaurants but they will not seat you.  It seems as if this is a matter of pride in the staff to make your dinner experience difficult.  Management needs to change this yesterday.  Otherwise they place is fantastic.

reviews.author: C B
reviews.title: Great experience!

He prepared a bath for us after an all day excursion, and would frequently leave fruit and cheese platters for us in our room to enjoy.  This resort was wonderful to stay at, but José definitely sealed the deal for us!

reviews.author: Andy S
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text:

Keep up the good work and the smile !!!
We will be back !!!
