reviews.author: Culture41908899577
reviews.title: Paradisus in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Housekeeping was excellent and the room was great, not enough Restaurant to make a reservation to go for dinner, it's a big resort, staff doesn't speak much English. Most of the people were from English speaking country therefore the staff should speak it enough to understand what we are asking for.

reviews.author: Ariana C
reviews.title: Great Visit!
reviews.text: We had such an amazing time at this resort. The grounds are beautiful and the beaches are to die for. We had the Royal Service and it was well worth it. Alvaro Fernandez was our personal butler and he took care of everything for us. We didn't even have to go look for him. He always found us everyday. Would definitely reccomend this resort again.

reviews.author: Relax29933586075
reviews.title: Wonderful staff, and incredible food!
reviews.text: We enjoyed this trip so much! We were traveling with a business group, and stayed in the royal service area. The staff was so great; especially Wilfrido at the royal service Sunset Bar and Rafael at the royal service beach were INCREDIBLE! This resort is lucky to have guys like this making guests feel so welcome and helping with everything they can. We were already planning a return on our flight home!

reviews.author: Inspire22266216083
reviews.title: Ho-Hum
reviews.text: Very friendly staff.  First impression was good but property need maintenance.  Had a couple cold showers, Room door handle was difficult to operate - tug twist & push just so to open room door.  Weather was terrific.  As soon as you get on the beach away from the resort many local sales people bombard all the guest.  No pre-check out service so give yourself plenty of time to wait and checkout at the main counter.  Buffet was ok, nothing organic - had enough of it after going for 3 days.  Mixed drinks not consistent and alcohol tasted adulterated.

reviews.author: Fearless36756432589
reviews.title: Pool Side Service
reviews.text: Freddy primarily served us at the pool.  He did an excellent job and we enjoyed him very much.  He represents you very well!  He was attentive without being pushy.   Was very knowledgeable with questions that we had.  Just was a fun person to have assist us on our trip.

reviews.author: Meander53264720737
reviews.title: Quick business visit to Punta Cana
reviews.text: Beautiful facility, lots of service.  I felt very secluded and cared for.  Food was pretty good and beverages were plentiful.  Room was very comfortable.  Maybe not as inviting to a business traveler as I would have liked, but I'm sure I was in the minority as a business traveler.

reviews.author: Travel50978510891
reviews.title: Third Trip
reviews.text: This was our third time to this resort in the last 5 yrs. All trips were business/vacation combo trips.  The resort is beautiful. Some seaweed on the beach but certainly not a problem. We felt that English communication had lessened with wait staff in restaurants, service was much slower and there were more miscommunications.  Some staff members were present through all three trips so we surmised either staff had been cut/they were too busy or morale was lower.  There were staff members that communicated very well but in general we thought there was a decline.  Generally speaking staff was not as friendly, although they all tried to help when asked and were very courteous. If going to this resort as a couple I would recommend Royal Service. I found the hotel buffet, Naos, to be crowded and chaotic at breakfast and lunch with lots of people and children. The Royal Service exclusive restaurant is quiet and in a lovely setting. The beach and pools are also very nice for Royal Service.  The highlight this trip was the butler service, included in Royal Service, which was much improved from previous trips. Richard was excellent and helped us in every way.  Spirit selections are supposed to be higher end in the Royal Service area but this trip we thought the selections were not as good as previous years. However our butler helped us with that.  We were able to get reservations to restaurants without a problem. The salmon in all a la carte restaurants was excellent. Our favorite was Mizu.  We found the cooks worked very hard and it was an entertaining evening. We ate there twice. Would love to see some basic sandwiches offered at lunch.  Restaurants mostly have full course meals/entrees so lunch takes time and is heavy. Basic ham or turkey sandwiches with chips or fries is what we would have preferred. We missed the specialty drink lists at the bars so you could order/try different drinks.  The rooms were very nice. There was a shortage of washcloths and sometimes bath mats but otherwise service was excellent. MAJOR complaint was a room service cart that had a wheel malfunction. It came by our door in Villa 7 as early as 6:30 and woke us up 5 out of 7 mornings with a loud screeching, squealing noise.  It needs to be repaired. Our spa experience was very positive. The resort grounds and property are beautiful and I love having a great place to walk/run.  Overall it is a great resort but it is expensive and I think a few things could be improved to fit the cost.

reviews.author: Departure22695425768
reviews.title: Very nice Resort
reviews.text: Very nice place. Friendly staff. More than willing to go out of there way to accommodate you. You won’t be disappointed. Golf course is a fun track. and was in great shape. Rental clubs weren’t bad at all.

reviews.author: Jesse H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Everything was perfect!  Everyone was very helpful, friendly, and genuinely nice. The resort was beautiful!  The activities were fun.  The food was amazing, but what my wife and I liked the most was the amazing and friendly staff.  My wife and I cannot wait to go back.

reviews.author: katefaulkner15
reviews.title: Great Service and Food
reviews.text:
Great food in all the restaurants.  Highly recommend paying extra for the Royal Service - better room with butler, private pool and beach areas and restaurants. 
Loved out bartender Wonda and our butler Jose!

reviews.author: Odyssey11738882323
reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Bring plenty of Imodium as you are likely to have diarrhea and also do not count on electricity 24/7 during your stay.  The power went out every day were there for 1-5 hours usually in the afternoon when we were heading for our room to cool off.  The butler service isn't worth it and the Royal Service is a gimmick as our butler gave us mostly lip service especially when making reservations at the restaurants.

reviews.author: montbalt43
reviews.title: Was Better 3 Years Ago
reviews.text:
I returned to the resort after an extraordinary stay 3 years ago. It is just as beautiful as ever but I think the quality of food, service and infrastructure has slipped. The power went out several times in my room (and those of other guests I spoke to), there were issues with the key cards etc. I recall the restaurants on property being much better 3 years ago - all of them seemed relatively bland this time.

You won’t find a more beautiful beach resort anywhere, but this isn’t a spot for “foodies.”

reviews.author: Jodi G
reviews.title: Boni was a great server! Thanks Boni!
reviews.text:
Boni worked hard and kept us hydrated all day, every day! Thanks for all the encouragement to have more fun (drinks). 

The wait staff were all cheerful and kind. We enjoyed the beach and the pool here at Melia. ❤️

reviews.author: Traveler31756477420
reviews.title: Education Conference Visit
reviews.text: Our recent trip to Paradisys Palma Real was excellent. We actually checked in 2 days prior to our original reservation due to a weather pattern in Ohio. Staff was very helpful and accommodating. Our stay at The Royal Service was made very special by our Butler Richard. The bartender Wanda was very nice and friendly. Our room was very comfortable. Food at all sites was great except for restaurant Vento.

reviews.author: Wanderer02995035509
reviews.title: Punta Canada 2019
reviews.text: The Paradisus is an amazing resort. Attentive staff, very clean and a great size. Georges and the staff at the swim up bar were very very good. The resort is very well organized. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Dream18693887670
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Best resort I’ve ever stayed at. Food was amazing, beach was amazing, rooms were amazing, staff was amazing, size of resort was amazing and easily walkable anywhere; I would not change a thing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: michellegrossman1000
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation - excellent service and location!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus 2/9/19-2/15/19 with a wonderful group from my husbands work. It was the most wonderful vacation we have ever had! From the breathtaking views from the entrance of the resort to the amazing suite and the soft gorgeous beach area, we were in paradise from start to finish! All of the staff were so welcoming and friendly! It is one of the most beautiful places I have ever been! 

Our butler Yohel was extraordinary! He checked in with us multiple times each day to make sure we were taken care of and to see if he could do anything special for us. Each afternoon he had a fruit tray or chocolate covered strawberries delivered to our room for a refreshment after we had been out all day. He was so thoughtful and wonderful! 

At the beach Rafael was Fantastic! Every day he had a lounge set up and ready for us. We liked one kin the sun and one I. The shade and he was so accommodating! He continually checked in with us and brought us cool refreshing drinks. He was so kind and fun to be around. 

We had the wonderful opportunity to dine in each of the amazing restaurants at the resort. Our absolute favorite for breakfast and dinner was Palazzo. Everything they serves was beautifully played and tasted amazing. 

We were here over Valentine’s Day and everyone went out of their way to make it fun and romantic! They decorated our room with balloons and rose petals. And Yohel baked us a heart shaped cake! 

We ate at the buffet every day for a wonderful lunch (the best pizza ever!!) and our terrific server Yonira Sosa was so happy and sweet! She made our Valentines Day lunch romantic with flowers and heart suckers on our table. She was so sweet and wonderful to be around. 

We had such an amazing time. Every time we turned around we saw something beautiful and a happy smiling face to greet us. Thank you so much for a week in paradise!!

reviews.author: crokriguez
reviews.title: Conference Perk
reviews.text:
An excellent place to have a Winter Conference!

The beach was beautiful, the grounds were well maintained and super clean, my room was spacious and lovely. We had a wonderful team building conference and enjoyed our time at the Paradisus Palma Real! I wish all of our conferences were in such a luxurious setting.

reviews.author: Sunshine44856048701
reviews.title: MUY BUENO
reviews.text:
Excelentes instalaciones, limpio y con personal muy amable. 
Los restaurantes podrían cartas mas amplias, igualmente están muy buenos. 
El buffet es excelente!!
Nunca encontramos el snack bar, el buffet era tan bueno que no necesitamos buscarlo mucho :)

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.text: I recently came back from a trip at the Paradisus. The hotel is beautiful, situated right on the beach with views of the crystal clear water. The hotels offers options for both pool and beach lovers and lots of different restaurants to choose from. My group stayed as part of the Royal Service which I recommend if it's an option. I have to give credit to one of the highlights of the trip, Pedro, who manages the Royal Service beach area. He was an absolute joy, so accommodating and helpful. He saved beach chairs for our large group every day and was so kind and helpful no matter the request. You can tell how hard he works!

reviews.author: mourino1
reviews.title: Amazing Staff & Great Resort
reviews.text: We have been going to Punta Cana for many years. This was our first time to this resort. Food was excellent with incredible choices. What made it even better was the incredible staff all over the resort. We especially want to give a shout out to the pool bar and beach staff, Gregori Colon and Fernando always went out of their way to make sure that we were comfortable. They always helped us find lounge chairs, towels and of course our drinks. When Gregori & Fernando were taking their days off, they presented us to the next round of staff that was coming in. We are from Las Vegas, where service is king, so to say that we were impressed says a lot! We were there with over 600 people from our company. We know that it is overwhelming having so many people coming in and out on the same days.One of the chefs, Eulin Martinez always accommodated us. He was at the Rare Steakhouse one night and at Brisas on the beach the next day and prepared us the most amazing dishes!! We would go back to Paradisus in a heart beat thanks to the great service and staff!

reviews.author: Paradise34673555221
reviews.title: buena experiencia
reviews.text: buen trato  , si deberían mandar ofertas para las personas que ya los visitaron , mi correo es realmoyano@hotmail.com , me gustaría visitar otros países que tengan su cadena de hotel en cualquier parte del mundo

reviews.author: Khadeen L
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: The scenic environment, relaxing room, fantastic pool and invigorating resort activities all contributed to a very well enjoyed vacation. Thank you to your friendly staff for making our stay so wonderful.

reviews.author: Relax18231831689
reviews.title: La estadía, la genta que labora ahi es de excelente calidad y te hacen sentir mejor que en casa
reviews.text: El servicio y su gente es de máxima Calidad te hacen sentir y lograr descansar como lo desean brindandote los mejores servicios durante tu estadíaRecomendaria a mis familiares y amigos este lugar para viajar y hospedarse

reviews.author: Travel63519418487
reviews.title: Over Priced.
reviews.text: A beautiful, over priced hotel which serves high school cafeteria food buffet style.  Some of the rooms don't have hot water in the shower and are in disrepair. The all you can drink drinks are sugary concoctions made with cheap booze in your own coffee travel mug if you bring your own.  The House/ Club/Moby-type music plays loudly until 1am.  If you're looking to super size yourself on cheap food and booze and pay huge sums of money doing it, this is your place.  If you want quality, go somewhere else.

reviews.author: dauph77
reviews.title: Business sense
reviews.text: We just got back from paradisus and it was a great trip. We took customers down for a business trip. The staff and facilities we great. They accommodated our group very well. Samual was our point person and he was fantastic and helping get everything perfect. He puts everything into helping you out. I highly recommend going here for business trips. There is so much to do and a great staff to help out

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.title: True Paradise!
reviews.text: This place exceeded my expectations! It was like a palace in paradise. Service was INCREDIBLE! Treated SO well. Room service was there on time every morning! Butler Jose was beyond reliable and knowledgable. Good vibe and atmosphere. had a massage at spa by Hector who was Blind! First for me and best massage I have ever had in my entire life and i have been to several world class spas. Highly recommend this place. Will be back!

reviews.author: cathy
reviews.title: Great waitress
reviews.text: I loved this hotel and breakfast was fantastic. It was made even better by a wonderful waitress, Yuleidi Rosa. She was attentive and personable. She kept my coffee hot and always had a smile on her face. Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Tara D
reviews.title: Edison and Teudy
reviews.text: Teudy and Edison were absolutely wonderful. The best bartenders at the resort. Go see them for sure!!they made me the best Long Island Iced Tea’s without the Long Island !! My whole group was impressed by their knowyof the drinks we ordered.

reviews.author: 720kellyn
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Food
reviews.text:
Just got back from a site visit to Punta Cana.  The Paradisua Palma Royal did not disappoint!  It is a great property with exceptional service.  Armando, our Royal Service butler took very good care of us during our stay.  We had dinner in The Winery the first night.....food was from Rare and was so good. 
Everyone on the property is very friendly and always making sure you are happy and well taken care of!
Thanks so much for making our quick trip to the Dominican a pleasant one!

reviews.author: LanceMannion
reviews.title: Royal Service section very good, main section service was inconsistent
reviews.text:
Royal Service: the service was very good, especially Martin on the beach, Yoel our Butler, and the hostess at Palazzo most mornings (her name began with a Y). The room was nice albeit a bit outdated. I can not understand why they build some of these resort hotel rooms with a partially open wall between the bathroom and the rest of the room. In this hotel if you turn on the bathroom lights there is no way to shield some of the bright lights from shining on the bed where your partner may be sleeping, or trying to sleep. And if you are with someone that you would rather not see naked if will take some very conscious planning (your kids, a sister, etc.) as there are sizable gaps that can not be sealed.

In the main part of the hotel where the bulk of the restaurants are, service was spotty. Some great staff, and some pretty poor service. Some meals no one would refill water or coffee, service in Vento was outright BAD and several people we met said the same about Vento. No Chardonnay at all anywhere at the resort.

Wifi coverage was excellent everywhere, including on the beach.

The Beach is great!  Soft sand, swimmable water, nice for long walks. Pools were very nice. Overall, the facilities are beautiful, just the service is mixed. I am comparing this to Paradisus Playa Del Carmen where the facilities ar enot as beautiful but better maintained and the service by staff has been consistently outstanding on separate visits.

reviews.author: CM1
reviews.title: Great Beach Service
reviews.text: Just wanted to do a shout out to Yolando Pierre who was the beach server at the Paradisus Hotel. He was extremely thoughtful, prompt, accurate and made our stay even more enjoyable and special. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gabriel0114
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text:
Just want to say what a great experience I had here. Worth it all! I was here with work friends, and newly made friends. The food was great and so was the hospitality! The people and the environment were awesome! It’s honestly a place that if you want to meet a group of people to hang out with and build up that friendship and feel that chemistry, than this is the place for you. Not only that but the amenities they had were off the hook! I also want to give a special shout to Domingo Beltre who took care of me ASAP looking for my checked luggage and making sure it was where I needed it to be and a very special shout out to Benjamin the Artist. This guy is full of joy, love, and a huge talent. It was great working along side him at the School while painting that beautiful Mural for the kids. I have no regrets about this place and just go for it, we will be returning as a group soon! 

God bless!

reviews.author: 305angel661
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Would have loved to stay longer... but will return for a vacation for sure! The place was excellent and had every amenity I would love. Too bad as i said I was there only for 24 hours. But I guarantee that i will return for an extended period!

reviews.author: SSSS611
reviews.title: Amazing again
reviews.text: They really take care of folks here. Especially Luis F at the swim up bar and Daniel at the front desk. Solid beach, food and amenities. Would recommend again and again. Keeps renovating to stay relevant. Go Luis, you’re the best! #service

reviews.author: Voyager03457865504
reviews.title: Excellent Trip!!
reviews.text: Royal Service is unbelievable! Argenis our Butler made the trip very special. I have stayed in the DR before and nothing compares to this resort. We look forward to coming back again for another vacation!!

reviews.author: Brandonkhall
reviews.title: Amazing Service!!! Butler Service!
reviews.text: Our butler, Ariel, provided us the most amazing service without being overly intrusive. We can’t say how satisfied with the service and the overall experience we really are. This is truly paradise in every sense of the word. If you’re looking for a 5 star experience, look no further. Thank You Ariel for everything !

reviews.author: Patricia T
reviews.title: Experiencia Convencion
reviews.text: El hotel en general es bonito. La habitación no es moderna pero tiene variedad de restaurantes y espacios para pasarla genial. El servicio de los empleados es mediocre pero hay una que otra excepción.

reviews.author: thewineygrape
reviews.title: Francis is an amazing butler!
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in a Royal Service Garden View Suite and had an excellent time. I was only there for 2 nights but I would definitely go back and stay longer. From the moment I arrived everyone was smiling, happy and greeted me. I then met my butler, Francis, and he showed me to my room. He was so friendly (he opened my wine bottle for me because I am weak LOL) and funny. I ended up not feeling well one of the days, no not food related, and when I told Francis he came up to my room that evening and attempted to make a bubble bath for me! Unfortunately, the cold water was not working and doing only hot water would make me boil alive. He offered to send maintenance up right away but I told him not to bother as I have a shower and wasn't planning on using the tub anyways. The night before check out Francis sent me a message asking what time I would like the bell boys to come get my luggage and they were RIGHT ON TIME the next morning!

The food was excellent. The Royal Service buffet was the best buffet I have had when staying in the preferred/premier rooms. Lots of options, tasty and filling. The first night I was there there was a dinner show which was a lot of fun and the food there was even fantastic! My last night there I ate at Palazzo and it was some of the best Italian inspired food I have had. Portions were great, each course came out in a timely manner and they kept my wine glass full without me even asking.

I would absolutely stay here again and recommend it!

reviews.author: CATHERINE B
reviews.title: Estadía en The Reserve / Eventos
reviews.text: Gracias a todo el personal del hotel y de The Reserve por todas sus atenciones; sin embargo quiero elogiar a nuestra ejecutiva se eventos Elaine González quien siempre estuvo más que pendiente y dío la milla extra para que nuestro evento fuese todo un éxito. También quiero agradecer a Rocío, a los señores Raúl, Porfirio, Rosendo, Moisés y a todo el resto del personal.

reviews.author: ralphmiller2018
reviews.title: My Review of Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My wife and I had a great time while visiting the DR and would return and stay again at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort.  This was our first time staying at an all inclusive resort and we found that the accommodations were above par.  The food was great, the service was great, the atmosphere was great.  We were there for an awards trip and both agree that we would return for a personal trip.

reviews.author: victormitchell
reviews.title: Awesome resort
reviews.text: Royal Select/Oracle Select took this resort to a whole new level.  I look forward to visiting Paradisus Palma Real Golf & SPA Resort again soon.  My favorite part about Paradisus Plama Real was the Spa and massage, plus the Greek Hydro-Therapy!

reviews.author: peteandrews
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. staff was very helpful. However they would come in to our room even when the do not disturb sign was on the door. The bar and pool staff were top notch. The food was alright..

reviews.author: brendaferza
reviews.title: Home away from home!
reviews.text:
Last week I had the opportunity to stay at Paradisus Palma Real and my experience was beyond amazing!
From the arrival, to the check in at Royal Service, to great food and warm treatment, I just loved this property!
Great food at Naos! I was amazed of the variety for lunch! 
The beach is beautiful and the views are breathtaking.
The room was  very comfortable and my butler was the best part!
They do dinner reservations for you and take great care of you during your whole stay.
An AMAZING OPTION to stay in Punta Cana!
For business or pleasure is the best option!
Thanks Alain Velazquez for your attention to detail!!
Keep the good work!!
See you soon Paradisus Palma Real!!!!

reviews.author: brown433
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: I stayed here for a corporate event.  The resort was great.  The staff was extremely friendly, helpful, and polite.  The food at the buffet was very diverse and was very good.  And the meal I had at RARE was awesome.  The rooms were spacious and clean.  Access to the the pools and beach were very easy and convenient.  I would stay here again.

reviews.author: kkok2018
reviews.title: Relaxing, well maintained place
reviews.text: nice relaxing place with well maintained facilities. Food abundant with some good restaurants. Security is present to keep the place well watched. There is snorkeling, fishing and trip-line activity. Cocktails were well above standard and we keep going back for more. I will recommend to anyone who is considering this as a holiday.

reviews.author: BoardingPass102137
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: My wife and I recently attended a company event at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We came in early and decided to upgrade to the Royal service.  We have traveled a lot but have never stayed at all-inclusive.  I have to say we were very impressed.  The property was amazing and the Royal Service made it even better.  Having everything taken care of was well worth it.  We had Juan Carlos as our Buttler.  He was fantastic.  If you do ever have the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus Palma Real, I strongly suggest asking for Juan Carlos.  He went above and beyond and made our vacation memorable.

reviews.author: Ángel A
reviews.title: “Great Property for an Incentive Trip”
reviews.text:
What a great property to host an inventive trip. My team was on the resort for 7 full days and nights overseeing our incentive event. The entire Resort staff provided 5 Star Service. We experienced Royal Treatment and the attitude of, “we will never so no” The Resort is stunning with all the outlets available with food, bars, casino and even a night club. Wow! What more would anyone want. I want to personally acknowledge the following employees.

Security - Joventino and the entire Security team. I’ve worked with plenty of security teams Globally and I have admit, this team is by the BEST! Trained professionals. Also, recognition for Eduardo the overnight lead!! Great Job and his communication to me and my team. 

Conference Services - Samuel. What a Star!! Samuel was all over our program and never ever let us down. We would see him up and about around 7a.m. and departing late at night after every scheduled event!! 

Housekeeping - Great service! Always smiling and providing our rooms with service. However, I would invest in signage saying Caution - Wet Floor slippery when wet. When mopping was done, it felt like one was in an Ice Rink. 

Rooms - Room decore is outdated, room doors need major renovations as every door seems to not lock properly. Electronic key system outdated. Not sure if safelok or the bing system is being used. But, whichever system is in place needs a major update. Key cards would deactivate periodically causing major timely issues of having the keys re-activated. 

Overall - It’s a great destination and property.

reviews.author: Odyssey600603
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text: Recibimos un servicio excelente de Fidel en el restaurant Misu. Agradable, atento y con formidables atenciones al cliente. Fuimos un grupo de 10 personas y aun cuando nos retrasamos se acuerdo a la hora de la reserva para cenar, el trato de Fidel fue cordial y receptivo. Excelente experiencia

reviews.author: Sarmo
reviews.title: Eight visit , still great , But......
reviews.text:
this is our 8th visit and had a great time with some of our friend. this resort is still growing , every time we are there they are doing some improvement . having said that this also cause some dilemma!! So here we go with the review 

check in was okay  since they were working on the entrance, it was done at lower level ,  bell staff although they see you they just walk around as if you are invisible. after we told them we are Royal Service  we became visible. the check in was great  our butler ALBERTO  was AMAZING , and made sure  we are taking care of,  bottle of Champagne in the room  with fruits, hot tub with rose pedals, cheese tray , Cabana around the pool  with restaurant reservation and  also include to cover for the short come of other people and department .  main issue was with the newly renovated rooms  which the TV and safe   was   not working and remote control had a mind of its own ( who ever programed it, did not read the instruction ) and took a  day to get fixed. wash sink splashed water all over the place when you turned it on !!! and few other issues that seemed no one did checked to make sure  they are in a working condition.  luggage  came very late and when they came the  check in tags that bell staff put in when they arrived  it seemed to be a nightmare to get that glue and sticky papers off !!! very annoying , poor Alberto has to come in with steamer and  scrub it for 30 min or so. 
Rooms--- rooms were clean  with exception of the mentioned problems. there was also no continuity either , one night turn down , one night not  may be towels may be not , and please don't ask if there are two person In the room , for two wash towel , you only get one !!!!
 restaurants:
the Palazzo restaurant ---  diner there twice service was great food was amazing . Jean Carlos and Jose were great 
Rare restaurant --- very poor service and for the steakhouse the ribeye (5-7  person in our party ordered ) was like chewing on the rubber no taste ,  So glad there was a nice buffet next door to go to !!:(
venti --- great food and service specially after the night before at Rare , Danny was great, great food service etc.
Nao--  breakfast and lunch buffet was great love the variety , and quality of the food as well as presentation . Staff , Davidson, Juan,  Maria  and many more were great and accommodating .
 staff at the royal club designated pool were great luis, gerinaldo, lee  made sure we are well taken care of . Please note there are only 7 cabanas around the pool  so don't expect just because you are in royal services you can get one every day !! please  share 
spa--- was great ( at preserve) 
the only other annoying thing was a presence of a loud group (total relaxation )   which  took over the pools and had an obnoxious loud music for many hours and it was so annoying 
Entertainment ---- usually they used to have some themed shows which they did not have it while we were there. but the entertainment group did a nice job at night  at Gabi beach bar area .

reviews.author: Jose Luis F
reviews.title: 24 hours perfect stay
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of staying at this hotel for a short business dinner meeting.
Couldnt be more perfect
I stayed at Royal Service section, just the perfect example of how exquisit luxury service has to be.
Great private check in at an awesome luxury lounge.
My buttler scorted me to my suite, clean, big, luxury suite with beautiful views to the beach
All kind of details were placed to welcome me.
7pm dinner at the Winery Restaurant. Oh my God. That Restaurant is Amazing! Service, ambiance, food and wine. 
Just 24 hours at Paradisis Palma Real that made me feel like ome week holiday perfect stay 
Definetely this is a real luxury hotel to stay. Dont need more than 24 hours to realyze it is
Gracias Paradisus Palma Real!!

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.title: Poca organización
reviews.text: Antes había mejor servicio, los colaboradores muy pocos se muestran contentos de servirnos. Buenas instalaciones si... nos dijeron una habitación que ya estaba ocupada. Es buen hotel, mejoren esos detalles.

reviews.author: Ruben C
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel and Staff
reviews.text: Our expectations were all met and beyond from the time we arrived until the time we left. The staff was exceptional especially our butler and friend “Argenis”.  The food included with the Royal service was fantastic and the mimosa’s were the best we’ve had. The only disappointment was all the seaweed on the beach which also had a smell although the entire experience was wonderful.

reviews.author: eli795
reviews.title: Sure Paradisus is the perfect name
reviews.text: I had to spend one week for business reasons and could enjoy full experience and that is one in a million, which I’ll always remember with great joy! I had the chance to see the absolutely unbelievable shows they organise for coffee breaks, lunch and dinner with many artists including top musicians, singers and performers of all disciplines. They sure know how to make your event unique and the overall stay awesome, never wanting to leave! The list of reasons that makes this resort so amazing and authentic is really long, cause everything surpasses any expectation! But indeed the best of it a part from the beach, location, pool with bar in the water, restaurants, huge rooms with jacuzzi, drinks and a far too long etc is The Service: extremely well coordinated to the very detail, helpful and nice!! THANK YOU. You sure want to visit it at least once in a lifetime, cause despite I have seen many places, this is top of the top!

reviews.author: ajferreiras
reviews.title: My Punta Cana experience
reviews.text: Great memories!!! Great experience!!! Runs like a fine tuned machine!!! Likely to continue traveling to this destination!!! Staff were very helpful and very welcoming. Mission accomplished. Food was delicious, events well organized, fun and affordable activities.

reviews.author: Sherry H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We travel quite often to Punta Cana for business and pleasure. This was one of the nicer resorts that we have stayed in. Very clean friendly service. Our room was in a great location close to the pool and beach. I highly suggest this hotel/resort for anyone.

reviews.author: Sherry H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We Enjoyed staying at this resort. We were here on business with a group of 100 people. Food was good company nightlife was good, Pool was very nice. My only complaint was how far away the rooms were from the beach.

reviews.author: Carla F
reviews.title: Business and Pleasure
reviews.text:
While the hotel was clean, beautiful, great grounds, and awesome pool, our fabulous experience came from the staff. We met professional people who treated us like queens. From our waiters/waitress, to pool staff to sommelier, to cleaning staff to bartenders, to every single person who helps you have the time of your life.  To call out those that helped have a trip of a lifetime, here are the people who deserve a shout out:
Beach Concierge - Fernando Gonzales, courteous, professional and aims to please. Abraham Torrez, Waiter Extraordinaire, made sure our dinner and breakfast were exactly what we wanted with best view possible.   Louis the bartender was a personal favorite, he was very helpful with suggestions of drinks and made sure we knew what time the entertainment started.  Nixon, was helpful with hotel activities and everyday he tried to make sure we knew what activities we could attend for the afternoon.  The tennis lesson and clinic was spectacular!!   Get down there and enjoy yourself!  Thanks to everyone who made our trip great and don't forget the Pool Concierge, Risarys, she was awesome.  My only hope is that they (hotel) would give more Waitress positions to women.  We had a female waitress at Aqua one evening and she was fantastic.  More of that is a good thing.  Peace and love to all at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: gkorona
reviews.title: GJK
reviews.text: Attended a conference & the resort was very adept at handling the large crowd.  Very friendly staff, good food & variety, nice beach.  Overall well done!  Threw a wonderful beach party for 550 people - nice stage & very well organized (portable bar, food, ice cram, dancers, music).

reviews.author: Dayanara O
reviews.title: Mucho que mejorar...
reviews.text: Tenía muchas expectativas respecto a este hotel ya que me habian hablado muy bien pero la verdad es que esperaba mucho más... Empezaré por lo bueno... Me gusta la vista de la playa inmediatamente llegas a recepción, la habitación que me tocó estuvo bien, la cama muy cómoda y el personal del area muy atento... Peroooo... de inicio fué MUY confuso encontrar dicha habitación, me pareció complicada la señalización de las villas, es como caminar en un laberinto... La comida “buena” aunque nada del otro mundo, el servicio en el buffet muy deficiente quizás por falta de personal (mesas sucias, falta de cuberteria, mucho tiempo de espera para encontrar algún lugar donde sentarse, recibir un café o un vaso con agua)... Lo peor, muchas historias  de robos (celulares, dinero en efectivo) en las habitaciones y hasta un atraco DENTRO DE LA HABITACIÓN de una compañera... Obviamente estas situaciones son alarmantes y por ello considero este un lugar no recomendado y al que no pienso volver...

reviews.author: evan1429
reviews.title: LADRONES EN ESTE HOTEL
reviews.text: En este hotel existen ladrones, recientemente asistimos a un congreso de médicos especialistas y a tres de mis colegas le robaron en sus habitaciones dinero. Una pareja fue asaltada dentro de su habitación en medio de la noche tremendo susto se llevaron. Cuidado cuando lo visiten no hay seguridad. Olvide mencionar el celular de otra de la doctoras fue robado en uno de los baños. Este hotel daña la imagen de los hoteles en mi país.

reviews.author: yorosey
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: I didn’t get much time to enjoy or explore the resort as I was only there for 1 night for a company function and my flight was cancelled. It seemed very nice and my room was massive. I am not sure if it is a DR thing or if it was because I was part of a corporate event, but I found the staff to not be very friendly/helpful. I found it very odd that I almost never saw anyone by pool or on the beach. The only meal I had there was on the beach for work function but did go to breakfast buffet but chose not to eat anything as it didn’t look that good to me.

reviews.author: Joseph Y
reviews.title: DON’T GO TO THE SPA - WASTE OF MONEY!!
reviews.text:
1. My first suggestion is to inform your guests to allow at least 1/2 before massage to get there and check in.  I was not informed that the Spa was a significant distance from the main hotel building.  So allow for walking or taking a golf cart and filling out forms and checking in.
2.  By the time I realized it was ways away it was 1:50pm - I got there right at around 2:03pm.  But there was no sense of urgency - everyone took their time. I finally met my therapist at around 2:20pm.  
3. The facility itself is open air - even the changing rooms!  So I was already sweating and hot when I met my masseuse. Don’t understand that at all given the humid weather. 
4. Therapist confirmed a deep tissue massage; walked me into the room (which was air conditioned - yay) and instructed me to disrobe and position myself face down on the massage table, which is normal.  But I t took her longer than I’m used to to return to the room. Again, just super slow - no urgency given the $3 a minute rack rate.
5. No pre-massage interview to confirm any problem areas, my my previous experience with massages, or any special instructions from me. She just got started.
6. She started with putting her hand underneath my face so that I could smell the eucalyptus oil.  The smell of her hands from previous massages where not pleasant and contrasted with the oil.  Then she began in the left leg and essentially spent the first 10 minutes lathering oil up and down my leg with very little massaging going on. 
7. After a while, I asked if she could move on and focus on my lower back (to give her a hint that what she was doing was adding no value) and she said that it was an 80 minute massage (I.e. I’ll get to it eventually) and got a bit annoyed at the suggestion. 
8. But this was unfortunately how the entire massage went. 10% massage and 90% rubbing oil up and down that area of the body. 
9.  When she got to my hands and feet, she did not take the time to individually massage each finger and toe as I am used to and to take her time with these important areas.  She just quickly rubbed a couple of fingers and moved on. Same with the feet - she focused on my arch but not the entire foot.  
10. There is too much additional detail to provide but there isn’t enough space here to provide it.  
11.  Enjoy the property but don’t waste your money on the Spa.

reviews.author: TrevA77
reviews.title: Nice hotel but staff not that friendly
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel for a conference for work. The work function was only three days, but I added on an extra two days at the beginning of the trip for a total of 4 nights / 5 days. The hotel was clean and stylish. My standard room was large with separate living/sleeping rooms. The furniture was a bit dated. The couch was incredibly uncomfortable. I think it was a pull out bed, but I couldn't even sit on it, so I couldn't imagine sleeping on it. 

The pools were incredible but close at 6pm. It was very hot, so I spent much of my time in the pool under a shaded cabana overhanging the water and making my way back and forth to the swim-up bar. 

The swim up bar, lobby bar, and beach bar were all quite good, with an excellent selection of liquors, juices, and blended drinks. The alcohol seemed to be watered down, as they would mix the drinks 50/50, but they didn't taste that strong. That's probably a good thing as it kept me from getting too drunk :)

The main reason for my overall poor rating of the hotel was the staff. At other 4 and 5 star resorts I have stayed at, the staff go out of their way to make sure I am having a good time. Here, they didn't seem to care one way or the other. None of them were rude, but they didn't do the simple things like saying hello when I pass by or checking on me while I was eating at the buffet to see if I need anything. In fact, every buffet meal I had to wave someone down for a coffee, juice or other drink. And even then, they often said they were getting it but never came back. I also noticed that when walking towards a staff member, rather than them getting out of my way, I would always need to step aside for them to pass. Not a big deal, but it took away from the 'pampered' experience they tout on their website. 

Another problem for me was the lack of English speaking employees. There were a few employees that spoke English well, but most of them didn't speak any or spoke very little English. I understand this is a Spanish speaking country so there is no requirement that they speak any English, but I don't speak much Spanish, so it was difficult for me. In my many other experiences traveling to all-inclusive resorts that cater to international tourists, most everyone spoke English quite well, so I was surprised here. 

Overall, I had a good time, but would not go back.

reviews.author: Dominique M
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text:
It was a work trip! Well let me tell you something, it was a job to remember!
The resort is immaculate, the service is exceptional, and the location is beautiful!
I am not one for all inclusive resort, but I have to admit that not having to worry about anything was great for a change.
the room I stayed in was remodeled and beautiful, although my colleague was a bit more "antic" looking! (I also had a Nespresso machine, and she did not!) The house keeping staff was always there ready to help, and in the multiple restaurants it was pretty much the same! The lunch and breakfast buffet was very diverse and original as well! I had sushi everyday. The other restaurant were very pleasant and good.
The only negative was the amount of seaweed on the beautiful white sand beach, but it is not their fault!
All in one, I highly recommand this beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: Christian O
reviews.title: Platinum Trip
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort through a work incentive trip which recognized peak sales performance for 2017! I brought my best friend with me.  From the moment we arrived, we were treated like royalty! At the main lobby their were staff members waiting to give us massages and pamper us after our flight.  They massages were a nice treat and the service was exceptional. 

We were paired with Nicolas, our butler extraordinaire during the trip.  I highly, highly recommend Nicolas.  He was extremely dynamic and upbeat and made my companion and I feel like celebrities.  He went above and beyond to help us book the best restaurants that the resort had to offer and made sure that our room and our clothes were immaculate during our stay! We love you Nicolas!!!

The excursions were also amazing! On our first day we did the Hoyo Azul Sennanote excursion (blue lagoon).  The landscape and scenery was like a painting.  The water was crystal blue and clear and the park itself was well maintained and had a plethora of beautiful, exotic animals. 

We also did the catamaran excursion which was another favorite of ours. We had the opportunity to bond with the other folks who won the award trip and enjoy complimentary food, drinks and dancing on the beautiful water. Loved it!

The Yhi Spa was exceptional. Another highlight.  We indulged in full body massages that left us relaxed after being in the Caribbean Sun!

All in all, an amazing experience, made even better by the fabulous staff at the resort! Gracias:)!

reviews.author: Jeff A
reviews.title: Financial advisor
reviews.text: We had a great experience at the resort. The service was excellent. One butler Armando was great in making sure our room was in excellent condition and helped get everything we needed. I would highly recommend this resort

reviews.author: Nate M
reviews.title: Amazing time!
reviews.text: So beautiful here and all of the staff was friendly. Deivi Silverstre was exceptional at recommending the best scuba trip I’ve ever been on! had a great time at the beaches and the water was perfect as well!

reviews.author: mbl0mberg
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort!  Amazing service
reviews.text: This resort is amazing. The beach is beautiful.  The food has been excellent - with amazing variety. The service is 2nd to none. My husband and I played tennis - they drove us down in a golf cart and offered us water and towels as soon as we got there. It's hot here so we needed it!  They happily drove us back the short distance across the hotel property. The pool is enormous here - you can either find a tranquil corner or fun at the pool bar. We bunked up at a pool cabana and one of the resort employees, Nixon, came by and played Connect four with us. He beat me twice and won my husband's employee a day off by beating my husband 4 out of 6 games!  (Connect four can be a betting game). I highly recommend all aspects of this resort and would gladly come back!

reviews.author: Russ M
reviews.title: Give all 5 senses a great vacation!
reviews.text:
Our company has an annual trip for the top sales performers across the country, this year we chose the Paradissus Palma Real as our destination this year and what a great choice!

The entire experience begins with the breath taking views you take in as soon as you get out of your cab ( see attached photos). These are the same type of views and amazing scenery shots we often see on computer screen savers or post cards!  No photo shop or touched up pictures- the sky really is the perfect blue and the ocean actually has those multiple shades of green and blue that you have dreamt of!

The Facility is well very clean, well kept, and has a large and expertly trained staff that appears to be predicting your every need and delivering it just when you need it.  No matter who or where you are.

The cuisine is also Outstanding!  With a great variety of tastes and choices and the freshest ingredients for every tastebud- from sushi, to seafood, steak, to pasta and everthing else you could want- all the way up to the 3 Star Michelin rated Passions restaurant where you will be treated to a 7 course experience that will be like nothing else you have ever experienced!  Only an artist can creat such masterful flavors that awaken every taste bud you have and often doing so all in the same course!

Many of our employees commented that this was our best destination EVER ( I have been to 24 different trips and this place ranks in the top three ( all three owned by this same family of properties too!) no doubt I will be returning with my family over the winter so that my kids can enjoy the total experience themselves!  Just the smell of the soaps and shampoos they supply offer me a sense of calm and relaxation the elludes me in my normal daily life!!

My experience was additionally enhanced after accidentally leaving my room safe open when it was holding my travel cash, credit cards and some of my wife’s jewelry.  The hotel had procedures to safeguard the contents and with the help of Katery and Vladimir, we were able to thank the housekeeping staff who took the steps to make sure the contents were safeguarded and save me from a miserable lesson in hotel security protocols.  What peace of mind!!

Overall, whether you are looking for a relaxing and romantic trip away with your spouse, an amazing all inclusive and exotic vacation for your group trip or a family spot to enjoy the most picturesque location you have ever seen- this property is a sure thing for a successful time away!!!

You will have nothing but praise from your family or  group for booking this place!!!

reviews.author: Ryan F
reviews.title: My trip to punta cana
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice the food is very good i made friends with nixon and reynaldo they are my Dominican brothers they kept me intertaind  the beach is pretty good the show. Ill have to come back soon

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Beautiful at First View
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days at this all-inclusive resort.  The trip was for a business meeting but we arrived a few days early to get in some 'relaxing' time. As the title says, the resort is beautiful, perfect beach location but there were many little things that took down my ratings to Average.

Our first SURPRISE was that the 3 story villa that our room was in had no elevator. It wasn't that we had to carry our bags up, that is done by the staff, but 3 flights up and down several times a day is a bit much. They were able to move us to a 1st-floor room. The only building that did have an elevator in the main building and it was not in operation.  If you have bad knees this is NOT the place to stay.

Food: We only went to a few of them as we had 2 nights of company functions. 

The buffet, NAOS, excellent. Good selection except they did not have any bagels for the cream cheese and smoked salmon. For breakfast, they have many stations where they can prepare eggs, fresh fruit juice station too.  Lunch, well the burgers are NOT of the same quality of meat I am used to and have a funny flavor. they have a good selection of other items. We stuck to salads and the fish chef was very kind to grill up some shrimp for us.  We did not go to the buffet for dinner but did stop by for dessert.  Hint, you can ask a latte, they do not tell you they are available.  The coffee is probably the best 'over the counter' I have had. It is not brown water.  The only real complaint is that they do not serve food all day long. 

OLIO is where you can get food when the Buffet is closed. Lunch selection was not great, burgers, hot dogs, Pizza, and salad. Probably great for kids.

Dinner, the first night we went to the - we thought it was a sushi restaurant but it was really a teppanyaki restaurant that served some sushi. NOT a place to have a quiet meal and we were told that it would be hours waiting if we wanted a table by ourselves as we did not make a reservation!  Food was typical teppanyaki, so-so flavor. The 'show' of throwing knives was too long and NOISEY! 

Our best meal was at BRI SAS .... we finally found Sushi and it was unique and delicious.  Even though it is listed as limited to RESERVE guests we were able to make a reservation there.

Last night we ate at RARE, a steakhouse, Again the quality of beef is not the same as in the USA. We both ordered a Rib Eye and it was very fatty. And the flavor wasn't what I am used to.

Pool Bar, not enough bartenders! Beach towel station, only 1 and it was not central to the pool. 

Spa, my wife went there 3 times and it was average. We had a couples massage and it was nothing to rave about. I did hear from one from our group that there is a blind masseuse, one male and one female that are incredible. We did have to take a golf cart to the RESERVE for these services.

Beach, it was populated by a good number of covered lounge chairs and there is a separate area with much nicer lounges for the upgraded guests. Local vendors do patrol the open sand area before the water but did not appear to be pushy.  There is a sign that says they are rebuilding the beach area and that is why the sea grass is not cleaned up. 

Some areas that need correction.  Floor outlets in the meeting rooms when not in use have no covers.  My wife fell when her heel caught the recess.  She was not hurt but could have been.  There were several other areas in the resort that have uneven transitions from cement to wooden walkways.  

One thing that upset many in the group was the 'vendors' that walked around the pool areas trying to get you to sign up for a trip or parasailing or some other activity. That was a nuisance. Also, there is a Vendor night and those people are very pushy, the jewelry seller ... well, let me just say his prices were stupidly high as were the cigar seller.  The onsite store was selling an insulated cup that water leaked into the 'sealed' area.  I went to return it and get a refund for a defective item and they would only give me store credit. The clerk took the cups and handed me back the receipt without indicating I returned the items and had a credit... I made her correct that... BUT when I went back a day later I had to wait while several clerks looked at the receipt and then she had to make a call. I ended up leaving a 'credit balance' with them as my purchases did not equal my credit and there was no indication they would give me cash or credit to my CC. 

Service by waiters, bellmen etc was very good. That was probably the best thing about the resort.

Overal the resort was nice, if I go back to Punta Cana I would select a different place to get a different feel.

reviews.author: dsemraurn
reviews.title: We love Nixon and Antonio!
reviews.text:
We just returned yesterday from 5 wonderful days at your resort. My husband was there for business with some colleagues who also brought along their wives. We were blessed with lots of free time to enjoy your restaurants (Rare was our favorite), the YHI spa for a wonderful couples massage, the adorable little wine bar, and your delightful pools. 

But I must say that Nixon and Antonio from your entertainment staff were the most memorable part of our stay. We met them down at the Gabi beach bar one night and they danced with our group, made us laugh and smile, and were so fun to be around. They both always had the biggest genuine smiles on their faces whenever we would see them throughout our stay and would greet us with a fist-bump or high five. Nixon even played connect four with our friend for quite a while. You truly have an engaging and hardworking group of guys there and we are so thankful to have met them!

reviews.author: derrik l
reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: 7 years ago when i visited the DR I swore I would never return. getting sick and the extremely poor service along with poor food choices..there are too many wonderful places in the world to enjoy. My partners/friends convinced me to join them at the Paradisus for a week of recharge and golf. It was excellent. Attentive staff, beautiful buildings, great food (some of the best sushi/sashimi I can remember eating at any resort I have been to). Beach is long and wide, pools are clean, plenty of beach chairs. Upgrade to Royal service well worth it.  Even when the horde of 1160 Americans descended on the resort  2 days before I left, the staff politely and efficiently dealt with the sun burned alcohol poisoned demanding conventioners. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Seaside747844
reviews.title: On Vacation and business
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royal Service and our butler Yohelvi was amazing made our stay very rememberable for us. Our towel butler Rafael put as in front so we had a beautiful view of the gorgeous beach. He served us with dry towels on our cabana beds and cold drinks with a great smile and personality. I enjoyed watching Pedro how he served his people he too is a fantastic towel butler and was very helpful to us. We love it here with the Royal Service and the food is excellent. Our favorite restaurant here was the buffet. The food was excellent and have great chefs making it have a taste to enjoy. We love the Royal Service and you will love all the attention that you are getting feeling like a king and Queen. We will be back next year or in 7 months.

reviews.author: Seaside747844
reviews.title: Pleasure
reviews.text: This is my and my husband’s favorite all-inclusive resort! Our butlers Yohelvi and Eduardo were very attentive and helpful. Our towel guy Rafael was great at helping us get great seats by the ocean. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lori J
reviews.title: Week long beach party
reviews.text: There were safety concerns regarding the first room we were in and the hotel graciously moved us to another room.  The hotel was beautiful, the pool and beaches were clean and inviting and the staff was amazing!  Daniel del Carmen went out of his way the entire week to make sure we were comfortable and taken care of.

reviews.author: Donald J B
reviews.title: Pentair Trip
reviews.text: We had a ground floor room facing the south just off of the pool. The room was nicely furnished, had a great bed, tiled walk-in shower and a jetted tub which we didn't use. The refrigerator was not real cold and they didn't restock it after I drank the pop during the week. The pool was great and so was the service at pool side wouldn't have had to even venture down to the beach. It was nice we could use 2 towels for the chairs so that the whole chair was covered and the towels were nice. didn't have a bad meal at any of the resturaunts that we ate at. I had a great time

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful hotel.  The staff is amazing.  I want to personally thank Zenovia for taking such good care of me and my family during our stay.  She went out of her way to make sure we were taken care of in every aspect.  She is an amazing person and a great employee.

reviews.author: Nidia M
reviews.title: Gran Mega Concurso Inter Empresas!
reviews.text:
Estoy en el desarrollo del Mega Concurso Empresarial por el aniversario de los 35 años de mi Corporación. Estoy muy satisfecha con la calidad y ambiente del hotel. La integración de su bella arquitectura clásica de acogedor ambiente con una maravillosa playa, verdadera joya de la gran franja blanca que es Punta Cana. 

La variedad y calidad de los restaurantes es un diferenciado definitivo.

El evento está a cargo de Yinette Peña, Conference Service Manager, ejecutiva que con su calidad profesional y simpatía está cumpliendo cabalmente nuestras expectativas.

Gran hotel! Recomendado ampliamente para los  grandes eventos de inolvidables historias.

reviews.author: Mottin1055
reviews.title: Very clean hotel
reviews.text: we were there with a group.  i would say that the indoor dinners were better than than the outside buffets.  there were several pools ranging from a very loud party pool to very quiet smaller pools.  there were always people working there.

reviews.author: SFphile
reviews.title: Beautiful beach and great service!
reviews.text:
Spent five nights at the Paradisus Palma Real, Nov 28th - Dec 3rd. Best beach I've ever been to. Miles of white powdery sand, calm water to swim in and perfect weather!

Popped up every morning to swim at sunrise. Planted ourselves under big shady palapas where we had excellent concierge service from George Alriche every day who brought out towels to reserve our spots, kept our ice bucket full of waters and/or our hands full of cocktails.

Lunch at the Bri Sas sushi bar... plates and plates of sashimi every day!

A great place to relax for five days!

reviews.author: Cristian M
reviews.title: Excelente atención
reviews.text: Muy bien atendidos preocupados en todo momento, gente muy amable. El mayordomo Francis si preocupación es admirable.. se pasa increíble, segunda vez que voy y las mejores experiencias. Las piscinas adecuadas, los restaurant espectacular, el service room funciona a la perfección. Solo escribí cosas positivas porque así ha sido mi experiencia

reviews.author: herenciaa
reviews.title: Should be better, but is HARD for them to make the EFFORT
reviews.text:
I spent the weekend At ILCO 2017's convention in the P Palma Real and It was quite "a little bit better" than my previous family weekend at the Caribe Tropical.

The hotel was practically empty, but the Reservation Department preferred to assigned the FAREST and UNDER MAINTANANCE rooms to some of us. Almost at the border of the two hotels.

The only available hotel buffet is, literally, AMAZING: LACK of EVERYTHING.

They offer 24/7 Room Service with a minimum variety and besides, charges you US$5.00 for "Service". Remember, this is a "5 star" ALL INCLUSIVE hotel.

The gels+soaps will be the only thing you'll find at the bathroom. Ahhh, TEARED towels / hard beds and pillows and do you remember when the flat TVs showed at the hotels, these are the FIRST ones. I spent more time trying to swap channels pressing the buttoms than watching TV. Los Philips TV. Very.

Again, as a Melia member, I truly recomend you: there are WAY MUCH better options for you to visit and spend top dollars. But, if you have LOW QUALITY requirements, this place is for you.

Also flies and mosquitoes. Great.

Enjoy the pictures. Ta-ta!!!

reviews.author: Ramon Armora
reviews.title: Awesome destination
reviews.text: Estuve en palma real hace unas semanas atras con una convencion de medicos y la verdad que el servicio y la comida son excelentes. Cabe mencionar a Niela y Raquel por parte de grupos, las cuales siempre estuvieron siempre dispuestas ante cualquier cambio o necesidad durante la convención. Espero volver pronto con mi familia a pasar unos dias alla.

reviews.author: Viejoby
reviews.title: This hotel stinks!!!!
reviews.text:
The service is very bad, bad attitude from almost 100% of the staff.
No lunch or snack bar they just close everything from 2 to 6 pm and tough luck is the attitude of the employees.
The room’s maintenance needs a lot of improvement.
The checkout was a pain we could not even get the invoice done correctly.
The pool hours are absurd, kids tough luck again.

reviews.author: mrkjcoleman
reviews.title: Lordco trip
reviews.text:
We've been home for 3 weeks & still can't stop saying enough about this fabulous resort!  Traveling just after Hurricane Maria ravaged the area was a bit of a concern but when we got to the resort everything was cleaned up.   We were part of a large (~1200) group so we were amazed at how organized the staff were, and everyone was so friendly & helpful.  
The food was delicious, no matter where we went!   Naos was the most extensive buffet we'd ever been too & had so much variety it was hard to try everything!   We also dined at Fuego, Passion, Palazzo, Mizu Teppanyki & Olio.   Every meal we had was fresh, tasty & well presented.   
We had the most delightful Butler, Zenovia Nova - I called her my angel!   We were truly looked after; dinner reservations, delicious treats left in the room, and attentive service without being intrusive. On 2 occasions we returned to the room after being out all day & there was a bubble bath waiting, one with flowers in & around the tub, making for a very romantic setting.  Zenovia's smile always brightened our day and the resort is lucky to have such an amazing employee.
Our days spent at the pool were made more enjoyable with George Alriche ensuring that we had everything we needed.   Zenovia took me out to introduce me to George and said that he would look after us and that he did!!   George always greeted us with a smile, remembered our names & what drinks we liked.  Excellent service along with a cheerful & efficient manner, that is what George provided. 
We'd also like to recognize Jesus in the Olio restaurant where we had breakfast on several occasions.  Jesus was always quick to bring us coffee, water & clear the table, taking his duties seriously as we tried to bridge the language barrier!!   
The evening bartenders at the lounge by Olio were 2 very energetic and engaging women who made us wonderful drinks & late night cappuccinos!   When we asked if one of them would take pictures of us with our friends, we discovered a budding photographer who arranged our poses and had us laughing as she angled for the right shot!  I'm sorry that I don't  recall their names, but we enjoyed the time we spent there with them. 
Finally,  I couldn't not mention this amazing customer service.   On the 2nd day of our stay we asked Zenovia if there was a possibility of getting a diet Sprite for our mini bar as my husband is diabetic.  Although the mini bar had Coke Light he prefers Sprite.   Zenovia spoke to her Manager, Gabrial (?) and found out that the Resort did not have any Sprite Light.  He called us down to the desk to meet with us & to apologize.  He said that they had actually gone into town to check out the 2 Supermarkets but they were only able to find Sprite Zero.  As this was actually what we usually bought we said that would be preferable.   Again an apology as the stores were now closed but that they would get it for us in the morning.  The next day it was delivered to our room with a note stating that if we needed more to just ask.   We were thoroughly impressed with this level of customer service! 
We had a wonderful vacation, the hotel is magnificent, the scenery spectacular, and the staff were fabulous!  Would definitely say that this was a vacation in paradise and look forward to returning again one day.

reviews.author: ianco2017
reviews.title: GREAT All-Inclusive experience
reviews.text: I was a guest the last week of September of this year and had a great experience.  The food was excellent, resort second to none and service was probably the best I have experienced.  There was always someone looking to help you out with whatever it is you were looking for and my concierge, Suly was very helpful with keeping me on track with my schedule and any other item I needed during my stay.  Luis provided a very high level of service at the pool bar as well.  I hope I get the chance to go back here for another visit.  Great Resort!

reviews.author: julioj832
reviews.title: EL MEJOR RESORT DE PUNTA CANA
reviews.text: Todo es perfecto. El mejor resort de Punta cana. Los empleados todos amables, siempre saludan y todos hablan inglés como mínimo. La comida 5 estrellas, un lujo. La edificación y distribución permite que todo esté cerca.

reviews.author: Candace E
reviews.title: Royal services
reviews.text: The best thing about this place is the beach & the staff ! My personal “Butler” was Ariel Benzo , he made my trip wonderful ! Had a bubble bath with roses many times after spending the day at the beach . I was a little sick one day and the staff went above to make sure I was well & always comfortable ! The staff helped make my trip as enjoyable and stress free as possible !

reviews.author: Rachelle O
reviews.title: Lordco 2017
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort. Food was good, service was good. 
I do want to mention two amazing men at the Exclusive pool and beach. Martin Tineo and Carlos Rosario took very good care of us.
I found parts of the resort dated and in need of some attention, but I am a very picky traveller.

reviews.author: My Info M
reviews.title: Great beach, booze, resort!
reviews.text:
This huge resort offers it all. From grey goose and patron, to pool games and bingo, to room service and clean modern rooms. Great views, and water pressure. Room has auto set AC that we could not set to be colder. Beautiful balconies facing ocean, fell asleep a few times out here listening to waves. No bugs to bother. 
Food was amazing! Lobster, steak, pork, chicken and all local sides were fresh and delicious. 
Service was out standing.
Pool views and miles of white sand clean beach, no rocks, no seaweed.
Spa was one of the best I've experienced Massage, hair salon, and nails.
Decorated room for Birthday celebration free of charge. 
Plenty of chairs or cabanas free to use, and staff to offer sunscreen to protect against sun burn. 
Room mini bar stocked daily. 
Business meeting rooms were impeccable, and all sound system worked seamlessly. 
Plenary of bottled water available.
Preferred club was a nice upgrade.
Buffet was casual dining, no wait, no worry.
Entertainment was good, handmade cigars, and Micheal Jackson show. Check in and check out was a breeze.
Will return for more great times in Punta Cana Paradisus palma reel the best of all 3 sister resorts. Great beach, great food, & top self booze. Worth every penny. Very little locals on beach, very laid back & nice clean area to walk to shops and restaurants on beach.

reviews.author: cchafe
reviews.title: Beautiful people at a beautiful resort
reviews.text: We have just returned from 10 days at The Reserve.  We were a bit nervous about possible damage due to Hurricane Maria, but were overwhelmed with the beauty of the resort! It was as if Maria had never stopped by for a visit.  Pool service was amazing with Gabriel Garcia, he stopped by often to make sure we had everything we wanted.  Tip:  try the fried chicken!! We had some from the bufett and were craving more! Gabriel arranged with the chef to have some prepared for us every day after that for lunch.  Wow, so impressed, he couldn't have tried any harder to make our stay special!  Willie at the pool bar was warm and welcoming, sharing stories of his family and was truly a pleasure to get to know.  The staff working the Gabi restaurant were very attentive - special shout outs to Virginia Alvarez and Alexander Ozona.  Lorenzo Michel made wonderful eggs cooked to order and helped with a few spanish words upon request.  There is truly so many staff that made this trip special as well - Domingo Espinosa, Victor Mateo, Angel Robles - thank you for your excellent service. One con - we were in a master suite, (if you can - stay in one - OMG amazing!),  the bathroom has two parts to it - one of the lights in front of the shower was burnt out making the room quite dark.  I requested the light bulb be replaced four times without success.  I gave up as I was already in paradise, the light bulb was such a little thing to worry about!  Golf carts were always available for a quick ride to the main hotel and the beach - white fluffy sand, and kept very clean by resort grounds crew.  Bravo The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana - I am already missing you and hoping to return soon.

reviews.author: Orianne J
reviews.title: Excellent Resort, Awesome People, Pristine Beach!
reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of recently staying at The Reserve at Paradisus last week.  We were part of a very large group that booked out both this resort and the Paradisus Palma Real.  The resorts were very clean, the service was awesome, the staff were all very professional, polite, and always smiling.  The pools here are huge and awesome at one resort, yet smaller and intimate at the other.  Just loved everything about this hotel stay.  The staff at Gabi buffet were incredible...Angel Robbs, Lorenzo Michel, Virginia, Pedro...and all the other wait staff were so great each day.  Food was delicious and the variety was superb!  Oh ya - and lets not forget our shuttle drivers - taxi-ing us back and forth numerous times a day....always smiling! 
Great resort thru and thru!

reviews.author: Mar
reviews.title: beaches damage awesome
reviews.text:
a large group of us went to paradisus resort 1200 to be exzact we stayed in the royal services section ocean front  room  stunning room stunning beaches  and amazing service   so much to dp on the resort and treated like royality  
some of our favorites are mamtim timco  wander our pool bartender   and carlos rosario  and also our butler ariol   highly recommend this resort and upgrading to royal service their are so many favorite people that go out of their way here

reviews.author: Anthony B
reviews.title: Alejandro Rivera made our trip wonderful
reviews.text: All the staff and workers were so nice to me and my family ! Especially "happy boy" Alejandro Rivera ! He made our stay so enjoyable with providing us with good laughs and making sure everyone was happy a great time ! Also Miguel Cedano also was so much fun and nice to us! We will be returning forsure! And Yolanda Pierre also was a huge help in making this trip so enjoyable. Bono Ramos was so much fun to be around and help us with anything we needed. Francisco Reynoso was an amazing entertainer and shaky shaky !!

reviews.author: Doris D
reviews.title: lindo lindo
reviews.text:
es muy lindo si q te relaja  todo el complejo es muy tranquilo y el personal muy servicial es mejor ser los primeros en el bufete si no se aglomera horas puntas de comidas.
las habitaciones son muy acogedoras.

reviews.author: Siomaracruz
reviews.title: XVII Encuentro de la JAD en PPC.
reviews.text: Esta no esta la primera vez que tenemos el honor de tener nuestra XVIII Encuentro de la JAD en este hotel y tener como Coordinadora a Asia Mateo quien nos estuvo dando seguimiento el a;o pasado y este a;o igual UN SUPER SERVICIO Y SEGUIMIENTO POR ELLA. Tambien bien gracias  a Alexander, Angelica, Moises, Grace, Rocio, Raul Vittini, Adriana de la Recepcion, Brito y Morillo, Francisco y andri  de Banquetes  el Camarero del Restaurante The Grill que es de Neiba con un super servicio que nos dio la noche de ayer y todo el resto del equipo. Mi gente de JSAV a Maria Olga que siempre estuvo con nosotros en cada momento, Andres y el resto de los chicos.

reviews.author: Wendy R
reviews.title: Encuentro de la JaD en RD
reviews.text: Gracias a todos los chicos por su asistencia y sobre todo la colaboración de nuestra coordinadora Asia Mateo quien nos estuvo apoyando con todo junto con el Sr. vittini, Angélica, Alexander, Rocío,Moisés, Rafael, Gustavo el chef y su equipo; Grace, un chico de Neiba que trabaja en THE grill. reviews.author: Rafael S
reviews.title: La mejor convención de la JAD
reviews.text: La mejor convención de la JAD gracias a la colaboración de Asia Mateo y todo su equipo de convenciones y banquetes. Es la segunda vez que repetimos este hotel como la misma actividad.  Nos veremos el año que viene.

reviews.text: Agradesco la asistencia de Asia Mateo quien se desempeño como nuestra coordinadora en el XVIII Encuentro de la JAD en Paradisus Punta cana. Tambien a quienes nos soportaron para esto fuera todo un éxito como Angelica, Vittini, Moises, Gustavo, Francisco, Rafael, Gustavo el chef y Rocio.. Gracias por todo chicos!

reviews.author: lisawmapres
reviews.title: Awesome Experience!
reviews.text: Great experience at this awesome resort. Everything about this trip was the best!  "Royal Service" was absolutely awesome!!  Jose' Lugo is THE BOMB!!!!!  He made an already awesome experience even greater!  Would definitely visit this resort again and recommend to others.

reviews.author: annesB9851IZ
reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.text: Overall, had an enjoyable time; however it looks like resort could use some cosmetic work around pool area.  peeling paint, etc...everything else was great.  August is a very hot month would not come back during that time again.

reviews.author: Thomas C
reviews.title: Miguel Royal Services
reviews.text: Miguel made our experience above and beyond any experience we could imagine.  He was always very polite, helpful, on-time, surprising, knowledgeable, and genuine.  He never complained about what we asked, and always delivered!  We cannot wait to one day see Miguel again, he is a stand up person and represents Paradisus Palma Real in a great way!  I hope all other butlers are as good as Miguel!

reviews.author: dougleblanc
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
The Butler was great, we felt like royalty! 
We loved the variety, freshness and purity of the food, I was told that They grow 90% of it on the island organically. The island tours gave us a wonderful feel for the geography of the island, safe and beautiful . We enjoyed the Zip line while getting a great view of the mountain area at the same time. We did the ATV tour to a farm, a private beach with a view of an awesome cliff, and a cave adventure to boot. The beach was the super blue water we expected and the seaweed was kept to a minimum.  loved it all!
Ive been on 10 trips with the company, this was in the top 3. 

thanks Felmine(butler) and Transamerica

reviews.author: Chente A
reviews.title: Sigue superandose
reviews.text:
Ya he estado en otras ocasiones y esta ha sido desplazamiento por negocios.

Compruebo que siguen las mejoras para mi gusto tanto en los restaurantes como los servicios de habitación

Excelente el servicio de wifi imprescindible para mi trabajo

Agradezco a D. Adrian Alonso manager hotel por si disposición a que la estancia fuera perfecta

reviews.author: Sean B
reviews.title: EXCELLENT RESORT
reviews.text: This resort was excellent.  My wife and I wish we could have stayed longer.  If you need a drink ask for Wanda Correa.  She is muy bien!!!   If you are looking for a butler, Nicolas Maracallo is great!  I would visit this resort again.

reviews.author: Colette G
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Visited with the TransAmerica Agency Network Leaders Conference, August 13-17. Stayed in Royal Service Villa 6. Just as beautiful as the promo photos! Food was amazing. Royal service was amazing. Clean! We spilled water on the floor and used a white towel to clean it up! No dirt! And a special shout out to our butler, Jose Salvador.
