I was able to text him at any time via What's App using their wifi, no cost. He went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. If you go, see if you can ask for him! And thank you Jose!

reviews.author: Bonnie S
reviews.title: Butler Ariel Benzo
reviews.text:
We wanted to take the time to give a five star rating to all the personnel that work for the Paradisus Palma Real and one specific Butler that went over and above his job description to make our stay here absolutely fantastic! We were taken care of like royalty and thanks again Ariel Benzo for the best service we have ever had on a vacation. We look forward to a visit again next year and will request you again, I hope you read this or someone tells you about our review and it puts a smile on your face just like the one you kept on ours throughout our visit. Thank you for helping us create some beautiful memories. Five star resorts and restaurants are all over the Caribbean  but your service and hospitality are beyond compare. Hasta que nos encontremos de nuevo mi amigo!!

Robert and Bonnie 
Room 2081

reviews.author: princessmaggie3
reviews.title: Great placefor business trip
reviews.text: I stayed there in June for business and had a great time.  The room was amazing, the staff was very friendly and helpful and they did a great job with our conference and group.  Our group coordinator went out of her way and made it memorable for all.  This is my second stay at a Melia property and hopefully there will be more in my future

reviews.author: Thefoogee
reviews.title: A great family vacation
reviews.text:
This is really a beautiful resort.  When you first walk in to check in at the lobby you are greeted by a breathtaking view of the pool, palm trees and beautiful ocean.  

We were in a 2 bedroom suite which was very spacious.  You walked into a living room area with a small kitchen, dining room table, a pull out couch and TV.  The master bedroom had a very comfortable bed, plenty of drawers and closet space and a huge jacuzzi tub with a 2 sink bathroom. Next to it was another room with a shower toilet and another sink.  The second bedroom has a little sitting area with a TV pull out couch, mini refrigerator, and a sink.   The bedroom had a king size bed and next to it was another large jacuzzi tub and next to that room was a double sink bathroom with a shower and toilet.  

I loved the large space.  The rooms probably could use an update but they were still nice.

The ocean was beautiful but they have a seaweed problem which the resort tried to clean on a daily basis but you had to travel deep into the ocean to avoid it so we opted every day for the pool.

What really made this vacation special were the employees.  Seeing Francisco and Junior Joaquin every morning at breakfast really made your day start off right.  We had a party of 11 and they always made sure we had a great table and excellent service.

Then off to the pool where we got excellent pool service from Daniel who always took exceptional care of our party.

In the afternoon there are plenty of activities from classes making sushi, cocktails, candles, and painting.  After that there were dance classes and Zumba taught by a fantastic group of guys, looki looki, coca cola and  .  Those dance classes were SO FUN.  They at night the plaza below the lobby has a hot spot of activity.  Usually, the same guys that were teaching dance would lead you in line dance or just dance with everyone which was super fun.

Regarding food, there was a main restaurant which had a huge buffet of anything you could possibly want and seemed to be open at all hours.  The restaurants were all pretty good. Some better than others.

I think if you have smaller kids you might want to think about staying a the reserve part of the resort, which seemed to have more organized kid club activities.

The resort offered daily workout classes like spinning, yoga, yoga on paddle boards, aerobics on paddle boards which was really fun.

We had a great time at this resort but remember this is on the Atlantic side and has much more of a feel of Mexico than Turks and Caicos, so everything is a bit relaxed and on island time.

reviews.author: Juan A
reviews.title: Great server
reviews.text:
Not all servers are made equal, and Jesus Evangelista gave us excellent service, going above and beyond in enhancing our experience in Palma Real Punta Cana. 

The resort is fantastic with its great plaza and stunning beach view.

Our activities guy Shakyshaky and his crew were great fun and the paddle board activities were a good change from the ordinary. 

Some minor tweaks can be made to their restaurant reservation system to give restaurant details and menus to guests ahead of time as wait time for our reservation was 30 mins. Seemed like the people ahead of us looking at every menu. 

Even with reservations, it took our appetizers over 1 hour to come out our dinner at the Rare steakhouse, main courses out in 90 minutes. All other restaurant serving times were normal.

reviews.author: TRuffini
reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for a Business Conference.  I found the gentleman who greeted you and took your bags to be so sweet and very friendly as were the front desk employees.  My room was beautiful and comfortable, but the shower was a little annoying to get used to but I managed.  Because I was there for a conference we really didn't get a chance to try out the a la carte restaurants, but we did eat at the breakfast buffet one morning (Service was slow and it felt like the waiters were ignoring us, but did eventually come over to clean our table so we could eat.  It was very busy that morning and they looked overwhelmed.)  All our other meals, etc that we had with the conference as a group were very good.  They did a good job labelling the food so you knew what it was that you were eating (coming from a person with a seafood allergy it can be annoying when you don't know what anything is and can't take the chance of eating something).  Our waitstaff for the most part during the conference were great.  The grounds are beautiful and the hotel overall is very clean.  The beach (while we didn't have much time to enjoy it) is beautiful, pools clean, etc.  As a Travel Agent I would stay here again (depending on the price) and I would send my clients here if it were a good match for them.  I do wish I had more of a chance to experience more around the hotel itself but overall I had a good experience there.

reviews.author: annalzubarev
reviews.title: Luxury Resort with an option of a Butler and Theft!
reviews.text:
This Resort has many Pros and many Cons. The Pools located all over this resort. However, Pools are NOT marked anywhere with the depth.  And they are over 5 ft in depth everywhere.   The food was excellent everywhere we ate!  Rooms were greatly cleaned.  There was a THEFT of iPhone's of 2 different people in 2 different room in the same day, which occurred during our Dolphin excursion. 

Bottom line - NO I would NOT come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: SeattleTravelFamily
reviews.title: Good selection of restaurants, older buildings, nice beach!
reviews.text:
We spent a week here in part, with a corporate event, in a Royal Service room. The depth of the check in experience (amount of information, tour, etc) seemed to vary based on which "butler" (a Royal Service perk) checked you in.  Royal Service has it's own check-in and lounge. The RS lounge has coffee and snacks and with a nice view over the swim up bar pool area, is a nice location to take a nice AC cooled break, with a beverage and a few moments of quiet. The rooms are all older, so while there are nice amenities, the age of the property itself limits the 'plush' environment.  Cable often went out for a day at a time, things broke, lights didn't work, fixtures were worn, etc.  Our room was always cleaned well, and our butler left wonderful treats (on schedule with most other butlers serving guests in our party).  Learning how best to utilize the services of the royal service butlers was ongoing. Some are always around checking in, while others are rarely seen and contacted only via the blackberry you receive at check-in. Our butler was quiet, but did check in occasionally --- however, he responded immediately when we called, and everything we asked of him was accomplished above and beyond our requests.  
There is a large variety of restaurants on the property, including a buffet the size of Texas! I enjoyed all the meals, but can't honestly say that anything was amazing. Portions are very small and everything was just.... fine. 
The beach is gorgeous at any time of day.  There are some vendors, but for those of you who may be familiar with the vendor traffic in someplace like Puerto Vallarta, it doesn't even compare.  
The property has a spa, that everyone loved - and a second water spa on site. There is a small store to purchase novelty items, which is expensive as on site stores usually are.  If you love to shop and venture off your lodging property to try restaurants, bars, and browse shops - you will be disappointed as we were. It just didn't have the options to go "into town" for dinner and spend the evening shopping, or stop for a beach side beverage, etc.  There are a couple locations on the beach in old buildings where vendors call home --but I'd definitely ask the hotel staff before choosing that  route.

reviews.author: Eve Y
reviews.title: Paradise for sure
reviews.text: I had been to the Dominican one other time to a different location and had a very poor experience so when I found out that I was traveling here for business I arrived with very low expectations.  I was blown away by the beauty and the great service offered at this hotel.  I enjoyed my entire stay and found myself wishing that I had extended my stay to this beautiful paradise.  I would definitely come here again.  There is many things for your entire family to do and many options for restaurants which are all good.  They are constantly cleaning and working on the property and the help is trained in offering the best service.  You cannot go wrong with this resort!  Way to go!

reviews.author: stefanoAroma
reviews.title: Great Place, food and atmosphere
reviews.text:
Beautiful rooms, beach, bars, lounges, extraordinay experience. Staff caring and attentive, meeting rooms spacious and well equipped.
It has been my second experience at a Paradisus resort after the Princesa del Mar in Varadero, I like the style, easy going but with a touch of luxury the all inclusive systema is great

reviews.author: Amit S
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
This is one awesome place to visit. Swim up bar was my favourite one. There won't be a moment of bore from the time of check in to out. Emelyaloian from reception was very helpful.

Tip: Royal service has beach view rooms, higher floor - better the view.

Make sure you don't eat fish for something before visiting coz you will eat a lot tasty ones here.

reviews.author: shwetabhandari
reviews.title: Wonderful stay @ Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
I visited this property for my office event that took place and was in the hotel for about 1 week... It was great stay and staff and environment is so good that you never feels home alone.

The staff keeps on enjoying , dancing and very helpful

reviews.author: JeanCarlosMarte
reviews.title: Came To Business With My Couple
reviews.text:
Bad service. Every employee talks about the new rules of the new Director. Everyone justifies the bad service because of him. The pool is too old and dirty. 

But not all is bad. Never go to the Mediterranean restaurant. But you can go to the sushi restaurant, the italian restaurant and the meats restaurant.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Watch your Valuables
reviews.text:
Note * I posted a review on the wrong resort  I didn't realize there were a few Paradisis Resorts in Punta Cana. 

This is the correct one. Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort.

My review:

Overall property is beautiful. There was a big event hosted there and its gorgeous. A five star big marketing event.  

I would have written a 5 star, if it wasn't for my husband's cell phone being stolen....from INSIDE the hotel room. YES inside his hotel room. 

He wasn't the only one who that happened to. It happened to another guest who was at the event, his phone also stolen from inside his room. 

It was just poorly executed, because how he was treated as a guest for that was not resort like at all. He was treated like he was at fault, like he was some 'drunk' tourist that was clueless or something.  Which my husband does not drink and never has. 

It was just a shocking event to have your phone stolen from inside the safety of your hotel room, especially while traveling abroad.  

Having worked at 5 star hotels myself this was unacceptable treatment of a guest. Please it felt violating. Not cool. 

So, while its a lovely venue remember to LOCK ALL your valuables in the safe peeps!!

Hopefully they learned from this particular mishap and caught the individual who was at cause.

reviews.author: Jennifer F
reviews.title: Amazing property, amazing staff - especially for groups and destination weddings!
reviews.text: We hosted a large group at the Paradisus Palma Real of about 300 guests. The team was truly amazing, ready to assist and always with a smile.  Hospitable, with an unyielding willingness to pitch in, which will not soon be forgotten!  For the leisure traveler, lots of activities, restaurants that appeal to everyone and more.  Definitely a must visit for Punta Cana!

reviews.author: TisaL
reviews.title: Large and good but not great
reviews.text: I was at the resort for a conference.  I have to admit I am not a fan of these very large all-inclusive resorts. If you like that type of hotel, this one will do fine.  It's clean and pretty well organized.  Most of the staff seemed friendly. Except at check in, he seemed he could not care less about me and explained absolutely nothing to me about the resort. It was late at night when I arrived. The many restaurants are ok, not wow.  Except Passion.. it is not included, and the experience is great and gourmet. Service was fabulous, by Jan Carlos.  Bana is very average (did not like my sushi roll at all), but they have a great server named Oslin.  It was impossible to get a decent wine by the glass in Bana.  In Vento they were able to accommodate better.  Breakfast buffet is good.. and a few of the staff around the resort are very attentive.  A couple are not.  Property is clean.  Garden is nice. Room is clean, but style is old-fashioned.  Bed and pillows are good.  Lighting is strange in the room.. and bad in the bathroom (at least if you want light to put on make-up, that's a challenge). Bathroom is open to the room.. which I don't like, because I like to steam up the bathroom when taking a shower. Spa (Oriental Garden) is great! Rooms are far, be ready to walk a lot.

reviews.author: Francesca C
reviews.title: Paradisus Resort .... un vero PARADISO !
reviews.text:
Ho trascorso (purtoppo!) soltanto 4 giorni in questo resort veramente paradisiaco.
Non so da dove cominciare ma provo ad andare con ordine :
All'arrivo un ottimo cocktail di benvenuto ed un personale della reception molto professionale e disponibile.
La stanza era enorme, molto spaziosa con vasca idromassaggio, angolo salotto ed un bel terrazzo.
La struttura è immensa, anche se l'hotel è al completo e ci sono molti ospiti, le innumerevoli attività proposte permettono ad ognuno di trovare tranquillamanete il proprio spazio.
La piscina è enorme con lettini in muratura per potersi godere il sole restando sdraiati in acqua. Alcune zone sono dotate di getti idromassaggio. Per i più sportivi e volenterosi, vengono proposti corsi di spinning in acqua e di yoga su paddle boards.
La spiaggia è spaziosissima e gli ombrelloni, le sdario ed i lettini, sono posizionati ad una buona distanza, sufficiente per avere la propria privacy.
Ampia anche la scelta dei ristoranti che offrono cucina internazionale, caraibica, snacks .... veramente per tutti i gusti.
Non ho potuto provare i servizi proposti dalla SPA quindi non posso dare un giudizio.
Il parco nel quale è immersa questa struttura è molto ben curato con tanto di laghetto artificiale (immagino) e di fenicotteri rosa.
Io non so proprio cos'altro dire ..... avrei voluto poter restare più a lungo ..... un vero paradiso !

reviews.author: Pkenty
reviews.title: Excellent hotel with great food and staff
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time staying at this hotel. All the rooms are really great with plenty of room , comfortable beds and great facilities.  The staff  are great and nothing to much trouble. The main pool with swim up bar is just great . The beach is very close and is quiet amazing ! All in all I would highly recommend his hotel

reviews.author: Veronica R
reviews.title: Increíble Servicio
reviews.text: El hotel es simplemente espectacular, vistas increíbles pero lo mejor es el servicio tienen el mejor servicio del mundo son tan amables que te hacen sent it como en familia. Gracias Emely Moran de recepción, Jonathan de Restaurante Naos y Andy del Bar. Gracias a todos.

reviews.author: manuela m
reviews.title: Hotel y personal 10
reviews.text:
Diogenes Martinez. Ahi ahiiiiii !!!!
Marcos Silvestre
Luis Ventura 
Alexis Nuñez 
Kelvin Ilario

EL MEJOR PERSONAL DEL HOTEL. 
Y SIN DUDA EL RESTO SON BRILLANTES 
LA ATENCIÓN, EL SERVICIO PARA REPETIR SIN DUDA.    
Las instalaciones y lo bien q Te hacen sentir. Con ganas de volver y para recomendar a familia y amigos. 

EXCELENTE !!!!

reviews.author: Rita S
reviews.title: Fantastic times
reviews.text: My experience here was simply outstanding. From the pool swim up bar to the meals at the restaurants, all was outstanding. I can't say enough about Ariel Benzo. My husband forgot his phone charger. Ariel got him one shortly after we settled in to our hotel room. I wanted to try drinking coconut water from a coconut. Ariel met us by the pool as we returned from an offsite excursion with the gentleman who has the fresh coconuts! The staff was extremely attentive! And oh my, the spa!!! A truly indulgent experience! I highly recommend a stay at the Paradisus Palma in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: dawnbogh
reviews.title: Beware of Charges made to your Credit Card - Hotel does not support you!!!!
reviews.text: I had my credit card linked to room -  Made NO Charges to the room at all during my trip.  We booked a snokling trip & parasailing trip through the company that is around the royal pool area - Rico.  Paid cash for the trip - they ask for our room number & when we booked the boat - they took our paper receipt to board the boat. All good right - not when I get my credit card bill - both charges were on the bill & ALOT more than what we already paid!  Hotel will do nothing - even though when we asked about that company - they said yes it was an approved vendor and that is why they were around the pool areas!!! So stay away from booking anything through this hotel , This is not how the hotel that our company had 500 people there for the week should handle things!! Don't go here - unless you want to get ripped off!!!

reviews.author: VinD513
reviews.title: Great resort, service and staff
reviews.text:
The place is great, the pools are beautiful, the beach is nice.
The staff is very polite and helpful.The drinks are very weak, I couldnt find one person who had gotten drunk off the free drinks.
We were with a large group of people and we all had a great time.
There was a wedding and another gathering when we were there and it still didn't seem crowded.The reserve is the way to go. Its best to book restaurants early or you wont get  seating. Stay away from passion restaurant, over priced and not worth it. It is one of the only restaurants that you have to pay for. WE also found that if you don't have a reservation for a restaurant  20 dollars will usually get you a table.
The buffet is OK but its not anything great.

reviews.author: Lorena G
reviews.title: Recomiendo paradisus resorts
reviews.text: Me encanto en general la gente te hace sentir como en casa, gracias por todas sus atenciones ya que la calidad de las personas hacen la diferencia en el trato diario y hace que la experiencia sea mas grata

reviews.author: ingridn247
reviews.title: Caribe Dominicano
reviews.text:
Un hotel recomendado para adultos con gran oferta gastronómica y diversión.
Gran variedad de licores
Servicio Conserje
Club Total Service
Bella playa
Gran piscina

Con centro comercial, de grandes marcas

reviews.author: Rena R
reviews.title: Nice resort at a reasonable price
reviews.text: We traveled to Paradisus for our annual business incentive trip.  It's a nice resort at a reasonable price if you catch a good sale.  The resort itself is not super huge which is nice.  Pools were nice and very clean.  We had a room in the Royal Service section but did not have any extra royal service perks which was a little confusing.  When the room was cleaned is was done very nicely.  However, we had 2 days that housekeeping didn't show up till 9pm at night.  The food at the restaurants and buffet were very good with the exception of the Mexican restaurant... food was cold and hard like it had been sitting for some time.  Most of the staff is very friendly but we encountered a few that were less than kind and would disappear if you asked for something.  The beach was clean, and there are plenty of beach huts to choose from.  Overall, it's a nice resort and we had a great vacation.

reviews.author: Annette F
reviews.title: Royal service was amazing....
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Staff was accommodating and friendly. Nicholas and Pedro made our trip extra special. White sand beaches with Palm trees ... Paradise!!!! We will definitely be returning soon. Oh don't miss the coconut gelato

reviews.author: renuajwaney
reviews.title: Paradisus did it one more time
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived the great team at Paradisus Palma Real took great care of us going above and beyond our expectations. Starting with the groups and conventions team led by Massiel Jimenez did an amazing job managing our group 300+ rooms suggesting great ideas to do our incentive trip the best we can had. Excellent execution of all our requirements, attention to detail, great group private functions, best food all over the place & best beach of the Caribbean.

reviews.author: Morgan J
reviews.title: My awesome trip!
reviews.text: Service here was tremendous although we had a few incidences of workers enter our room without permission! One highlight of our trip was Wanda Corres. She was attentive, nice and remembered all of our preferences. Thanks for a great trip

reviews.author: Maureen P
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text: It was my first time in Punta Cana and the Paradisus Palma Real did not disappoint. The Royal Service was amazing (I would highly recommend!) and my Butler, Carlos H, went above and beyond for my stay. He made all of my dinner reservations, reserved me a cabana when requested (Royal Service has their own pool area), and made sure I had everything I needed for my room. He even went as far as bringing me a beautiful fruit plate, dessert plate, and cheese plate throughout my stay.  I cannot say enough good things about his customer service. The resort is absolutely beautiful. I was very impressed by the entire grounds. The food was wonderful. Aqua was my favorite restaurant but Rare and Bona were nice as well, and the buffet didn't disappoint either as they have plenty of food options to choose from. I was here on business but I will absolutely be coming back to this resort for a personal vacation!

reviews.author: allisonsA5391OX
reviews.title: Work Conference
reviews.text: Went for a work conference in early May. Overall it was a good experience. Hotel was very nice and the service was great! I had a traveler in our group who had several food allergies and they were beyond accommodating.

reviews.author: Kim Y
reviews.title: Incredible Staff!
reviews.text: We travel every year on an incentive trip with PartyLite and this year we had the absolute pleasure of being helped by two very special staff members...Marilia, who deals with group travel and Alvaro, who was our butler for the week.  Alvaro was ALWAYS available via the cell phone provided by the resort and took care of even the most mundane of requests (we're not high maintenance but sometimes you just need something).  Marilia was over the top with what she did for me personally.  You see, I have a massive amount of food restrictions and I have never been treated as well as I was on this trip.  Marilia had the head chef create custom meal choices for me for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  All I had to do was text her using WhatsApp to say which meal choice I wanted, which restaurant I was going to be dining at and at what time.  She went so far as to introduce me to the head chef and the sous chef AND she would stop by during some of my meals just to check on me.  Given that she was dealing with our group of hundreds, I was supremely impressed that she took the time to keep in constant contact with me.  We couldn't have been more happy with her, so much so that my husband hugged her every time we saw her.

reviews.author: onthegreenregion
reviews.title: Fun, fun, fun!
reviews.text: We visited the Paradisus Palma Real on a company incentive trip.  I always look most forward to visiting with many friends who come from all over North America.  But can I just say that Daniel Del Carmen made our daily pool time so much more fun!  His friendly smile and attitude was contagious - he took great care of all of us.  Thank you Daniel!

reviews.author: Paouri
reviews.title: Hermoso
reviews.text:
Las habitaciones son de un buen tamaño y mi cama fue sencillamente enorme.... Disfruté mucho el hotel, la playa y la comida.

Es mi segunda vez en este hotel, y realmente me encanta... Los mojitos están deliciosos

reviews.author: Ira S
reviews.title: Great Get-a-Way
reviews.text: Great place to get away and enjoy the islands. Friendly environment, great service, spacious rooms, variety of restaurants, and nice layout... Something for everyone... Would be happy to return again.

reviews.author: R4757BD
reviews.title: Royal Service!
reviews.text: Stayed in the Palma Real royal service, garden view junior suite.  Butler service was excellent.  Joell made our reservations nightly for dinner and handled daily reservations for our 'Palabra' on the beach.  Other emplyoyees who made our stay positive were Martin, on the beach, and Lee at the Royal Service pool bar.

reviews.author: tylermathewk
reviews.title: Bladmire - The best!!!!
reviews.text: Bladmire was the best butler ever, I would love to tell everyone that the stay here was welcoming and stress free. Everyone treated my with respect and without any problems at all. Please see Bladmire He was our butler.

reviews.author: gabrielaveronicap
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente viaje, muy acogedor el hotel, excelente atención , muy buena gastronomía , el Naos un éxito , habitaciones muy lindas, la atención del personal excelente, la limpieza un lujo, las piscinas un sueño! Volvería siempre!

reviews.author: Local_Diner66
reviews.title: Relaxing and Fun
reviews.text: We stayed @ the far end of the resort bordering the Reserve.   Royal service meant that our group had our own private pool and beach area, along with access to the entire resort.  It was all inclusive for food and beverages, and butler service was included.  Miguel, our butler was both informative and attentive.  I had heard from some of the other guests in our group that their butlers were a little rude and non-accommodating.  I guess it's hit or miss with the butler service.  The restaurants and meals were plentiful, although everything closes super early so plan on eating dinner by 7pm since all of the restaurants have a close time around 9:30pm.    The casino is super tiny with crappy slots and dealers that are as rude as can be.  We had heard the casino @ the adjoining resort was a little larger and friendlier, but we didn't have a chance to venture over.  Our overall experience was positive.

reviews.author: bellad719
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: If you're looking for a relaxing time, this is the place to go.  The layout of the resort was nice so it didn't feel packed.  Our butler Ferman was attentive.  We called him every morning to reserve a lounge cabana on the beach and there we met Pedro that served us cocktails until mid-afternoon.  The weather was beautiful.  The beach was gorgeous.  There should be additional entertainment at night.

reviews.author: JC C C
reviews.title: BMW SALES
reviews.text: The Reserve was Amazing!  Food exquisite..rooms magnificent...Beach and pool awesome!  My only complaint would be the song called Butler Nicolas.  He is originally from NY.  EVERY TIME and I do mean EVERY TIME we asked him for anything he told us where to get it.  I even had to get my own luggage when they took to the wrong room...which was a simple mistake.  He does NOT and I repeat does NOT deserve to be a butler at this amazing establishment!!!!

reviews.author: Jake B
reviews.title: Butler service was great
reviews.text: Our butler, jose salvador, made our trip. He gave us a phone where we could call him anytime for anything. He would even come out to the beach to check on us periodically to see what he could do. Reservations, spa appt. snacks, drinks, things for the room were all done and we never had to lift a finger. He would also leave us nightly surprises in the room. We even forgot something while checking out and he ran all the way back to our room to get it so we were not late for the airport. He is what stands out most about this resort and what made our trip so relaxing.

reviews.author: Judy D
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The beach is perfect at this resort, with a nice breeze and large chaises.  My room was very nice and the grounds were beautiful.  Butler Carlos Hinostroza was fantastic and made sure I had the perfect beach chair, dinner reservation, champagne in my room and countless other delights.  I really loved the evening in the court yard because they had music and dancing.

reviews.author: Oleebg
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, huge, massive buffet
reviews.text: Comfortable, large (though not luxury) rooms with good aircon, and OK wifi. The bathrooms are a bit dated. The beach is terrific and the service is very good. The swimming pools are terrific also. Variety of restaurants and bars - huge buffets.

reviews.author: Peter F
reviews.title: COE 2016-2017
reviews.text:
Had a great time our butler Armando Minier was attentive to all our needs. Here is a photo of just one of the things he did for us. Thanks for a great time    
I would recommend this to everyone who needs a relaxing time

reviews.author: gullabella
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is beautifully located directly at the beach. Huge, huge hotel. All inclusive. I stayed with royal service which included a butler. The first 3 days this one was invisible, then I got another one, very good and helpful. Food was excellent. Wifi free, worked now and then

reviews.author: garret c
reviews.title: Impressive property on the beach
reviews.text:
Hotel property, pool area, spa, beaches, restaurants all well appointed and maintained.
Hotel room was very clean and updated. Restocking the mini bar was not done daily, no food or snacks in room.
Hotel staff, especially housekeeping staff spoke very little English.
Meals were good but not exceptional, good variety with the different restaurant choices.

reviews.author: Christine N
reviews.title: Very pleased indeed without butler and beauty of Resort
reviews.text:
We had Jose Salvador. Excellent butler and service! He would bring champagne to our room, fix up a beautiful soaking bath, bought us fruit and cheeses and chocolate covered strawberries. Any time you need dinner reservations or spa he would set it up. Very pleased indeed!
The hotel setting itself was very beautiful. The grounds looking out to the ocean was breath taking. Everything immaculate and clean. 
Recommendations: I highly recommend upgrades and use safe to lock up valuables

reviews.author: Jodie F
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text: booked a room with 2 beds, was given a king size bed and my guest on a business trip was told to sleep on a stained couch. looked like my mechanic dad sat on it in his work clothes. went to call the front desk to complain only to find out the phone didnt work. walked 1/4 back to th3 front desk to let them know the issue with the one bed and the phone not working only to be told we have the largest room in the villas so its okay. they were not able to provide 2 beds until the day before we left as their other hotel flooded so they gave our room to these people. they brought a twin size bed into the room for my friend to sleep on. we thought all was set until we used the toilet. wouldnt flush. took 4 calls to get it fixed. a couple of days into the trip we saw the same twin beds they gave my friend to sleep on lying out back in the grass of building 39. they were there everyday after that as we checked for the next 3 days. may favorite was discovering blood on my sheets the 3rd night. maid service was hit or miss and a couple of days went by without any clean towels. when they were there you would see your cup moved ontop of the tv or a used rubber glove on the floor. one night at the buffet i found a kleenex in the romaine. i asked for more romaine and it was like this was a common occurance. they really need to put more effort into keeping the rooms clean like they do the common areas. it was common to hear from other guests they had bugs in their rooms amd similar cleanliness issues. many of the activites listed on the website are not available. the only nightly entertainment is  a michael jackson show, cirque de i wanna be solei and robots dancing in the bar. the gift shop staff were dishonest. they would tell you what you had in your hand is 20% off then you would buy it, they would tell you yes, on sale but on the receipt there is no discount and when you asked they would go oh no i didnt say that.

reviews.author: Mel1451
reviews.title: Unfriendly and Poor Service
reviews.text:
I came here for a work trip with over 200 people. The resort its self is nice. Beach had plenty of chairs as well as the pool. Building and features are lovely. Furnished nice. Our room was a junior suite. it was perfect. Big balcony with a Jacuzzi. Note that our room said ocean view.... however we could not see the ocean out our window. We had to walk to balcony, lean over and look to the right through 2 buildings to see a sliver of it. Many other coworkers had the same experience with that. So if you really want a good ocean view, get an ocean front room. Some people in our group got a butler. Not one of them raved about it. Apparently they have several couples to service and they complained that they were not as reliable or reachable on the phone as they wished. However would do some things requested. I don't know how much extra that is but I'm not sure that I would spend the money based on my coworkers experiences. 
 Food was OK. Nothing to rave about and certainly not the worst food I've had from an all inclusive. However during the day there are not many options for eating. It's just the buffet, a burger place, and a coffee shop with pre wrapped items. Wished there were more options. Also, the lunch buffet didn't open until 12:30 which I thought was pretty late. 
If you want to do the spa, be prepared to pay a pretty penny. Seemed like every service was around $150+ and on top of that an 18% gov fee, plus tip! Ridiculous if you ask me.....
Now, the thing I REALLY disliked about the hotel was the service and attitude of the staff. UNREAL. No one cared to do anything for you. I dreaded asking anyone for anything (such as coffee at breakfast or a roll of silverware) because no one was happy to do anything for you. You should have seen how pissed the omelette guy was when a lady asked for an eggwhite omelette. He was shaking his head the whole time I guess because it was wasteful? So awkward. So unpleasant. So disappointing.  I was even mocked by a bartender when asking if they had the Rose wine there. Absurd. When checking out, I was scolded for leaving my key in the room, short answered on everything, and never a "how was your stay?" or "thanks for staying with us". These are just some examples.... but its hard to enjoy your stay when the staff acts like they don't care about you. You pay alot of money to vacation and they are supposed to be trained on how to care for guests. I would never stay here again. Will not be visiting Punta Cana again either...2nd time in this country and over all would much rather be in Bahamas or Mexico

reviews.author: James O
reviews.title: Relaxing Fun Vacation
reviews.text:
The resort is clean and beautiful.  At night, the lighting and music transport you.  

You might be assigned a butler.  We were completely non-impressed with this service.  We did, however, meet a young man who took care of our room service and provided other lasting touches to our stay.  A big shout-out to #Rafael Fortuna.

reviews.author: Amber C
reviews.title: Some Tips For You ..
reviews.text:
Recently traveled to this hotel for a business trip, first time to Punta Cana.

Check In/Out:

Upon arrival to the hotel we inquired about upgrading to a Royal Service and it was a decision I do not regret. It made the check in and out process simple, allowed for my husband and I to escape to a quiet part of the hotel - and allowed us to an enjoy an ocean front room, of which there are not many.  The majority of this hotel is made up of garden views only.

There are many options for Royal Service, one is that you just get the "perks" of the additional restaurant (that was offered for $45/pp/pn - and the restaurant we went to only would have charged $40pp for the meal).  For this I do not see the value. The others were choices based on the type of room you have (both of these include a butler).  I think it was $100/pp/on for the garden view and $150 for the ocean front .. so we figured we would go for the ocean view! Royal Service allows for a later check out (1pm) then the rest of the hotel as well.  The Royal Service lobby for check out was quiet and without a line - unlike the long lines at the main check out.

Although I'm happy I upgraded, it was a bit steep in comparison to other hotels I have had a similar experience at.

Butler Service: 

Our Butler Jose was friendly, attentive and available when we needed him for reservations at the beach, pool and restaurants.  He even worked with my husband and had champagne and strawberries delivered to our room, as well as snacks and a bubble bath throughout the trip. Our experience with Jose is where the rating for this hotel deserves a 5 - if you go, request Jose .. he did everything to make our stay special and relaxing! 

FOOD/DRINK - BEACH/POOLS

As far as the rest of the experience .. we ordered room service the first night - it was timely and allowed us to relax in our BEAUTIFUL room after a long day of traveling.  The Royal Service allows for more options for lunch and dinner then the rest of the hotel (I think there were 4 restaurants vs. 2 for those not in Royal Service).  We opted for the adult only side of the beach for our first few days and had a relaxing time - the Service on the beach is not great and there is not food available.  The ocean is full of seaweed, so we didn't spend a lot of time in the water - also many many peddlers on the beach trying to sell things (and I mean you don't get ten minutes where you aren't trying to avoid one - we would laugh "don't make eye contact, pretend you're sleeping")  

The Royal Service adult only pool is quiet has a bar and many beds for laying out.  The main pool has an area for Royal Service where I thought children were not allowed, but they were there .. don't get me wrong, I'm ok with kids being on vacation with their families ... I just don't think that an area should claim to be free of children when it isn't. The swim up bar was riddled with kids, and that's a place I would have rather not had them.  Slow service at most bars throughout the hotel and no consistency in the drinks (or the alcohol they use) - asked for certain drinks and they wouldn't "have it" but we could see it on the shelf - our group had the premium package for liquor so that was frustrating. 

We ate at the buffet - many options, the burger place for lunch - which was great! It turns into Mexican for dinner, Pallazzo (Italian/upcharge for non royal) the Bana sushi restaurant - not many choices, but everything we had was great, and then hibachi (this is usually a fun show and it was just watching a man cook - however other tables seemed to be having a better experience) we also ate at Rare, the steakhouse - this was amazing!! A few options for upcharged items, but the whole menu was fabulous! 

If you order morning coffee - order it an hour earlier then you want it and it will be right on time :)

We didn't go to other restaurants as we had pre-planned events - and those were fantastic! We heard that the other restaurants were all very good as well from the group.

NIGHTLIFE

The majority of the restaurants are in the plaza, right in the middle of the hotel - which is fun to see everyone dressed up and enjoying their evenings .. there is a casino (I heard not so great things about the dealers from others but can't speak for this) there is a nightclub as well, I didn't spend much time there but nice to have a late night option! Gabi Beach is fun for the early evening but closes early - cool vibe and entertainment. 

SPA

There are two areas, one in the Garden and one at the reserve.  If you don't like the whole spa process and just want to get a massage - pick the Garden .. you will get a massage in a hut and check out.  If you want a steam or the hot/cold tubs, they are for Royal Service in a separate area off the pool - kids were in the pool so my jacuzzi experience was not the relaxing end to the massage I imagined it to be.  The massage I had was fabulous, but after hearing about the facility at the Reserve, I wish I would have gone there instead.

All in all - the hotel itself IS gorgeous, the grounds are beautiful and the views are perfect, comfy beds too! 

Final thought - if you're traveling with friends, be aware that the bathroom privacy is NOT there :) the room is separated by shutters and wood spindles. Glass doors in front of the toilet and shower.

reviews.author: Ryancbarber
reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text:
Stayed 5 days at this incredible resort. Service was great. Food was outstanding. Luis the poolside bartender was extra great! Each morning he saved a cabana for us near the swim up bar. The rooms were also really nice. 

Room service was excellent.

reviews.author: NJVMichigan
reviews.title: SUBPAR SERVICE ..SUBPAR EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The best thing about this resort is the pool and beach. The rooms are very tired more of what you would expect at at a 2 or 3 star. The worst thing about this that tainted the entire trip was the the attitude of the employees, servers. They would never approach you for a drink...not exaggerating on this. You had to flag them down. In the restaurants the servers were very inattentive and demonstrated poor attitudes. Rarely do you even get a smile. One hostess even rolled her eyes when we told her lunch for two. I would NEVER again stay at a Paradisius and I especially will never go to the Dominican Republic again.

reviews.author: Anthony B
reviews.title: Natanael F
reviews.text: We spent an entire week at he beach and had amazing help from this guy. Amazing service by the beach (a la playa) and at the pool (a la piscina). Very attentive, recommend giving him tips, he will take great care of you. Gracias Natanael!!!!

reviews.author: Roger C
reviews.title: amazing beauty
reviews.text: had a great time with my wife at teh Palma Real Golf & Spa with last week.  Staff were very helpful, many food options that were all delightful.  felt very cared for in so many ways.  Will be returning in the future.  Easy access to all kinds of excursions.  Highly recommend sailing the hobies in the beautiful azul agau.

reviews.author: ddmarsh87
reviews.title: Wonderful experience! Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: We were part of a group and stayed in the royal service part of the resort. This meant a couple of pools with no kids and a private butler. Armando Minier was our butler for the week and did an amazing job. Very kind man - he took very good care of us. I had an issue with the very firm mattress the first night and he got that rectified the next night. I can't say enough good things about his service. The resort is spotless. The staff there really keep it beautiful. We ate at the buffet as well as some of the restaurants. Food was very good. It is all inclusive which is great! A lot of food choices!  My only complaint is I really wanted to do some shopping. We had someone helping our group with excursions, etc and he said they had a shuttle to a shopping mall. This was a HUGE disappointment and the source of some frustration. We passed the shopping mall and pulled up in front of this building. There were just 5 of us and we were then shuttled in one door. He then proceeded to tell us about tobacco, cigars, etc. and would not let us just go shopping. We then end up in a cigar shop. Through the glass doors is a regular tourist gift shop. I started to head that way, but nope, not allowed until he was done with his lesson on cigars and getting us to buy some. We then went to that next shop (only to find out that was the only shop besides our last shop which was chocolate). He gets commission on what he helps us buy. Others in our group had the same bad experience. Very little in the way of choices. We came home without getting some things we really hoped to find on this trip. It was a bait and switch and we were all pretty upset about it. That was the only negative on the whole trip.

reviews.author: brendarg2017
reviews.title: Súper recomendado
reviews.text: Excelente ambiente y calidad, habitaciones confortables. Las amenidades de la habitación se terminan muy rápido y no las vuelven a surtir. Los alimentos son variados, el único problema es que el horario de comida termina muy temprano

reviews.author: johndavid800m
reviews.title: Review of Jose Salvador- Butler at Paradisus at Punta Cana
reviews.text: Our service was good.  We had a butler named Jose that did a good job in making our stay more enjoyable.  The exclusive offering was worth it because I felt like the food was better.  Bartenders were friendly and gave good service.

reviews.author: rblazarus
reviews.title: 10 DAYS IN PARADISE
reviews.text: We brought a large group to the property and everything was spot-on! We had Armando Mineer and he was amazing. Anything we wanted was accommodated and he is a true professional!  Highly Recommend!! This is an amazing property !

reviews.author: Na0mi82
reviews.title: Beautiful location but let down by food and cocktails
reviews.text:
Came here with my husband's company for a week. The hotel itself is lovely. Really pretty grounds and beautiful white sand beach. It's a huge place but never felt overly busy. There were always lots of loungers etc on the beach and by the pool.

Main positives were:
- The staff. All lovely, very attentive, great to chat to and great service
- The spa! Amazing. Make sure you go at least 30 mins before the treatment to get the full experience.
- Premium spiritsi ncluded in all inclusive, not just local brands

Main negatives were:
- The food. The buffet was ok but the restaurants we ate in were quite poor. Especially the Mexican (blue agave) which was probably one of the worst meals I have ever eaten. We booked as a large group and were given a 'fiesta' menu. It was all terrible. Particular lowloghts were the soggy 'burritos' filled with a chinese style stir fry type filling, tacos made with an unidentified grey meat and cake covered in sweetcorn. The service was also terrible. My husband ended up having to go and find some wine in the cupboard after waiting 45 mins for a drink.
- The cocktails were all very overly sweet and not that good (except for the espresso martinis in the lobby bar which were fab). It's the only time on holiday that I've not enjoyed drinking pina coladas!

Overall we had a nice experience but if I'd booked and paid for the holiday myself I would have been a little disappointed.

reviews.author: misty a
reviews.title: 4 days in punta cana
reviews.text:
My review of this property: it seems tired....this was a shorter 4 day Vacation and I have wanted to go home after day 1.

#1. We had a oversized 2 room suite, good in size, but lacked much. The shower didnt work right, minimal warm or hot water, no water pressure. Only day 1 were we provided wash clothes and Diet Coke in the minibar. There was only 1 small beer in the fridge each day. After that it was always a call and a long delay to get them to the room. There was a large empty kitchen, must have been a time share or villa at some point with space for even a washer and dryer. Very dated decor. The television had terrible picture and service. No movie channels. Minimal English. Only 1 working phone. Terrible wifi. And the safe was a disaster! Was hard to get to work and a stress on us to prepare to leave the room every time we had to deal with the safe!

#2 food was a let down overall. Breakfast was the best meal. Lunch offered few restaurants but numerous buffet option. However we prefer to eat al la carte. Alcohol was plentiful, but rarely offered pool side or beach service meaning you had to go to the bar. No food was allowed pool side. Drinks were served in paper cups that crumbled after the first few minute. 
Dinner lacked pizazz even though multiple restaurants. House wines included were terrible. 

#3 there were no hot tubs unless you paid to use the spa. Only 1 large pool for non-reserve guests...made us fee less important.

#4 the beach was pretty, numerous chairs and cabanas at our leisure but were always hassled by locals wanting to sell souvenirs.

#5 the team of 4 that staffed the towel cabana were down right rude and made us feel like we were asking for the moon when we asked for a towel. Every day!!

#6 the hotel ran out of napkins for breakfast and towels for pool during the daytime hours.

we do travel often and have become accustomed to great treatment but I would not return to this property unless it was free and I would want to upgrade to the reserve so I don't feel like I am a bother to the staff. 
I am not excited about punta Cana for sure and would not recommend it!!
Oh by the way, it rained 3 days! No suntan for us and there wasn't much to do with your time when it rained. I am so glad to be going home today!!

reviews.author: Blondie6558
reviews.title: Good hotel with great staff
reviews.text: We recently stayed here on a business trip. The rooms are somewhat dated but the food and location were decent. Francis N. was our butler in the Royal Service. I cannot say enough good things about him! He was incredibly friendly and hospitable our entire  stay. If you plan to stay in Royal Service, request Francis as your butler!

reviews.author: roadwarrior495
reviews.title: Run down and not maintained
reviews.text:
This place is a dump.  When I checked into my room, TV did not work,  Telephone did not work.  WiFi did not work.  I called the front desk from my mobile phone and all three issues were fixed within an hour.  Day 2:  took a cold shower in the morning and the TV again did not work.

Hotel is very old and tired.  It's a great location but the property is not maintained.  It rained this morning and water was leaking from the ceiling in the hallway - thank god it was not in my room (was on the top floor).

Food is mediocre.  Drinks are served in paper cups - you can taste the wax from the cup in the drink.

Most of the staff claim they don't speak English when you ask for something.

At best, this is a 3 star property - much better options are on the island.

reviews.author: gjb-6
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
I was lucky enough to join my wife for a business trip here. I quickly realized that all inclusive is one thing but above and beyond is another. The quality of food, drink and service was beyond high expectations. With that being said, it should be for the price they charge. You won't be disappointed. 

The grounds are immaculate and decent size. Not just the beach front everyone really comes for.  The selection of restaurants is impressive and quality is outstanding.

reviews.author: Troy A
reviews.title: Our Butler service was spectacular!
reviews.text: The room was immaculate with 24/7 room service and a very dedicated butler. If you have the option to choose I would highly recommend Francis who treated us amazingly and provided countless services throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Lupe C
reviews.title: Drinks /service
reviews.text: Andrea smoothie  bar, great service  excellent drinks very nice lady. I really  enjoyed  my trip to Dominican Republic,  Punta Cana  Paradisus Palma Real resorts thanks Andrea for prepared delicious  smoothies.

reviews.author: 120erikj
reviews.title: It was a DREAM ;)
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience but disposed about promises and results.  

I would recommend the hotel to friends and colleagues.

Everything was present sun, beach, food and drinks   what do you need more ;)

----------

reviews.author: mickyloghin
reviews.title: Best Resort Ever
reviews.text: This was by far the best resort my husband and I have ever visited. We had the Royal Service and we definitely treated like Royals since our arrival there. Francis was always checking up to make sure we had everything we needed and went above an beyond to surprise us with big and little details that made us feel at home while enjoying a marvellous vacation. I loved that all the staff was genuinely kind and helpful, especially Francis. The rooms are clean, the food is great and the garden is something out of this world. Loved it!

reviews.author: marina g
reviews.title: Paradise on earth
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort is breathtaking.  I have never experienced such excellent care in the Royal service.  Our butler, Alberto, was ubiquitous; he made our stay fabulous.  The private beach and pool were the highlight of the trip.  Swimming with sharks and Manta Rays was certainly a unique experience.  That excursion was capped off with a trip to the lagoon where fun and frivolity ensued.  My husband and I loved every minute of it.

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Above Average Food - Below Average Room
reviews.text:
The resort is located on lush, expansive grounds, right on the ocean with a majestic Romanesque foyer.
Many resorts offer unlimited mediocre buffets. This resort offered unlimited superior food choices: fresh fish in abundance, e.g lobster, ceviche, and dream homemade ice creams.
Our room was large, tastefully appointed but had poor lighting and smelled of...mildew? The climate is humid, so washing did not dry quickly, which may have led to the smell.  Some rooms are located 10+ min walk from the foyer.

reviews.author: Nina M
reviews.title: Lindo lugar
reviews.text: O hotel é lindo, tem uma vista maravilhosa saindo do lobby para a escadaria onde você vê a Praia.... entre os restaurantes o melhor é o Acqua, vale a visita para experimentar a comida mediterrânea. O que deixou a desejar foi o atendimento... não é ágil e falta bastante atenção dos funcionários...

reviews.author: Dennis R
reviews.title: Great Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: Very Clean and beautifull place to vacation. Everyone was very nice and our Butler Francis was the best. We would go back in a heartbeat and will request Francis as our butler again. Lots of excursions to choose from each one has their own local shop to purchase momento's be ready to negotiate pricing. If you know Spanish great plus.

reviews.author: Mwarrenfeltz08
reviews.title: KEEP Glam
reviews.text: Exelente fantastico gracias por sus servicio  el equipo de actividades es exelente en especial la shorty baila fantastico quede bien encantada gracias shorty por hacer que mis vacaciones fueran lo mejor espero regresar lo mas pronto posible es El mejor hotel que e visitado gracias

reviews.author: TualatinChris
reviews.title: It could be the worst hotel experience...EVER
reviews.text:
I travel more than 100 days per year.  

In spite of tipping well, I can't remember a hotel that had more indifferent service that was darn near hostile at times.

Our experience started at check-in, electronic rooms keys that didn't work - three times.  No bellman at either check-in or check-out, dragging luggage to one of the farthest rooms (3046).  Also there was no apparent way to lock the room door from the inside...housekeeping interrupted us at particularly inconvenient times.

On check-in you are given a color coded bracelet to wear.  If you have the "right" color the staff and servers are high 5ing the guest and are very attentive.  If you have the "wrong" color you are ignored.  In 35 years of traveling throughout the world, I have never experienced class distinction like this!

It felt like the concierge that made our dinner reservations at the property was doing us a favor.  The concierges clearly didn't communicate the dinner reservation to the restaurant's front of the house staff.  

The buffets look much better than food tasted.  The steak at Rare was quite nice but the gentlemen that had sommelier on his apron and zwearing the tastevin (silver cup) was clueless in the art of wine service, including reaching across my wife to serve me the nice Brunello that we had ordered.  With one exception, (Edwin Padilla who was amazing) the restaurant servers were inattentive at best.

The beach is nice but it remained a mystery how to get lounge chairs and towels, in spite of tipping.  

In the evenings there is no way to escape the techno and disco music.  That was the one advantage of having a room far away from the lobby.

The very worst experience was when I went to front desk to get change for tips.  I gave the front desk a US $50 and explained I need to tip hotel staff.  He only gave me US $45 back.  When I asked why only $45 he said "the $5 is my tip," seriously.

In a million years, we will never return to this property!

reviews.author: Thais F
reviews.title: Muy buen servicio
reviews.text: Estuve en Hotel Paradisus Palma Real – Punta Cana – Republica Dominicana en Março de 2017. Servicio muy bueno, especialmente de Alexis Angomas con el room service! Vale la pena. Si tienes la oportunidad de conocer, hagalo.

reviews.author: Kim A
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort on a beautiful beach.Rooms were clean.  Beautiful landscaping and gardens. Excellent service from Nathaniel Fernandez while on the beach and at the pool! Always friendly with a smile and fast with the drinks!

reviews.author: Pete May
reviews.title: Best Hotel I have ever stayed at
reviews.text:
I was there shooting a wedding again, 2nd visit. Just simply amazing. I cannot find fault with this hotel at all and it is worth every penny in my opinion as a pretty well traveled destination wedding photographer. Rooms are spacious, some open out straight into the pool, food is amazing, fresh squeezed orange juice, amazing steaks I just don't know what more to say.

Would I spend my own money to go to this hotel? Absolutely 100%

reviews.author: Anita L
reviews.title: 13 cucarachas en mi habitación
reviews.text:
La primera impresión cuando llegue al hotel fue muy buena... preciosos jardines, imponente piscina, la habitación muy bonita y cómoda con una vista al mar espectacular.
Me alojé en la habitación 2110, la noche que llegue encontré 8 cucarachas pequeñas (si 8...) llame a recepción para avisar del episodio y me enviaron un joven muy amable con un repelente para insectos para solucionar el problema, me explicaron que no podían cambiarme de habitación "porque el hotel estaba al 110% de capacidad".
A la mañana siguiente encontré otras 3 cucarachas, volví a presentar la queja y me
Dijeron que "iban a realizar una fumigación y limpieza profunda del cuarto"... esa misma noche encontré otra cucaracha saliendo de la nevera... pedí que por favor me cambiaran de cuarto ya que no podía pasar una noche más "en compañía de cucarachas".
Para cambiarme de habitación me sacaron de una cena en la que me encontraba a las 9:30 pm (no pude terminar de cenar acompañada) porque dijeron que "me cambiaba a esa hora o no lo podrían hacer más tarde"... Me dieron la habitación 2032... limpia, pero mucho menos elegante y cómoda que la anterior. Me dejaron sin cenar así que me "invitaron" a pedir comida a la habitación porque ya eran las 11 pm y los restaurantes estaban cerrados. 
Hoy en la mañana pedí el libro de quejas para contar mi experiencia y pudieran mejorar para el futuro pero me lo negaron...
Lo mejor del hotel fue la amabilidad de los meseros del room service. Mi experiencia personal en el hotel Nefasta... solo quería volver a mi casa... si regreso a Punta Cana seguro no será a este hotel 😰

reviews.author: Jennifer and Br... R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Beach
reviews.text: We just returned from the Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  This resort is beautiful from the lobby to the pool to the beach!  My husband earned this trip for being one of the top salesman @ his company.  Much to our surprise we were upgraded to Royal Service by his company as we were also celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary.  Our Butler Jose Salvador was amazing!  He always checked on us and was willing to do anything to make our stay more enjoyable!  (Thanks for the toothpaste Jose!)  Unfortunately we are not accustomed to this type of service, but Jose was so kind and thoughtful!  He made our experience a trip to remember.  Thank you Jose!  Much love to you from Wisconsin!

reviews.author: jlbushman
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real went Above & Beyond!
reviews.text:
Held our awards trip at the Paradisus. This property is beautiful and the staff is amazing. Our event went incredible smooth thanks for Niela Eugenio and her staff to ensure our receptions, activities, food/drink and rooms were perfect. Our program went smooth thanks to her and staff. Would be thrilled to work with her again.

Stayed in the Royal Service area for duration of my stay. Jose Salvador was our butler and he made the experience even more enjoyable. He was very kind and caring and would regularly check in to make sure our stay was going well and if we needed anything. He did an amazing job making sure we taken care of. 

At the Gabi Bar the bartenders were attentive and quick and the dance floor had Shaky Shake keeping the crowd going. Super fun atmosphere and Shake did an amazing job getting people dancing, and remember you and your name whenever you saw him throughout the stay.

The Avenue Bar was a great place to stop for a laid back drink and fun conversation with the bartenders. Juan Suarez, Nicolas, Ruth, & Rosita did an amazing job keeping people happy and engaging with each guest. 

All the restaurants on the property were top notch. Including the bars located in-between each restaurant. Osiris Bello Rosario & Sandy Cueto did a wonderful job interacting with guests, providing great conversation and delicious drinks. 

Great property, great staff, great experience! Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Compañia B
reviews.title: travole
reviews.text: thanks to the room service and its stuff, they are the best at tha hotel, we prefer this service by nicolas de la rosa sosa he is friendly and carefully with each service... thanks nico ... see you nex year....

reviews.author: HikerRick
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Was fortunate to stay here March 12-17, and thoroughly enjoyed their Royal Service plan.  Part of that service is a personal assistant, or butler.  Jose Salvador was my butler, and he made my experience awesome!! He was always happy, had a great attitude, and anticipated everything I might need or want to do.  Definitely ask for him if you are considering the Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: outdoorluvr
reviews.title: Not an all inclusive fan
reviews.text:
I stayed here 3 nights for a business trip. The beach and the pool are nice, but people get up very early to put a towel down to reserve their chairs for the day. I woke every morning for the sunrise, which is beautiful but also the same time the trucks drive along the shore to smooth out the sand.
The restaurants are mediocre at best. I found the buffet to be most reliable, because there are so many choices and you don't have to rely on being served. Service is slow and really not very good. The waiters are not attentive at all, and half the time I do not think they knew what I was asking for - even basics were not delivered as asked.
The rooms were comfortable, but a colleague said she saw some roaches. I was on the 3rd floor and there was no elevator. They will bring your bag up but you have to find someone to do it.
The gym was nice, but not 24 hours. The service in the gym was very good - water provided, also aromatherapy towels after the workout.
Make reservations for any free activity in advance, because it will not be available last minute. Same for restaurants that require reservations.

reviews.author: Paulinho D
reviews.title: Quase o paraíso
reviews.text:
Ótimo resort, limpeza ok, wi-fi ídem.
Oferece uma praia exclusiva dentro do resort (que comporta mais de um hotel), porém a distancia e a obrigação de utilizar um carrinho de golfe para se locomover dentro do hotel, atrapalha e muito!
O quarto na verdade é uma casa, com uma sala com vários ambientes, simplesmente gigante!
O banheiro também é gigante e conta com uma banheira incrível.
A ducha deixa a desejar.
Tanto a cama, quanto roupa de banho e de cama são de ótima qualidade.
O resort compensa o ponto negativo da locomoção com uma infinidade de restaurantes de ótima qualidade.
Lembre-se que alguns restaurantes exigem reserva e dress-code.
A variedade do buffet de café-da-manhã poderia ser um pouco melhor.
Os drinks servidos no resort são de boa qualidade.
Enfim... Quase perfeito!

reviews.author: wh1066
reviews.title: Wonder Beach Exposure-Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Arrived on 3/9 late afternoon to a wonderful personalized check- in experience.
It all started with my Royal Service butler.. Jose Salvador. What a great experience and service level he provided until I departed on 3/18. He was absolutely magnificent !
With a private pool environment for guests of Royal Services, Francisco Cabrera delivered everyday for cabana/beach chair reservations as well as anticipating all drink requirements ! These two individuals stood out for exemplary service!!
One other standout in the beverage and food options on site was Miguel German in the Rare/Bana bar area.. you must allow him to show you his "magic show" as he prepares excellent cocktails.. he is special.
All around excellent experience that I will repeat with my family and grandchildren with a purchase of Melia points and membership..!
Great food options, nighttime excitement and wonderful pools and beach.
My only watch-out is protect your belongings and safety upon arrival into PUJ to only use pre-arranged transportation to resort.
Check- out experience was wonderful with terrific service and explanation from Gissel Ramirez..
Worth the trip and experience.

reviews.author: Mike53705
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful location, beautiful resort, fantastic beach, plenty of restaurants and very nice rooms. We recently stayed at the resort as part of a group of around 80 people. We had a number of group dinners, meetings and group excursions. As part of the host group, whenever we had a question or concern about anything, Grace was always there to help to help us. She was with us before any event started, stayed with us throughout the event to handle any problems and was with us all the way to the end. The attention she paid to us as a group made us feel extra special.

reviews.author: Josh K
reviews.title: Movement Mortgage Presidents Club
reviews.text: Our trip was AMAZING and our butler was a huge part of making it so very relaxing and enjoyable. Armando Minier took SUCH GREAT care of us that when (not if) we come back, we will request him again!! No matter what we requested, he came through quickly. We didn't have to worry about anything the entire time we were here--except for enjoying our vacation!!

reviews.author: Nicki T
reviews.title: Great resort!!
reviews.text: This resort is gorgeous and everyone is so friendly. Jose Salvador is awesome and if you get the butler service request him. The best resort I've gone to so far. The food, entertainment, beaches, and clubs are nice. Lots of stuff for kids to do as well.

reviews.author: Paula G
reviews.title: Very very Large
reviews.text:
Interesting resort. We were here as part of a large group. Grounds are beautiful, gorgeous landscaping with all types of bridges, ponds, eco walking trails, and gorgeous zen like design around the spa.
However, you are mostly left on your own to find your way around, as plan/ design was not well thought out. Each part is lovely, but isolated from the rest which creates no flow. Could walk all over, very flat, and good for running. I took a run to find the gym, but ran in circles until I found it. It was teeny with only 3 treadmills for a ton of people..they did have spin classes and only 5 people from the massive amount of guests showed up.  Maybe not an athletic crowd. Yoga class on the beach had a good turnout, but the instructor was not a real yoga person, and it was a terrible class. I expected better, but got used to not great. Paddle yoga in the pool ( sounds great) which I did want to do, had only 5 or 6 boards, all taken, so I couldn't participate when I really wanted to.
Rooms need updating. And heard most complaints about the sinks, the toilets, and very dark with no place to put clothes.
Food, good,but trying a little too hard to be gournet, and not quite up there. But tasty, fresh, and diverse.  Reservations needed, but very disorganized system. Passion, was a joke.
But, the place seems packed and popular in spite of its faults. Help is not really trained well compared to many other all inclusives from another resort company we usually frequent.
Stayed for 4 days, and was very pleasant and beach was great. Wouldn't be able to take the disorganization for a week!

reviews.author: Missy M
reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice and grounds are very beautiful but make sure you have the Royal Service, (Pay Extra) The Reserve is far from the beach just FYI.Check in is a nightmare, 3 hours in line. Then checking out tried to recharge our credit card for our entire stay. Keep all receipts!  

Food is normal all-inclusive food and drinks are good!

reviews.author: Lexington11
reviews.title: Bring your own Pinot Nior
reviews.text:
Because you can't get any here for less than $95 per bottle, and that's the stuff you would pay $19 at your local Food Lion.  Would never come back even though we stayed at the Reserve, which is comparable to the concierge level at a hotel.... supposed to be special with your own personal butler... really?  You met him on the first day and he gave you a cell phone in order to give you the confidence that he was available to you day and night..... and then he didn't answer your calls the very next day.... 
Infrascture of the place is phenomenal, room is very big and nicely laid out.  That's the biggest plus of this place.  Spa, well.... service is poor.  None of the jacuzzi's or saunas would get hot enough and there was no one around to assist.  Restaurants? Mmmm well at best a 3, again untrained service personnel.

reviews.author: Lauron2013
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Great beach with lots of chairs. The beach was very clean. Hard to get a lounge chair, too many people saving them, however there was a lot. Too much VIP areas that weren't used. Room was tired and needed updating. Food was awesome, especially the steak house..We had previously stayed we a La Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and it was excellent, this was not up to that standard. Staff was awesome!  Golf was included in the price however no Marshall with slow play and carts and drinks were way overpriced

reviews.author: joleenew
reviews.title: Pampered!
reviews.text: We were there as a thank you/gift trip, so we can not comment on pricing/value. We were well pampered. Take advantage of royal services. They were always ready and willing. The massage was a very relaxing experience.  We really enjoyed the spa's pool, showers and sauna - on a rainy day. Overall it was a great trip.

reviews.author: fredeleroux
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Amazing hotel with lots of great facilities and activities available: tennis, basketball courts, kids zone, gym, spa, casino and more. The staff is super friendly and loveable, I was lucky enough to be able to stay in touch with some of them. The rooms are spacious and kept incredibly clean. The food is delicious, it offers many variety to please everyone and the service is great but could be improved. I highly suggest this destination to anyone, as much as families or couples. Bring out your dance moves, because the parties get you moving down there. Enjoy!

reviews.author: fullmoon2008
reviews.title: Okay, but......
reviews.text: This is the second Paradisus resort for us.  The Royal Service is nice yet our butler was the worst imaginable.  I believe the language barrier was a big part of the problem.   It seemed as if the total organization of the resort was off.  However, the beach is beautiful even if there are no seashells.  Off the resort beach one is beseiged by vendors selling cigars, marijuana or as they say, "Anything you want". This was truly annoying.  We actually enjoyed the Zenlike atmosphere at the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen more

reviews.author: Deborah H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Dinner at the Palazzo was amazing and our waiter Miguel Jimenez was excellent. Our best meal in the entire resort. Also liked the Hibachi Grill with the friendly staff and amazing magician located at the bar between the Hibachi and Rare. The Blue Agave wasn't so good for lunch or dinner and the service was slow. The only food available during the day was the buffet. 
Our Butler Jeuri was excellent. 
For the extra cost, I would pass on this service. 
The rooms were okay. I didn't like the opening to the bathroom, it didn't allow for privacy and they were in need of repair and maintenance. The lighting in the main hallways, stairways and pathways were too dark and almost dangerous. 
It was confusing to find your way around the villa's!
The beverage service at the beach wasn't so good, pretty much self service. Also no snacks or food service available in the beach or pool area. They really need a pool grill area with a nacho bar or something. 
Live entertainment, some evenings with very nice talent. 
Departing from the resort was very quick and efficient and the taxi was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Scott B
reviews.title: Company Trip
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, great gathering places around bars poolside and very friendly staff.  Especially Lilian Aquino, at the Bargarita!  The restaurants were very good.  The grounds are very beautiful and well maintained.

reviews.author: pjhd2
reviews.title: Gabi Club
reviews.text: We went to this restaurant for breakfast everyday.  You can get good food for breakfast anywhere on the property but the people working here were great.  The staff were very attentive and friendly.  Special thanks to Celso, Julie, Anthony, Liz, Santa, Nesto, Yariza, and Jose.  Great team!

reviews.author: Murillo S
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Hotel incrível. Quartos enormes. Piscinas lindas e Praia incrível. 
Tudo incluso não se gasta nada a mais

Funcionários excelentes :
Wilson e luis do restaurante The Grill. 
Benita bar de la playa. 
Todos mui atenciosos!

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Poor quality staff
reviews.text:
The overall trip was fabulous; The resort is breath-taking and the wait/pool staff are wonderful. The reason I gave this place a less than par review was due to the amount of things stolen from our room by the maid services. 
After discovering a large amount of money was stolen from my purse (our fault for not using the safe), we put a "Do Not Disturb" sign on our door and immediately went to report it. Upon returning to our room a half an our later with a security officer, The sign was gone and our door was wide open. The maid who was inside told us, verbatim, She watched us leave, and even though she saw the sign, she thought she could go in and clean anyways. Pretty sneaky!

reviews.author: kjean1980
reviews.title: My favorite place yet!
reviews.text: For those of you that I've stayed in an all-inclusive resort before, you know the food is not always awesome but usually good or decent. Unfortunately, the food was so good here that I probably gained 10 pounds! Play we're here for a business retreat. Have to the wonderful job of putting together some really great gatherings with the theme every single night. The staff was polite, the rooms or large americlean, the beach was beautiful and did a great job of getting us involved games at the pool everyday.  We are planning to take a second trip here soon!

reviews.author: giodit .
reviews.title: Experiencia increíble
reviews.text: El hotel es maravilloso y las camaristas muy cordiales. Un cariño especial a la supervisora Gladis Jiménez y la camarista Yohaira Martins que cuidaron tan bien de la limpeza de mi cuarto, mismo después de mucha arena de la playa.

reviews.author: alanasteinberg
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay. Beautiful beach and attentive staff--especially Argenis Romera, who was so helpful in getting us anything and everything we needed to make this an incredibly relaxing vacation. The best of the best!!  Johnny was our favorite waiter at the breakfast and lunch buffet and Rare, the delicious steakhouse.

reviews.author: Brian D
reviews.title: Great property, excellent service!
reviews.text: Royal service is the way to go if you are going without kids.   Alexander is a fantastic butler!   The food was great.   Private pool and beach were awesome.   We loved every aspect of our trip except having to leave.

reviews.author: Bennylin1437
reviews.title: Best dinner in years
reviews.text:
Isidro is the man, best experience 😎😎😎🤔

The tasting menu is the greatest and the service is amazing, how my man Isidro bringing us extra round of our favor dish.

The restaurant is nice and quite.  Very 👍

reviews.author: aferrisw
reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Slow staff, and the majority are unfriendly.I would give it a 6 out of 10 in cleanliness.  Food was not very good either.Very disappointed,  would never recommend it to anyone.  Everyone we travelled with agreed it needed to be updated.  This is my first bad review ever!!

reviews.author: tom k
reviews.title: Blue Agave
