reviews.text: Agustin Delakofd, Carlos Manuel, and Juan Robles were our chef and waiter staff.  We were dining at the Blue Agave.  They went above and beyond to make our visit great. They were there to wait on us and find us seats for a group of twelve.  As they had to slide tables together.  they just did a great job to make our stay be more relaxing.

reviews.author: Steven T
reviews.title: December 2016 trip to Paradisus
reviews.text: Out of all the all inclusive resorts that we have been to, by far the food here was the best.  Not only were the specialty restaurants wonderful, but the buffet restaurant had the most choices in comparison to other resorts.  Grounds were well manicured, check in was easy, and the room service did a wonderful job.  Best of all to help us navigate the many options that the resort offered, as well as the Dominican Republic was Enrique Quinones.  Enrique offered great communication, helped us book several items, and always had a huge smile.   Looking forward to going back some day!

reviews.author: DonMcW66
reviews.title: great place but in need of improvments
reviews.text: Just returned from a business conference at this hotel (second time in 10 yrs) Overall its a great place, food was great most service was great just missing out on a lot of the little details which could have made this hotel so much better. The hotel was full last week which I guess is why our room had 2 queen beds pushed together to form 1. Some lights in the room including the fan didn't work. Only decaf coffee in the room for morning coffee room service never happened before noon most days after 4pm one day it never happened at all. Beach service was very hit and miss most days you had to get your own drinks at the bar. And not a lot of servers speak much English.

reviews.author: tgravelle
reviews.title: Buffet Service - Samuel
reviews.text:
Samuel/Isaias was a wonderful buffet attendant, singing and dancing during his entire shift...  every day he greeted us with a song about coffee!!  If only we could take him back home with us!! 
The buffet had a variety of food with an omelet bar.

reviews.author: kchaucer
reviews.title: Amazingly positive experience at our first all inclusive vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent a week in December combining pleasure with his annual company sales meeting.  This property was amazing.  The buildings, pools, rooms, etc. were all beautifully furnished and kept immaculate.  We thought the food was great, and heard several other guests say it was the best food they had ever had at an all-inclusive resort.  The beach at the resort was the best of the entire island.  And the ENTIRE staff at the resort were genuinely friendly and helpful.  One employee stood our above all others.

Caroline Franco, of the Concierge Desk, was the best I have ever experienced.  She greeted me every day by name, with a big smile and went above and beyond to get us reservations each evening for the restaurant of our choice.  She made great recommendations and followed up the next day to see how well we liked it.  She even remembered our room number from our first encounter!

We had two great business events: a welcoming cocktail party outside on one of their many beautiful patios, and an amazingly pretty awards dinner on the beach complete with white tablecloths and special lighting.  They could not have been improved upon.

reviews.author: Nadia Radulovich
reviews.title: Días inolvidables en Paradisus
reviews.text:
Pase una excelente estadía en Paradisus. La comida notable. Gran variedad de platos. El buffet cambia sus platos todos los días para todas las comidas, asegurando que uno evite comer repetido.
Mucha atención al detalle. Todo el personal fue muy atento.

reviews.author: El melocotón X
reviews.title: Excelente sitio
reviews.text: Lo mejor del Resort es Raynol Tamayo y Santos Frias.  Super amables, carismáticos y serviciales.  Ahora ya se bailar bachata.los mejores de el todo resort el personal muy buenos muy buena comida todos muy buenos

reviews.author: Mac V
reviews.title: Buenas vacaciones
reviews.text: Raynol Tamayo el mejor maestro de bachata, merengue y salsa! Woooow!  Buena atencion muy alegre amigable ademas muy buen servicio de las demas personas muy agradable con gusto regresar a este paraiso ...

reviews.author: Dra Audrys L
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Buena comida, buen trato, buen personal, encantada una vez más de estar aquí y reducir el buen trato de los empleados me hacen sentir en casa o mejor. Santiago Núñez y Juan Fran moreno de room serviré nos dieron el todo por el todo

reviews.author: Cari
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Excellent food, beach is gorgeous and service was prompt. The rooms are comfortable and have adequate amenities. I have been to several hotels in the area and this is one of the best. You should bring mosquito repellent.

reviews.author: 629estherv
reviews.title: Mejorar
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel,comida inigualable.Debe mejorarse la limpieza en habitacion y baño.Lo de más esta muy bien y con un personal super atento y preparado.Encontre bebida y picadera que ningun hotel me habia ofrecido

reviews.author: Nairobi F
reviews.title: Super hotel y muy buenas atenciones
reviews.text:
Muy satisfecha, el servicio de Alimentos y Bebidas muy bueno, las atenciones del Room service son maravillosas. 

El joven Fernando Geronimo fue muy cortés y atento. Dispuesto a ayudar y muy respetuoso. 

Todo es bueno en la comida aquí ... Recomendado

reviews.author: Edward F
reviews.title: Room service lo mejor
reviews.text: Este room service fue lo maximo fernando geronimo y francisco reyes fueron las personas mas amables y profesionales en servicio que jamas habianos visto excelente profesionales a la hora de dar un gran servicio muchas gracias por todo..!!

reviews.author: Martha L
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Me encantó el servicio en este gran hotel especialmente el gran servicio de room service que nos brindó Fernando Jerónimo y Francisco Reyes fue espectacular desde buenos vinos hasta buenos quesos muchas gracias..!!

reviews.author: tashalatoyaw
reviews.title: A Slice of Heaven
reviews.text: This is a nice resort with excellent amenities.  I will caution that it is a large resort with shuttle (golf cart) services to various onsite destinations.  The 24-hr room service is a super plus, when you are prevented from leaving your room. The buffet choices for breakfast, lunch or dinner are superb and I am sure you will find something to your liking.  Stay away from the mamawana, only if you are not a drinker.  The nightly entertainment was fabulous and very interactive.  I will certainly put this on my travel list to come again!!!

reviews.author: Barbara F
reviews.title: simplesmente um sonho!!!
reviews.text: Pensa num lugar paradisíaco!!! Esse lugar realmente é inacreditável! os quartos sao enormes, super limpos, camas confortáveis e a vista da varanda é deslumbrante... as piscinas do hotel sao lindas, a noite elas se transformam com luzes coloridas...e a comida? Nossa... vários restaurantes dentro do hotel. São tao bons que vc não sabe aonde vai comer...alem da programação social que tb é sempre alto astral! Diversão garantida pra toda a familia!!! vale muitoooo a pena! Um dia quem sabe voltarei com meu marido e meus filhos!

reviews.author: 51peggye
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Butler Area, and our Butler was wonderful, Francisco.  He was very accomodating, friendly and wanted to make sure we had the best experience.
The Pallazzo restaurant had terrific food, the rest of the food was good but nothing spectacular.
The private pool at the Butler area was very very nice and relaxing.
The other Francisco who waited on the beach and pool area was also terrific

reviews.author: Ken J
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Wonderful trip....place was great. Our special thanks go out to Carlos (our "butler"), for the very energetic way he handled our every request....to Felix, Martin and Miguel, Oscar and Ingrid at the Palazzo restaurant who made that a great dining experience and to Leonardo, the bartender at the Royal Service adult pool that greets everyday with a level of enthusiasm that is second to none. The people that we met that worked for this resort made all the difference. Everyone has the ocean, the beach, nice rooms, etc., but the people I have listed above I would ask for again when we return. They are the difference makers.

reviews.author: Tracey W
reviews.title: The staff and service are what makes this place hum!
reviews.text: Stayed here for business event and extended a day.  The staff really go out of their way to please you.  So polite and always a smile.  The food has been good and it's nice to have so many options.  The butler service has been helpful on many fronts.  Only problem I had was going to spa for gel pedicure and the total experience lasted 20 minutes.  The description said 50 minute pedicure.  However, they called to to ask about my experience and I told her. She expressed much concerned about that so perhaps they will do something about it. I will update if they do.

reviews.author: 323charlsm
reviews.title: Paradise...
reviews.text: This was a trip we will remember for the rest of our lives. This was paradise and the professional staff on hand was there to accommodate at every turn. It was an amazing time with outside excursions and in house cuisine for every meal. I'd recommend this place to everyone, because it was paradise.

reviews.author: KathiKSL
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: I was there in 2009 and this was my second visit.  The physical property is gorgeous.  Great pool and beach facilities.  Sadly, I thought the food was less than average.  No creativity......nothing seemed fresh.  Breakfast was okay due to the omelet station, but the bacon was baked into a clump everyday.......no crispness and greasy.  Nothing looked appetizing, but I tried some different things and things that should be hot weren't or cold weren't.   Burger at Blue Agave pre cooked and no flavor.  Guacamole was like soup.  They took leftover pastries from breakfast to make cupcakes for the coffee bar (not horrible but not cupcakes).  Beverages seemed watered down.  Dinner at the Tempanyaki table was a let down.........our chef had no personality or showmanship like the other tables.  The meal was not great.  One night of two catered dinners was okay but again not great. Seemed to be a lot of issues with the rooms.  Some lost power, some toilets didn't flush, our lock was broken and our shower had to be fixed due to a leak and no hot water.  Staff is friendly and they try but even though the hotel was about 40% they seemed stretched.  Pedro (Mono Grande) on the beach is a delight....always smiling and offering help to make your day wonderful!

reviews.author: Leandro B
reviews.title: Excelentes jornadas de trabajo en el hotel
reviews.text:
Estuvimos entre el 16 y el 22 de octubre en el hotel participando en unas reuniones de trabajo y la verdad es que todo fue excelente, el servicio, las habitaciones, la comida, absolutamente todo.
Sin mencionar la playa y las piscinas que eran muy buenas para relajarse en los momentos de descanso. Pienso que es muy recomendable para ir en familia. y sin duda que volvería, pero esta vez, de vacaciones solo para disfrutar.

reviews.author: Pav M
reviews.title: Bueno

reviews.author: Amaury A
reviews.title: Excelente Asistencia y Comodidad
reviews.text:
Gracias por sus atenciones. Las habitaciones son una maravilla, la comida, el OSSOBUCO lo mejor en VENTO Restaurant. El chekin out todo super.

Melvin Concepcion & Luis Florian
La gente de actividades, muy cheveres.

reviews.author: Jose R
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text:
Excelente Dias con el grupo de Hebalife 

Excelente las actividades de la piscina dirigidas por Melvin Concepcion, Luis Florian y Naomi José ... Me gusta la comida de Gabi Beach recomendado !!!! 👏🎉😜🍾

reviews.author: Alan R
reviews.title: Exelente
reviews.text: #juanpolanco #lauravaldez exente  personas con una calidad de servicio exelente personas  Muchas gracias para todo es super y los maleteros no recuerdo sus  nombre pero a ellos tambien Muchas gracias un hotel definitivamente exelente

reviews.author: Alan R
reviews.title: Me encanto el servicio  los maleteros , y un  batender  que se llama juan grabiel
reviews.text: Gracias  por el exelente servicio y el buen trato  definitivamente uno de los mejores hoteles  de república dominican y el caribe ............ aunque me ubiese gustado durar más tiempo mínimo dos mese jajajjajaja

reviews.author: Veloz S
reviews.title: Excelente esperiencia
reviews.text: Un gran equipo de personas dispuestas a dar el 110% en su compromiso y decicacion a la excelencia en el servicio al sus huespdes y a todos cuanto visitan las instaciones, su ambiente tipo colonial con un toque moderno

reviews.author: Yineska T
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text:
Ir a un hotel y pasarte 10 días y como quiera sentirte como en tu casa, no tiene precio... muchas gracias a todos, en especial a Massiel Jimenez que trabaja con tanta entrega y dedicación, eres una excelente profesional.

Yineska Taveras

reviews.author: adamisouzas
reviews.title: Visual and comfort
reviews.text:
Wonderful hotel, clean, courteous attendants, varied diet. I loved the Xique Xique and Gasoline, 
dance teachers! 
Evenings at Gabi beach bar always new and exciting! The eligible restaurants are top notch.

reviews.author: jamespmoninger
reviews.title: great time!
reviews.text:
Very nice resort.  Everything you're looking for. LOTS of activities to choose from.
We even saw a Dominican winter league baseball game.
Cesar De Los Santos brought breakfast everyday and was very helpful.

reviews.author: tdowning123
reviews.title: Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Visited this resort for a customer work/vacation trip each nigh we spent time at the Gabi Beach Bar, great breeze right off the ocean, open air seating. Incredible ambience.  Service was excellent, one particular server stood out each night Yessenia Martinez went above, serving with excellence. Great place to hang out at the hotel after dinner

reviews.author: Familia L
reviews.title: la pasamos muy bien!!!!!
reviews.text: estuvimos la semana pasada en un congreso es ese  hotel maravilloso, para pasar mucho mas de una semana  . nos alojamos., en la habitacion 3903, excelentemente atendidos por carmen lebrun, quien nos atendio dispuesta a solucionar cualquier problema, felicitaciones para ella y gracias!

reviews.author: ClaudiaLococo
reviews.title: solo se piensa en volver!!
reviews.text:
mas que palabras de agradecimiento...fuimos por el congreso y jamas me he sentido tan bien atendida. la amabilidad la dedicacion , buen trato,y esmero de todos es sorprendente!! 
son increibles...EMMANUEL Y FLIA LIONI (gabi bar) SHAKY SHAKY, LUCKY LUCKY (/equipo de recreacion) ALEXIS (repositor de cuarto) LA CHEF DEL RESTO JAPONES LOS MOZOS, NOEL Y RICARDO(gym) y tantas personas mas que por desgracia no recuerdo sus nombres pero se que agradeci personalmente lo maravillosas personas que son!! 
Solo pienso en volver con toda la familia y que sientan y vean lo mismo que yo! 
GRACIAAAAAS!!!

reviews.author: Joselin A
reviews.title: Great times
reviews.text: Raynold tamayo was a great entertainer. Good dancer, great attitude, was helpful. He made the stay much more pleasant with his positive attitude and always trying to include guests in activities. Great service!

reviews.author: Guillermo C
reviews.title: Desorganización en la recepción, picardía en el restaurant peruano........
reviews.text: Fui a un Congreso, y arribé al hotel cerca del mediodía. Me respondieron que las habitaciones se podían ocupar recién a las 15, pero una media hora antes de eso comenzaron a llegar diversos huéspedes anglo parlantes que recibieron su habitación de inmediato. Ante mi queja, me dijeron que se había demorado la liberación de mi habitación, lo cual no es la mejor práctica, porque los huéspedes debieran ser atendidos en una base de ¨primero llegado, primero atendido¨, y no con habitación fija. Luego pedimos un vino de 37 dólares con un colega, y nos descorcharon uno similar de 95. Para destacar, solamente la excelente atención en el bar de playa de Feliciano del Rosario y Joel Valdez. Por lo demás, el hotel es correcto, las habitaciones se hacen a tiempo, el minibar se repone y hay higiene y variedad de servicios. La playa no me pareció tampoco de las mejores, meramente regular, hay algunas algas y pozos

reviews.author: twilobaby
reviews.title: Planning a Wedding???   SERVED…at your command!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana is at your service INDEED for the wedding of your dreams! The wedding team, service providers and the entire staff at the Paradisus are well equipped and have the capacity to accommodate a wedding on any scale from your most romantic elopement to the grandest wedding affair you can ever imagine.  I KNOW this because I recently had an opportunity to experience their services in “real time”, when I visited the Paradisus Palma Real on their “Love at First Site” experience.  This experience is offered as an option for those interested in finding the perfect place/setting for their wedding OR for those who have selected the Paradisus, but would like to have an opportunity to walk through and experience all of the details of their special day with an onsite wedding coordinator.   The bride to be who also happens to be my sister, myself and my mother were extremely fortunate to be paired with Raquel Vega who is currently serving as our on-site wedding coordinator.  Raquel Vega’s commitment to quality service and professionalism was thoroughly and dutifully exemplified by her actions from the moment we arrived at the Paradisus, to the day we left.  Ms. Vega currently remains at our service to this very moment even though we have left the property and are in the period of waiting before my sister’s big day!  

Another integral feature that was provided to make our experience a relaxing, stress free and COMPLETE was appointing Francisco Santos, our butler, as part of Royal Service during our 3 day stay at the Paradisus.  Talk about service provision and attention to detail!  Francisco listens to EVERYTHING you say and without you having to ask HE KNOWS what to do.  This is a very important and rare attribute to find these days in service provision.  The killer, Francisco Santos’ temperament and attention to detail came off naturally!  Yeah Francisco was our “butler” but he was completely on another level of service that simply cannot be trained.  I don’t know what Francisco’s supervisor understands about Francisco’s commitment to service, but from where I come from - New York City – He should be training or monitoring for this brand of service at a higher level at the Paradisus.  I feel so lucky to have had Francisco make my short business trip feel like Shangri-La !  

So,  there you have it….the Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana is at your service and your wish is truly your reality!  I can’t wait for my sister’s wedding because I plan on having a grand time : ) But you don’t need to take my word for it, I encourage you to experience it  for yourself.  Ask for Raquel Vega if you are planning a wedding and Francisco Santos as your butler on Royal Service if you are lucky enough to catch him in that capacity on your trip.

reviews.author: bekiu k
reviews.title: A perfect place to combine business and leisure
reviews.text: I stayed in Paradisus Palma over an important fair held in the resort. My team and I had a wonderful stay and also had great results. Special thanks to Niela Eugenio the Convention Services Manager who took care of all details with professionalism and dedication. Her attention and support contributed to have a pleasant stay combining business and fun. I would love to be back again.

reviews.author: tagehilal
reviews.title: Company Incentive Trip
reviews.text:
Our convention manager Niela Eugenio handled all of the details for our company incentive trip perfectly.  She was very responsive and accommodating.  The group was more than pleased with their luxurious trip.

Thank you.

reviews.author: odee16
reviews.title: Wedding Planning
reviews.text: My mother, sister and I went to the Paradisus to plan my wedding. I'm so excited I get to go back. The staff and hotel were simply amazing. We booked for a standard room but was upgraded to Royal Service. The royal service at the hotel includes a butler, a cellular phone, royal service clubhouse, RS Restaurants, RS pool, RS Beach and access to the nearby hotel; The Reserve. Our butler was Fransisco; he was also amazing. He was available 24/7 via the cell phone. Having never had a butler before, Fransisco exceeded my expectations, he went above and beyond to make our stay an enjoyable one (which really wasn't hard the place is amazing). He took special care of us. My wedding planner was Raquel, she took us thorough the whole wedding including venues, wedding menus, flowers, table decoration, DJ, photographer and indulged my request to tour the different option of rooms. All of the rooms include a full size Jacuzzi and balcony, all very neat, safe and free of Zeka (thumbs up(important to me)) This hotel is gorgeous, the pool and beach are absolutely beautiful. The artwork, relaxing lounge beds, cabana, chairs, etc. The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is right...I can't wait to have my wedding there. I would gladly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real as a destination wedding location or even a place to just vacate your life and feel Royal while doing it!

reviews.author: Laura H
reviews.title: Corporate Rewards Trip - Excellent Property
reviews.text: I planned a group corporate rewards trip at the Paradisus Palma real with 54 guests from Oct. 4-9, 2016. Nancy Tibavizco was our group contact and she and her staff did an amazing job. She was very responsive to all our group needs and everyone was very happy. The property was amazingly beautiful, the rooms were nice (Luxury Jr. Suites), and the food was mostly excellent. The service really stood out for all our guests - from front desk to room service to bar staff, they were all very accommodating.  The nightly performances were fun and the Gabi beach bar was always a really fun atmosphere.

reviews.author: ivethma12
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive Service for Corporate Groups
reviews.text: The service was great. The staff member were always helpful and very professional, especially our group hostess, Niela Eugenio, who was always present coordinating and making sure all the events went perfect.  Excellent food and hospitality.  Highly recommended by a very prestigious multi national.

reviews.author: Marta A
reviews.title: Excelente atencion
reviews.text: La calidez humana con la que nos atendieron fue muy apreciada. Recibimos una excelente atención para el grupo de más de 40 personas. Nancy Tibavizco nos atendió súper bien. Muy profesional. Todos estuvimos muy bien contentos. El hotel ademas es muy bonito.

reviews.author: Nita S
reviews.title: President's club
reviews.text:
Our event for 100 people was flawless! Nancy Tibavizco was a event planner on site. She made everything seem so easy starting from checking in, to meeting space to food to entertainment, decor, etc.
Francisco santos was our room butler and he served many other rooms along with ours. He came meet us at the beach several times to make sure if we needed anything. We made sure we were we'll taken care of! Truly felt so special being here. More like being pampered like we were there for a honey moon And not a business trip! Thank you so much Nancy and Francisco! You made me look good as the company event planner!

reviews.author: jtsj16
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text:
This is a really nice property that should not be missed.  Nancy Tibavizco was outstanding to work with as we had a group of about 100 at a meeting there.  

The rooms were nice, although water temperature can be a little tricky in the shower.  Overall, my family and I had a great time and would definitely return.

reviews.author: Daniel C
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real and it is a stunning resort with impeccable service, excellent cuisine, friendly staff and well appointed guest rooms. I definitely recommend you to book your next vacations here in this resort. Meeting facilites are top notch

reviews.author: lowellh790
reviews.title: Beyond my expectations!!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and the staff during our stay was impeccable.  Possibly the best all-inclusive resort we have ever stayed at.  Many options for food, beautiful beach front property with many chairs and cabanas for everyone to use.  This is one vacation that I would not have changed a thing!!

reviews.author: MPHersh
reviews.title: Louis Sanchez
reviews.text: Most amazing trip ever!  We were treated like royalty by the entire staff at the resort.  Service = 5.  Food = 5+.  Accommodations = 5+.  Our personal butler was Louis Sanchez....the most amazing assistant you could ever dream of.  On a 1 to 10 scale, Louis is a 12!!!  Be sure to request his assistance when you check in!  Definitely a repeat location 😉👍😃

reviews.author: A3591IRandrewl
reviews.title: Relaxing week
reviews.text:
Thought the food was excellent for an all inclusive. Sand on the beach was amazing, very soft and didn't get hot. Really a wonderful overall experience. 

My only complaint is I think the beds and pillows are too firm and of poor quality 

Aerial was my butler. Super nice and helpful. Had a heart for service

reviews.author: ChoppyBadger
reviews.title: Work program saved by an INCREDIBLE Convention Services Manager
reviews.text: I was part of a team that operated a corporate incentive program & we had challenges at the property in getting things done. I believe our program would have failed if not for our CSM Niela EUGENIO.  She really went above and beyond and made sure that every single detail that we were concerned about was taken care of.  From a beach party that was rained out - she saved the day by surprising us with a video wall in the ballroom that made you feel like you were outside.  I would only come back to this property if you guaranteed me that I'd be able to work with Niela again.  AMAZING job, Niela!!!

reviews.author: msouffront
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel para Cumbres y Reuniones
reviews.text: Coordine una Cumbre de Gobernadores del Bancos Centrales en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real, y todo salio perfecto, el trabajo realizado por nuestra coordinadora de grupos Niela Eugenio fue mas que excelente, siempre estuvo atenta a nuestras necesidades, desde los preparativos previos hasta nuestra llegada al Hotel.  Todo transcurrio tal como se planeo gracias a la excelente disposicion de su personal y sobretodo de Niela Eugenio.

reviews.author: SAS23
reviews.title: Company President's Club Trip - Attention to detail and atmosphere were amazing
reviews.text:
In 2014 I starting planning my company's President's Club incentive trip to take place the the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in March 2015. It was my first time planning an international trip for over 100 people. I was very nervous. Then I spoke with and virtually met Niela Eugenio, the Convention Services Manager at the property. She was the easiest person to work with. Very attentive to detail and cared about my event as if it was her own. She even threw in her own touches and customized our all-inclusive bands to be the color of our company. Her and I hit it off right away when we met on site and she was there throughout the whole trip to make sure every detail was achieved and that my guests and I were all happy and enjoying ourselves. Even in areas outside of her responsibility (such as our excursions), she made sure our needs were exceeded. Because of her hospitality and professionalism, and the amazing staff at the Paradisus Palma Real, I planned our next trip at their sister location in Playa del Carmen, Mexico. I cannot say enough good things about Melia's properties. I would highly recommend to anyone travelling whether alone or with a huge group.

Cheers, 

Sara

reviews.author: wadeh24
reviews.title: Great people
reviews.text:
Antonia and Angelita from the lobby bar were great.  We also had a great experience with Wandy Castio and Juan Sudrez.  

Kids club was in the reserve area, but easy to access.  Club didn't open until 9:00, so we would have preferred if it had opened earlier.

reviews.author: Paola Andrea F
reviews.title: El mejor lugar para que tus clientes vivan experiencias Inolvidables!!
reviews.text:
Hace unos idas estuvimos realizando un evento para uno de los clientes mas importantes de la Agencia. y recibimos todo el apoyo y profesionalismo de todo el equipo del hotel, todo esto encabezado por Massiel Jimenez quien fue nuestro apoyo en todo el proceso del evento que resulto siendo un exito!! 
Gracias Massiel y todo tu equipo por ayudarnos a cumplir nuestro objetivo que era un cliente feliz :)

reviews.author: AnaPrada
reviews.title: INOLVIDABLE!!!
reviews.text:
Hicimos una reunión por 4 días con 300 personas!! Todo fue perfecto !! el evento un éxito!!! el servicio impecable, siempre tuvimos manos que nos ayudaron en TODO, logística, alimentos , habitaciones, camareros etc .
Su líder Massiel Jimenez, increíble , siempre dispuesta ayudar, solo nos queda decir GRACIAS por cada uno de los detalles, gracias por su paciencia y por su dedicación.

Sin duda volvería hacer otro evento allí !!!!

reviews.author: angelicavillarroel
reviews.title: El lugar perfecto para llevar a tus clientes a vivir una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text:
Tuvimos un evento para 300 personas con uno de los clientes más importantes de la agencia.

Recibimos todo el apoyo, profesionalismo, experiencia, servicio y sobre todo,el don de gente, de todo el equipo de eventos de Paradisus Palma Real.

Gracias por apoyarnos y hacer que nuestros clientes vivieran una experiencia inolvidable. 

Gracias Massiel Jimenez  por haber  liderado este evento, por hacer que que todo tu equipo y todo el personal que tuvimos a nuestra disposición atendiéndonos en el hotel diera lo mejor de sí.

Sin pensarlo haríamos de nuevo un evento allá!

reviews.author: Ana Teresa F
reviews.title: Un lugar para relajarse y disfrutar
reviews.text: Las habitaciones son amplias, tiene variedad de restaurantes, la playa hermosa, un spa completo con excelentes instalaciones y la atención fue amable siempre. Tuve problemas con el jacuzzi dentro de la habitación pero lograron solucionarlo sin inconveniente.

reviews.author: Brooke S
reviews.title: Great hotel for an incentive program.
reviews.text: I recently hosted an incentive program for 100 people at the resort and it was fantastic.  We utilized Royal Service & The Reserve for our guest rooms which are ocean view rooms, which I think is key.  The service levels were fantastic, especially from Niela Eugeio who was in charge of taking care of our group.  She didn't miss a beat with the details of the program, decor, entertainment, guest room needs, and she was always available on property to help out.  Not to mention she has a great attention to detail.  ALSO, the restaurants at the hotel were great, good food and beverage options and great service.  I would love to bring another group to this property.

reviews.author: ams122779
reviews.title: Wonderful Corporate Event
reviews.text:
I recently planned a work incentive trip at the Paradisus.  I live in the U.S. (Iowa) and had never been to a Paradisus resort.  I had been to the Dominican several times and wanted to try out a new place.  I had to reley on the events team and do all the planning over email.  The event planner I worked with was Niela Eugenio.  She was amazing to work with.  She helped coordinate everything for our event and I didn't have to worry about a thing.  She was extremely responsive via email and was there on site if we had any questions at all.  I would highly recommend this resort for any couples looking for a romantic get a way or even for a company event!

The beach was also one of the best beaches I have ever visited!

reviews.author: Sergio Luiz M
reviews.title: Excelente opção
reviews.text: Levamos um grupo de incentivo e nos hospedamos com serviço Royal. Os quartos são melhores localizados, todos mais próximos a praia com serviços de mordomo. Usar esse tipo de serviço e poder desfrutar das áreas reservadas de praia, piscinas, restaurantes, faz com que a experiencia para um grupo pequeno e exclusivo seja melhor em todos os sentidos. Creio que o serviço de mordomo poderia ser um pouco melhor e com mais atenção aos hospedes. Talvez um pouco mais de treinamento a equipe ajudaria. E tambem melhorar o restaurante exclusivo deste serviço. Talvez um ambiente mais claro, com mais luz e mais espeço também seria mais adequado pela diferença que se paga para o 'serviço Royal'.

reviews.author: Francisco M
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones de mi vida
reviews.text: Con respecto a Dahiana Moreno actividades y al resto del personal del hotel he encontrado un alto enfoque de servicio al cliente y una sonrisa siempre para sus clientes. Muchas gracias por su atención. Dahiana Moreno excelente mis vacaciones con ella si regreso espero verla aquí es la extrella de actividades y la sonrisa y la atención gracias

reviews.author: Ricardo K
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, habitação bem espaçosa, comida com muita variedade, piscinas excelentes e praia linda.
Ideal para eventos e passar férias com a família. E muito obrigado a SHORTY pelo atendimento!!!!!

reviews.author: Alexandre Rosis
reviews.title: Sensacional
reviews.text: Very nice resort. Good food, good rooms, excellent people like Shorty taking care of us all the time! The beach is awesome, swimming pool amazing and All inclusive. I do recommend staying there. Nice days in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: 122cortega
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text:
Uno de los mejores hoteles en que he estado.   Mención especial merece Gilberto Mejía, en el bar de la alberca principal.   Sus sugerencias de bebidas hizo este día memorable.
La playa es de arena blanca y muy fina; el mar es turquesa y con temperatura muy agradable.   Tiene una piscina principal muy grande.   Respecto a la comida, es muy buena y la atención es de lo mejor.  Espero regresar pronto.

reviews.author: Sam F
reviews.title: Mis mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: My stay at paradisus was incredible, all thanks to the great staff! Especially at the beach bars. Had an incredible 4 days being spoiled at h2o by Jose de los Santos, Benita Mercedes and Josue camillo!! Do not mis out on the great time you can have with them!!

reviews.author: adelabaez
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Lindo hotel, confortables camas, amplias habitaciones, limpieza superior y magnifica playa.
Si desean disfrutar en relax usar el spa es una buena decisión y seguro saldrá reconfortados. 
Tiene restaurantes para servir y disfrutar una exquisita comida y a la vez se puede usar el bufete. Disfrute de bebidas internacionales y los amantes de mariscos tendrán una maravillosa experiencia.
El personal es muy amable y dispuestos a responder cualquier inquietud que el huésped les presente.

reviews.author: Jennifer O
reviews.title: Great beach!  Friendly staff!  Went above & beyond
reviews.text: Definitely will come back to this resort!  It was a great resort!  Very helpful staff - who went above and beyond after I realized I had left behind one sandal!!!  We had a great time here!  The food at the buffet was amazing and I think one of the best All Inclusive buffets I've ever had!

reviews.author: HSTravelGal
reviews.title: Slow service, poor connectivity
reviews.text:
While this resort is certainly beautiful,  my second trip to the Dominican is sure to be my last. 

My husband and I had been to the Dominican before and one of my previous reviews will show you, the trip was less than stellar. When the opportunity presented itself to take a second trip on my company's dime, we figured why not give it a second shot.

Bad idea. 

Upon arrival, we were able to quickly make our way to the front desk for check-in. Given that we arrived earlier than the rest of our group, we were able to upgrade to the preferred Club Suites. They seem to process everything pretty quickly and brought us into the preferred area to wait for our room to be ready. After an hour-and-a-half wait and a staff that was not able to communicate very clearly with us, we finally got into our room. 

The better part of the afternoon had since been wasted as a result of this delay. While we were waiting we were attempting to connect to the Wi-Fi, which was unsuccessful. We were unable to check voicemails, and Access Wi-Fi on a regular basis, which meant that I was unable to tend to business while on a business trip. 

We were provided our own personal concierge while staying in the preferred section of the resort. We were given a cell phone to call our concierge whenever we needed something specific or wanted to book a service. 

Most of the time the phone was just ringing and nobody answered. At one point we scheduled a cabana to be reserved by the private pool so that we could have one day of relaxation. The day we had it reserved we could not locate our nameplate on one of the Cabanas. We were told that our name would be listed and that it would be reserved for us. They ended up reserving it for the next day, which was our last day in the resort. 

We considered partaking in some of the spa services, but the rates are so much higher here than they are in other areas of the Caribbean.

When all was said and done, my husband and I vowed to never again travel to the Dominican Republic. We have had so many great trips to Mexico and have come to the conclusion that if it ain't broke don't fix it.

We will continue to travel to Mexico and possibly other Caribbean island but, if you are considering a trip to the Dominican please do plenty of research and ask around. It's worth the extra effort to get full scoop before you go.

reviews.author: Hector M
reviews.title: Hostess
reviews.text: The hostess Gabriela Martinez Acevedo was awesome, very pleasant and excellent greeter.   She is a keeper plus the young gentleman Julio Aponte was awesome quick response and always smile , food was well prepared for breakfast and dinner at the Gabi restaurant.

reviews.author: JHawkFan85
reviews.title: Great resort, friendly staff - Very enjoyable time
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited the first week of May, 2016. Business oriented; but the trip was for pleasure; travelled with a group of a couple hundred people and getting checked in, baggage dealt with and getting excursions and dinner reservations on site scheduled the day we arrived were surprisingly trouble- free. 
We ate at several of the on site restaurants and enjoyed all of them - Blue Agave (Mexican) was good overall, but our favorite was Rare (American steakhouse feel). The burgers and steaks were delicious, and the pear caramel dessert was beyond fantastic. We also spent a fair amount of time at the buffet for our meals for breakfast and lunch. The food at the buffet was very good and they have everything your little heart might desire for any of the 3 meals, should you find yourself without a reservation or needing a meal in a pinch. 
The staff are all very friendly and accommodating and most speak at least some English, which helps a lot.
 You will probably be told that tips are included as we were - Every tourist down there gives out tips and you will feel bad if you're the only one who isn't doing so. We were there for 5 days and burned through just over 100 dollars in mostly 1's and a few 5's- we ran out. The staff are very appreciative of tips and go out of their way to help you with anything you need, so the tips are- in my opinion- just part of the trip expense to figure in. 
We went to several of the night shows- Michael Jackson tribute, Lion King and circus act and they were all very good. Also participated in candle making and finger painting and those were great experiences as well.
As far as the beach- it has a fair amount of "seaweed" on it but it is well kept and has many areas sectioned off for safe swimming. There is a couple places just off the beach where you can go into a market style area and bargain with the local merchants to buy souvenirs from them. 
The accommodations were great as well, with nice beds, good wifi, and they were quiet as well. Overall, we had a fantastic time and would recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: aaritao
reviews.title: Paradisiaco
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, magnífica comida e instalaciones de primera. Facilidades ora toda la familia. Seguro y centros de compra relativamente cerca. Honestamente no tengo idea del precio efectivo pues pagamos tarifa corporativa, pero sin duda un lugar para pasarla muy bien

reviews.author: farmtraveler83
reviews.title: Get a Room Upgrade for Sure
reviews.text:
Came here for a Business Trip, so we did not pick this hotel to stay at.  Overall the grounds of the hotel are very nice, clean and well kept.  The beach is very good and like any large resort, get to the beach early to get the spot you want, otherwise you will be fighting the crowds for a chair with a table or an umbrella.  

Pros:
Beach quality and maintenance; Location excellent as you can walk the beach, housekeeping does a good job.

Food - the food was overall good and the drinks were made with better quality liquor than some of the other all inclusive locations we have stayed.

Cons:
Rooms are DATED - when we first checked in we were taken to a room that was terrible - it looked like it had not been updated since the early 90's  - the tv didn't work in the bedroom or the living room and it was not going to work.  I required we be moved as it was less than acceptable - we were taken to the main building and got a room with a garden view which was much better - this room had been updated and up to my expectations of a resort hotel.  If you are going to stay here - verify the room that you will have in advance.

Staff - the language barrier was terrible in the restaurants - we were charged for a bottle of wine that we didn't want and the hotel would not remove this from our bill.  I thought the service was a little slow compared to other all inclusive a we have stayed.

So, if you want a good beach and good food, this is the location for you; however, if you are looking for more of a room with a view of the ocean, I would recommend other locations.

We will stay at another resort the next time in the Dominican before coming back here again.

reviews.author: 922mar_aluisam
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
My experience was very very nice, you don't need to go out, this hotel has everything you need, you can rest, enjoy the beach, eat very well and do excercise at the beach.
The nights are magical because the ambient, the ilumination and the music are excellent.
The room was very comfortable.

reviews.author: Luah G
reviews.title: Gostei muito da minha estadia por lá...
reviews.text:
Fui ao Paradisus para um evento corporativo e minha estadia por lá foi excelente.
O hotel fica em uma das praias mais bonitas e limpas de Punta Cana. Fiquei em dos quartos com vista para o jardim - super bem equipado e silencioso. 
Os aparelhos eletrônicos no quarto (TV, rádio, etc...) já não estão mais muito novos, mas em um lugar tão gostoso, não são necessários.
A estrutura do hotel oferece muito o que fazer para os hóspedes: fitness club, spa, jardim zen, várias piscinas, restaurantes, etc...
O restaurante japones é bem gostoso! Basta reservar com antecedência. 
Existe um carrinho de golf que leva os hóspedes gratuitamente para um Mall que fica dentro da grande área do complexo. Nesse local existem várias lojas, restaurantes e um supermercado. 
O staff é super amável, como em geral, todos os dominicanos. Só precisam aumentar a eficiência no restaurante principal.
Valeu a estadia!!

reviews.author: Lori L
reviews.title: Jorge Rosando (our Butler) was top notch.  He handled our every need perfectly
reviews.text: The hotel accommodations are The Top of The Line.  Always clean, neat, quiet.  The staff was extremely helpful and took GREAT care to make sure our stay was TOP NOTCH!  Our Butler Jorge Rosando was the best! He handled our every need perfectly.

reviews.author: tdelos2016
reviews.title: Paradisus is best all-inclusive resort we have ever stayed!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have traveled to 15+ all-inclusive resorts over the past 6 years. The service, atmosphere, and cleanliness of this resort was outstanding during our visit.

The one person that made this trip so special for us was our butler, Charlton. We have stayed with other resorts who have butler service but Charlton's service and attention was superior. Not only was he friendly and quick to respond to requests, he always went out of his way to find us on the resort to check in and see if we needed anything!  In fact, even when he was "off-duty," He displayed the true definition of outstanding customer service.

For anyone considering this resort, our experience was outstanding. If you choose to up grade to "butler-service" level, request a room in the area Charlton is working. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Alexandre Ísola
reviews.title: Espetacular.
reviews.text: Instalação esplêndida: praia maravilhosa, piscinas excepcionais, tratamento dos funcionários na quase totalidade impecável. Na totalidade acima de bom. Alimentação de ótima qualidade. O que mais me incomodou em Punta Cana: o aeroporto. Confuso, mal sinalizado na chegada. As pessoas não sabem bem o que fazer em cada "etapa" da entrada. Placas apontando para direções opostas. E ao finalmente sair, muita confusão para encontrar seu transporte. Isso precisa ser melhorado. Mas de resto, voltarei!!! Belíssimo País, população acolhedora e simpática.

reviews.author: Nancy R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled here for a week in May. It is a beautiful property. The beach is wonderful. Our room was spacious and private. We were located near the beach and the smaller, more private pool. The food was good and the restaurants were fine. We especially loved Aqua and the lobster at Rare! The staff was friendly and helpful. We would definitely go back. We had stayed at the Hard Rock two years ago, but found it to be too big and spread out.

reviews.author: VanceMcCurdy
reviews.title: Experienced Travelers Beware
reviews.text:
I just got back from a 4 night stay at the Paradisus Palm Real, and stayed in the Presidential suite as a part of their Royal Service. Upon entering the hotel, the grounds are magnificent! It is one of the most beautiful hotels I have ever been to- the beach is very nice, and definitely the royal service side is nicer because it has nice beds and lounge chairs to relax in! The water is not what i was thinking as the waves do not really crash on the beach.. more a a choppy lake feel and little debris floats around at all times.

Let me break down our whole stay:

The Room: the pictures of the rooms definitely seem to be false advertising. The presidential suite is not in any of the pics- the rooms are rather small, they do have a jacuzzi in the bathroom area, but the king bed is two queens beds pushed together- wasn't expecting that.. The hotel fridge that is stocked for you is only stocked of sodas and Budweiser and was not stocked each day unless you specifically asked your butler to restock it for you. Definitely not the amenities that you read about.
We actually had items stolen out of our room 2 of the 4 nights. We reported it but the language barrier made it confusing because we do not speak much spanish and english is only spoken really well by a few of the employees on property.  Very disappointed in the rooms!!

Food: the food very subpar at the restaurants and was always SOOOO slow at dinner. Our favorite food was at Palazzo which is for Royal service guests only. We ate at Rare- the american steakhouse and it was not good at all. After we sat for over an hour in the non crowded restaurant, we asked for our food to go because we were tired of sitting there. The Teppanyaki restaurant was just okay, there are so many good hibachi places in the US and this was nowhere close.. also very very slow. The mexican restaurant was okay, and the latin place was okay. We thought the best food and selections were at the buffet and often regretted not eating there because the other restaurants were disappointing. 

Drinks: the drink service is also very slow as most bars we attended- pool bar and Royal Service Bar- only have one bartender for all the guests. So when customers order numerous frozen drinks, the wait can be VERY LONG. Wanda who runs the royal service bar is awesome! She was the highlight of our trip! very friendly and funny and worked hard to make a million frozen drinks as fast as she could. While we were on the beach, we were under the impression that someone would be helping serve us while at under the huts or in the bali beds- but NO- you must go up and get all drinks yourself. And often times, the drinks seemed very watered down or a funky taste to them??

Butler service: I honestly am not sure what is so special about the butler service. you get a little phone and the most they really do is make your dinner reservations and reserve the Bali beds by the royal service pool. The bali beds were very nice to have and very private away from kids and spring break acting young people! lol. our guy was very nice, but i guess we just thought we would be getting a little more after staying at Sandals resorts and having their Bulter service. 

Resort credits- kind of silly - you get coupons to use them for and all of them you must spend $100 at the cheapest to get a slight discount- the massages are very high priced and the coupon gives you $50 off.. this may sound like an incentive, but don't be fooled- you have to fork over more than $1500 to get $500 in discounts.. not really a hotel credit?

We were hoping that the sketchy guys who are trying to sell you drugs and random things on the beach would be shoo'ed away by the hotel security guys, but it seems as if they were all friends and buddy buddy so they lingered around at ALL times during our stay. 

Overall - our stay was nice because we made the best and got over the fact that this was not as 5 star as we thought it would be. I have traveled all over the Caribbean and this has been the most disappointing. The resort appeared to be the nicest in the area of the Dominican that we were in for sure as we stopped at numerous places on our way to an excursion, so I am assuming Punta Cana is just not as nice as the resorts I have stayed in while in Jamaica, Aruba, Belize, St Lucia, St Thomas, Turks and Caico, Puerto Rico, and the Bahamas. 

The resort definitely needs to be a little more upfront with their rooms pictures and their description for butler services. This was the most disappointing part of the trip- well and the very slow food (room service took over an hour- 3 of the 4 times we ordered it) and was not very good, and the language barrier was difficult at times and the lack of bartenders made for long waits to get a drink!

reviews.author: ok2goKansas
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
What an amazing view!  The moment I entered the resort, I was stunned by the beauty of the property and the view of the ocean.  We enjoyed the vast variety of choices at the buffet and loved the other restaurants that are also offered on the premises. We were surprised and pleased with the entertainment options.  While we were there we saw a lip-sync version of The Lion King and a great Michael Jackson impersonator. I discovered that I love parasailing!
 This was our first visit to an all-inclusive resort, and we plan a return trip sometime in the year to come.

reviews.author: mitimom
reviews.title: Got the wow factor
reviews.text: As all inclusive so go, Paradisus is showy and fun. Lots of great white sand on a gorgeous Caribbean beach. A buffet is open most hours of the day featuring a great variety of foods. Lovely garden areas surround the guest rooms which are large and comfortable. Several sit down restaurants take reservations and are included in the price. Passion, one of the best places you will ever eat, is also on the premises for an additional charge. While this is all positive it is also quite crowded and service for the buffet can be slow. It also impresses me as an average cruise ship on land.

reviews.author: ChicadelaIsla
reviews.title: Amazing piece of Paradise!
reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel, wonderful amenities, activities for the entire family, not a moment to be bored and yet all the time in the world to relax and unwind. Our bartenders, Antonio and Rudy, were wonderful!! We especially loved the drink we nicknamed "The Antonio Special". It was like experiencing the taste of the island in a drink- and you can have it alcohol-free like I did! Your trip will not be complete until you get "The Antonio Special" at the bar at Gabi Beach.

reviews.author: LindafromVaBeach
reviews.title: Nice Venue
reviews.text: This was our company trip.  It was nice and relaxing.  We were pampered thru out visit.  Food was good.   Choices were good,  Wish the Casino was larger.  Nice trip.  Beautiful Views of the Water and Pools were very nice with the swim up bars.

reviews.author: silviapM3460CM
reviews.title: one of the best experiences
reviews.text: The people is the best I have known in different countries. They are very polite and honest. I would come back always. They really make you feel they want you to have a nice stay. Rooms are nice and clean, confortable, food was good. Resort was very well organized. I was easy to go around. Gourmet restaurants are world class with good prices.

reviews.author: Miguel D
reviews.title: Simplemente Espectacular !!!
reviews.text:
Me aloje 4 dias en mayo 2016, fui a una convención bancaria, por mi trabajo y fue todo un sueño. El Hotel es realmente un espectacular, la atención es muy buena y las playas muy lindas, lo mismo que las piscinas. 
Las habitaciones son amplias y el All Inclusive es brillante ( excelentes los restaurantes y los bares). 
Por lo que me dijeron es de lo mejor de Punta Cana y de los mas caros, pero bien vale la pena!!!

reviews.author: Carmelo S
reviews.title: Relaxing, and a true paradise!
reviews.text:
I enjoy my stay here, the weather was beautiful, and the grounds were meticulously maintained. The people were very nice, and trustworthy. I left my safe open, i came back to find a not. I called security to have it opened and they made me make sure everything was their. there was 300 cash in place site, i looked at and said if this here then everything is fine, which everything was. 
I had some minor communication with the golf staff, but the resort was excellent, breakfast, lunch and dinner excellent, good variety, and the resort knows how to let the guest have a great time and help them have a great time and unwind. 
One particular person who went way above and beyond was Juan Suarez, he was the waiter in the buffet for lunch and breakfast. When I would walk up before even approaching the hostess, he would escort my wife and I to a table and come back with water, coffee and are usual drink ( would always ask if we wanted the same thing first)
Awesome people, good food, great atmosphere, and a top ten beach! what more could you want!

reviews.author: julioecastroc
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: Durante mi estancia en el hotel, las atenciones fueron de primera, desde la llegada hasta la salida. Felicidades por el buen trato. Fui a cubrir una actividad para el medio de comunicación que represento y fue un exito total.

reviews.author: bathunter2015
reviews.title: Five day Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: As an all included resort stay, we could relax and enjoy the restaurants of our choice, the ample sized rooms, the beach with large tiki umbrellas and drink service, the huge pool with swim up bar service, the evening entertainment, and the gracious, friendly staff.

reviews.author: jen m
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: The lodging was great, the people very friendly. The beach was spotlight but my favorite was the spa. A massage to write home about! The salt water pool in the back was magical! I liked that it had two different buffets for morning and lunch. The restaurants were far beyond the buffets however. Great food at restaurants, did a beautifully done tasting menu one night! The only thing missing there was local culture. Where was the local fare-none was offered onsite. Some of the fantastic people I would like to mention who went above and beyond Isidro Gustavo, Bilis, Danny, Belkys, Carty & Wanda-thank you!

reviews.author: Niny P
reviews.title: BUENA OPCION
reviews.text:
Es un lugar muy agradable.. Lindos exteriores.. No me gusto la comida de los restaurantes diurnos..playa preciosa.. Buen servicio..
Internet gratis..me encantaron las actividades diarias.. Buenos shows nocturnos

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Outstanding resort
reviews.text: Royal Service Suite facing the ocean are outstanding rooms. Ask for Jose Lugo for your butler. We were there for two trips in May and Jose was extremely attentive. Best restaurants were Palazzo, Miso, Vento and Aqua.

reviews.author: Manu M
reviews.title: Pior hotel que fui na vida!!!
reviews.text: Estive no hotel na Convenção do meu trabalho e fiquei muito decepcionada, fui furtada no quarto do hotel, o que ocorreu com mais 5 pessoas do meu grupo, a gerência do hotel abriu investigação, mas até minha saída não tive resposta, informaram que seria feito contato pelo telefone deixado ou por email, mas nao tive nenhum retorno. O atendimento em alguns restaurantes do hotel é horrível, os garçons te ignoram, te vêem na mesa, mas fingem não ver. Muito decepcionada.

reviews.author: Augusto
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: Hotel muito top... Sem palavras, o lugar eh muito bonito, um paraíso... Agradável... Hotel muito limpo... Vários restaurantes a disposição... Tempo excelente... O Wifi funciona muito bem.. Serviço quarto também, agora o serviço na piscina fica a cargo de gorjeta, isto posto, não eh muito funcional...

reviews.author: Rosana G
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, muy buena atención. Las habitaciones enormes, muy cómodas y llimpias. Para recomendar. Excelente los restaurantes, con menues variados.
La conservación del agua de las piscinas, musica ambiental, limpieza en general, transporte dentro del hotel, todo excelente. Los empleados super simpáticos y serviciales. Para recomendar.-
Al medio día se puede almorzar en Gaby Club o Gaby beach, en ambos lugares todo lo que elijas es de muy buena calidad.

reviews.author: J9122TMstevec
reviews.title: Trip in May 2016
reviews.text: Resort is very nice when walking in.  Service was slow and our room had a terrible musty odor.  When calling for maintenance, they do not fix the problems or you have to wait forever for them to show up.

reviews.author: bryankeithb
reviews.title: Fun plenty to do
reviews.text:
It was a blast soecially the entertainment. The only things i couldnt get passed was first the bathtub had no cold water , and the shower had no hot water.  Also , i went a full lunch with no drink because the staff was ignoring me waving at them. I had to go to one of the bars for a water. 
Then the rooms air conditioning is too moist ..my clothes in my luggage felt wet and smelled wet. I had to put my clothes outside to dry from my suitcase.
And the bed wasnt any better i felt like i was sleeping wet. My hair didnt dry after a shower over night either. 

Nice place but miserable sleep. And room

reviews.author: matt m
reviews.title: 5 star service
reviews.text: Upgrade to the royal service.  You will be treated like royalty.  Bartenders were very accommodating and all tried hard to impress. Wifi is slow during peak hours. Cable channel selection was impressive.  There are a lot of kids--be prepared.

reviews.author: 29alisons
reviews.title: Paradise Found!
reviews.text:
We visited last week for a company incentive trip. Nearly 300 employees and customers from my husband's company descended upon the Palma Real, and we all thoroughly enjoyed it. The property itself is beautiful. We had a standard room, which was pretty close to the ocean and pool. The rooms are very elegant and spacious. The whole resort looks like a postcard. 
   We dined at three of the reservation restaurants. We really enjoyed Blue Agave, where I had a very good chicken enchilada. Aqua, which is in The Reserves, has great seafood. The saganaki appetizer is not to be missed, and my husband and I were very happy with our snapper and salmon. The chocolate soufflé was to die for. Rare was terrible, and everyone else we knew who dined there had the same experience. The service was great, but the steaks were just awful. Don't waste your time.  We found that the buffet for lunch and breakfast had a nice variety and we were always happy with it.
   We spent a lot of time at the beach and the pool bar. We were usually not offered drinks on the beach, but perhaps it was because we didn't sit under the palm umbrellas closer to the bar. We did go to the shops along the beach that the locals are always trying to get you to visit. We enjoyed bartering, and came away with some nice souvenirs. They may seem overwhelming, but we found the people to be harmless and entertaining. They're just trying to make a living in the best way they can. When told no, they accept it.
   The service at the resort was very good. Almost all were very friendly and accommodating. Jessi, a bartender at the Gabi bar, was so eager to please and seemed happy to see us every night. We really looked forward to talking to her every time we saw her. We found that it really made a difference when you took time to ask about their lives, their children, their likes and dislikes. A good tip is wonderful, but they enjoy a bit of humanity like anyone else in the service industry. We left a lot of good tips and made some connections with people, as well.
   Our only complaints about the resort were no washcloths, and safe security. I came back one day to find a sign by our safe that said I needed to call the front desk. I did, and they said the safe was open when housekeeping came, and they needed to reprogram it. I recognized it was possible that we left it open. You do have to hold it closed when it's locking. The second time, I walked in and the closet door was open and the safe was wide open. No sign, and housekeeping had been there. There was no chance that we had done that. It's the first thing you see  when you walk in and the last thing you see when you walk out. We put the do not disturb sign up after that.
   We did three excursions. We went deep sea fishing, where we didn't have a bite. Others on different boats did, but we had no luck. It is just trolling, so don't expect to have a rod and reel in hand. We took a Segway tour of the ecological park, which we loved. Juan and Hector were so knowledgeable, and the sites we visited were pretty amazing. A lagoon and an abandoned resort were the highlights. 
   We also went to Scape park for zip lining and dune buggies. The zip line was our first time, and it was everything we wanted. We flew over the jungle and along cliff walls, and felt safe. The dune buggies were not worth the time. It was terribly dusty and smelled so much of gas that it just wasn't enjoyable. You do get to spend about 10 minutes at a point where the Atlantic and Caribbean merge, but I would have been happy to stay there the whole time. Scape park is really worth going to. 
   All in all, we loved it. The resort is fabulous and we went on good excursions.

reviews.author: cyclebike2
reviews.title: Caribbean Paradise!
reviews.text: Our first impression when arriving was "awesome!". The resort grounds, pool, beach, and cabana huts for shade are incredible. The buffet is readily available for all meals...food selections bountiful!. Our room suite was clean with full pampering. Special thanks to Bellboy, Ramon Calderon who greeted us at reception with a smile and was welcoming to us as guests...he was friendly and professional. Service was exceptional and staff tended to any need. The entertainment staff, Gasolina and Caramelo were energetic and really got you involved to participate in activities.

reviews.author: karenth0mps0n
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Our room was nice, everything was clean, staff was great, food was very good, drinks were wonderful, there were plenty of activities to attend, lots of dancers and lessons, everything was A-1.  Most staff spoke good English which was a pleasant surprise.

reviews.author: Suzy E
reviews.title: No help from concierge or check out
reviews.text: Employees where not helpful. Concierge said she would help me and she never did, as well as employees when I was checking out. The concierge put a hand written note in her desk and said she would contact me and never did.

reviews.author: Hector N
reviews.title: Mi experiencia en Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort
reviews.text: El hotel está enclavado en un paraiso del Caribe, los accesos desde el aeropuerto están muy bien organizados, tienen un camioncito que te lleva gratis al centro comercial del hotel por si quieres hacer shoping, prueben el Mamajuana, y el ron Barcelo son muy buenos.  La atención en el hotel es magnífica, todo el personal está siempre al pendiente de lo que puedes necesitar.

reviews.author: 213nikkis
reviews.title: GIS Vacation Review
reviews.text:
Hotel was beautiful
Beautiful scenery
Fabulous food and service
Many options for dining.  this was amazing for an all inclusive
Clean environment
I would recommend this to anyone 
Take advantage of the butler service.

reviews.author: martineza389
reviews.title: Es un lugar Magico
reviews.text: Playas inmaculadas, a la diversion del Surf y a una excelente y deliciosa gastronomia.  La eleccion perfecta para unas vacaciones en familia, posee el lujo exquisito, el area de Royal Service exclusivo para adultos y el servicio exclusivo de Family Concierge en The reserve.  Una experiencia de resort tan completa que la experiencia es inolvidable.  Situado entre vibrantes jardines tropicales y frente de una de las playas mas hermosas del Caribe.

reviews.author: marilynv156
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: I loved my 2 day stay at your resort. I went for business but i'm already planning my vacation stay there. Jean Hernandez from the buffet and Ricardo from fuego were exceptional employees. On our last day there before checking out, we ordered breakfast from room service, and it was perfect. The best breakfast i have ever had. So mad i didn't take advantage of the room service the first morning there. Every where we went, employees always had a big smile on their face and always greeted us with Hola. It was great and i loved it. I wish i could own a room there and go whenever i just needed a break.Keep up the great work.

reviews.author: mikecA2169GD
reviews.title: Paradisus Paridise!
reviews.text: Awesome Resort. Great Value and super friendly staff. We have been to dozens of resort all over Mexico, San Juan, St.Thomas, and Hawaii including the Grand Wailea in Maui.  The Paridsus was was my favorite and most memorable. We shall return soon!

reviews.author: johnkyleb
reviews.title: Paradisus Golf & Spa
reviews.text: We had an enjoyable time while a guest at the hotel..  Played golf one day and the course was fun and in good condition.  We felt the hotel and surrounding area was beautiful but the staff and the dining needed some management.

reviews.author: 893joyf
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: This resort was beautiful and had so much to offer!  The pool atmosphere was fabulous and the beach was beautiful.  The hibachi restaurant was the best meal we had and buffet had delicious food and many options to choose from!

reviews.author: Vanessa T
reviews.title: Bon complexe
reviews.text: Super bon complexe! Les chambres sont belles, les installations aussi! Très dommage car le complexe est loin de la plage (7 minutes a pied) le service à la plage, dan sa section réservé est très lent! Vous êtes mieux d'aller chercher vos drink vous même ! Même chose à la piscine, il devrait y avoir plus de serveur! La plage et la piscine, rien à dire sur les installations c'était parfait. La nourriture est bonne mais le matin le buffet c'est toujours la même chose. En gros c'est un bon complexe mais sans plus.

reviews.author: dtsleighton
reviews.title: Felt like Royals!
reviews.text: I want to thank or private butler,  Jose Salvador for his attention last week on our vacation.  He was friendly and warm.  He did not hover but provided just the right attention.  He was quick to respond to our calls and always helpful.

reviews.author: Torre de Pizza
reviews.title: Increible
reviews.text:
Trato excelente, buena comida y servicio, el resort es una maravilla, tranquilo, bien cuidado, silencioso, decorado como un paraíso oriental, lo recomiendo al 200%
La playa es muy bonita, Gabi beach perfecto para pasar el día en las tumbonas con buena música y tomando algún cocktail

reviews.author: Sean M
reviews.title: A nice resort.
reviews.text: The resort is a nice resort and a beautiful beach. Plenty of water sports and chairs available. The resort has a nice layout and entertainment at night is nice. You can hang near the beach at a nice lounge area or step it up and hit the dance club. The food is hit or miss. You need to be choosy at the buffet. Some choices are good and some are bad. The service at the resort can be a little more friendly. The staff is not as engaging especially in the restaurants. I would recommend upgrading to their reserve service if you are looking for a little more attention and pampering.

reviews.author: annakY9152XB
reviews.title: Raj na ziemi
reviews.text: Gorąco polecam ten hotel. Dla osób lubiących wyśmienitą kuchnię, pięknie serwowane posiłki, dobre drinki. Można poczuć się jak w raju. Super obsługa, b.miła i pomocna szczególnie na plaży ;). Bardzo fajne wieczorne dyskoteki w barze na plaży - polecam!

reviews.author: lfdv2016
reviews.title: Welcoming staff, spectacular beach and relaxing resort!
reviews.text: Although rooms are dated they are spacious and inviting. Our king bed was wonderfully comfortable. Housekeeping was efficient and friendly. Room service was as expected and timely. We especially loved our breakfasts poolside with Wandy Castillo who greeted us every morning with hot coffee and a welcoming smile. He treated us with great hospitality and exceptional service! Fabulous pool and best of all, beautiful wide white sandy beach! A lovely relaxing getaway to paradise!

reviews.author: Angela G
reviews.title: Awesome Caribbean all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: Spectacular venue with fabulous and courteous service. Many choices for on- and off-site activities, casino, boutique, spa, lovely and comfortable rooms with nice resident buildng sutuated around a serene natural setting with water feature. Didn't feel like a hotel but rather a luxury apartment complex. Pools are numerous and there is a Reserve area for privacy. Beach accommodations include tiki canopies with table over beach lounge chairs and complimentary bar service. You can choose to be as active or restful as you wish. Room service good and timely. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Lack if understanding English made it difficult to make reservations.
reviews.text: We liked the the hotel and location the weather was great but they have an English barrier and it made us have issues a couple of times . We were there 5 nights, three out of the five nights our reservations not being done right. Due to someone in the process not knowing what we were asking for.my friend had a butler that came with their room which they really enjoyed , but he was the one that made all our reservations for dinner and like I said before three out of the five nights our reservations were not there when we went to the restaurant . I would have thought  he spoke their lanuage and how could it get messed up?? Well it still did. Very disappointing !!

reviews.author: marisolc975
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay, staff was super friendly. Headphones went missing from room and we did find an employee in our closet when he was supposed to be refilling drinks. Lost total sense of security and trust in staff.

reviews.author: willow73
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT! AMAZING PROPERTY!  AUTHENTIC FOOD AND EXCELLENT SERVICE!
reviews.text:
First time in Punta Cana and first time at Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  Room was clean and spacious.  Garden View 3rd Floor.  Not a bad walk from the main lobby and pool area.  No bugs in sight for the whole trip.  Clean towels, stocked fridge, great turn-down service.  

Pool and food/restaurant options were excellent!  We ate different food every day (and we really only ate at the "buffet"!).   Our server at breakfast and lunch was hard working and remembered our favorites even though he had hundreds of guests to manage I'm sure!  His name was Davidson Germain!  The food choices were fresh (particularly the fish).  The fruits and smoothies were delicious.

The beach was clean and the sand was white.  We really loved the free cabanas on the beach (and in the pool).  Bartenders were attentive and made some fun drinks.  I enjoyed the beer but by the end of the trip, it was getting somewhat bitter.  Great activities throughout the day and night.  Casino was very small.  Only a few tables and a few machines.  Look for workers giving out $10 match play coupons each day at the pool.

Wine bar, night clubs and music were all great.  We really enjoyed hanging around the fountain areas at night with the colored lights, music and great people.

Felt very safe the whole time but really had no need to venture away from this palace!  I heard the golf was incredible but a little pricey.

Finally, when checking out, the housekeeper started cleaning our room and the bellman took our luggage out before we actually checked out.  We had a few personal items (Apple Watch and charger) charging on the dresser before we were leaving for airport.  When I went back to the room, everything was gone.  I went down to front desk to inform them and I was told to go meet Carlos at Bell Desk.  He had everything in safekeeping for us and knew our exact room and everything!  What a great relief and a testament to their trustworthiness!

reviews.author: davidwladue
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
This property as compared to other options for your travel dollars is average at best.  To be more specific;

*Avoid the Royal Service rooms.  No better than an upgrade at a typical Hilton Garden Inn.  Absolutely NOT worth the price.  Avoid, avoid, avoid...do NOT fall for this rip off. 

*Very average to poor food.  If a restaurant in the US served food like you find here it would be out of business quickly. 

*Customer service is average at best.  The employees seem to be "just doing there jobs" without any real interest in their customers.  Almost uninterested and unengaged...

In general, you can find many much better options for your travel dollars.

reviews.author: bamagirl2016
reviews.title: Alabama girl
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful and the service is excellent!! The staff is very friendly!! We hope to return on a couples get away in the next year! We are now spoiled to the all inclusive vacation! Hope to go on some of the outing/adventures next time around!!

reviews.author: 476caseys
reviews.title: Ecellent
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus for a Company Event and the staff was excellent. They were all very friendly and very engaged with the guests. I would highly recommend this resort. I would love to go back for a pleasure vacation.

reviews.author: jvand0
reviews.title: Traveling with a group for a 3 night stay
reviews.text: The service was excellent.  The resort was very clean.  The buffets were fabulous.  The young man who helped organize the events, Shaky Shaky, was very entertaining and kind.  Ivan was also a very friendly waiter.  Would definitely return to the same resort.

reviews.author: NancyGreyStreet
reviews.title: Nancy Greystreet
reviews.text: Unfriendly staff.  I far prefer Jamaica or Cancun for an all-inclusive . Front desk Personnel are not very helpful .  8 Atlanta and the buffet so far  in both  we're not great . Below average food.  Beautiful setting. Nice enough rooms.

reviews.author: Texas_artB
reviews.title: A Tripical Paradise
reviews.text: This Hotel is magical! I was here for a week to attend a small meeting. The employees at Paradisus Punta Cana went out of their way to make this meeting a success. Thank You to all involved! We will be back to this lovely Hotel in the beautiful country of The Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: P9629QIfranciscoc
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente Experiencia. Atención personalizada. Se preocupan mucho por el confort de los Huéspedes. Todos los empleados son muy amables. Los Alimentos de primera calidad, preparados con Higiene y de muy buen sabor.

reviews.author: Chrissy S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Just returned from a five day trip to the Paradisus Palma Real.  We stayed in the Royal Service adults only section.  The staff were the friwndliest, happiest people I've encountered on any vacation.  Our butler, Faustino was a pleasure.  We did not ask too much of him, but when we did, he delivered.  Check in and check out at the RS lounge was quick and made us feel special.

reviews.author: VacationLover1022
reviews.title: Awesome all inclusive resort!
reviews.text: The friendly staff, the welcoming & gorgeous facility, the terrific food whether buffet or sit down restaurants, the beautiful, clean beach & the best sense of security & safety! We can't wait to return. Thank you to Junior who does a terrific job on the beach! He sets up your chairs, makes sure you are enjoying your stay, brings numerous drinks throughout the day!!

reviews.author: Realtor Al
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Neidinson Sosa was excellent! He was very attentive to our requests and was proactive in asking what we wanted. This hotel, beach and grounds is spectacular and worth your staying. Very astute staffing and service.

reviews.author: daveF4962TD
reviews.title: Enjoyable but some room for improvents
reviews.text: Great resort.  Very beautiful setting and fantastic beach!  Food was good for punta Cana but overall just average. Rooms seemed a little dated and worn. We tipped frequently and service was adequate but not enthusiastic. Was here mostly for business but stayed a few extra days for ourselves.

reviews.author: 314grettab
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PARADISUS PALMA
reviews.text: Upon arriving, the check in was effortless, welcoming and warm. the open air lobby, bar and view to the sea, past towering fountains an polls, the architecture was stunning. The white sand beach, had plenty of tikis  for shade, (zero litter), lots of chairs and cabanas at pool too. Great beach service of cold Presidente and Miami Vice drinks!
