Beautiful room and public areas, very well kept. The buffet area had multiple choice of food styles and preparations, again very very clean. Our room was comfortable , quiet and beautiful. I would go back to this resort as the staff so friendly and the property very well maintained.

reviews.author: The Brautigan A
reviews.title: Wish I was there longer
reviews.text: Great food very nice rooms. I loved the room service I loved the pools  and I loved the beaches.Will go back again. Very !friendly staff. The weather was outstanding. The dining and the spa where great. I would like to thank Carlos and from the spa Jenny and Ruth for being so nice and helpful.

reviews.author: eley864
reviews.title: Palazzo restaurant is the Bomb!
reviews.text: The staff at restaurant Palazzo was awesome.  Thank you Oscar,Felix,Richard,Miguel,Yunior,Jhoniedy, Marino and Zenovia for making our dining experience suburb.  Special shout out to our butler Yohelvi who took great care of us for 5 days. He checked on us everyday. Surprised us with fruit platters in the room after a long day out. Came back to a warm bath with roses in the shape of a heart. He even took the initiative to book our dinner reservations. WHAT A STAR!!!! OVERALL A WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: ESI Circle of Excellence
reviews.text: Eduard Meinda was our butler and provided top notch service throughout our 5-day stay! Always smiling and going above and beyond. He took care of all of our needs and wants!! We will ask for him personally when we return to the Paradisus Palma Real resort. Fransisco was also always smiling and going above and beyond!! These 2 guys were awesome!!

reviews.author: F1287BEmarianar
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: La estructura  de primera,  la atención  ambiente de primera,  las habitaciones  inmensas,  cómodas,  todo de lujo.  La única Nora. Negativa fue la ducha,  un poco difícil de entender pero en verdad estoy super contenta  y satisfecha de la atención,  la comida,  los que trabajan ahí gente super educada y gentiles . Si me preguntarán que hotel podrá aconsejar en Punta Cana de seguro diría Paradisus  Palma Real.  Gracias

reviews.author: Beachgirl044
reviews.title: Best Resort Ever!
reviews.text:
We stayed from March 2 to March 9, 2016 in the Royal Suites.  This is the best way to go when staying here because you truly feel pampered and get access to everything at the resort.  You also get your own butler.  Ours was Luis Sanchez.  Let me tell you, when we stay again we will ask for him.  He was always there when we needed him.  Was quick to fulfill our requests and was the nicest young man.  Helped us get into one of the restaurants when it was already "full."  Honestly, every staff member was always smiling and ready to help if you needed them.

Hotel is beautiful.  Marble, travertine tile, granite.  Beautifully landscaped.  We took a long walk along the coast and the Paradisus was by far the most beautifully kept beach.  Lots of umbrellas and chairs on the beach.  Beautiful turquoise waters.  They have several bars for the tastiest smoothies.  Mixed drinks available, too.  Food was excellent.  One of the restaurants has a buffet (breakfast, lunch, dinner) that goes and goes.  Fresh fruits, veggies, meats.  Several ethnic foods prepared.  Chefs on hand to cook your food how you like it.  Has a great view of the beach.  Was fearful of drinking the water before we arrived in Dominican Republic.  No problems at the Paradisus.  Drank water from the tap with no worries.  They have several water bottles in your room at all times and serve from large bottled water at the restaurants.  Truly nothing to worry about here.  We were with a large convention and none us had anything to worry about.

Hotel has a private pool with a bar for royal service.  But the property has a huge wrap around pool that is so clean and relaxing to be in.  They also have a pool that is geared towards small children.  Lots of outdoor bars to keep refreshed.   Property is one of the cleanest I've been to.  Rooms were always cleaned each day and the beds are wonderful.

I'm sure it's hard to believe this place is as good as what I've written, but it's true.  We have been to many resorts on many different islands.  If you want money well spent, relaxing environment, cleanest hotel, you need to stay here.  I know we will be back.

reviews.author: Jacmalex90
reviews.title: A wonderful week
reviews.text:
What a great week we had.  Hosted a group at this wonderful resort, Francisco Cabrera always had chairs, towels, and drinks for the group.  Great job Francisco, you made our stay great.

The golf here was good, the food was also very good.  Get the Royal Service well worth it.

reviews.author: A1888BTpauls
reviews.title: Awesome staff
reviews.text: Out of the hundreds of employees that waited on us, we never met one that was not happy to help us.   This is an amazing quality.  It shows me the resort values it's employees.  And, in turn, they value the guests.  Very cool.

reviews.author: bb444342
reviews.title: Best place I've ever stayed at!
reviews.text: Nothing beats this place to the places I've stayed at thus far! You have to experience it to understand. The place smelled amazing (want their incense!), the food was the best I've tasted at any caribbean restaurants and I've stayed at Iberostar and other places 10 total and their drinks were fantastic!

reviews.author: brianlooper2003
reviews.title: Great all inclusive resort with lots of options
reviews.text: This property was an excellent get away for our sales trip.  We had a group of about 45 people and the staff at the Palma Royal took great care of us.  My butler Samuel Rodriguez was excellent at coordinating our groups dinner reservations and ensuring that we had a cabana next to the pool.  The pool water was a little cold however we hung out at the pool bar and had a great time.  It was nice to have the adults only Palma Royal pool as it gave a smaller more exclusive feel.  The cabanas are also right next to the pool, so it makes a great place for a group to keep your stuff all day.

reviews.author: sully3941
reviews.title: Great resort and beach
reviews.text:
Had a great trip here in Jan 2016. The Reserve was defiantly the best section of the property. It is away from the beach but the shuttles ran constantly. 
The pool at the Reserve was very nice and all the staff were very attentive. 
We had a lot of guidance from Jason (A-Rod)at the front desk. He was always friendly and answered all our questions.
Would highly recommend this resort

reviews.author: bobbyX4536CN
reviews.title: awesome beach!
reviews.text: Paradisus was a nice place to stay.  Not quite 5 star quality but I give it a strong 4.  The plenty of dining choices with food being above average.  Pool experience was very good.  Beach is awesome!  One of the best I've ever stayed at in the Carribean.  I'd go back.

reviews.author: lwc2468
reviews.title: Staff, grounds, and experience
reviews.text: We were in th Royal section with Argentis as our butler and he was extremely mannerly, polite, and accommodating.   Martin assisted us on the beach with exquisite service!  Overall; our experience was devine and could not have had better service!!  The grounds were clean and I felt very safe and relaxed.  Thank you Argentis and Martin for taking such wonderful care of us during our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Resort.

reviews.author: shelleyclark2016
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: This is a unforgettable experience! Its like a cruise on land. Top notch service. Make sure you bring some money to tip the employees for their GREAT service. The place is kid friendly. You can relax by the pool or the amazing view of the beach! This place is highly recommend.

reviews.author: mike_baumgart
reviews.title: Awesome Resort
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience at this resort!!! It was our first time in the Dominican Republic and I am sure that my wife and I will be back. As people from Wisconsin, we like to spend time at an establishment that provides some beverages paired with friendly faces. We met Lilian, Eddie and Juan and let's just say, we want to go back to Paradisus JUST to see them and visit!!! Overall we are very thrilled with our experience here at the resort, the staff is friendly and the location is gorgeous!

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.title: Amazing place with great staff like Butler Samuel Rodriguez + Massage therapist Ivelisse Ramos
reviews.text:
As you walk into this resort you face the stunning blue waters beyond marble floors and statues of the property.  Everything is grandesque.  We hosted 100 people at this resort who all wanted to get something slightly different from their stay.And this resort delivered.  Nancy Tibavzico hosted our group and was helpful during our nightly events et al.
Day to day, our butler Sammy (Samuel) Rodriquez went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed and more.  He surprised us with fresh fruit and avocados (knowing I am crazy over these things and dont eat processed foods), ran bubble baths for us with rose petals, ensure the wine in our room was my favorite, and just became an overall friend.  He was the butler for myself and my CEO during our site visit and I requested he stay our butler and help the other company founders in our group during our visit.  They all had an amazing experience and "Samuel" is known by first name to us all.

Another mention is owed to the spa.  Managed by Milena, who is quick and effiicent, her whole staff is kind and welcoming (plus very capable).  The spas are all beautiful and spotlessly clean.  They make you want to live there - and feel like youre in another world.  My massage therapist Ivelisse did a fab job during my massage and eye treatment and I bonded with her, to the point I'd love to hear how shes doing months from now.  Again, a friendship.

Final note, Eileen at Cocotal Golf was speedy and efficient.  Although i dont golf, the others in our group who did had an amazing time.

Thanks all!  We LOVED our stay.

reviews.author: wish4fish
reviews.title: The hotel goes above and beyond!
reviews.text:
I recently traveled to the Paradisus Palma Real with a group.  Our group had the Royal Service which was just wonderful.  Our butler was Elvis and in addition to meeting our every need, he was just an incredibly kind and sweet person.  Everyone who worked at the hotel was nice and friendly and helpful.
The beach was gorgeous. The pools were gorgeous. Our room was gorgeous.  We had a huge bed, and a bathtub that could fit two. One day I came home form the beach to find that Elvis had drawn us a bubble bath!  And the minibar was always stocked.  The last night I got dehydrated and I called room service at 2 am.  They were at my door with a few bottles of water in a couple minutes!
But here is where this hotel went above and beyond:  a woman on our trip had a serious medical emergency.  It was really scary and eventually she had to be sent by medivac back to the states.  When the emergency happened, she called the front desk which called our butlers.  The butlers got an ambulance right away and the hotel actually sent a staff member to the hospital to serve as an interpreter.  He stayed there for the whole time.  This was such a necessity and we were so grateful for their support.  And the staff was so caring.  Every time we saw them, they asked how she was doing.  They did everything they could to help the couple involved and to help our group.  You won't find that everywhere you travel.  The Paradisus was really top notch when it came to service.  Thank you Paradisus!  Our group really appreciated all of your support through a tough time.

reviews.author: Hunter Thompson
reviews.title: Fantastic All Inclusive
reviews.text: Spent four days on the property and the food was great, the property was well maintained, but the real difference is the staff.  You get a personal "butler" or concierge when you check into the property.  We were assigned Samuel Rodriguez who took the time to learn our names, and stayed in contact with us throughout our stay.  His attention to detail and responsiveness was above and beyond.

reviews.author: 775nalinic
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Me encanto! Las comidas y bebidas con  excelente  calidad  Podria volver  una y mil veces Lo mas valioso es el trato  de todo el personal del hotel fue amable, destilan alegria constantemente, nunca vi a nadie triste ni cansados. Realmento los  felicito.

reviews.author: Rob B
reviews.title: Magnificent Resort
reviews.text: This is a trip that I qualified for due to sales performance.  Their were over a hundred of us awarded.  My significant other and I were blown away by the accommodations of this resort.  We had no idea what to expect.  The facility was absolutely beautiful and the staff were very friendly and helpful.  I would highly recommend this resort to anyone. It will not disappoint. The beach and pool area are beautiful as well. The dinning overall was wonderful.  The beverage service while on the beach was awesome and fun.  The room was very nice and the huge bed was super comfortable. The only beer in the in-room refrigerator was 2 Budweiser...which for me is kind of lame.  It would be nice if they left at least a six pack of a flavor of choice and also would be nice to have several mix drink shot size bottles.  Basically there is no free drinks offered in the room.  This seemed illogical due to the fact we were staying in an "all inclusive resort" .  The only beer you can get is the native brand presidente' which is about like bud.  Very disappointing from my point of view.  Most all mixed drinks were poured with native booze, although they did have a few name brands like absolute and tangauray/bombay.  Alll in all this was not a huge deal and the trip really was amazing.  We would definitely return to this resort if it was affordable, but would contrast to others that may have less restrictions.  Very clean facility...highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: El Sammy!
reviews.text:
Having only one butler one can't say for sure, but it is hard to imagine a more attentive, responsive and knowledgable butler. So, I feel safe to say that Samuel Rodriguez is the best!  

From the champagne in the room, dinner reservations and pool side lounge spots, Samuel did it all. 

Thanks to him and the entire staff at Paradisus for a fantastic escape.

reviews.author: Ursula T
reviews.title: Stunning location, stunning hotel and amazing people
reviews.text: The hotel is aptly named, it is like something out of paradise! It was my husband's business trip and I was allowed to come along for the ride! We were part of the 'royal service' and I really did feel like I was a royal.. We had our butler ( thank you Jose) who was amazing, nothing was too much for him. The rooms were massive - two double beds put together in our room, also well equipped, with a Jacuzzi and a balcony. The beach was literally 2 mins away, as were the amazing swimming pools. The food was delicious. Anything you wanted was catered for. There was fresh fish, meats and vegetarian options.The staff in the restaurant Palazzo --Juan de Aza, Felix, Richard, Miguel, Yontidi and Yunior were fantastic - friendly, attentive, but unobtrusive. I had breakfast there each morning overlooking the pool - heaven. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: 469pattyp
reviews.title: Wonderful Dominican Experience
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days and I wished for just a few more days.  We especially enjoyed the beach.  The sand there is wonderful, and we like to walk and did so every morning and evening. The food and wait staff were wonderful.  The agave restaurant had excellent food and we also enjoyed the buffet.  Our room was wonderful.  I highly recommend.

reviews.author: cville2014
reviews.title: Great all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus Palma with a large group and enjoyed our stay.  We especially appreciated the great Royal Service from Martin Tineo on the beach each day and from butler Jose Salvador from beginning to end.

reviews.author: Melissa O
reviews.title: Excellent hospitality team for business conference
reviews.text: Yohanna and her team of hospitality leaders did an amazing job accommodating our needs. We had a group of 40 and everything from the food quality, AV service, Beach games and organization was 5 star. Highly recommend this resort for any group.

reviews.author: JenniLynn101
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text: Went to this resort for 4 days. The resort is beautiful and spacious. The pool area is large enough to accommodate it's guest without being overrun which was nice. We never had a problem finding a beach chair - pool/beach. We had the all inclusive royal service. The restaurant that stands out the most was Aqua. Great food and service. When you check in you get a butler- Super important for reserving ANYTHING you want during your stay - (Golf, dinner reservations, beach beds, mini bar request ). Carlos Hinostroza was our butler and he did an awesome job! From making reservations to the aromatherapy turn down service at night- he was great!! They give you cell phones to contact them at anytime. The entire staff was very professional and helpful.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Always a great visit
reviews.text: This wasn't our first visit to Palma Real and it won't be our last.  The resort is beautiful and the people are outstanding.  The Club Melia staff were amazing from beginning to end--Lenny; Anny; Luis--always available to help us.  Luis Diaz at the pool bar is the BEST--he remembered us from a few years ago.  He was always smiling and very helpful.  We loved the activities staff as well.  Two thumbs up to "Shaky Shaky!"  You are a blast!  Thanks to the rest of the activity staff as well--Caramelo; Luis; Snoopy; Beyonce; Carlos; Miguel; Leo.  You make the place so much more fun!  The restaurant staff was also amazing.  The new set up for Naos is much improved.  Special thanks to Gilberto and Antonio Ramirez too!  Beach staff--very busy but SO friendly and helpful!  George & Edwin--thanks for the drinks!  You rock!  Can't wait to visit this fabulous resort again.  It feels like home!

reviews.author: Moira D
reviews.title: The Royal Service is Worth it!
reviews.text:
We had two butlers, Samuel and Miguel and they were OUTSTANDING! They went above and beyond taking care of our group of 10 ppl. They spoiled us and made us feel like VIP guests!
Martin was great too and made sure we had the best seats on the beach everyday.

reviews.author: sandy-tim206
reviews.title: Week in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We just got home from a week at Paradisus Palma Real and it was amazing!  We upgraded to the Royal Service and we even had our own butler - Faustino Ramos who made the week extra special!  He brought a bucket of ice to our room every day at 4:00pm so we could have a cold drink after a long day on the beach!  He also filled our jacuzzi tub a couple of times and had candles lit to greet us when we came back to our room in the afternoons!  Overall, he was just a gracious guy, so genuine and helpful in so many ways.  

We were there as part of our annual corporate employees award trip and we travel a lot so know what good service is when we see it.  From the moment you walk into the main lobby you will see the qualityl of this place!  Everyone was very friendly and helpful, the room was spacious, exceptionally clean and the beach was second to none!  I even had to make a quick trip to the pharmacy which is on the property and couldn't have asked for better assistance from the onsite staff and doctor.  

Restaurants were all very good.  We've been to several all inclusives and have had highly variable food at other places.  Overall, we were very happy with the food choices and the evening restaurants were excellent - our favorite by far was Palazzo (Italian).

If you are considering a trip to Bavaro Beach, I would highly recommend this resort.  Great location, amenities, staff, food, pools!  What more could you ask for.

reviews.author: Tracey B
reviews.title: Resort was good but service was great
reviews.text: The rooms were nice nothing too special. We didn't have warm water in our shower until someone came and showed us how to use it correctly-heard the same from several people we went with. Great customer service from several of the employees including our butler Yohelvi Aracena who somehow just showed up when we needed him. Zenovia, Felix and Richard at the Palazzo restaurant made our meals enjoyable and entertaining. Martin Tineo at the Royal service pool was awesome and had us ready everyday for maximum relaxation. We also had a great time and great sangria from Luis at the Avenue bar. Thanks to the employees for making this trip great!

reviews.author: emm462
reviews.title: Great place - wish I weren't there on business!
reviews.text: A beautiful place - the gym should be open earlier for attendees who are traveling on business (although I realize that's in the minority). But amenities are excellent and the place is beautiful. Thanks!

reviews.author: Steven S
reviews.title: Great get away vacation
reviews.text: Great place to go in the winter to get away from the cold weather.  Great hospitality!  Super service!  Beautiful beaches!  Many activities!  Very Relaxing!  Wonderful climate!  Will plan to go here again in the future.

reviews.author: A1987ACjohnr
reviews.title: Upgrade Royal Service if you are a couple!
reviews.text: If you are a couple you must upgrade to the Royal Experience and ask for Edward Mendez as your butler and his butler buddy Francisco to take care of you.  The two together are no match for any other. And then make your way to Palazzo restaurant where Chef Nicholas will work his magic and whip you up a 4 or 5 course dinner that's outstanding.  His does this while you commiserate with world class mixologist Marino Panayes and Richard Ortiz (Bones) our incredible waiter..  They are all family now!!!!!  It was our Garden of Eden for 5 wonderful days.

reviews.author: robertmS9474IS
reviews.title: Needs some TLC
reviews.text: This was our 5th trip the the DR, first time at a Melia property but this one needs some TLC and attention to details.  Food and drinks are average. Main complaint was that we had no hot water in the bathroom all week even after notifying them twice and having the water heater worked on.

reviews.author: Teresa K
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus for a week along with business colleagues. We previously thought that all-inclusive resorts weren't our preferred mode of travel until we stayed here. This resort is large and spread out so that it never feels crowded and has a general feel of ease. We saw many families with children of all ages that were welcomed as warmly as we were. Not only is the resort beautiful, clean, and immaculately maintained, it is also staffed by a wonderful group of people. From the groundskeepers to the cleaning staff to the wait staff, all are ready with a sincere hello and willingness to help. In particular, the service of Alexander David at the restaurant Vento impressed us so much that we've decided to return with our family as soon as we can. Thanks, Alexander, for making our stay so enjoyable!

reviews.author: 678josepht
reviews.title: Joe Talan
reviews.text: Excellent facility.I want to especially mention that our butler "Elvis" was absolutely amazing in his quest to make sure we were taken care of!!Everyone on the property was friendly and attentive.Food was spectacular.The property was clean and attractive.I would definitely come back again to this facility.

reviews.author: A7177NPpauln
reviews.title: Top Notch Service
reviews.text: We booked the royal service package and were impressed. The team a Paradisus did a great job of providing excellent service.  Our butler Louis was always available to provide us with what we wanted, while giving us space to enjoy the beautiful pool/beach. . We would return to our room after a day in the sun to fined snacks and beverages .  The staff at the pool and beach area were very welcoming and a lot of fun. The staff at the royal service restaurant Pallazio  were outstanding.

reviews.author: better2seeityourself
reviews.title: Can't Wait to Go Back!
reviews.text: From the minute we arrived, we were treated so hospitably by the amazing staff.  Whether just relaxing or looking to dance and party, this resort offers it all and they make sure you never lack for wonderful food and beverages.  Luis at the pool bar made us the best Bushwhackers even though he had never made them before and then taught the rest of the bartenders to make them! Talk about going beyond!  Angel and Luis kept us dancing by the pool and on into the evening at the Gabi Beach bar and beyond!  Keep dancing guys!  Kudos to Miguel (Rare Bar) and his magic act!  Make sure not to miss this show.  Yefri at Bargarita's was amazing!  His infused Tequila Margarita's were so fresh and unique.  Oscar ant the Gabi Beach Bar and Gregory at Blue Agave were so hospitable and helpful. The resort is amazing.  Make sure you make your dinner reservations when you first get there, they have to be made at the Concierge desk by 4:30 each day, however you always have the option of the buffet which is always amazing and fresh.  It's always a good idea to head on out to the beach or pool early in the day to reserve a good spot, especially if you need more than one chair.  Make sure to look for the guy on the beach with the fresh coconuts. So refreshing!   We also checked out the Spa. The ladies giving the facials were wonderful. Make sure you show up and hour before your appointment and wear a swimsuit so you can enjoy the Co-ed areas.   I recommend everything about this resort and can't wait to go back with my friends and family!

reviews.author: Cindy N
reviews.title: Wonderful Time!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma is a beautiful resort with top notch staff. Everyone is friendly and knowledgable. We upgraded to Royal Service and if you have that opportunity I would definetely recommend that you do so. Our butler, Luis Sanchez was fantastic, always taking care of our needs even when we didn't know we had one. There is a variety of food to meet everyone's tastes. I would recommend Passions 7 tastes with the wine pairing if you want a special experience. Palazoo was another favorite of ours and our waiter, Hector Morleny provided wonderful service. The Yhi Spa is also great and see Joan Abreu for a water treatment experience like no other!

reviews.author: Patty K
reviews.title: SECOND TIME TO THIS RESORT IN 3 YEARS
reviews.text: We were part of the ROYAL SERVICE experience  We had a delightful butler, Jowell. He took exceptional care of things for us!  For us personally, having a palapa to sit under at the beach is key.  Angel always had a spot ready with clean towels without us having to get up at the crack of dawn to save a spot!  The personnel at the PALAZZO Lounge and Restaurant were top notch!  Shout out to Richard, Junior and everyone who greeted and served us...and bartender Martin!  Great Resort....TATIORUE VACN!!!!

reviews.author: T C
reviews.title: Some good people.
reviews.text: Shaky shaky and camillio were awesome. Davidson was our server everyday for breakfast and lunch. He was very attentive and more than willing to help with anything. He's the one who helped us get appt for facials. Juan Medrano was amazing as well. These four guys really made our trip more comfortable

reviews.author: Charles K
reviews.title: Great place to stay in the Dominican Republic
reviews.text: Stayed for 6 days at the Paradisus Palma Real in the Royal Service section. The whole facility is beautiful but aging. Our Room was very nice but the bathroom is a little too public to the room(no privacy). Our butler Jose' Savador was very attentive.We had a great time. All the restaurants are good but we especially liked the Palazzo because it was small and not as noisy as some of the others. We were treated very well there by Peggy Gustave, Richard, Felix, Osualdo, Yoneidi, Jucudeaza and Miguel. The beach is beautiful, action packed with thatched roof cabanas and is fully served. There was great entertainment every night. The Lion King, Stomp, Michael Jackson show, etc. I would go back their.

reviews.author: cybilt
reviews.title: Business and pleasure
reviews.text: Resort is a little pricey but I would go again. The rooms were a little outdated but who goes to PC to stay in the room and watch tv. The staff was excellent in every area of the hotel. We tipped the staff but they didn't act like they expected it.  The sales people on the beach were annoying. My friend finally just have one $5 to go away

reviews.author: Jon C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort
reviews.text: Loved every minute of this vacation!! Amazing eating and fantastic service! Would've liked to have gotten the cost down a grand but no complaints : )  next time we'll try non peak season. But will definitely go again to this resort!

reviews.author: Teddy B
reviews.title: Something for all adults
reviews.text: Just completed a 5 day business/ vacation stay. We had perfect weather and the resorts grounds and buildings are top notch. My room was clean, the bed comfortable had all the amenities that you want. Only problem I had was last 2 day's no Hot water in early AM. The pool is top notch as is the swim up pool bar, Bartenders willing to make what you ask and do so with a smile. Beach is nice but lots of sea grass and poor clarity it may have been because of a weather related event. Never got a chance to try all the different restaurants but the meals I did have were all good to above average with good selections and changing offerings. Not sure where they get there Chorizo sausage but it was great by itself or on Pizza and eggs. I did get a massage and was not disappointed. I did see a comment about staff and while most are cheerful & willing to do whats asked, I can see what he is saying. It may be a culture thing and there may be a lanuange component to it  but for comparison the staff at Beaches or Sandals are much more engaging, In no way though did it effect my trip experience. Over all I had a great time and would recommend this resort to any one looking for a relaxing to activity filled vacation

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Operations and Management
reviews.text:
Resort runs flawlessly, energy management practices are second to none.  Recycling was performed each night and am where waste streams were sorted on site.  All non essential systems where off each evening from fountains to lighting.  Occupancy sensors used throughout the resort - zero wasted energy.

Joell the butler was awesome and Pedro Cedano made the beach experience exceptional.

reviews.author: Patriiicia90
reviews.title: Hotel de lujo
reviews.text:
He tenido la suerte de visitar este resort y he quedado fascinada. Cuenta con numerosas instalaciones y servicios para adultos y niños, desde que entras al hotel ya estas visualizando el mar. Tiene el área The Reserve (familiar). El complejo es muy parecido al Paradisus Punta Cana (más económico), la arquitectura, los edificios, los restaurantes, los servicios, el mobiliario... la diferencia es que este hotel está paralelo a la playa y desde cualquier punto se visualiza la playa y el P. Punta Cana se adentra, teniendo muy pocas habitaciones con vistas al mar y mayores distancias para ir al lobby o a la piscina.
Recomedable para lunas de miel, bodas de plata, eventos especiales o aquellos que puedan permitirse este lujo.

reviews.author: Patriiicia90
reviews.title: "Espectacular"
reviews.text: Quedé encantada con este resort. Ofrece numerosos servicios y actividades, para hacer una estancia divertida y amena sin necesidad de salir del resort. Cuenta con Kids zone para los peques, actividades en la playa, piscina y piscina infantil, animación, discoteca en la zona de playa y discoteca en el lobby principal, casino, tiendas, spa, gimnasio, alquiler de bicicletas, restaurantes, tren... algunos servicios llevan un coste adicional como los masajes, tratamientos o las actividades motorizadas. Los restaurantes no llevan coste adicional pero si se necesita reserva previa. Añadir que hay gran variedad para elegir en los buffets y la comida es bastante buena. Las habitaciones están muy limpias y son exageradamente amplias. Cuenta con wifi gratuito en toda la propiedad, incluido la playa (donde el wifi llega sin problemas). La estancia fue excelente, nos trataron genial en todo momento y muy atentos. Sin duda, espero poder volver algún día!!

reviews.author: josemanuelm747
reviews.title: Hotel muy acogedor con excelentes zanas verdes
reviews.text:
Todo el hotel esta armonizado, muy buen ambiente y excelente atención personal.
Variedad en  restaurantes y zonas de animación. 
Lo que menos me gusto es la dependencia del personal de las propinas, que a pesar de no solicitarlas se nota que las esperan y eso da sensación de que con los importes abonados al hotel no da para una política de incentivos, no sujeta a propina  Que puede confundiese con la mendicidad.

reviews.author: Roc M
reviews.title: Great Stay!!!!
reviews.text: This was my first experience in the Dominican Republic and I loved it.  The resort was top notch from the food, service and amenities.  The pool was entertaining and the beach was peaceful and absolutely beautiful.  The food was excellent at all the a la carte restaurants and buffets with Fuego being my favourite.  It was also open for late night meals for those who ventured off the resort for some entertainment.  I would recommend this resort for those looking for a 4.5 star or better experience.  I did not have the Royal Service so I could not comment on that.  The seaweed problem (sargassum)  continues for almost all of the caribbean but the staff stayed on top of this the best they can.  I had a very positive experience at this resort and I look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Kevin N
reviews.title: Incredible.  Worth it.
reviews.text: We stayed at the royal service location at Palma Real.  The staff was unbelievably friendly and available.  I couldn't complain about a single moment while on this vacation even if I tried to find something wrong with it.  It's all about the staff.  If you get royal service, request Ariel for your butler.  And if you see Juan bar tending on the beach or adjacent of the front desk, tell him Kevin from SC, USA says "Mucho Gusto mi amigo."  The food was amazing and I really felt as though we couldn't have been gifted with a better experience.  Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!

reviews.author: Terrey C
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: What an unforgettable experience!  The staff and service was phenomenal. The grounds were clean and peaceful as well as the public bathrooms.  All of the restaurants we visited had great food and service. This was our first trip to Punta Cana and I would definitely go again!! If requesting a butler, I would request Juan de leon. He provided exceptional service and attention!!!

reviews.author: thongn255
reviews.title: Very nice and pampered.
reviews.text: Our stayed was very nice.  Our butler - Samuel was very attentive, and thank you Samuel for prepared the bubble bath.   It's awesome with the touch of candlelights and flowers.  The soundproof of room was very bad.  We were kept up by the loud talking voice of our next-door neighbor for the entire night.  Thanks goodie, it was only one night that we heard noise. Yet, the mini bar required few times of reminder and couple times of tips ($$)  but other than that was a very  nice trip for us.  Couldn't goes wrong with the Royal service.

reviews.author: shel121
reviews.title: Vento Restaurant Review
reviews.text:
Jose Marmot and his team of ten people made us feel so welcome, his attention to detail was second to none , we cannot fault him and his team ... 5 ***** 

The flavour of the food was truly authentic and cooked to perfection. We enjoyed a relaxing evening with great service and an amazing attention to detail!

reviews.author: Kristen R
reviews.title: A fantasy world you never want to leave!
reviews.text: From the moment you step onto the property and handed your first tropical drink, you are immersed into a Caribbean fantasy world!  I was greeted by my butler, Elvis, who did his absolute best to meet my every want and need.  From scented bubble baths, to cheese plates in my room in the afternoon, even some leaving me some Frangelico for my morning espresso, he did it all!  The activities staff was always organizing something fun by the poolside, Zumba, yoga, painting, music etc.  At night, they put on wonderful shows and dance parties!  Special thanks to Shaky Shaky and Caramelo for the late night dance lessons and my new moves!  Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: catbatham
reviews.title: Very well taken care of....
reviews.text:
We have just returned (literally) from this amazing resort!  We stayed for 6 days at the reserve.  We had an amazing butler ( Jose Salvador) we didn't want for anything.  Jose took care above and beyond the call of duty!!!  He made all of our reservations, and made sure we had shade wherever we went.

Fuego Restaurant was by far the best of all for us.  The steak and lobster was amazing!!!  The ambiance of the restaurant was beautiful!  RARE restaurant was great the first night, subsequent was not.  If you like your meat med rare ask for med as they cook it VERY rare (raw)

The breakfast buffet was good.  The lunch buffet is good and on the beach, with limited choices but enough.

The room service is very good.  The american breakfast is good.  Also the french toast.  The fresh orange juice is yummy.  The coffee machines in the room are hit and miss and VERY loud!!!

THe beds are very large and comfy! Hot water is hit or miss, but comfie shower with rain heads. Nice balcony.

Remember to reserve (pool area)  your bali bed in the reserve area the day before.  There is also beds on the beach that are nice too.  The ocean is warm, the pools are freezing.  ( biggest downfall) for us was the cold pools.  The swim up bar was neat but water too cold to enjoy for long.

Always lots of entertainment going on.  In the evenings after dinner the Gabi Bar is the place to be for live shows and dancing alot of fun!!!

Contrary to what I have read before, they do rake the beach every morning, and clear all the seaweed away!

The resort is beautiful and very well maintained.  I would stay here again.  There are of course little things here and there that could be different, but NOTHING derailed our vacation.  If you have the opportunity to ask for your personal butler please ask for JOSE SALVADOR, he is the best of all the butlers we saw.  Overall, a wonderful experience!!!  Memories to last a life time.

reviews.author: tolstoroukov
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Lots to Offer - Great Royal Service with Amazing Butlers!!!
reviews.text:
If you are considering coming to Punta Cana here are a few tips. I have brought 120 people to this resort staying in the Royal Service level of the hotel. Definitely, would recommend that over the regular side. You get your own butler (use him - ask for wine, ask for the bath, ask for reservations - he will help!!!). You get access to a few additional Royal Service Restaurants that are really good. You get your own personal beach area. 
Here are a few tips: 1. Ordered an umbrella by the pool in the morning for the next day. It is included in your service but they go fast. You would have a chance to get it later if it is not available but only if someone does not show by 11 am. 
2, You don't need a car - Every tour operator will pick you up from your hotel. All you need to do is get to the hotel. 
3. Spend the extra money on the Passion Restaurant - the only one that costs more. Amazing food. 
4. Best Free Restaurants to try - Fuego, Palazzo, Bano (Hibachi). 
5. Tip accordingly - no need to go all out but a few dollars here and there and your butler as well. 
6. If you are looking for better wine or alcohol it is only available for free in the Royal Service lounge.

Take a Catamaran excursion - it will blow you away!!! It has a stop where you jump off and walk in the water while drinking cocktails and it is amazing!!!

Great place to go visit.

reviews.author: tix2travel
reviews.title: Paradise in November
reviews.text:
I traveled with a group on this trip.  Our rooms were in the Royal Suites which had all of the personal attention you could imagine while at an all-inclusive resort.  We even had a personal Butler!!  Woo hoo.  He surprised me with a bath complete with chocolates and a wonderful note.  We were given cell phones so we could reach them at any time, but I rarely ever used it.  But he was always there when I needed him and made sure that I was well taken care of.

The resort is huge!  It's right on the beach and our rooms were only steps away from the private beach that were reserved for Royal Service guests only.  There were seven restaurants to choose from.  Since we were only there for 3 nights I didn't get to dine at most of them, but the ones I did dine at were good.  The service was excellent and food was always served with a smile.  There are plenty of bars and a smoothie bar right on the beach.

There's a Disco that I spent some time in dancing and having a great time with my co-workers, a casino, and shopping right on site.  There's also a theatre that has nightly shows and somehow I left without seeing one.

The resort has a shuttle that will take you to shopping free of charge.  You take a short shuttle ride to the shopping center and there you see all of the shops that we have at home.  So if you are looking for more non commercial shopping like markets and hand made crafts, then this is probably not for you.  But if upscale shopping is for you, it's great.

The sand is soft and wasn't extremely hot to walk across.  The only downside to the beach was the amount of seaweed that was along the shore.  There were men hauling it away in dump trucks (yes, that's how much it was).  I know this is unusual for the D.R., so I just attributed it to nature and realized that sometimes there are things that are just out of our control.  I stepped over it and enjoyed the warm, turquoise waters.  The water is fairly shallow so you can really enjoy the water.

The food was okay. I can't say that it was extremely tasty or totally bad.  It was average.  The buffet always had a large variety to choose from, a salad bar, pizza, desserts, seafood, and sushi.  Drinks are served and there is always someone around to get anything that you may need.

The resort itself is clean and well maintained.  There's ample seating for everyone and plenty of shade.  There is a Garden where you can go and meditate, relax, and clear your mind.  It's quiet with seating and low lighting at night.  There's a spa but I can't speak on any of the services, but some of my co-workers went and said they really enjoyed it.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay here and would recommend it.

reviews.author: stjohnjessica
reviews.title: Over Rated
reviews.text:
Don't get me wrong - there was nothing WRONG with the place - but for the price tag - it's just average. I understood it was supposed to be above and beyond. 

The food was mediocre at best. I had one meal that I thought "this is good", the steak at the Grill, but other than that what I would expect to eat out at any restaurant at home. 

The rooms were very nice, but it was that little extra "wow" that was missing. For being The Reserve I expected to be a little bit wow-ed. 

And it was good service, any old restaurant kind of food, and nice rooms.

reviews.author: Ronal U
reviews.title: Buenísimo
reviews.text: Mis vacaciones en el hotel Paradisus punta cana fueron muy muy buenas las atenciones  son de primera y el hotel es bellísimo los empleados  muy amigables y gentiles muchísimas  gracias a mis amigos  jhordan y noel  del equipo de animación. .

reviews.author: WGlady
reviews.title: Fun Fun Fun  Josias inirio(Obama)
reviews.text:
Josias inirio (Obama) is great. Makes sure the guests have a blast. Friendly and engaging entertainer on site. Dance partner not to be missed at Gabi Beach party. 
Tons of fun and makes you the life of the party. Dances better than anyone I've ever met.

reviews.author: kteach2016
reviews.title: Choices and Service!!
reviews.text: We have experienced a great week On the Reserve at the Paradisus. We were very satisfied with our service from an extremely friendly, helpful staff. Our room was wonderful except that their really wasn't a great chair for someone who recently had hip surgery. Desiree and Cleybi did a great job keeping our room in tip top shape. We thought the food was delicious. In fact we saw little need to go to the upscale dining areas as everything we had was great. The number of choices was unreal in our opinions. If we didn't like the buffet meat choices, we could pick a raw meat choice and it would be instantly grilled in front of you. We never did. We loved the choices in front of us. We didn't have much luck catching the bus. The odds for us were we were always waiting 15 and up to 25 for transportation to the beach.

reviews.author: Артем М
reviews.title: Шикарный отель очень высокого уровня
reviews.text:
Для изысканных туристов кому нужен шик и обслуживание на высшем уровне - вам в этот отель.
Пляж наверно один из самых красивых каких я только видел, компактная территория с релакс зонами, крутые бассейны
ну и  контингент конечно

reviews.author: Kristin M
reviews.title: Large Group Meeting
reviews.text:
Before I begin I must say that I have been here twice; both times for a work outing of about 80 people so this review might be different if it wasn't such a large group. 

Pros:
The resort is beautiful and very large
The buffet restaurant (naos I believe) was very good with many options
Room is nice (but not private at all)

Cons:
The food. Almost my entire group got sick. This could have been from the majority of our food being catered and not going to the restaurants but even still, the food needs to be sanitary (it was directly catered from the resort).
Mosquitos and bugs were bad.
Very large language barriers 
Housekeeping cleaned our room and TOOK OUR PHONES AND WALLETS SITTING OUT AND MOVED THEM. Granted we shouldn't have left the belongings out but housekeeping took our valuables and put them in our safe and locked it with their own code. So when we returned to the room we assumed they were stolen due to no note or anything being left. We had to have security come and help us (he wasn't very nice and blamed us). 
Only two beers, neither being a light beer. 
Housekeeping would take dirty towels but not replace them with clean. 

Overall, even though it was not a great experience as a work outing, I would never stay here for personal.

If you are debating between the DR and Mexico, hands down go to Mexico. 

Tip for anyone coming from out of the country: Do not check a bag if you can get away with it. There is no order to their airport and the lines will take you over an hour just to check your bag. Security will take your belongings (I'm assuming to just keep for their own). They took a portable charger that had been cleared by TSA for approval. With the language barrier they wouldn't give it back.

reviews.author: Attitaly
reviews.title: Ottimi servizi, ma il mare...
reviews.text: Meglio altrove il mare, in altre parti dell'isola. Noi lo abbiamo trovato spesso agitato e con molte alghe. Il resort offre tanto in termini di attività, si gira con le macchinette tra un'area e l'altra essendo enorme. La zona della Reserva è ancora più esclusiva e selezionata.

reviews.author: Vinny L
reviews.title: good for a family getaway but could be better
reviews.text:
Although everything is inclusive, the facility has a lot things broken, the shower is leaking, no hot water shower (this is for sure everyone is complaining), broken concrete   inside the room, poor quality TV and channels, mainly the facility is not well maintained. Service is great, personnels are kind.

Some of them don't know where my room is when I first checked-in, lost in their weird building design and had asked two clerks - they don't know where it would be. This should not happen.   

Pool is clean all the time, drinks are great. Beach is clean but seawater is sandy. 

Food is just so so, yes all inclusive all you can eat, and they tried to make you feel good they have EVERYTHING, but everything is not really authenticated. A lot overcooked, you have to find what you can enjoy after couple tries. Water is salty so never drink the tap water.  

Overall, it's good for family staying if you can tolerate certain defections, it could be better.

reviews.author: Oliver R
reviews.title: Birthday holiday
reviews.text:
One of the best hotel experiences ever. We were too happy with it in general that we did not mind the small failures. 

Some examples on my birthday. 
The Concierge came up see us at our breakfast table in the restaurant to congratulate me to my birthday. At night the whirlpool was filled and the room nicely decorated with red flowers. The dinner at the restaurant where one usually has to pay an addtional fee was free. All this was fantastic and nerver happened at other hotels were I spent my birthday before. But other hotels left a birthday card and some sweets or even a cake after room service on this special day. We were not sure if the flowers/whirlpool was for my birthday or for our tipping the room maid. At the restaurant despite having noted at reservation that it was my birthday there was no special nor any recognition of the special day. Should we have asked for that more explicitly? We only noticed the free restaurant dinner at checkout when it was missing on the bill. Failure of the restaurant or gift for my birthday?

Screws were missing on the toilet paper holder and the mini bar door, Staff must have noticed as both were refilled regularly. Screws were still never replaced. We did not bother to report as mostly everything else was to our satisfaction. 

Some services were inconsistent like the nightly turn down service carried out in a different way and not every night. 
Waiters were in general very fast, friendly and efficient but not up the standard they try to create. E.g. empty glasses taken away  before we left the table, Sometimes we were missing a fork or knife and staff did not notice when they served the food. Instead of replacing forks and knives with new ones they were taken from our used appetizer plates and placed back on the table. Those things should not happen but being in the Caribbean we did not mind and enjoyed the high quality of the food. Even with the house wines we were always satisfied. 

Our room was about 1 km from the beach but we always walked instead of taking the frequently operating carts. The park/garden was way too nice to just drive through and amazingly well kept by an army of friendly gardeners.

We never felt pushed to tip.

I would always come back to this Paradisus of the all inclusive world. They just make too many things perfect and that will make you oversee the little imperfections. 

Thank you Paradisus for a wonderfull holiday and keep up the efforts!

reviews.author: marcospineda2
reviews.title: Imperdible
reviews.text:
Excelente experiencia, excelente servicio y equipo de trabajo, excelente las instalaciones. Ferancisco, uno de los mayordomos del Royal Service, fue muy agradable, atento y profesional. 

Gracias por todo!

reviews.author: abogadosean
reviews.title: Kid Zone is great-room cleaning service a nightmare
reviews.text: The Kid Zone was wonderful for my 11 year-old. Great option to be able to relax during the day. However, the cleaning staff continually barged into my room even with the "No Molestar" Do Not Disturb card on the door. One cleaning lady appeared shocked to see a naked over 50 year old guess standing there. Another time, the eager water bottle guy barged in when I had on head phones and was playing my guitar. I did not hear the door knock or open and nearly had a heart-attack. Another time, the bottle boy barged in again. The staff explained that even though the back side of the purple card that says "Do Not Disturb" is blank (nothing written at all), "it means come in and clean or service the room"! En serio? I guess they don't understand what people who read and write might think. They clean crew regularly congregated outside the door and talked loudly at 10 am... If that is my only complaint, then things were not so bad-however for the price, they should respect privacy.

reviews.author: 321douglasg
reviews.title: Its the Little Things that mean the MOST
reviews.text:
As some of you know I work for an online travel service and travel quite frequently bringing my family (wife and now 18 month old) in tow.
I am used to the usual issues with resorts and islands but recently have been more and  more impressed with Punta Cana

I must say the RESERVE is a stellar resort. HUGE, spotless and for those who like the finer things.
The only draw back if any is the size as getting places does tae a while and the restaurant resos fill up fast. However this leads me to my story.

We wanted to get into the Asian restaurant for Sushi and had been unsuccessful however ESTEFANIA at the Louge/Recepcion who tried to make these reservations for us felt bad. When we got back to our room that evening she had a plate of Sushi made up and waiting for us as we could not get it in the restaurant 
NOW THAT IS SERVICE

Other notable was JJ or YY as they say and Amborix who got us everywhere we wanted and everything we needed and made us feel like old friends
Great job and thank you

PS the wifi was Free FAST and everywhere beach ocean everywhere !! lol  it never went down amazing.

reviews.author: Francisco O.
reviews.title: Too short...always too short
reviews.text:
I went here for a meeting but the enjoyable ambiance made one to forget this was work. Nicely populated with several different species, this kind of arboretum lies very near from the beach, but secretely placed not to be in the stream of people walking and for sure, having fun.
 Third floor suite with jacuzzi with a view, balcony, indispensable air conditioning and a very good all inclusive service.
At check-in I registered at midnight with almost no problem but the lack of a restaurant to calm hungry after a very long trip.
Warm staff, ready to solve any kind of query

reviews.author: Karin R
reviews.title: such a lovely paradise indeed!
reviews.text:
Staff are wonderful and one stands out in particular...Davidson Germain was a ray of human sunshine. His smile lights up an already brilliant day! He went above and beyond to make us feel special...like we were the only people he wanted to serve that day. What a gift he has. Thanks Davidson!!
Food was good, beach is like the finest sugar, beds very comfy

reviews.author: RenataEirasMD
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text:
Great Resort! 
I've been there for a business conference, and probably will come back with my husband for vacation.
Big rooms, lots of food all day long, amazing beach! 5 different restaurants, though the breakfast is served just by the beach, with and espectacular beach view. 
Wake up really early and watch the sunrise. It will worth it!

reviews.author: Amy F
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!  Wonderful time!
reviews.text: We loved it!  Especially appreciated Rafael, bartender at Fuego, who took great care of us!  :)  Loved our Royal Service with Edwardo as our butler - awesome!  Also enjoyed our outdoor spinning class which was challenging but good.  (Don't remember the instructor's name, but he was really good.)  The workout room was great.  I wish I remembered the personal trainer's name too.  He was always there - all hours of the day, every day.  My husband and I went here on a "work" outing.  It was truly amazing!  Beautiful place, wonderful weather, awesome experience!

reviews.author: iCorpPilot
reviews.title: Super nice hotel and staff...
reviews.text: The title says it all. This was a last minute business trip (flightcrew) and both of us (2 rooms) couldn't have been happier with this "all inclusive" 5 day stay. The food selection and availability was outstanding. The WiFi was good bordering on very good. Just be careful of the taxi company you use from the FBO to the hotel. The taxi driver charged us $45 for a 20 minute ride. That seemed very high to us.

reviews.author: Alberto R
reviews.title: un sueño
reviews.text: excelentes atenciones un lugar para sentirse en el paraíso, para conferencias, con unos salones excelentes, espaciosos, acogedores, excelente ambientación, fiestas privadas, no hay igual, quiero ver si el próximo fin de semana a ver si repito.

reviews.author: Marllen R
reviews.title: Me encanto
reviews.text:
Excelente Hotel!!! 
Felicidades a los chicos del bar de la piscina al lado del Gabi!! Excelente
 atención.  
El servicio muy bueno!! El hotel esta divino!! 
La habitación chulisima!! Muy linda. Y la atención de todos fue espectacular.

reviews.author: A5197GEstephenb
reviews.title: Unbelievable Experience
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful.  The butler service was wonderful ("yay" Jose Fernandez (Hernandez?)!  We love you!)  Make sure to see at least one sunrise -- incredible.  The pools were beautiful and the beach pristine with beautiful beds under the palms.

reviews.author: Raquel G
reviews.title: FUE SOLO UNA VISITA DE INSPECCION PERO WOW QUE ME HUBIESE QUEDADO!!
reviews.text:
Solo estuve un día en este hotel y fue sin dormida pero las instalaciones son preciosas, así como el nivel de entretenimiento. Me gusta el trato del personal y que todo se concentra cerca. Conocí los salones para eventos y me parecieron espectaculares.

Pude probar el restaurante PALAZZO, sin duda una cena exquisita y los mejores postres que he probado en Punta Cana solo que es exclusivo para huéspedes royal.

La playa es lindísima y el juego de colores de luces durante las noches hacen que en verdad te sientas en un paraíso.

reviews.author: Redbudian
reviews.title: Follow-up review from a second stay
reviews.text: We originally gave this hotel high marks due to the great stay we had a few years back.  However, when we returned we noticed a huge difference from our first stay.  First of all, the property was not maintained well.  Our room had many things that were out of order, crumbling or missing.  Secondly, the hotel also seemed to be  less clean.  Not only from lack of cleaning, but the wait staff didn't seem to care (or know) about proper hygiene or sanitary practices.  Flies covered the food on the buffet, food was left out too long (e.g. raw sushi grade fish that was unrefrigerated and the guy who plunged your toilet could be seen behind the buffet within minutes of his service visit.  Next, the "vibe" of the hotel has changed.  We watched a European tourist passed out on the couch after what I am assuming is a rough night out.  No one checked on the man, no one escorted him to his room - he just stayed there sleeping (passed out) as we ate our meal.  What seemed like a great family resort has gravitated towards the party crowd, which had to be hard to watch for those with young children.  Many of the people in our large group (300+ who were there for a short business trip turned vacation) left with enteritis and other intestinal issues. We had a few who were hospitalized due to dehydration.  Not sure if the water filtration was working or if it was due to the lack of cleanliness (I suspect it was a combination).  The hotel would not acknowledge any issues and told us we must have arrived sick.  Seeing the number of people in our group, who traveled from all over the U.S. and Canada, I'd say that is highly unlikely.  Bottom line: we will never set foot on this property again.

reviews.author: j k
reviews.title: Excellente!!!!
reviews.text: My visit was short but excellent, thanks to Domingo Beltre the Guest services manager.  I basically was a walk in, and he welcomed me like I had a reservation!!  He sealed the deal for my to definitely reserve a room for next year with Royal Service.  Thanks Domi

reviews.author: Ian B
reviews.title: A deal is not a deal at Palma Real
reviews.text:
I attend a week long conference at the resort but to meet connecting flights I extended for a day. I was offered the extra day at $282 a night and this was taken from my credit card straight away so no disputes about the price. Went to checkout the next day and was told they need an extra $40 as THEY made a mistake and offered and charged me the wrong rate. 

The manager did not seem to be perturbed that this practice is unacceptable ethically and probably illegal any where else in the world. The manager was polite but not going to budge nor get my taxi and only after a long long discussion agreed it was there mistake and apologised. So given they would not get a taxi to allow me to get my flight I paid. It kind of felt like a polite hostage situation.

I can only assume they make them pay for mistakes like this. The bottom line is a deal is not a deal at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort, it's just a starting point for further negotiations.

It was a shame as I found the place well appointed and serving staff helpful and polite. Not so pleased with reception but maybe I am a bit scared from above incident.

Had one other incident with a maid entering the room when I was asleep. Scared the hell out of me. Probably a language thing as I said no turn down but really needed to put the sign out.

There is definitely however Dominican time and organising even the most basic things can be challenging. In fact it reminds me of Fiji, except in Fiji they follow normal commercial practices and would have at least done something to fix their mistakes. Bulla.

reviews.author: R8226DAJ
reviews.title: Rude experience
reviews.text:
Visiting for a big conference.  Nearly all the staff was rude and I felt like they were mad about working there.  This was particularly true in the restaurants where they did not take any requests.   They were so rude in one that we walked out.

The WIFI was also terrible - in the rooms it was so weak that it would constantly kick you off.  It was better in the conference rooms but still weak.

reviews.author: Barbara R
reviews.title: Travel Agent Inspection
reviews.text: This place was like Heaven on Earth! We had a great time and our Butler Jose Salvador was AWESOME! He provide us with the best of the best! Walked us to Dinner, had our bath water ready for us, wine and fruit.  You name it this guy was great! We also at dinner at Vento and we had a wonderful waitress YuderQui Javier (Judy) we love this lady!  She help us order in Spanish. Wow! she also remembered all of our names.  Thank you Judy for being a great help to us all. :)

reviews.author: nuriaz135
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel, excelente comida y atención. Mejorar en la coordinación entre la reservación y los restaurantes. Nos gustó la atención por parte de los empleados todos muy amables y con ganas de resolver cualquier inconveniente. Las actividades con los animadores muy divertidas y los animadores y animadoras con muchas ganas de ofrecer entretenimiento.

reviews.author: ANICA1234
reviews.title: EXCELENTE SERVICIO
reviews.text:
Agradezco todo el apoyo brindado dentro del Grupo de Herbalife .. Gracias Asia, Johanna y Angelica por todo el apoyo brindado durante el éxito de este grupo.

Un servicio eficiente y cordialmente invitada a regresar.

Mil gracias

reviews.author: Ann D
reviews.title: Marino Payamas, our bartender at The Reserve restaurant was fantastic
reviews.text: Marino was our bartender multiple times while visiting the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. The first time we were there, he learned our name and called us by name each time after. He always had a smile on his face and went over and above to make sure we were enjoying our trip. Cudo's Marino! We will miss you and thank you for your professional service.

reviews.author: gabrielgZ8038JN
reviews.title: Un excelente lugar para disfrutar cada momento!
reviews.text: Muy buen Hotel para disfrutar en cada una de las actividades que se desarrollan. Muy buena atención en todas las áreas y  una gastronomía muy variada. Habitaciones amplias, muy frescas y con muy lindas vistas, pero es cierto que algunas quedan un tanto lejos del lobby como fue mi caso. Las playas muy cuidadas y las actividades nocturnas que allí se realizan son claramente espectaculares.

reviews.author: Eduardo H
reviews.title: Super bien atendido en una agenda apretada
reviews.text:
Super bien atendido por todo el personal. En esta oportunidad me tocó una habitación muy bonita, amplia y tranquila.  La comida es muy buena y las instalaciones y playas son muy buenas.
Definitivamente recomiendo este hotel.

reviews.author: Minor R
reviews.title: EXCELENTE ESTADIA
reviews.text:
Estuve hospedado por 4 noches, desde mi ingreso la amabilidad del personal tanto maleteros como del front desk me cautivo.  Luego al ver las instalaciones tan exclusivas y de tan buen gusto decoradas, me confirmaron que seria una grata experiencia.  

La habitación asignada fue en la zona de Royal Service, realmente muy bien decorada, espaciosa, confortable, con muy buenos amenities, minibar completo.  Las camas sumamente confortables.

La playa es sin duda hermosa, y el area de la piscina limpia, amplia y perfecta para descansar y tomar el sol.

Con respecto a la alimentación merece un 1000% por su calidad y diversidad.

Realmente recomiendo visitarlo sea por trabajo o vacaciones.

reviews.author: DarienC
reviews.title: Beautiful Luxurious Resort
reviews.text: Food is decent for all inclusive.  We did the Royal Service - which was a very romantic and over the top experience for a couple.  A perfect R&R get-away - so many beautiful spots to relax by the pool or by the beach.  Not a lot of activities for couples.  We did the local culture excursion with Punta Cana Mike and loved it!  Food was very good for an all-inclusive, but would recommend that you make reservations for all nights upon arrival since the best restaurants book up.

reviews.author: Ivan N S
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: Excellent lodgings, ample food menus and cold beverages. Best of all, the bartenders, maids, waiters and cooks. Their demeanor was professional, courteous and funny.  Good for families and better for couples. Fully recommended!!

reviews.author: Connie L
reviews.title: My visit to Punta Cana
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Resort has great restaurants, lovely white sand beach and pools. Great Hospitality and lots of fun activities to do in the resort. I'm not good in painting but did the painting class there. With the coaching of Oxnal & Yoselin, I enjoy the 1 hour oil painting time which haven't done that for more than 20 years. They're artistic, fun and GOOD DANCERS...a lot of fun with them. Don't miss the painting class when you're there!

reviews.author: Dynamitetravel
reviews.title: Good Option For Bavaro Area
reviews.text: This property is breathtaking when you first walk in! The rooms are very spacious and relatively updated. The property is in a great location near dining, shopping, and nightlife. Liliana at the guest services was great and Yessica with group sales was outstanding if you are looking for a property to host a group this is it. The only cons I had were that you had to make reservations for almost all of the restaurants. As you know this can be frustrating when you are first arriving because there aren't many options available. I also thought that the drinks/snacks provided in the room could have been a little better for it to be considered a 5-star property. The spa was very nice I had a massage and it was outstanding (I think her name was Evelyn). All in all it was a great stay and I would consider returning for sure. If anyone has questions or would like pictures/video please feel free to contact me.

reviews.author: Lschneida
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Impeccable service, Top notch amenities
reviews.text: As soon as we arrived at the resort we were welcomed with fresh cold towels, cucumber water, and a view of the ocean so pristine I couldn't believe I was about to spend 8 days soaking it all in!  The resort is massive so I definitely got a bit of exercise going to and from the room each day--which I enjoyed.  The facilities were all perfectly maintained and staffed.  The gym was the best resort gym I had ever seen--well stocked with modern equipment and always supervised by a trained professional.  Each of the restaurants had the same amazing service.  I mostly ate at the main buffet for lunch and dinner, but tried Vento, Rare, and the Hibachi restaurant and was equally impressed by all 3.  The most impressive aspect of this resort by far was the entertainment:  this place is a party!  Dancers, musicians, circus performers, and outside groups put on shows each night; however, the rooms were far enough away that the entertainment did not hinder a good nights sleep should that be your goal.  I cannot wait to make my way back to the Palma Real!

reviews.author: Tia J
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: From the moment my mother and I walked on the property to the moment we left, everything was unforgetable. The was my first visit to an all inclusive resort and the Paradisus has set the bar very high. The resort is amazing. The amenities are wonderful between the private beach, the swimming pools, the restaurants, and the activites that are accessible through the resort. Additonally, we also had butler service with Yohelvi. He is AMAZING!!!! From the moment we were assigned, he was extremely attentive to our wants and needs. When we made a call or request, he was there. If you have the option for butler service, please, please request Yohelvi if he is available. I would definitely visit the Paradisus again and recommend it for you travels.

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text: I have been to a handful of all inclusive resorts throughout the Caribbean and I can say with 100% honesty that the Paradisus Palma Real surpassed them all. I have and will continue to reccommend this resort to any and everyone.  It is truly a first class experience from the moment you enter the property.  The grounds and facilities are maintained consistantly throughout the day, providing for a clean and comfortable environement. Our room was spacious, and set up for the perfect home away from home.  The resort offered a variety of foods during breakfast, lunch and dinner at the main dining buffet and also offered tons of options to eat at other restaurants throughout resort.  The food and drink was delicious!  You will never be bored at the Paradisus Palma Real because there is so much to do.  From a wide range of organized group acitivies, shopping, shows, and just pure relaxation, you will always find something that intriques you. To save the best for last, I cannot say enough kind things about the staff. Each and every staff member was so kind, accommodating and genuinely willing to make sure your experience was unforgettable.  I enjoyed walking around the resort and receiving smiles and 'Hello's' everywhere i went.  It truly made the experience at the Paradisus Palma Real feel even more like home for the week.  I would reccommend this resort for a couples get away, family vacation or even a week away with friends!

reviews.author: Tory S
reviews.title: Another Fantastic Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at a Paradisus resort, and I must say, this experience has again gone above and beyond surpassing my expectations. The staff are friendly and the service is impeccable. Aside from the beauty of the resort and the many amenities it had to offer to its guests, I especially enjoyed the wide array of entertainment offered, from shows on stage to aerialists and even the dancers that perform during night life. This resort has something for everyone, and I would highly recommend it to anyone planning on visiting Punta Cana. This is THE PLACE to stay.

reviews.author: Madelyn W
reviews.title: My stay at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This was my first time visiting the Dominican and I must say it is one of the most beautiful resorts I have ever been to. I have been to many tropical places including Cancun and Costa Rica, both with great resorts, this one tops them all. Not only is the scenery breathtaking, but the hotel and service are impeccable. The resort is always clean and those that work there are extremely friendly and willing to get you whatever you need. I was there as part of the Patriots Cheerleaders, but I certainly plan on going back with friends and family. I even ran into a family that was visiting there for the third time! They just could not get enough! There is plenty to do for everyone of all ages. I strongly suggest choosing this resort, when visiting the Dominican, it is truly amazing. I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Lasondra26
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is the most beautiful resort i have ever visited. The atmosphere is perfect for relaxation and the staff go ABOVE and BEYOND to make you feel at home. Everyday There are a variety of activities to engage in (Beach volleyball, water aerobics, salsa classes, yoga) and that is just to name a few. Housekeeping did a phenomenal job everyday for all seven days of my trip. The food was exemplary and there was variety of options for everyone. The beverages were delicious and carefully prepared. I absolutely will be visiting again in the near future!

reviews.author: Stavros23
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Incredible!!! The staff was so generous and kind! It was such a beautiful resort with amazing amenities. I definitely hope to go back in the future whether it's for business or pleasure. One of the best resorts I've ever been to!

reviews.author: Nmanelas
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely amazing. I had a spectacular time here! The rooms were always clean, the food was great, the beaches were beautiful. The resort itself was beautiful! The staff was so welcoming and I felt at home. By the end of the week I was not ready to leave. I would definitely come back to this resort, and I'd recommend it to anyone. I don't have a single complaint. I was very well taken care of here.

reviews.author: Delaney B
reviews.title: Beautiful, well-kept resort!
reviews.text: It's been about a week since returning from the Paradisus Palma Real and I wish I was back! The staff is so friendly, facilities are impecable (I constantly found myself wondering how they kept everything so clean, and not covered in sand) and the beach is beautiful, with the most perfect sand! It was my first experience in the Dominican Republic as well as my first time staying at Paradisus Resort and I would recommend it to any of my friends or family looking for a relaxing, beautiful, beach vacation. Cheers, Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Rebeka S
reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: This was my first time visiting  the DR and I can't wait to go back... all because of the Paradisus Palma Real! This hotel was absolutely amazing! Upon first stepping foot onto the property, you will be taken away by the beautiful grounds.  It is so picturesque! Everything is spectacular from the rooms, to the food to the service!  The rooms are clean and very spacious.  The buffet is delicious and offers a large variety of cuisines at each meal.  The restaurants on the resort are also fantastic!  The staff is always pleasant and willing to help guests with whatever they need.  Not only is the staff friendly, but they are very talented!  They provide entertainment by singing and dancing and engaging with guests.  I definitely recommend this hotel for group trips, couple trips and family trips! It is perfect for all occasions!

reviews.author: Kayla B
reviews.title: The trip of a lifetime!
reviews.text: I spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was the most amazing experience. The resort is absolutely stunning with the beautiful views. This was my first time visiting DR and I do not think it could have been any better. The staff was extremely amazing, welcoming and fun. There were fun events during the day and night including dancing and some live music. The room I stayed in was spectacular and always extremely clean. The The food was great, both the buffet and the different restaurants were delicious. There was plenty of space to relax by both the pool and the ocean. Although I did not travel with kids I did see that there were a lot of things for children and families to do together, there is an entire kids zone. It was a great resort and definitely a place I would go back to.

reviews.author: Tracy S
reviews.title: Absolute PARADISE!
reviews.text: I've traveled extensively and the Paradisus Palma Real was, by far, the most beautiful resort I have ever stayed at.  The property is exquisite. The rooms are designed beautifully, from the canopy beds to gorgeous marble floors; even the hallways and aisles leading to the rooms are beautiful.  Housekeeping and all of the staff are friendly, courteous and on point with ensuring every need is met.  The food is delicious, with so many options. The buffet has an endless variety of amazing food for everyone's taste and there are so many restaurants on the property to choose from. The pools are huge and clean with ample chairs to enjoy the area. The beaches are incredible, just like the photos show.  The entertainment is non-stop, from singers and dancers to mimes and aerialists to mimes, you're always engaged. The spa; not enough adjectives to describe the beauty and tranquility. That could have been a vacation in itself. I will definitely be planning another vacation to the Paradisus Palma Real within this year. I highly recommend it.  OUTSTANDING!!!  If I could give 100 stars, I would.

reviews.author: 411julia
reviews.title: A Dream Vacation, Relaxing, Fun, BEAUTIFUL!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is an absolute dream. The rooms are clean, big, and the beds are very comfortable. The whole staff from the bar tenders, to the servers, to the water aerobics instructor, are all so nice and accommodating. They truly understand the importance of customer service. The property is absolutely breathtaking. Absolutely loved the pool, and the beach. At night they have many restaurants to choose from. From Italian, to sushi it is everything you could want and more. And if you want to stay out late The Red Lounge plays great music and is a lot of fun! I strongly suggest this resort to families, couples, and friends!

reviews.author: Amandas12345678
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a top quality resort.  They paid special attention to keeping the grounds clean at all times-- there was constantly staff paying attention to small details and keeping the resort immaculate.  The beach is a quick walk from the room and there is easy access to the dining options from the beach and pool.  The buffet is accommodating to all dietary needs and great quality.
