The resort is family friendly and provides entertainment at night to help you make the most of your vacation in Punta cana-- there is no need to travel off the resort if you are looking for fun! I would recommend this resort to anyone who travels to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Cara S
reviews.title: Unforgettable Stay
reviews.text: I stayed here for 8 days last week and it was absolutely incredible! The staff really went above and beyond to make sure guests were comfortable. The entertainment was fantastic and there was always something going on every night. There were live musicians as well as remarkable DJ's. There was a variety of choices for food too! (along with their amazing buffet.)  As far as little things that matter, beds were very comfortable, rooms were always cool (if you set it for that of course), the housekeeping was spectacular,  never had to ask for more they were completely on top of things. Overall definitely the best resort I've been to. This was a business trip for me however as far as the next leisure trip I plan to go on, this is definitely going to be my first choice.

reviews.author: Alyssa M
reviews.title: Outstanding resort
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus Palma Real and had the most amazing time. The rooms were amazing and always clean and spotless. The food was delicious, I would say to definitely take advantage of the restaurants around the resort. It is so easy to make the reservations and try new food each night. The buffet is also amazing. The pool was clean and warm and large so you could either be by the swim up bar area or in a quiet secluded area. Great area for the kids and overall a great resort for the whole family!

reviews.author: Brittany D
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I had an absolute blast at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. The staff was so accommodating and made my trip one I will never forget. Also, the smell of incense and the calming music made my day every morning. The resort was clean and the food was so delicious. I can't wait to go back and stay at this resort again. I definitely suggest this resort to anyone looking to stay in Punta Cana! You won't regret it!

reviews.author: Lisa I
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: From the moment I walked in to the resort lobby I was floored by the aesthetics and decor. There were beautiful fountains, lounge chairs and chic looking bars leading up to an endless looking pool that contained mini soaking tubs and submerged chairs in the water to keep yourself cool. The resort was very modern an up to date. When I traveled the staff had let me know that the resort was full, however I never felt as though this was the case. Any time I needed ANYTHING at all, it was there, ready in seconds. The buffet food was outstanding, constantly being changed and menu items rotating daily (I am a Chef and a tough critic and I was extremely impressed by the quality). The beach was manicured daily and I was specifically impressed when I saw a seaweed truck in the morning cleaning up the seaweed that washed up on shore the night before. What an extra added touch that just proved how thoroughly the resort was thought out and dedicated to detail. The staff was really just so attentive, I cannot say enough good things.. there was always someone cleaning or replenishing my room with towels/water/ turing down my bed. You really will not be disappointed traveling here with a spouse for a romantic get away or with children since there is a wonderful children facility at the "reserve" portion of the resort where they can play with other children and can find MANY activities with the very attentive staff. It literally looks like a Disney Land for kids where everything is catered to them and made especially for them. I went over there to check it out and all of the staff and kids were having the best time..I even saw a rock climbing wall?!?! So YES! I would recommend traveling to this resort over and over again. It was a magical trip and I would go back any day!

reviews.author: Hlebeau
reviews.title: Perfect Resort!!
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Paradisus and it was wonderful! Not only was it beautiful, but it was clean, the staff was amazing, and the food was great as well! I highly recommend this resort to anyone looking to travel to the Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: Karen L
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana gets 5 Stars from me!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was hands down the most beautiful resort I've ever stayed in! The pictures don't do it justice! I had an amazing experience from start to finish. The hospitality and service was top notch, the hotel was always amazingly clean, the food at the buffet and in all of the restaurants was delicious- all in all it was an incredible experience! The beaches at the resort were also a highlight for me- there was always plenty of beach chairs and there was a spacious amount on beach reserved by the hotel. You wont be disappointed if you choose to stay here!

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. I was there for eight days and would have loved to stay for more if I could have. The hotel is very clean, the rooms are beautiful, and the location can't be beat. There were plenty of great dining options. The staff was very friendly as well. Can't wait to go back soon!

reviews.author: Seng100
reviews.title: Friendly and entertaining resort
reviews.text: I was pleased to have had the opportunity to stay at the Palma Real for a brief business meeting/conference on the premises. As may be expected, the all-inclusive resort is rather large and designed to provide all the amenities that one may expect viz. selection of different themed restaurants, several large pools, spa, casino and numerous drinking stations/bars. Witnessed a wedding during my sojourn and there were many evidently "honeymooners" in attendance as well. Staff were extremely friendly, attentive and professional; food selection was broad and plentiful but the quality/taste could be of a higher standard (but maybe expected for an all-inclusive hotel). I had the privilege to stay in a one bedroom suite, which was very large and comfortable. The fridge was stocked with free (non-alcoholic) beverages and the wifi was free and robust; everything in the room worked well. The hotel is located on the ocean front, which was very beautiful, and while I did not partake, there were a number of activities offered to guests. I took a massage at the Yhi spa which is located some distance from the main hotel - the spa is well laid-out (pretty) and the service rendered was acceptable. This is a high-functioning and well-maintained resort that is worthy of your consideration - for vacation or business.

reviews.author: Eduardo D
reviews.title: Excelente reunión en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Acudi a este hermoso hotel a una reunión de negocio y nos dimos tiempo para entretenernos y descansar, descansar, descansar. los animadores siempre estuvieron al tanto de que el buen ambiente estubiera presente tanto en las albercas como en el bar de playa, felicidades a Big Mac , Rey Rey Jazz y Angel
Mención especial el buen trato, calidez y atención de meseros camaristas y todo el personal del hotel.

reviews.author: Bill S
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!!
reviews.text: Big thanks to my butler Luis Sanchez!!!  My man took care of us the whole week we were there.  Very relaxing atmosphere with opportunity to party when you want.  Food and Beverages never stop!!!!!  Appreciate all the service Luis and good luck with the baseball career :)  Also props to the Royal Service pool bartender of the century Leonardo.  Best attitude I have ever seen.  Our group loved him.  Well done guys and the Coco Loco's con a coconut was awesome.  Chow!!!!

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Award trip
reviews.text: The hotel is very pretty. The rooms are amazing. The staff was friendly. The food was just OK. It was nice that they had an adult only pool area. We had a great time on the beach too. The service on the beach was slow and some times not there at all. The Michael Jackson Show was fantastic!

reviews.author: Roozbeh2015
reviews.title: Not a quality place.
reviews.text: I was very disapointed to have our meeting in this resort. Not a quality place for the dollar you pay. Bad wifi. Low quality food. Not a professional front desk service. Bad room service. Had no hot water on day. No electricity one day. No water one days. Three days of no service. I selected a place to impress my people. But end up with disapointing experiance. When i discussed these issues with the resort managent, they were indifferent. Not even an apploglogy.

reviews.author: Diane E
reviews.title: Royal Service was awesome
reviews.text: The Royal Service is absolutely the way to go our butler Sandi Gil and Bartendar at the Sunset bar Leonardo Mota were awesome. Leo was busy all day but never failed to disappoint. He was entertaining and provided great service.

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: Best Vacation EVER
reviews.text:
Upgraded to a superior junior suite - highly recommend it - you have a back deck with a private backyard with a 4 poster bed in it.  The resort is amazing...seemed overwhelming at first because it's so big...but it's really well laid out and easy to get around, especially with the constant shuttles that are running to take you from the lobby, beach, your room, etc.
Perfect beach, awesome pool - normally I would stay at only one or the other, we alternated every day because both were so beautiful and fun.
24/7 room service and great food, amazing staff.  Can't say enough, was the best vacation I've ever had!

reviews.author: Shawn Q
reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.text: The beginning started with my Butler Luis Martinez, THE BEST service and consistent with communication to make my wife and I feel at home. Better than home. I have to mention the other folks that made this trip enjoyable. Piterson,Alberto,Sandy,and Nelson at the pool bar. The two young ladies at the Spa also were great. This trip was so memorable and relaxing do to the service and personal touch. They all made us laugh and I left with knowing that I will come back and do this again! They did a great job making you feel like Family,

reviews.author: 2500CoCo
reviews.title: GYM
reviews.text:
The gym and the staff at this resort were very awesome.  They helped train and motivate us to keep our workouts going during our trip.... as it is a top priority for good health and well being. The personal trainers there are very personable and deserve to be thanked!!!
I will be going back not only for the wonderful time we spent there ....but also to enjoy the great people and the wonderful atmosphere.  I give it a A +!!!

reviews.author: kristi g
reviews.title: Royal Service, Paradisus Palma Real Resort, Punta Cana
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from an incredible week at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort with Royal Service! The resort was absolutely beautiful and the service was impeccable!! We had the privilege of having Miguel as our Butler and he ensured we had lavender scented pillows and a rose bath drawn on our 2nd night there. In addition to Miguel, we absolutely adored Martin Tineo!! Martin secured our "spot" on the beach every day and tended to our every need while we were on the beach! He always had a smile on his face and we looked forward to seeing him each and every day! I truly can't say enough about Martin, Miguel and our experience at the resort!!

reviews.author: 722jill76
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: We spent a week enjoying the perks of Royal service! Our butler, Luis Martinez was beyond exceptional! He went above and beyond and was extremely accommodating. The sunset bar offered fun and helpful waitstaff. Leonardo was a great bartender and Martin delivered our drinks to the beach. He always had our beach bed saved and pulled out in the sun waiting for us. Access to the private palazzo restaurant was my favorite of all the restaurants. We ate most of our meals there and began requesting Alexander Guzman. He 'gets it' when it comes to service with a smile. He loves what he does and shows huge potential! Good luck as you move your way up to butler. Luis will teach you well!  These guys made the trip wonderful!

reviews.author: Remolloy
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: We just returned from a corporate trip to this beautiful resort.  Our room was large and spotless. The resort grounds are well tended.  Our butler, Sandy Gil, was extremely helpful and friendly.  He did a great job for us all week.  Angel Frias at the pool and beach was great.  Leonardo Motor, the pool bartender, did a great job.  Jersey Campo is a great guy, very helpful.  Gregory at the Blue Agave Restaurant is a show by himself.  Really, all of the staff are extremely helpful and friendly. Great trip.

reviews.author: Dan H
reviews.title: Bristol Myers sales achiever trip
reviews.text:
Totally Awesome
Cannot give this resort higher reviews.  I resort was superb.  Our private butler Jose Salvador, was outstanding.  He spoke very good English and was attentive to our every need.    He took care of any concern we had and prepared our hot tub every afternoon for my guest and I.   When I go back, I am going to special request Jose as our butler.    Our beach bartender, Martin Tineo, was also outstanding.  He never left us with an empty drink and was very polite.  When you visit, these are two guys you should look for.   Very satisfied 
Dan from Minneapolis

reviews.author: white1960
reviews.title: This is what Vacations are for
reviews.text: I just got back from this resort and I must say I was impressed. It's hard to say what stood out the most but I guess the number one thing would be the staff. They bent over backwards to take care of all your request. We had the Royal Plan which includes your own personal butler. Now if your a needy person, one that doesn't want to have to get up early in the morning and save a primo spot at the beach or pool, if you want someone to iron your travel wrinkled clothing, if you want a bottle of primo scotch, or make reservations for you at a restaurant. OR if you are in the mood let him know you would like to surprise your wife with a special romantic jacuzzi  experience than you need to do the Royal experience.

reviews.author: Tia Noelle S
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: Had the most wonderful time at the Paradisus. We stayed in the Royal Service area and highly recommend it.  The attention to detail and special customer service was worth it. Johnfi Rivera, our butler, is absolutely superb.  Handled everything we needed, and went out of his way to make us feel special.  Also, Alexander at the Palazzo Restaurant always had a smile and and made sure our dining experience was fantastic.  If you go, request these gentleman!

reviews.author: Christina L
reviews.title: Cool place but wifi is horrible
reviews.text: This place was very nice, clean, the food was good, service good. The only thing we had problems with was the wifi. We had our family trying to contact us with an emergency and we tried using the wifi calling and it was not available most of the time. Other resorts we have stayed at had free in-room calling to the US which made it nice. Another thing- it is very hot and humid in Punta Cana and this resort had no way to circulate the air- no fans. When the wind wasn't blowing it was almost unbearable. The one and only swim-up bar had very slow service with only 1 bartender. Besides those things, it was great.

reviews.author: Tiffany P
reviews.title: Amazing destination
reviews.text:
I went to the resort on a business trip, travelling with 200 other people. We stayed for 5 days. My overall impression of Paradisus was great, 

though there were still plenty of reminders that I was in a third world country.

The grounds were very well maintained. My room was very clean and comfortable. It did not catch on fire, like the rooms of three other guests in 

our group; I considered this a plus. I ran a jacuzzi bath every night before bed. My butler would bring in scented bath oils for me, and even 

offered to have my bath ready for me at the end of the day. The water pressure was great. The wifi, not so much.  The whole time I was there, I maybe got an hour of good signal. The shower should have came with a manual, but after a couple of misadventures I got the hang of it.  

The food in the actual restaurants was great. I tried to avoid the buffet-style food for lunch and dinner, as it was hit or miss. The "American" 

food items in the buffets were off in flavor just enough to be off-putting. If I stuck to more "exotic" foods in the buffet, it was decent but 

not amazing. Dishes relied pretty heavily on local goat cheese, which I was extremely tired of after two days.

Making reservations in the actual restaurants was definitely the way to go. All of the food I had in the restaurants was amazing, though due to a 

fire the week before, I think about 4 restaurants were closed. They served a lot of buffet food to make up for the closings in banquet rooms that 

otherwise are probably closed. I went to Vento and Bana most of the time. 

Passion by Martin Berasategui was definitely a wonderful culinary experience, and worth the extra money. Do not miss this dining experience if 

you are into fine dining. This was the only restaurant on the grounds that had any local flavor, using lots of root vegetables and fresh seafoods. The desserts and wine were to die for.

At night, I enjoyed hanging out at the Red Lounge Bar. After two days, I was tired of the regional beer, Presidente. I got tired of the language barrier, and would just tell the bartender to "make me something".

I had the best massage of my life at the spa, splurging on the most expensive package. Definitely worth it.

I will be back on my own time, without the company next time.

reviews.author: 518davideg
reviews.title: MSL Sales Conference
reviews.text: Awesome time, and gorgeous resort. Great service and the restaurants were excellent. Appreciated the cleanliness and the attention to detail throughout the resort. The people were great, and made us feel that they were there for us. I can assure we will be back!!!!!

reviews.author: troyk17
reviews.title: VERY nice facility!
reviews.text: One of the nicest places we've been to! Very Clean.  Good Staff.  Great food! Nice beach.  What more can you ask for? :)  Weather was great while we were there.  Just don't make your plans around the "Rainy" season.   I would definitely make a return trip in the future!

reviews.author: Rachel O
reviews.title: Great place for a vacation!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a President's Club held at the Paradisus Palma Real resort.  

Pros: 
- Resort is well maintained with very friendly staff.
- Felt very safe at all times.  Safe in room is big enough to fit a laptop within as well as many other items.
- Pools are big and the beach is really nice
- Miguel Abreu is a fantastic person/butler and took great care of us!
- Leanardo Mota was a great pool side bartender, very friendly and made some great cocktails :)
- Lots to do in the evening with many restaurants (make sure you make reservations a day ahead)
- If going for a romantic trip, highly recommend upgrading to get the Royal Service
- I didn't expect maximum speed, but wifi is throughout and even reached the beach.  Don't expect 4g or 50mbps... but enough to Skype and check facebook.

Cons:
- Rare (steak restaurant) was very inconsistent with quality of meat and temperature of steak to order.  Get there early if you care how your steak is cooked.
- While i like a nice clean room, between the cleaning and mini bar stocking, the team knocked on the door at least 4-5 times a day.
- Swim up pool bar was not staffed appropriately so always took a long time to get a drink
- Resort coupons are only worth it if you talk to the right person!  Depending on which staff member you spoke to depended on the rules of the coupon.  Very inconsistent in messaging between all levels of staff.

reviews.author: Neal T
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We recently spent 5 nights at the Paradisus Palma Real for a business reward trip. It is a beautiful resort. The views are some of the best in the Carribean. The rooms are first class, very comfortable and the service was very good. There is so much to do at the resort, with a casino, and shows that we never left the grounds. The food was excellent and the service great. The only concern, & it is a small one, is that it was a little understaffed around the Royal Service pool for getting drinks. However, the service was great everywhere else. We especially loved Omar, our Butler. He took great care of us and the Resort should be proud to have such a wonderful staff member. He made every day a joy and relaxing.

reviews.author: ATLTarheels
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: This all inclusive resort literally had it all: awesome customer service, great facilities & excellent food.  The staff was friendly and accommodating, especially Evelyn, our group's liaison, and Arcenidas, our waiter at Ventos.  Fantastic dinner at Passion, one of the best I've had in years.  Even our surfing excursion to Macao Surf Camp was top notch.  Would definitely go back and highly recommend the resort and surf school.

reviews.author: Pope00
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel - Staff needs work
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a 4 night getaway as part of a promotional trip that my wife earned through her business. The hotel itself is very nice. Our suite was well appointed, and the grounds were very well kept. All of the facilities were very nice. It is important to note that we were not in the Reserve, nor were we Royal Service. 

The food was good. Not fabulous, but very good. Nice selection at buffets at breakfast and lunch. We ate at three of the restaurants, Steakhouse, Hibachi and Spanish. All three were good.

Bar selection was not very good. Only local brands of booze were served for the most part. 

Our only complaint about the trip was the service was not good. At every turn, they seemed to be understaffed. The staff itself would regularly forget our orders in restaurants. The pool bar seemed to be totally overwhelmed with orders at all times. To be clear, no one was rude. But no one ever really went out of their way to help us. This was not our experience at a few other properties we stayed at. Maybe it would have been better if we had Royal Service. 

We wouldn't rush back. While it didn't dampen the good time we had with work associates, there are better options.

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.title: Amazing, beautiful, some staffing downfalls
reviews.text:
Wow!  Absolutely gorgeous, well-maintained facilities.  Towel system is fantastic.  Great snorkeling in front of the hotel, and loved that the snorkeling equipment and about 4 or 5 other water activities were included.  Wi-fi on the whole resort, a bit slow, but it always worked.

Food was amazing!  The variety of the huge buffet was fantastic as well.  We actually thought about skipping our dinner reservations a few nights to enjoy the buffet.

If you visit this resort, I encourage you to be serviced by a few people that stood out to us with excellent customer service:  Marcos Benjamin and Ramon and Franklin at Fuego.  They were super attentive and very fun.  We received fantastic room service from Jesus Villaman.  He went out of his way to see if we needed anything else.  Manuel Javier was great at Bana for our hibachi dinner.  All of our dinners we were well taken care of.

If you choose to eat in the buffet, you may want to grab your own drinks at the bar.  We would order and most often not receive them, some meals we were lucky to have water.  And, expect slow service at the bars.  Staff are very friendly and knowledgeable, but they are understaffed, and also don't have too much of a sense of urgency.  It was not uncommon to wait 10-15 minutes for a drink, including a bottle of water.  BUT, they did a fantastic job of remembering the order of who was next.  It was much appreciated with wait times being so long.

If you like to hit the spa, this is the place to do it!  Gorgeous water facilities and we got the best couples massage.  Rosanna and Alexandra were phenomenal!  And Andres was very knowledgeable about the water facilities and explaining how and why to use them.  Very wonderful staff in the spa. 

Overall, amazing experience!  I would absolutely go to this resort again, and simply expect the slower service.

reviews.author: Jennifer E
reviews.title: Royal Service Experience.
reviews.text: When you stay at the Paradisus, spend the extra money to upgrade to Royal Service (RS).  Well worth the price. Exceptional food, premium liquors and top notch service.  The staff is fabulous and very friendly. They want to make your stay extra special. Royal service offers a private area on the beach, in addition to private pool areas. Also included is a private restaurant dedicated to RS. Another upgrade I would recommend for a very small extra price is having a butler. The butler will assist you with all reservations and special requests. Our butler was Gabriel Dalusma. He was fabulous and took care of our every request. At the RS beach, Francisco Cabrera brought us drinks, including his special drink. Ask for these two gentlemen when you are here.

reviews.author: Claribel T
reviews.title: Acogedor, hermoso, eficiente.
reviews.text: Su diseño en general es hermoso, su personal eficiente, sus instalaciones en sentido general, sus playas, las opciones para bodas en referidas área, las opciones de restaurantes cuenta con un Excelente servicio del personal que nos atendió,  su menú variado y exclusivo.

reviews.author: Travel_purposely
reviews.title: Great stay in a little slice of Paradise
reviews.text: Received Royal treatment at the resort. Restaurants were top notch, Spa was heavenly, beach pristine, and our butler, Gabriel Dalusma, did an unbelievable job catering to our every need and want, even personally going to pick our tickets in town. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Patrick . H
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The staff is very friendly and we enjoyed the beach. It is very peaceful, quiet and relaxing. The food was delicious, the rooms are beautiful, the beds comfortable. Wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.title: Wonderful Time !!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time in the Royal Service part of this resort. The food was great and the drinks tasted wonderul. Our butler Luis Hernadez was great. Omar in the business center was so polite and shared some of his coffee with us ( which was delicious !). This was a great vacation and we cannot wait for the next time !

reviews.author: Wolfhabel80
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This place was amazing. The staff was great and we had a great time. The royal service really helps you take advantage of everything. The Palazzo in the royal service area is one of the best meals we had on our trip.

reviews.author: ECUPirate
reviews.title: Great stay...
reviews.text:
My wife and I were down in Apr. 2015 with my company.  So all of our arrangements were pre-arranged for us.   The check-in was super easy.  We had the Royal Service package, which came with a butler.   Sandy gave us a quick tour of the grounds and escorted us to our room.  I honestly believe within about 30 minutes of our arrival we had our toes in the sand.

The rooms/ grounds were clean and the staff was super friendly.  We spent most of our time relaxing on the white sand beach enjoying the crystal blue water.   The cabana/ beach waiters, Franscisco, Marty and Lenonardo, were fabulous.  They really hustle and took great care of my wife and I.

Again, being a company event a few of our meals were pre-arranged so we didn't make it to all of the restaurants.  But I can say that I was not disappointed with any of our meals.   

Our overall experience was great...

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: FAntastic Experience
reviews.text:
This was my first all inclusive and was a wonderful experience. The staff was processional and friendly, from the grounds crew to the butler service. Food was better than I expected for an all inclusive. Nothing I ate was amazing, but everything was of great quality and I did not worry about getting sick at all. 
I would highly suggest the royal service; having the private beach away from the crowds and kids really made the trip for my fiancé and I. It is worth the money for the butler and private areas. 

Wonderful stay, and If I ever return to the Dominican Republic I would not go to another hotel.

reviews.author: lincoln m
reviews.title: perfect
reviews.text: This hotel is very nice , all very well kept, the food delicious, the service very good , I liked the pool and restaurants especially the buffet .. also I loved the room service , very friendly FERNANDO GERONIMO...

reviews.author: keri2579
reviews.title: Amazing Convention!
reviews.text: The Paradisus is the perfect name for this resort!  It was absolute paradise!  Just walking into the resort takes your breath away.  The nightlife was fun, the food was amazing and the staff were outstanding.  Big-Mac, Mini-Me & Rey-Rey were always engaging and fun!  They made our experience a memorable one!  We are sure to visit again in the future!!

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: AWESEOME RESORT TO STAY AT WHEN IN PUNTA CANA
reviews.text: By far the best & classiest resort we have ever stayed out. The food was great, the grounds were immaculate, the entire staff were courteous & attentive! BIG thanks to Oscar Palanco & Rudelania Rincon

reviews.author: Terry C
reviews.title: GREAT PEOPLE
reviews.text: beautiful water ,excellent resort and plenty of activities to keep every one busy. you have to take a bus to go zip lining in the mountains it's a blast. and take a cultural tour through the country side.  you will love seeing how the people live.great food and plenty of rum for all.

reviews.author: Irene L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - loved our butler
reviews.text: As soon as I walked into the hotel, it took my breath away.  The view was truly spectacular.  The grounds, hotel and pool were immaculate.  We had the Royal Service and our butler, Faustino, was amazing.  He made us feel very important and took fantastic care of us.  Not sure how he did it but he found us several times a day, no matter where we were, and checked on us.  With a resort of this caliber, I feel the only slight negative was the food, and the bathroom set up lacked some privacy.  Steak house could use more and better options.  I was there for 7 days and would come back in a second.  If you are thinking about going here, do it you will not be sorry

reviews.author: Carol M
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
The Royal Treatment is an understatement.  Our butler Luis Sanchez made our stay amazing!  It is just a beautiful resort and the most relaxing vacation we have ever had.  We were with a large company group and they handled the movement and activities for all of us easily.  The restaurants are all very good, so even if you don't have or miss a reservation it's okay!
Thank you Luis!

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text: My friend and I were at the beach everyday. Our bartender Onardo Marino made our trip that much more enjoyable. He was very personable, spoke English and always wanted to make sure that we were taken care of and happy. He had great drink suggestions and wanted us to get the whole island feel, it was wonderful. Even though all of the people that work here were very friendly and helpful, Onardo was definitely our favorite, I highly suggest looking for him on your trip!

reviews.author: Rachel S
reviews.title: People
reviews.text: Onardo Marino was the best bartender we had on the trip. He was friendly and even served us at the beach. He spoke very good English, too. His service was accurate, fast, and he came just when we needed a new one. Onardo was very easy to get along with.

reviews.author: JSeaton
reviews.title: Great all inclusive Hotel.
reviews.text: The entire resort was very clean, everything was wonderful. Beautiful landscaping everywhere!Attention was paid to the details. The Royal service was excellent. The staff went out of their way the entire trip. Excellent food and drinks were always available and were regularly brought with out asking. I was very impressed by the entire staff. Everyone was very welcoming and genuinely wanted to help. I will go back!

reviews.author: Jordan S
reviews.title: Amazing Staff, amazing service, delicious food!
reviews.text: From the start i knew this would be a great trip. I was there with a large group staying in the main Paradisus resort, but since I'm in a power chair and the best rooms for me to access were in the Reserve we were placed there. From Ambiorix the bellboy and Santiago who is also a bellboy who drove me around on their wheelchair golf cart the whole week, to Eddy Wilson in the Reserve lobby who always looked out for me the staff was excellent and went above and beyond each day. Elvis Lopez our concierge was great at taking care of all our dinner reservations and reserving pool cabanas, and Jennifer in the Gabi Club waited on me hand and foot.

reviews.author: Leanimal_14
reviews.title: The Learning Experience
reviews.text: Very great service and customer service. The experience was unforgettable and I cannot wait to go back. Jazz, Big Mac, Rey Rey, Mini Me were all amazing. The sun, beach and food was very good. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Julius A
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel and Service
reviews.text:
This was our second time to the resort in two years and we noticed many upgrades. First of all the airport in Punta Cana was easier to get through customs and also for departure. I would have to say if we had the same experience we had at this airport, would have reduced the overall rating as it added some stress to our trip.

This time around we had the royal service which included a butler and access to a Private Pool area, restaurant and wasn't as crowded as the other section. You can reserve a bali bed and a cabana where you can read, sleep under shade which was very relaxing by the pool.  With the top shelf bar available until 9 PM in the VIP lounge and bar in the room, didn't have to worry about alcoholic beverage access.  

I recommend this hotel and especially the service our butler, Alvaro Fernandez, provided who was attentive to our needs. I know it is pricey and was fortunate enough to enjoy this experience as a company Incentive Trip, but it made a major difference in my overall experience of this resort with the royal service package.  It was considered the best Incentive Trip our company has held!

reviews.author: Jeffrey J
reviews.title: DR for families
reviews.text: Good bang for the buck. Concierge service was excellent. Very good food options. Great place for a family with children. There were children's activities all day and excellent staff to watch them. Kids could opt in or out.

reviews.author: Perry L
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: The Royal Service is awesome when you want an experience where you don't have to be concerned with anything. They are attentive to all your needs and have knowledge of the entire property. Great Experience.

reviews.author: Shirley B
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text:
Stayed in the Royal service area of the hotel, had a personal butler named Gabriel, he 
was Awesome, came back ffrom the beach and he had a hot bubble bath drawn, the tub surrounded with lit candles. We really felt special.

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, everyone was very friendly,always smiling and most helpful. Our private butler Jeuri Ferreira was the greatest. He was there for us whenever we needed him and he was always very pleasant and you can tell he loves what he does. It shows in the way he treats you.
A must try.

reviews.author: Yanaemaxim
reviews.title: Un giardino botanico
reviews.text: Struttura alberghiera eccellente , le piscine bellissime, Vegetazione eccellente,settimana  piena di eventi di animazione ,colazioni da sogno ,7 ristoranti a tema .Organizzazione perfetta. Per il Guest Sevice  affidatevi a Marlenis Vi aiuterà' per qualsiasi problema.  Segnaliamo per il tennis , Domingo , un istruttore disponibile è sempre  sorridente.      Per quanto riguarda l'animazione il cuore pulsante e senza alcun dubbio sono Oscar e Laissa veri insegnanti di balli latini , veri coreografi di spettacoli , degni  rappresentanti di un paese pieno di passione..  Grazie a tutti Voi

reviews.author: Mary H
reviews.title: Culture
reviews.text: This place was great! Staff was so helpful! Very Clean. The only thing We were disappointed in was there was no Dominican food on the entire resort.  The service was outstanding, will be going back next year!

reviews.author: Linda F
reviews.title: Nice but would upgrade on a return
reviews.text: We attended an all expense pain business retreat here - just the basic all inclusive package. The scenery and beaches were beautiful - but the food got boring unless you spent extra in one of the restaurants. The room was spacious enough but the bed and pillow were very uncomfortable and worn out - once again - no upgrading to feather allowed unless you had the 'royal' package - even at our own expense. Would possibly o back but definitely would upgrade ahead of time

reviews.author: Danilo C
reviews.title: Paradiso di nome e di fatto
reviews.text: Trascorsi  7 gg in pieno relax una struttura fantastica per spazi e servizi ... Personale da 10 e lode sempre col sorriso sulle labbra e disponibili per qualsiasi esigenza nonostante la struttura fosse piena  quindi con uno  stress lavorativo pari ad una settimana ferragostiana italiana. La spiaggia spaziosa pulitissima e fornita  di ogni confort .. mare dai colori caraibici come giusto che sia. I ristoranti compresi nella formula all inclusive spettacolari su tutti the grill e fuego. A voler trovare il pelo linea wirless lasciava a desiderare e troppe zanzare in camera. Per il resto  impeccabile.

reviews.author: Angela D
reviews.title: great property
reviews.text: Overall a great experience! Felt very comfortable and well taken care of.  The food was excellent... The variety was impressive.  Towels were sometimes hard to find after early morning. Thank you for your service!

reviews.author: Tracy W
reviews.title: Thank you Alexander Guzman from the Palazzo restaurant Exceptional Service!
reviews.text:
On a recent stay at Paradisus Resort in the Dominican with my wife, I wanted to take a moment to personally thank a server by the name of Alexander Guzman from the Palazzo restaurant. 

Alexander went out of his way to provide exceptional  service and  a memorable experience. He was very accommodating,  going out of his way whenever he saw us and I wanted to pay a special thanks as a result.  Alexander Guzman is great ambassador of the  resort!

Thank you.

Jason Segato

reviews.author: Edward K
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had a great time and an amazing atmosphere. Jurie was an amazing butler and guide to all things Dominican Republic. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a vacation or remote business location.

reviews.author: jerseylou1
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: Very good resort went with a large group of people, all the restaurant at the resort were good and every night there was some thing to do with different bands every night. They had thing to do durning the day with both ocean and pool  if you want to get wet. I would go back again.

reviews.author: jerseylou1
reviews.title: Good Time
reviews.text: Went there  with a large group of HVAC contractor's had excellent time  several restaurants on property to chose from , even the buffet food was very good , night lift had different groups at the bars, with dancing  if you wanted to. I would go back again.

reviews.author: Augie G
reviews.title: Amazing resort, views, food and incredible STAFF!!!!!
reviews.text: This is our second trip, this resort is beyond amazing- Everyone is so sincere and friendly. The property is absolutely beautiful. Never a dull moment- relax or enjoy all the activities. If you book request Johnfi Rivera as you butler- HE IS WONDERFUL!!!!!!!! So sweet and always helpful... made our visit better than the first one! Next time we visit will request the Royal Service and JOHNFI!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Viktoria S
reviews.title: Exselente
reviews.text: mi Estadia fue increible Los restaurante todos muy Bueno,Los Chico  de LA playa son incredible El servicio estuvo maravilloso LA atencion fue exselente Ramon Ramirez,wander Roa,Luis Santana,Oneida zorrilla y Santos frias son super  atentos

reviews.author: Ally R
reviews.title: Todo exselente
reviews.text: Todo exselente el hotel muy Bueno todos Los Chico son muy Gentiles en la playa son muy  amable el servicio exselente Ramon Ramirez Santos Fria Wander Roa Oneida zorilla Luis Santana son fabuloso es el mejor

reviews.author: Kim C
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We returned last night from a 5 night stay at this resort.  The grounds were very beautiful and the staff all speak very good english.  Our butler was attentive to our needs, however, only upon request. Others in our large group would talk about how their butlers went above and beyond to please them, unfortunately, we did not get one of those. 
We were to have royal service during our stay there, however, I do not believe that the royal service people got much that was over and above the other guests other than a private pool and beach area.  We stayed in the general pool area most of the time because we could not get anyone to bring us drinks in the royal service areas.  That is something that needs to be improved!  As mentioned above, we got better service in the general areas.  
On our second last day there, the entire resort ran out of beach/pool towels for almost an entire day.  
My husband did not care too much for the food at any of the restaurants we ate at, although, I did enjoy the food that I had.  
Overall as I said before, the grounds are immaculate, and the people are friendly.  Our vacation was relaxing, which was what we wanted.  Just the few things mentioned above could use some improvements.

reviews.author: Evan A
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Great food, Great people
reviews.text: I stayed here for 6 nights and it was amazing the quality of this hotel from the food which every restaurant we ate at was top notch.  Drinks were very good always quick to refill them.  Towels at the pool every day for the beds.  Super safe walking around at night guards all around the hotel.  Water was very blue just a little seaweed all on the sand where the shore washes up but they even cleaned that daily.  Room was amazing.. Cleaned to perfection daily and Nightly bed turned down at night while we were at dinner.  We were given a cell phone to Contact our Butler Samuel Rodriguez who was top notch the best!! So attentive and made our trip the most amazing vacation ever!! Request him if you can also Louis was helping us out as well even though he wasn't our butler i can't say enough about both of them felt right at home in DR very nice people!

reviews.author: TheKu
reviews.title: Awful expierience.......
reviews.text: Beautiful property, food service has major issues. I too was part of a 400 person event at this hotel, not my first Dominican trip, actually this was my fourth time visiting punta cana. The previous review that was posted quoted numbers of 100 out of 400 becoming ill........ I think that number is low. Every other person you spoke with had experienced some degree of stomach issue, my first hand knowledge is that i traveled with a party of four, we were all sick, some longer than others, we stayed seven days, six nights, my daughter in law was down five out of the seven days, she and my son are still sick after returning home. This is not a big issue to a lot of people, but when you spend the kind of money this resort charges you do not expect to have to deal with this sort of thing. What good does a fantastic looking buffet or an amazing restaurant menu do for you when the only thing you trust is rice, bread, and bottled water, so as you can keep something down or controlling its exit, not fun.  Not fun when you have four school aged children at home, who you pack for, who you arrange for them to be watched by family, who then takes them to all activities, etc, while you are gone, so you can have some much deserved time away, time you plan for, time you look so much forward to, not to spend it in your room on or around a toilet..... You miss group activities because you never know how close the nearest bathroom would be. Yes it was plain awful. I have traveled all over the Caribbean, through out Mexico, South America, and as i said above punta cana three times previously, always you have a few people who get ill, but this is not an exaggeration of the number of travelers who were sick. I will not go into standing in four inches of water everytime i took a shower for it did not drain, will not go into after returning in the middle of the afternoon from a walk, chasing a two inch water roach around the bathroom until i caught it, will not talk about the mini bar service, absolutely no liquor at all, asked for it on monday, asked again on tuesday, never did show up. They give you two presidente beers everyday, keep in mind there are two people in the room..... they will bring you two more if you call for more, if you get up to a quantity of six in one day, and call again, ( because you have nothing else to do, your wife has been laying in bed all day sick)  they tell you that you have had enough for one day and can not bring you anymore. All inclusive?, i think not unless, you are talking about the stomach issues you will have. I do not mean to trash this place, the company that we traveled with, we have traveled with for years, the tour group that they use are very professional, and very much on top of their game, they are both good companies and do their homework. Was no way they could have seen this coming. The property was magnificent, the staff was very friendly, maid service was awesome, but they need to address just what exactly is making all of these people sick, at this point in time i would never stay here again, or recommend it to anyone. The only reason i did not give this a zero rating was because the property, the rooms, the beach were all very beautiful, but you can not stay here seven days and not eat or drink.

reviews.author: Barb M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Wonderful People, Take Stomach Medicine
reviews.text:
We traveled to the Paradisus Palma Real Resort February 13th. 2015.
The resort is absolutely beautiful. Grounds are manicured to perfection. Our room was very nice and the bed was comfortable. Minibar had beer, soda and juice. No vodka etc. Every staff member we came into contact with was excellent and willing to do whatever they could to make our stay enjoyable.
Victor Benitz delivered our breakfast every morning and took our order for the next day. Always very prompt and friendly. 
Food at the buffets was just ok. There were lots of choices but not too much flavor. 
I guess that is a good thing since we got very sick during our stay with diarrhea. We were in a group of 94 people and almost everyone had a similar experience to ours. We tried to find a common "cause" but everyone went on different day trips, some drank liquor some didn't. We knew to not drink the water so we brushed teeth with bottled water and took precautions like that. We noticed a lot of people complaining about sickness at this resort since last November on trip advisor. My guess is that there is a bad water filter on an ice machine or someone mis-handling food.  I might give them another try in the future, but would probably take a long look at the reviews to see if the sicknes issue is resolved.

reviews.author: 421ohio
reviews.title: Beautiful place but food poisoning ruined the vacation
reviews.text: When we arrived at the hotel we were amazed at the beauty of the place. The staff was so friendly, but all of that quickly changed when one by one we watched our friends go down with food poisoning. By the end of our 5 day stay over 100 of our group of 400 were down with food poisoning and 1 remains in the Dominican hospital .  We've visited many islands and always dreaded returning home , but on this trip we couldn't get home soon enough.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Business Center Exclusive personalized service
reviews.text: Its a great hotel to go to, everyone is extremely friendly, the food is very delicious and the view of the beach and rooms are beautiful, A special thanks to OMAR BM1 for his friendly help and service during my stay. Business Man number 1...Omar Hernadez

reviews.author: Juan Pablo S
reviews.title: Excelente hotel y excelente servicios
reviews.text: Me siento muy bien por el trato que recibí por el personal del hotel Paradissus punta cana. Especial la joven de bares a yohanna Páez y Alejandro Suárez.. Y la comida es muy buena, el personal de limpieza es muy simpáticos.. En definitiva excelente hotel..

reviews.author: TravelCoord17
reviews.title: Amazing service and beautiful property for a group event!
reviews.text:
We recently spent 6 days at the Paradisus Palma Real.  This was a sales incentive trip for our company so we worked closely with the group sales department.  I was the travel coordinator for the trip; there was 46 of us total.  We chose the resort solely off of internet and trip advisor research.  It did not disappoint!  Because this was a group trip I had extensive contact with the resort in the months leading up to the trip.  I can not say enough great things about Elizabeth Reynoso.  She was my main point of contact while planning this vacation as well as the events that we would host during our time at the property. Elizabeth was always available to answer my numerous questions via email or phone call.  This was my first trip to plan and she was very patient with me and taught me several things about the group planning process.  Leading up to the trip Elizabeth made great recommendations in regards to the events we would host.  From menu planning, to decor recommendations, entertainment options, and lighting...there wasn't a single thing that Elizabeth didn't suggest or help me plan.  She was very proactive in making suggestions that were best for our group and our budget.  Elizabeth was very friendly, accommodating, thorough, organized, precise, kind, and she was always one step ahead of me in terms of helping me plan.  She made my job a lot easier and smoother!  She went out of her way to fulfill all of our last minute requests.  I can't say enough great things about her!
During our group check in process we got to work with and meet Ana Almonte and Natalia (intern from group sales I believe).  My husband and I as well as our President of the company and his wife stayed at the group check in area all afternoon to greet our guests as they arrived.  This allowed us to spend extended time with Ana and Natalia as well as Elizabeth who was coming back and forth from checking on the status of our DMC (shuttle).  Ana was such a joy to work with!  She is so personable, full of joy, and fun.  Her customer service is top notch!  Later in the trip I needed something done in our room and I spoke with Ana at the front desk and her quote to me was "consider it done!"  This is exactly how she approaches her work.  She wants to fulfill every request plus more for the guests at the hotel.  I saw this several times with her.  Her attention to the guest's needs and her interaction with the guests was superior!  Natalia was great as well!  Anytime I saw her during our stay she always asked how our stay was going and checked in to see if there was anything we needed or how she could serve us!  Natalia is very kind and again a great attention to customer service.  
Food - this was my first time to visit an all inclusive resort and I was pleasantly surprised at the food options.  We enjoyed all of our meals.  My favorites were the beef tenderloin at Vento, rice pudding dessert at Fuego, the ribeye at Rare, the shrimp entree at the Hibachi restaurant and the creme brûlée at the Hibachi restaurant.  There were plenty of restaurant and food options and everything tasted great!     We enjoyed breakfast and coffee every morning at Naos.  One of our favorite waiters was Francis Baez.  He served us every morning at Naos, we made it a point to sit in his section each morning, and then he also was our server at Rare.  He was always on top of it!  Our coffee cup was always full.  He was always so pleasant to talk with and he made our dining experiences very enjoyable!  He is very kind and a very hard worker!  Daniel at Fuego was also a great server!
Events - We hosted two events during our stay.  We had a private breakfast in the Olympus Theatre and a private farewell dinner that was supposed to be at Gabi beach but because of weather we changed it to the Apolo ballrooms. (prior to this event we hadn't walked down to the ballroom area.  Even if you don't have an event in the ballrooms at least walk to this part of the resort.  It is beautiful down there with lush greenery and a water feature.) The food for each of these events was amazing!  Everything was set out nicely and looked very elegant.  And the taste of the food was great!  The shrimp and avocado salad as well as the chicken and apple salad that I picked for the farewell dinner was delicious!  I went back several times for more!  The lighting team and the decor team did a fantastic job!  Both rooms looked great for each of our events!  Again, Elizabeth helped me choose just the right decor that fit our budget!  The AV team was great as well!  
Entertainment - The resort offered many different activities to keep us trying new things while we were on our vacation.  The entertainment team was great!  Reynoldo, Angel, and Rony, Jazz, and  Pamela were so friendly, outgoing, full of energy, lots of smiles, and provided lots of fun and laughs during our trip.  The trip would not have been the same without them!  

Overall this was a great vacation and I would recommend this property!  The resort was beautiful and the sand on the beach was so soft!  The thing that sticks out most with me on about this resort is the customer service!  It is top notch!

reviews.author: Janelle J
reviews.title: Best trip I've ever taken
reviews.text: This place is beyond amazing. It's clean, large enough you don't have to fight for chairs, reservations or a spot at the bar. The people are friendly and actually want to help you when you ask. The food is beyond what we expected. High end alcohol labels and quick service. Never ran into any issues. If we could rat this place a 6 star then we would do it in a heart beat.

reviews.author: starkap
reviews.title: relaxing trip
reviews.text:
my husband was offered this free trip for appreciation of doing business with group we were with. Arriving at resort was a short bus ride and breeze check in. We were in one bedroom with kitchen and Jacuzzi room 2219, was amazing and had no need to upgrade to royal service and did not feel we missed a thing by using royal service. First night our group had a reserved spot on beach for dinner and was awesome with great service. second day was leisure and hung out by pool and beach. The beach is beautiful and plenty of chairs to find. The pool on other hand is hard to catch a lounge chair unless you get there early in morning. The main buffet always had good food and plentiful, but was a little repetitive after a few days of same thing. The third day we left early for excursion on dune buggies. We had a blast and was covered in mud by end of the excursion. That night we ate at fuego seafood restaurant. We had lobster and scallops. The portions were small but very good. on the fourth night we went out on ocean adventures with pirate ship for dinner and show. This was highlight of our trip and must do in punta cana. Rest of week we just relaxed and rejuvenate. The property is beautiful and lay out is perfect for walking. On one afternoon we took part in cocktail demonstration. Big thanks to yass, rey rey, reyna, ronny, angel, pamela, bigmac, and nelson for fun in making cocktails. 

Cons: There is not much to fault (especially for free trip), but one thing to note is casino. The third night we took money out of resorts mac machine, which only gives you Dominican money. If you want to change it out to usa dollars you need passport and I.D. The casino will not give you chips in there own money. They will only accept usa dollars. This maybe a big hassle for anyone that exchanges money prior to arrival.

reviews.author: Ashleigh O
reviews.title: Trip of a lifetime
reviews.text: We felt like royalty on this trip. The food, drinks, atmosphere, people, beach, accommodations were perfect. The poolside was our favorite place to relax. It was very clean, the nature was well-maintained and the team that worked there was very kind and fun!

reviews.author: Kenneth S
reviews.title: A very beautiful property
reviews.text: Top score for architecture, beauty, scenery, cleanliness, maintenance. Low score for gift shop prices, slow service, the one Banking machine on the property, unfriendly staff at casino, poor service at Nexus Tours. The food was really good, and they have a nice chunk of ocean front property(which is hurt somewhat by the dozens of boats, helicopters, and things I've never even seen before, flying by constantly).

reviews.author: MiloATL
reviews.title: INCREDIBLE Experience
reviews.text:
This was our first experience with an all-inclusive and it did not disappoint!  We will be going back to Paradisus!

We were here for a Board meeting and extended our stay for a small vacation.  The amenities were first rate.  I highly suggest staying in the Royal Service section, where you have a personal Butler to attend to your every need!  We stayed for 8 days/7 nights and on 3 occasion came back to our room with some sort of romatic setup- a drawn bubble bath, champagne on ice, rose pedals on the bed, etc.  Made for a great trip.  Tomas was our Butler and he pampered us like we've never experienced- making sure we did not have a want for anything and making sure everything was taken care of- including checkout- all the way to the curb to catch our ride to the airport.  A very polite gentleman.

The food was excellent, which we did not expect from an all-inclusive.  But WARNING- make sure if you order fish, it is cooked thoroughly.  We did have 4 people in our group get sick from undercooked seafood- not pretty!  And pay the upgrade for the premium liquor package- its worth it.  The best meal we had by far was at Fuego- the lobster tails are fantastic and the Duck Risotto was great!  

The service is outstanding all over the property, but especially on the beach in the Royal Service section.  Ask for Angel- by far the best beach attendant we've ever had on any trip.  We had about 14 spouses on this trip, and boy did he spoil them!  Every day their chairs were set up, he remembered who wanted sun and who wanted shade- and the drinks he just kept them coming!  

About the only negative I can think of is not every hotel employee speaks english, so we had a few times we ordered something, thinking the person understood, and we'd never see them again, but usually someone else came along who could handle the request.  

All in all a fantastic trip.  Delightful people, great location, great amenities, great service.  I hope we return soon.

reviews.author: Doug C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: What a great experience.  The Royal Service is the way to go.  Our Butler Samuel did everything to make us feel pampered and welcome.  All of the staff is friendly and very helpful.   Room was great although we lost power a couple times in the middle of the night and it affected the AC and our sleep.

reviews.author: Krystal A
reviews.title: Great place for the most part
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, friendly staff (though communication sometimes was hard as some didn't speak real great English, but we are visiting there country so I look past this)!!
Rooms are nice, though not a lot of privacy in the bathroom, it is pretty much open to the rest of the room. 
One thing I will say is I could not for the life of me figure out how to turn the lights on in the room (none of them worked) after searching for 20 minutes there is a master switch that you have to turn on, i wish they would let people know this, as I was with a group of people and we all had the same issue.
Overall a great place to stay, great atmosphere, beaches were great, pool was beautiful!!

reviews.author: Kelly T
reviews.title: Seamless experience
reviews.text: This is an extraordinary all-inclusive. The attention to detail shows morning, noon and night, from groomed sand on the beach to the activity schedule to the individual cocktail menus at each bar. The range of food was vast and the quality superior. Staff were friendly, Best mango I've had in years.

reviews.author: JoelleWeidner
reviews.title: Absolutely awful!
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. Beautiful place, but we did not feel safe the entire time we were there. Customer service in the restaurants was pathetic too.  For a five star place and $700/night I expect WAY more than what I got! Things were stolen from our rooms, wait staff were rude and unaccomodating. We will never return!

reviews.author: Ema067
reviews.title: Brillante hotel
reviews.text:
Para mi el mejor hotel de punta cana.
Amplias habitaciones, servicio exquisito , comida excelente 
Espacios comunes muy amplios y ordenados 

Hotel muy recomendable para pasar unos días de vacaciones y disfrutar de entré otras cosas de sus restaurantes

reviews.author: Glenda J
reviews.title: Almost a Dream come true!!!
reviews.text:
We went with a group with Curry Seed. The rooms are clean and the view is amazing !Staff are friendly and lots of smiles.We enjoyed the restaurants Blue Agava,Fuego.
The Buffet is GREAT, some of the help you will ant to meet are Yudy a waitress, Davidson a waiter that makes a special coffee for you if you like coffee! Another great employee on the beach is Big Mac lots of energy for the stretching on the beach. Peterson in the Royal Services was a very special person to us on our visit.On our Rum tasting event Wander our waiter was very attentive! Omar in the business office was very helpful for getting our boarding passes to print out before we left .On our evening meal at the Buffet Rafiel , was very good at what he does to help serve wine!!! Over all our stay was very relaxing or as busy as you want it to be. WE LOVED OUR STAY!!!

reviews.author: Reviews19
reviews.title: Amazing service and very clean resort
reviews.text:
I went with my wife to Paradisus Pallma Real Royal service and we were served like king and queen by Argenis  he is a very kind and he know what it means a royal service he did a fantastic job I was in room 3031 beautiful room.  The hotel provide a cellphone just for us to contact our butler Argenis at any time from anywhere during our visit great idea. room service was amazing too, restaurants specially the buffet was really impressive so much better than our Canadian Mandarin fresh and delicious I have to mention that Abraham at the buffet is really really good he always manage to have my favourite juice "Maracuya" he was the only one that knows that amazing fruit and he made a glass of it in breakfast time for me and my wife. He is awesome too. Best trip ever to Punta Cana. Service everywhere is very friendly and professional. We really like this resort. The only negative thing is the ATM machines there are not good at all. Make sure you have enought cash some you don't have to use them.  Spa was amazing too.
Thank you,
Santiago

reviews.author: Karla M
reviews.title: Incredible from start to finish
reviews.text:
This was a trip won through work. I didn't know what to expect since it was my first time going away (though my partner said he would make the same review and he has been everywhere!!). It was the most incredible experience I could have imagined!! Every single staff member in and out of Royal Service was truly exception. They were constantly full of smiles, laughter and jokes. Always making sure we had a great time and we're enjoying ourselves. 

Two exceptional staff members ( and I say this because they were exceptional but also because we spent the most time with them and got to know them ) were our Butler Ariel Benzo, and the royal service bartender Leonardo Mota. Both of these gentlemen went above and beyond every single day of our stay and truly made sure that the trip was a memorable one from start to finish. Our Butler would make sure we had dinner reservations every night and a cabana  every day. The bartender always made for a wonderful time by the pool, laughing and dancing and singing (and always making sure our cups were full). Each and every memory that I am taking home with me is exquisite and I feel so spoiled by the staff at paradisus  that I fear another resort will only disappoint me now!!

I have looked up the price since coming home and it is absolutely worth it to stay in royal service. We met one gentleman who loves this resort so much he goes for 2 straight months of the year!!!! That's a true testament to the service and experience provided at this resort, I'd say!

I will be back FOR SURE. Hopefully once a year if I can! I want to make paradisus my second home because I loved it so much!!!

reviews.author: Alyson H
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text:
Just got back from staying at Paradisus. It was beautiful!!! Clean, manicured!  Had a garden room view.  The balcony was private and enjoyed early evenings having a drink on the balcony before heading out.  Luis was our in room wait-staff. He  was phenomenal.  Food was better than I expected, and had more options than I expected.  I read reviews that upgrading to royal service was worth it....I would imagine that would be very true for those without kids (I did not have kids with me... got sick of yelling and whining).  The beach did have seaweed wash up, but was groomed rather quickly.  Best part of beach was my service from Jorge Alriche (crazy nice!!!!) and Onardo Marino.  Two GREAT, PERSONABLE, and ATTENTIVE guys that were quick with service!!!!! 
If Luis the butler that was mentioned in an above review, was the same Luis that I had I second that statement! AMAZING service, and could not be any nicer of a person!  Loved him!  
Never did any spa treatments, heard it was average for the crazy prices!  I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.text: Tried another resort for a little less and it was a glorified motel.  This Paradisus was a cute above for just a little bit more money.  The resort was well laid out, rooms were away from the bars and night entertainment so, it was quiet at night.

reviews.author: Tina0215
reviews.title: Business and Pleasure
reviews.text: The Reserve is stunning!  The staff, the food, the beach all wonderful, I felt like a Queen.  The staff at building #39 was amazing.  Our fridge was always well stocked, we never ran out of soaps, shampoos, shavers, drinks.  You name it, we had it.  There was always a tram running throughout the day and night to ride on.  However, we enjoyed walking and soaking up the beauty that surrounds the gardens.  When on the beach, you can ask one of the gardeners (they are dressed in green), to get a coconut from the tree, just be careful not to drink too much.  I have to tell you that there was a certain bartender that made a wonderful impression on me, his name is Jorge and he is at the Avenue Bar in the main lobby.  He always remembered my name and the adult beverage that I liked.  His cousin works there as well, but for the life of me I cannot remember his name.  He was fantastic as well.  They both taught us a bit of their language, which was memorable to say the least.  I made it a point to see them one last time before we had to leave.  It felt like we were leaving a dear friend that we will never see again.  Thank you for making our stay one of the most memorable moments in our lives.  We hope to visit again.

reviews.author: abailey13
reviews.title: We love RayRay!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at this resort on a Seed trip with approximately 500 other farmers and seed salesmen.  The property that this resort resides on is absolutely massive, and all of the resort staff treated us wonderfully. We experienced short rain showers while we were in the Dominican, however the resort is set up to provide adequate coverage as you walk to and from events/restaurants.  My husband and I spent some time with one of the activity directors, Reynaldo Gonzles...better known as RayRay. The guy really knows how to do his job!!! He made everything fun and is fantastic with names, and made sure to talk to everyone.  He went out of his way to ensure that my husband and I had a good time. Rony was another great activity director.  He kept all the sand volleyball games fun and entertaining!  Speaking of sand...you won't find any place with better sand than the Dominican!!  While the beaches seemed to be experiencing a seaweed problem, hotel staff ensured that the beach was cleaned and raked every day!  Overall a very good stay at this resort!

reviews.author: Tara P
reviews.title: TCI and pleasure
reviews.text: Wonderful accommodations loved everything and the service was wonderful.  Especially happy with the friendly and courteous Yarol.  Can't say enough!!  The food is delicious the coco loco drinks plentiful,  and I was very pleased.  We had some rain and the staff even made the rainy days fun!!  Most days were sunny and lovely!!

reviews.author: joan n
reviews.title: Nice but slow
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed  there on a business trip. The resort is spacious and nice. They have golf carts to take you around the property so you don't have to walk very far. The service was a little lacking and so was the food.

reviews.author: labailey09
reviews.title: Nice place!
reviews.text:
We had a great trip. Rooms are nice, staff is very accommodating. Beautiful beaches, big pools, and a lot of restaurants. We had quite a bit of rain while we stayed, but the resort is set up to keep you dry mostly anywhere you are. The activity directors were great! ReyRey is the man! He will make you feel right at home...if you play beach volleyball, you want Rony as your ref! He's a lot of fun. We came with a group of 500 people...the staff did an outstanding job of taking care of us! Our group rated the food at 7/10. 
We recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: Tammy G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort beautiful beach superior service
reviews.text: We recently spent 7 days at this beautiful resort.Our experience was second to none.The pools, the beach, the dining,the spa were all exceeding our expectations,but the service was best of all.We would especially like to acknowledge the concierge and housekeeping staff at the reserve #40.Sophia,Elizabeth ,Sandra,Nikel,Estefania,Yarol,Maria .

reviews.author: Bsavelli
reviews.title: Owner
reviews.text: Jose Luis de los santos, has been the most outstanding waiter we have ever had at any resort! He personally gets 5 stars from our entire group that traveled to Punta Cana, Paradisus resort. The entire staff was a great help and the food and rooms are excellent also.

reviews.author: Dan C
reviews.title: Una vacación excelente.
reviews.text: Servicio excelente, los camareros que trabajan a la playa (Luis y Miguelino) son muy amables y traen todo que queremos. En el hotel, hay muchos restaurantes con platos y menú diferente. Nos disfrutamos en todos lugares.  Hay muchas piscinas y bares de piscinas. También tienen un KidsZone, si tienen niños. El Spa es fenomenal también.

reviews.author: Sandra N
reviews.title: Exceptional All-Inclusive resort
reviews.text: Went for a company function Jan 23 rd for a week.  Stayed in the Royal Service area and it was excellent. Check in was fabulous in a private area with drinks and appetizers while we relax during check in.  Our butler then shows us to our room which is located beside beach.  We have private pool, eating area and everyday fabulous Angel set up our beach area with towels .  The restaurants were very good with our favorite being the seafood restaurant by the beach...look out for bartender😀 and the Tapanayaki.   Buffet was definately worthwhile and very different with fresh seafood, meats, salads, sushi, etc ..most of all the people were terrific, friendly, helpful, and fun.  We tipped lots as we know they live on minimal wages and appreciate the tips and they deserved them.  Big thanks to our butler Sandi who looked after us all week.  A great resort and tons of great memories...definately would go back...thanks to all the great staff!

reviews.author: rayofsunshinegirl
reviews.title: "Excellent Service"
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real! The property is beautiful and the food and service, other than no working room phone, was great. I'd like to mention one employee in particular, who was outstanding and went above and beyond to make our stay extra-special. Edgar Perez was on duty for more than one of our events and was so personal, engaging, and attentive. A definite asset to Paradisus!

reviews.author: ann w
reviews.title: the best of everything!
reviews.text:
this was our second trip here, and we would do it again! the food, beach, accommodations, and service were always spot on. we enjoyed our waitstaff at every restaurant, but they also rotated staff, so we were lucky enough to have a favorite staff member, Judekqui Javier, serve us, and chat with us a several locations. she was very professional, friendly, and personable! she went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable, and it was just a pleasure to see her! her name  is equivalent to our "Judy". hope you are fortunate enough to meet her there!

 we were primarily interested in reading and relaxing on the beach. towels always available, also drinks, food, and books to swap. i always take 10 or so books, and leave them as i finish them - leaves me room to pack purchases!

reviews.author: Craig567
reviews.title: Best of the Best Linda
reviews.text: From the moment of arrival to departure we were treated like VIP's. All the staff were welcoming and helpful. We were part of a business group of close to 600 people and we really felt like we were in Paradise. This resort is all inclusive with at least 8 several themed restaurants to choose from as well as a buffet, There was music at night of different genres. The rooms were spacious and our balcony overlooked the beautiful well groomed gardens; the bathroom had an oversized jetted tub and spray shower. The pool is huge with swim up bar and the beach was beautiful white sand. There were lounge chairs under cover and plenty of activities like volleyball on the beach and sign up activities for the more adventurous. We had the Spa service at The Reserve and even just the treatment pools showers saunas and steam were amazing. Special recognition to Carolina Franco the sweetest hostess who seemed to be everywhere; Juan, our server at the buffet (sorry don't remember his last name), but you can ask for Senor Lindo, And Big Macdonna the activities coordinator. It was a wonderful time and very beautiful, muy Linda!!!

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Pool bar folks were awesome
reviews.text: Emilo and Santo Polanco never left us with out a drink they became our friends they were so nice we loved them Silvio and Robert Jose Los santos Wendy Nunez Annabelle Jennifer lady espinal they were not too busy to get us towels or whatever we asked THANK YOU GUYS for a great vacation

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: Service is spotty
reviews.text:
I just got back from a 5 day stay as part of a work function.  There were over 200 of us and it was the second year my company booked at this resort.  We had name badges that identified us as part of the group and the service received was very different depending on whether or not I was wearing my name badge.  If I was wasn't wearing the name badge service was very, very slow even though I was tipping well.  It was quicker to get my own drinks and even then the wait at the bar was often 5 minutes or more even though it wasn't busy.  The bartenders seemed to find it more interesting to talk to each other than the guests that were waiting to be served.  We waited for 20 minutes for to make a dinner reservation and the lady that booked it rolled her eyes when we told her we wanted it for that night.  It seemed like a huge imposition but when we got the restaurant there were only 4 other tables there.  The food at the buffet was good but we were often finished our meals before we even got water.  The rooms were large and very clean but, like other reviewers have pointed out, the bathroom situation was less than ideal if you wanted any privacy.  All of the regular rooms were far away from the pool and the beach and there were no convenient elevators.  We didn't mind taking the stairs but if you have a mobility issue ask for a ground floor room.  Skip the disco, it's tiny.  
I noticed that the majority of the 5 star reviews were from people who upgraded to Royal Service.  I agree if you pay extra you should get extras however, this resort is quite pricey and the service for the "standard" trip should be better than it was.  
The pool, the beach, and the grounds are stunning, however, the pool was freezing!   When I had my name badge on the service was great!  Based on that I would have to say that upgrading to royal service is probably worth it.  I probably wouldn't go back to this resort based on bang for your buck.  I have stayed at another all inclusive in DR and the service was much better for a lower price.

reviews.author: PTNGIRL
reviews.title: Group Trip in Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: Our group had an amazing time at the property. It is clean, the grounds are manicured and beautiful, the staff is polite and helpful, the food is phenomenal. All the way around we had an awesome time. If you have a group you would like to book this is the resort I would choose again and again.

reviews.author: Melinda C
reviews.title: Great Time in Paradise!
reviews.text: I had a really great stay the Paradisus Palma Real Resort! The activity guys Francisco, Macdonald, Angel, and Rony were great! they were always there with a game, some dancing or whatever! thanks guys

reviews.author: BrendaLR317
reviews.title: Incredible staff and services
reviews.text: Just recently visited The Reserve on a business trip. It was a paradise experience. We enjoyed the relaxation, food, fun, and the beauty of the property. Service is important to us.  The staff was awesome at every turn!  .  So awesome I would be remiss to not mention their names.
