Please pass on our personal gratitude to Tony Sainteloi, Anabel T, Cesar Luis, Sandra Cedeno, Jima V, Sonayo, and RoseMary at the Bana.  They certainly added to our wonderful vacation experience!

reviews.author: Lorna S
reviews.title: Dominican getaway
reviews.text: Just spent 5 days at the Paradisus hotel in Punta Cana. It is a huge hotel, too big for me but big has it's benefits.  Lots of choice for places to eat, lots of seating at the beach and beautiful giant pool.  Our garden view room didn't have much of a view as we were on the third floor and all we could see were palm fronds. Too bad because the gardens were very pretty. Room was huge and very comfortable and had a well stocked fridge. There is golf and tennis and lots of activities by the pool. The buffet is the best I've ever had. Always a great selection and I love the smaller portions, perfect for having a taste of everything.  The fish station was my favorite with at least 6 different fish types to try.  The best restaurant is Fuego by far.  The service at the hotel and the buffet in particular was amazing.  Always happy, friendly, polite and very  accommodating  .  If you can get the royal service, you get a butler and a choice of 2 extra restaurants.  Nice option but not necessary, unless you need someone to draw you a bath.

reviews.author: Suzette D
reviews.title: Service Extraordinaire
reviews.text: This was a first class resort with first class service.  Reynoldo and Big Mac made it so fun.  The people there were a joy to be around.  Desserts were amazing.  Food was great!!!  Our room was beautiful.  I would go there again in a second!  I loved it!!!  Thank you to all who made our trip so enjoyable...This was a little bit of heaven on earth!!!  The view was spectacular.  Paradise is the perfect title for this resort.  The zip line tour was fabulous!  They made it so safe.

reviews.author: JTPost1201
reviews.title: Will definitely go back
reviews.text: Great service , friendly people!!! A must for anyone to go and relax...Try the "Dos Amigos" at the Sunset Bar and enjoy the day with Bartender Leo Mota!!!!  The private butler service is phenomenal...thanks to Juan De Leon. The restaurants will satisfy any thing that you crave.

reviews.author: kskochinski
reviews.title: Royal Service Staff  Excellent- Jorge Rosado & Martin Tineo -
reviews.text: My spouse and I spent a full seven days with Paradisus Palma Real Resort with all inclusive and their extra offering Royal Service. This is an extra cost that came with fully dedicated staff. Our personal butler Jorge was our first butler experience. He was attentive and very pleasant always seeking us out to find out if we were in need. He would arrange our activities and any other special needs. The jacuzzi with champagne was a nice surprise! Martin was our pool and bar server - what a out going fellow! Every morning he prepared out beach chairs which were ours the entire week with no scambling around for towels or chairs in the morning. These were reserved and we had no issues with this at times confusing process of reserving chairs for the day. Our area was a private beach  which was another great benefit for what you are paying for this extra. Martin was always happy to see us at any time of the day. We felt fortunate to have won the lottery on the staff at Paradisus Resort as we heard some staff (rare) were not as  fully engaged. Jorge communicated his hours as well so we would never be looking for him. Only issue we had was that the phone to contact Jorge was never working very well but luckily for us he was always around and looking for us when we needed something. A great first time experience in the DR and we would high recommend the hotel and these superb members of the staff.

reviews.author: Dawn B
reviews.title: Winter Get Away
reviews.text: 85 and sunny...couldn't ask for more! But the Paradisus gave us so much more.  Beautiful resort, friendly staff, great activities, incredible food.  Our daily entertainment and activities man, Francisco Reynoso, made sure we enjoyed ourselves!  AKA Mr International in da house!  Such a beautiful resort and impeccable service made this resort a place we will definitely be returning to.

reviews.author: Leanne S
reviews.title: Winter trip
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with royal service at this resort.  Our butler, Samuel went above and beyond our expectations. We have not had the opportunity to have a butler before. I highly recommend it.  Samuel was exceptual, nothing was too much for him.  He always had a smile and responded quickly to our requests, whether it was dinner reso'os or booking tee times.  He did it effiiciently.

reviews.author: 22twiggy2222
reviews.title: wow
reviews.text:
we were at the paradisus for a corp event. we normally stay at more "economical" places but now ...not sure how we can go back after experiencing the level of food, service & grounds. 
even if we don't go back to dom rep, we may try the chain in playa del Carmen (our fave spot)
(we did not do the royal or reserve)

the rooms were beautiful..excepting the open concept bathroom area.  not sure the logic there but if you are a couple, you'll be fine 
ask for a room near the lobby.  we had a room backing on the service road (even after I emailed prior to, to request not getting this after seeing reviews) .yes it is loud, but not a trip-ruiner 
turndown service at night !
the maids start at 8-8:30am ,heads up...didn't bother us as we are early risers

the food ..ahhhh the food ,,we had transferred from another hotel & wow what a difference. the buffet was a sight to be seen. we had dinner at rare ,,,the steak was excellent (ask for well done, as they like med rare in dom rep)
the drinks were good & they give out bottled water at the bars 
the room service was apparently very good ,,friends had it. 

the activity staff was wonderful considering that not a lot of people participate in the activities
big mac, reyna & Francisco were great! if you have a chance please do the water aerobics, painting & "zumba" ...it is fun & gets you moving & its not boot camp :) 

the grounds are gorgeous & they play soothing music along the paths. at night , it is well lit & beautiful.  the spa was excellent.  the ritual baths are free! try it ! just as soothing as a massage. golf course was very good.  there is a shuttle that takes you to the shopping centre at the traffic circle (we didn't know this until we were leaving) ..name brands etc.
(you can walk to the right along the beach for vendors for trinkets,,be firm with what you want to pay. walk away if you have to.  they are very pushy & wayyy overpriced.)
there are shops in the hotel too if you don't want pressure & don't like to haggle

what a great time at this place !  would love to go back to this hotel!

reviews.author: Linda R
reviews.title: My Compliments
reviews.text: 01/17/15 to 01/24/15 - Went here on a company trip and extended for an additional 3 days.  My company did an excellent job and I felt very appreciated.  The resort did an excellent job setting everything up.  The resort is beautiful and the staff could not have been more friendly, always smiling, always greatful, always appreciative and thankful, they will easily engage you in conversation.  Some have better English than others, but none the less, communication was understood and a non-issue.  The room was beautiful (#3082), the beds were very comfortable.  Room service was great and fast.  I thought it to be strange that the ladies who tended to the rooms knocked on your door to do a room check (reporto, as one said), don't know what that is about, but it didn't feel intrusive.  The pool looked small, but was quite big once you got in it and provided enough room as not to invade your personal space.  The pool was freezing and it may have just been this time of year, but also because it was deep; had to be 4.5 to 5' deep.  Unusual, but I enjoyed the fact that it was deep.  The beach I enjoyed.  The sand was soft and a fine grain.  The loungers on the beach were comfortable.  There was a bit of seaweed, but that's the beach.  I saw pics of other traveler posts and maybe more seaweed at certain times of the year than others, but, it didn't bother or ruin my vacation.  There were several restaurants to choose from, I recommend trying them.  My sister & I only made it to Rare because you do have to make reservations as son as you get there otherwise you will get really late night dinners.  So we ordered room service to hold us over and never made the dinners because we were too full.  I was surprised that Rare, being a steak restaurant didn't serve filet mignon and tried the rib eye which was too fatty to me.  The waiter recommended the "flap" steak and it was delicious, highly recommend this cut of steak.  As for the food, not good.  Again, didn't try all the restauants, but the food left a lot to be desired.  I mean you are not going to starve.  But, I have found this to become true for a lot of the all inclusives now, I think this is were they make cuts or hire inexperienced chefs.  I understand the desire to cater to all ethnicities, but when I am in your Country, I want your food, like your mom and grandma would make.  Besides how much I love Spanish food.  Overall a great experience and yes, I would go back.

reviews.author: Snooderhead .
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Fantastic resort with wonderful amenities. There are plenty of options for food and fun. Great location and a gorgeous beach. The staff was truly exceptional. One of the standouts is Ana Almonte at the front desk. So kind and gracious. I shall return.

reviews.author: claramaidanafigueroa
reviews.title: viaje de trabajo
reviews.text:
Aunque cualquiera sueña con ir aunque sea por negocios a Punta Cana,  la realidad es que nunca es lo mismo que estar de vacaciones. ..La diferencia la marcan este tipo de tratos,  que te hacen sentir especial todo el tiempo,  haciendo de tu estancia. .. un privilegio!
Nada sería igual si no fuera por el mérito de tu mayordomo personal.  Jhonfi Rivera y su trato excepcional hicieron que mi recuerdo de ese hotel sea el mejor. 
Sin duda volveré y la próxima vez será por placer!!!

reviews.author: RepDom87
reviews.title: Regresaria sin dudarlo !!
reviews.text:
Estuve en este hotel desde el 18 al 21 de Diciembre del 2014 por cuestiones de trabajo, pero sin duda me gusto bastane el servicio y las instalaciones del hotel, habitaciones comodas y confortables, buen servicio, me encantaba cuando iban de noche a preparar la cama para dormir y me dejaban un chocolate, lindo detalle.
El Nuevo restaurant Naos , bello y con una decoracion diferente, la comida colocada por secciones tambien hace que se vea bien organizado, he visitado otros hotels y este tiene un estilo unico. La comida del Gabby beach tambien me gustó mucho.
Lo unico que agregaria aqui es que la ambientacion nocturna es un poco limitada en las noches, pero despues me encanto y sin duda  lo tengo en mi lista para regresar.

reviews.author: Ophelia B
reviews.title: Corporate Stay & Play
reviews.text:
Was there for a Corporate Event; everything was on property - from banquets - snacks, coffee - a 5 minute free massage, to all the food, our beach party etc. And it was wonderful. The service was great, the property is gorgeous, the rooms - spectacular and CLEAN; 24/7 room service was a delight. 

The only downside is that you are at an all inclusive, so you may get bored with the food. Their Mexican restaurant on property was delicious and Rigoberto was both entertaining and professional. 

We stayed for two days a few properties over in saving $50/day and it was NOT worth moving. Should have stayed here.

reviews.author: callielisa
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: This is our first time at the Paradisus Punta Cana.  We are enjoying our stay very much. From the moment we arrived we were treated so well by Yeison Jejadou.  He checked us in and got us set up with our room with the friendliest manners.  Spending time at the beautiful pool, and being waited on by Jose d'Los Santos and Emilio Valdez has made us feel very welcome and we are enjoying the first class service that they are providing!  The folks at the massage area, Roselina del Rosario, Margaret Inaoau gave wonderful massages poolside in a Cabana.  We also were treated wonderfully by Guillermina Caraballo and Luis Floriaun.  So far, the restuarants have been good.  It is best to make a reservation.  The room maid Maria, not sure of her last name, is very accommodating and friendly too.  You can really tell that the staff want to make your vacation an exceptional experience.

reviews.author: WorldTraveler34607
reviews.title: First Class Service and Attention
reviews.text: We found ourselves for a week in Paradisus Palma Real for 5 days. My family is in the hotel and restaurant business so Iam not easily impressed. This property provided one of the best experiences and service of any hotel I have visited in my extensive travels. All the employees, especially at Naos restaurant, strive to provide personal attention. Each and everyday as I arrived at Naos restaurant the employees recognized me and hurried over with my coffee just as I like it. the service was attentive but not overbearing, just perfect. The staff was happy and very professional. It is an unusual combination. I wish to thank those employees, which were many, for the attention: Fatima, Carolina, Nelson, Abraham, Alba, Omar, Joselyn, Francisco,Yuderqui, Mr. De Dios, one of the supervisors, was around all hotel premises and ready to assist in any matter. The selection of meals in the buffet was of high quality with some items prepared a la carte. Beautiful views and many areas to sit and relax. You may always find a private area amongst all the green. Another exceptional employee was Ms. Ruth Tejeda. She works in the Spa area but she helped me with any request I had in any area, a very kind person and wonderful representative of the hotel. You will find that the employees are very humble and although the property caters to the high end client it all remains accessible and friendly.My only dissapointment was with the front office employees. Each time I visited the front desk I thought I ad stepped out of the PAradisus Hotel and gone elsewhere. All employees in that department with the exception of one, Joselin, were unable or unwilling to help. Their vocabulary was No and Not Possible. When the front office was unwilling to help I directed myself to Omar at the baggage desk and he bent over backwards to resolve. He also deserves very high praise.This property is definitely worth a visit when in Punta Cana. I hope to return. Annette

reviews.author: Jayne K
reviews.title: Staff in the Royal Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus for 10 days. Excellent service in all restaurants. Our "butler" whose name is Johnfi was a real treat, professional and willing to help with any of our needs. Ask for him if you are staying in that section. The buffet for the all-inclusive was fresh, delicious, and attractive with lots of choices. Breads and pastries weren't the best but  we realize we are used to more shortening and sugar than the Caribbean countries.

reviews.author: Dawn Michelle
reviews.title: Friendly, Helpful Staff and Beautiful Property
reviews.text: The entire property is so stylistically decorated and well maintained and you simply cannot beat the location.  Combine this with lovely staff, who go so far out if their way to make your stay special; and very high quality food - this is a perfect retreat.  I'm planning our corporate senior leadership meeting there in January and have been very impressed so far.  On the Royal Services side, guests are assigned a butler and I had the nicest, capable gentleman - Angelo Mercedes!  Also on the Royal Services side was the most sincere and energetic, Francisco Caberera on the beach!  I will point our VIPs in their direction during our meeting.  Highly recommend as a retreat and will update about the success of our meeting next month!

reviews.author: Warren I
reviews.title: Great Resort and Enjoyable Wedding
reviews.text:
Just returned from a PPR for a wedding for two clients of mine and 80 of their closest friends.  Paradisus Palma Real was a very nice resort that had made significant improvements since our last visit in July 2014.  On our previous trip the wi-fi network did not work very well and one area of the resort was shut down due to construction.  This trip the wi-fi worked great and the new buffet and bar area were great additions.  The resort continues to work to improve and make the experience better for guests.  We worked directly with Raquel and Claribel from the Romance Department and both were very helpful in ensuring everything went well for the wedding couple.  They did a great job at making things go off well and working with a wedding area on the resort that had never been used before.  Jose and Johan at the front desk were exception at taking care of our guests and various issues that arouse with rooms, check-in, etc.  

Of course, our favorite bartenders, Roberto Flores and Annabelis were there and did an amazing job as always at taking care of everyone and making sure that the experience was awesome.  The rooms were clean, the resort well kept, and the food and beverage some of the best I have had at an all inclusive.  

The only negative of the trip was a few power outages that occurred during our stay.  But, the resort did a good job dealing with it and I know when we were leaving the GM was already addressing the issue to get things fixed with the supplier.  

A very nice resort and great place to go for a group or vacation.

reviews.author: Elizabeth M
reviews.title: Muy bueno hay cosas para mejorar
reviews.text:
Excelente el lugar, la ambientacion y el servicio lo unico que no tiene menú para celiacos fundamental en estos tiempos que cada vez hay más y representa un servicio a brindar.
El lugar vip en la playa es chico y estamos muy juntos y son pocos
Otra característica osa a mejorar es el wifi hay solo en el loby

reviews.author: Reynilda
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Me ah encantando el excelente servicio de fernando geronimo y cesar la fle un servicio de primera pocos servicio eh visto como este la puntualidad la rapidez y el profesionalismo de ellos me dejo sorprendida gracias por todo...

reviews.author: Missy J
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: I was recently at this hotel and received excellent service from a few individuals who assisted during our visit. Our butler, Jonfi Rivera, was so attentive and helpful and Omar Hernandez was also very hospitable. I really enjoyed both of them and feel they deserve special recognition!

reviews.author: Carolina C
reviews.title: Gran Final VIII Circuito Golf Melia
reviews.text: Excelente organización y equipo comercial acompañados por un complejo de ensueño, Cocotal Golf a 2 minutos hicieron que esta final fuera inolvidable para todos, tanto organizadores como invitados e finalistas, esperamos poder repetirla en el 2015!!!

reviews.author: meggy_034
reviews.title: WOW Experience!  Great for Groups
reviews.text: I recently returned from an incentive trip at this property that I planned for my company.  It was an incredible experience!  The property is beautiful and there is so much to do.  The food was really good and there are more restaurants on property than you could actually each at in a week.  My butler Johnfi Rivera was awesome.  He didn't miss anything, made all of my reservations as requested, provided the aromatherapy on my pillow as I asked and even suprised me with a candlelit bubble bath waiting for me when I returned to my room late one night.  Our groups and coventions manager Massiel Jimenez was steller.  She was great to work with onsite and was always there when we needed her.  Her right hand guy, Omar in Convention Services was also wonderful.  He helped with anything we needed to take care of our group and make our incentive trip a great experience for all who attended.  Luis and Nicolas were the two butlers who were assigned to our VIPs and they were great.  Thank you to all of the amazing staff at the Paradisus Palma Real!  Exceptional service provided all around.

reviews.author: Kat C
reviews.title: A Great Place for an Incentive Event
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of being involved with an incentive trip for a worldwide company and couldn't have been more pleased with this property.  I was a travel staff member and our event was for 1800 guests.  The transfer from the airport to the property was only a 20 minute ride.  There was a shopping mall on the edge of the resort and and there were hotel shuttles available to transfer hotel guests.  The grounds were beautiful and well maintained throughout.  There was a wide variety of restaurants on property, both ala carte and buffet, to choose from.  The buffets were excellent with lots of items.  Definitely not your standard all-inclusive buffets. The swim up suites at The Reserve were nothing less than amazing.  The pools at The Reserve, the Palma Real, as well as The Royal Service were fabulous.  The staff were very friendly and always went out of their way to be of assistance.  The butlers that were assigned to our executives for the program definitely knew how to provide VIP service.  My shining star on the event though was Daniel Rodriguez!  He is the Hospitality Manager and was my VIP Coordinator for the program.  He was very attentive, very responsive, and knew how to get the job done!  He thought outside of the box to resolve challenges and no request went unanswered even if it wasn't the norm for the property.  And with the presence and the respect that Paradisus has overall in the Dominican, the locals were very responsive to some our requests.  Example:  The resort has a market one night a week where local vendors come in and set up booths to sell their goods.  It is a large event held at Palma Real.  Unfortunately, the market was not scheduled during our event.  By us just posing the question to Daniel if we could schedule the event during our program, it was done!  I would welcome the opportunity for another corporate event at the Paradisus and the pleasure of working with Daniel Rodriguez and his staff!  The Paradisus would be a great destination for an incentive event!

reviews.author: D Richard F
reviews.title: Perfecto....again
reviews.text:
This is my family's and my third trip here and like before, Paradisus Punta Cana hit the mark. We are members of Club Melia, a great decision by the way, and stayed in The Reserve. Beginning with our reservation process through the entire trip everyone has been gracious. The team very helpful to coordinate our car service and even dinner reservations before we arrived. 

The great team at hydro grill and Reserve Pool areas were always on top of what we needed. Took very good care of my daughter and her Shirley Temples. Always with a good attitude and ready to help. Move at a slow and deliberate pace which helped us ease into vacation mode. 
Santo Polanco, Jose De Los Santos, Emilio Valdes, Melvin Brizon, Jose Reinoso, Ramon Simbert, Lismeiry.

Santo at the pool greeted me every morning poolside with a smile and a good morning. Helped me get me chairs aligned for the day of sunning, swimming and of course doing nothing. 

This place is perfecto and we will go back. I would recommend this to anyone needing to relax and unwind.

reviews.author: micnmissy
reviews.title: Great Property! Great Butler service from Johnfi!
reviews.text: It was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and we had a great trip. The property is beautiful, the beaches are beautiful, the food is very good for an all inclusive, and the Butler service is great! Our Butler Johnfi Rivera did a great job, was very helpful, very friendly, and handled everything we needed! He spoke very good English and always had a smile on his face! You won't regret a trip to the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Alicia M
reviews.title: Excelente servicio!
reviews.text:
El Hotel, las instalaciones, el servicio! Todo perfecto, las habitaciones bellísimas, el trato por parte del personal muy cálido, siempre a las órdenes. Agradecimientos principalmente al Sr. Barón Justo quién nos atendió en varias ocasiones mientras estuvimos en el Restaurant. La comida excelente! 
Gracias por todo, esperamos estar pronto de nuevo por allá! 

Alicia Morillo hab. 0409 Del 12 al 16 de Nov

reviews.author: MrsNeh18
reviews.title: So large you think you are alone!
reviews.text:
The property was beautiful and every staff member that we spoke with was exceptional.  The room we stayed in was a large room with a full kitchen and three, yes three, bathroom sinks.  It was located in the villa section of the resort which overlooked a garden in the back.  Security was top notch, even placing guards in the back of our villa.  

There are two pools, the main pool and then the private reserved pool.  The same applies to the beach, if you take advantage of the reserved section its a very quiet experience.  

The only negative thing I would say would be the smell of the room but I don't think that there is much they can do as its a very humid place, the room smelled musty and damp.  There was mold on the decorative pillows that I would throw on the floor but the rooms were very clean and they also leave wonderful chocolates once the night comes, they even close the shades!

I would stay here again in a heart beat, the deck with rocking chairs are so peaceful and they always provide entertainment at night!

reviews.author: Kay G
reviews.title: Can't wait to go back
reviews.text:
Came here with a large group for a 5-day retreat during the first week of November. From the minute we got there till the minute we left, the staff went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and relaxing. 

Bar and pool staff  at the Reserve were remarkable-- Santos, Raul, Jose Rivera, Ted, Ovando, Edwin, Felix, and so many more. They were all very friendly and attentive. Spa team was just as great. 

Service at the restaurants from the main lobby building could have been faster. 

Skip the buffet for lunch and dine at the grill by the Reserve pool, think it's called Aqua. 

Wi-fi available throughout the majority of the property.More swim-up bars would have been a plus. 

Overall a great trip. Would definitely recommend this location to a friend.

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.title: Amabilidad!
reviews.text: Siempre están dispuestos ayudarte, buscar la solución, agradarte, servirte sin importar nada!!  En especial al joven Omar Hernandez (Negocios) muchas gracias!! También en el Restaurante Aqua el Sr. Jose Rivera, el joven Alexander Ozuna y Andis y todos en el Restaurante The Palazzo.

reviews.author: Benny T
reviews.title: Business and vacation get away
reviews.text: My first time to the Dominican Republic.  It was a great experience and a great resort.  The amenities are great, the people are very friendly and always willing to help you, the beaches are fantastic, plenty of restaurants at the resort, and the food is good.  We especially enjoyed the services of our butler, Jose Salvador.

reviews.author: Deidra P
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
The accommodations are excellent.  We had the best service by our waiter on the beach, Francisco Cabrera!  Each day he kept us hydrated and had our beach chairs ready.  Never have had such service by a waiter.  

Thank you Francisco Cabrera!  You made our stay wonderful and so relaxing!  Would return again.

reviews.author: Juan Sebastián G
reviews.title: Cosas para mejorar
reviews.text:
Nos quedamos en una convención. Para mejorar 1) Compramos Royal Service y la verdad no encontré nada extra el haber pagado por ello. 2 ) Días lluviosos y en una habitación se filtró el agua y hubo goteras. 3) Algunas veces el servicio fue muy lento. 4) A una compañera le salió un bicho dentro del vaso de una bebida que pidió en el casino. 5) No me hicieron el aseo en 2 días argumentando un aviso de "no molestar" que jamás puse y además llamé insistentemente para que me hicieran el aseo. Lo destacable fue que recibieron la queja con diligencia. 6) Hay un puente en madera donde varias personas se cayeron por estar mojado, debería tomar precauciones ante esto. 
No sentí que el precio se ajustara al servicio. Se puede pagar mucho menos y tener un mejor servicio

reviews.author: Doris G
reviews.title: Great experience!!!
reviews.text: Unforgetable.......and with the personal touch of my Butler Jose Salvador it's one of the most special  places I have visit in the Caribbean!! Highly recommended...... facilities are out of this world, personal are so dedicated and nice, food is great!!!! If you want to have  perfect vacation this is the place. I went for business purposes and ended spending the weekend! Jose Salvador thank you so much for you service and dedication. ...you are awesome! !!

reviews.author: LouLiz36
reviews.title: Request Richard at the Palazzo Restaurant
reviews.text: We enjoyed this all inclusive resort. The rooms were spacious and beautiful, the ocean water was warm even in October, and we relaxed on the beach on one of dozens of shaded mattresses either reading a book or watching a movie using their strong wifi. The staff was kind. But I'd really like to encourage people to eat at the on-site restaurant, Palazzo, which was the best breakfast and lunch we found, and to request Richard. After one meal with Richard as our server, he took it upon himself to see to it that we receive a first-rate, personalized dining experience for the rest of the week. For example, instead of standing in the buffet line for crepes/omelets/french toast, he'd have us relax at our table and expedite our order to the front of the line, then deliver it to us. He memorized our names and addressed us personally at every meal and quickly learned our unique tastes and preferences (coffee with no cream, french toast with extra cinnamon, etc.) and even went across the resort just to bring us a special drink we'd tasted at a different place the night before. He really is the best, but be sure to tip his extra efforts even though I don't think tips are expected. He made us feel like VIPs and is just such a nice guy to boot. It's worth it.

reviews.author: dawn g
reviews.title: Fabulous experience
reviews.text: Lovely property. Staff was very accommodating and always ready to help. Rooms in the Royal Service, only way to go, were beautiful and very comfortable. This is one of the nicest properties I have seen in Punta Cana

reviews.author: mesheree1
reviews.title: Nice place!  Great restaurants and grounds.
reviews.text: We loved the Paradisus.  The dining room was under construction so breakfast was in the conference rooms.  We figured out after that first morning that breakfast overlooking the ocean is way better than a huge room with no windows.  So we did the restaurants after that.  We had the Royal Service package that gave us access to all of the restaurants on the property.  I loved the hibachi grill place.  We had excellent food at the restaurants.  We'd heard people didn't like the food before, but I think they had a different package.  The spa was amazing.  Loved the spa next door too.  We went surfing at Macao beach and took a snorkeling trip to Catalina Island.  Both were amazing!  Our room had a few quirks.  The Wi-fi never really worked, and the lights were a pain to figure out.  But overall we were really pleased with our experience.

reviews.author: Barbara L
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: Las atenciones son excelentes,las habitaciones maravillosos, el servicio expectacular todo muy bien cuidado.... Me encnanto el servicio de la habitacion y fernando geronimo muy cortez y profesional con todo... Em general todo perfecto...

reviews.author: William C
reviews.title: Magnificent Beachfront Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort that pampers guests endlessly. Our butler in Royal Service was outstanding - most attentive, but allowed for our privacy and relaxation, as the beach concierge. Room was clean, spacious, luxurious.

reviews.author: william8092014
reviews.title: Compact a+ Hotel! All in!
reviews.text: The view is incredibe when you arrive to the hotel. The food havent had any concerns, great buffet and the restaurnats are very good, loved the lobster night though. The rooms are always clean... Pool is huge. No complains so far. We had a Heavyhitter event and the Business area is nice. Omar Hernandez helped me alot in the service with anything i needed. Cool peoples!

reviews.author: CCP201
reviews.title: An incredible all inclusive property that exceeds all expectations
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed every moment of my trip to the Paradisus Palma Real. The point of my trip was business and to view three Paradisus Resorts and I was thoroughly impressed by all (Paradisus Palma Real, Paradisus Punta Cana and Melia Caribe Tropical).  The service was impeccable - as soon as you arrive there are cool towels infused with lavender, vanilla, orange (*change daily) and fresh water. The view upon arrival is truly beyond words! Every morning I received a delicious variety of breakfast items from room service and Eduard Campusano delivered it with a huge smile and a friendly hello! The pool and beach areas were lovely - more than enough room for all guests to enjoy. I truly cannot wait to plan a trip back to this property next year with my husband!

reviews.author: EzequielParis
reviews.title: Room Service
reviews.text: Un servicio excelente y un trato magnifico. Atentos y muy agradables, siempre dispuestos a ayudar. Especialmente el servicio de Fernando Geronimo, una excelente persona y mejor profesional. Cordial saludo a Cesar LaFle muy cortes y amable en el telefono. Gracias a los dos.

reviews.author: Marcelo B
reviews.title: 100% recomendavel!
reviews.text: Um dos noteis mais incríveis em que tive o prazer de conhecer na minha vida! Tem atracões de todo tipo (balada, teatro, restaurantes), e nao tive necessidade quase de sair conhecer a cidade! Podemos passar 1 semana dentro do hotel sem repetir atracões! Recomendo muito!

reviews.author: TigranDina
reviews.title: Целый комплекс удовольствия
reviews.text:
Номера большие и чистые. Еда разнообразная, американская. 
Если еще не были в Америке, советую попробовать еду. Она иная, чем в старом свете. Совершенно другие вкусовые ощущения! Это для тех, кто любит новые ощущения. Хотя пугали комарами в Доминикане, я их не заметил вообще. Взял против комаров специальный фумигатор и практически (только один раз употребил, да и то впустую) не использовал. Главное ночью не открывать окна.
Рекомендую экскурсии на море. В море у отеля постоянно какая-то тина, но она чистая!!!
Я безразличен к азартным играм, но для любителей - прекрасное казино. Для таких как я - прекрасное кино наяву - особенно, когда кто-то выигрывает крупную сумму и думает как бы тихо смыться. И ему позволяют! 
Много американцев, и они каждый вечер гуляют, потому всегда весело.
Прекрасный СПА комплекс, с великолепными массажистками и за смешные цены, ведь каждому гостю дается куча подарков. 
Отель прекрасный. Доминиканцы еще не испорчены многолетним туризмом. Потому все чисто и все вежливы.

reviews.author: Gabsantanadiaz
reviews.title: Un Sueño...
reviews.text: Desde que llegué me sentí como una reina. Muy buenas atenciones! Un equipo de animación espectacular, Rafael siempre nos encontró una actividad nueva y entretenida, Gracias! El equipo de Grupos es muy atento, especialmente Yohanna Genao, quien estuvo pendiente de que todo saliera bien durante nuestra estadía. Los camareros del Gabi Club son muy atentos también. Por favor, procuren ir a la fiesta de la playa que hacen los sabados, eso no tiene comparación! Es sin duda lo que mas disfruté. En fin, desde el principio hasta el final de mi estadía todo el mundo fue muy atento. Pronto volveré asi que espero que sigan con ese excelentisimo servicio.

reviews.author: Tyra J
reviews.title: Great service from Ramon Fuego
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The room was fantastic, the pool was beautiful and the service was great.  Our favorite spot to stop for a drink was the Sky Bar.   Ramon took excellent care of us.  He not only greeted us by name, but remembered our drink of choice.  Definitely would visit again!

reviews.author: GregorioRodriguez23
reviews.title: Hotel excelente, Grupos y Convenciones
reviews.text:
Hola, mi experiencia fue genial en este hermoso hotel, aparte de sus instalaciones hermosas, su comida, sus actividades la mayor experiencia es su personal.

Estaba trabajando en para un comercial del ministerio de turismo en el cual el hotel nos facilito todas las herramientas para llevar a cabo nuestro trabajo. personas como Massiel Jimenez, Belen San Matin y Omar Hernadez así entre otras maravillosas personas del staff. 

Gracias Paradisus, vuelvo pronto pero de vacaciones.

reviews.author: Aash411
reviews.title: Baron Justo
reviews.text: Baron Justo was an amazing waiter and he really took great care of us.  Overall the hotel was very nice - been there before.  The restaurants are nice.  The rooms are pretty good.  Wifi is the biggest problem from the rooms.  From the lobby it is okay provided many others are not trying to log in.

reviews.author: Karen D
reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.text:
All expectations were highly met and thensome!
Samuel Rodriquez, our personal butler in the Royal Service was amazing! Super friendly and VERY helpful!
Also, Stephania Auguste, our greeter in The Palazzo every morning was fabulous!
All in all the experience was truly an unforgettable one!!

reviews.author: Hector B
reviews.title: Muy costoso para calidad de servicios ofrecidos
reviews.text: Excelentes habitaciones con detalles de descuido en aseo y reposibcion de articulos de baño, 5 días sin WIFI por problemas tecnicos que prometieron resolver y  nunca sucedió y lo peor un total desaorden y mala atención en los restaurantes, especialmente en el desayuno y almuerzo, sin ningún tipo de disculpas ni propuestas de soluciones, En la habitación fue mucho mas fácil comer que en los restaurantes. Afortunadamente fue un viaje por convención y  no de vacaciones.

reviews.author: Warren I
reviews.title: Great Resort with Great Staff
reviews.text:
Great resort.  Went for a planning meeting for a future wedding and had a magnificent time.  Check in was problematic the first day as we arrived at 3pm and rooms were not ready but staff worked hard to get us into room.  Day one was spent at pool bar and the bar tenders are great.  Pedro, Antonio, and Gustavo were excellent in taking care of us.  Kept the drinks flowing and always checked on you.  Roberto Flores and Juan in the Avenue Bar were awesome.  They became daily friends and great bartenders.  Julio showed up working that bar our last two days and was great.  His Bananamama drink was loved by all.  Not to mention we had plenty of Mamajuana's in the Avenue Bar.  These guys were awesome.  Late night at the Sky Bar is great with Freddy.  Freddy's Boom Boom Shot is a staple now.  Our favorite staff member was our Royal Service Butler, Samuel Rodriguez.  Samuel took care of us from moment one at the resort and was very attentive.  He took care of numerous last minute dinner plans, ensured housekeeping took care of our room and kept the mini bar stocked (Presidente's for everyone).  He was reachable all hours of the day, event outside of his work hours.  He regularly checked on us.  Mariela in the Romance Dept was also great as she provided our wedding tour for myself and the clients.  

The resort was clean, well kept and the rooms were nice.  There were a few con's to the place but overall it was a great resort.  The wifi was a problem as it only worked well in the lobby. However, we found out that this was a relatively new problem that they were having with the service provided and they were working to fix it.

reviews.author: Michelle R
reviews.title: AMAZING TIME
reviews.text: Was there for 5 days and I tell you from the staff to the food everything was amazing, the staff in the pool area where funny, attentive and very very friendly, WILL GO AGAIN WITH ALL MY FRIENDS....RECOMMEND THIS PLACE HIGHLY

reviews.author: Gary E
reviews.title: Hot Chef
reviews.text: The visit was part of a work convention. We all had a great time the staff are excellent and very attentive. Everyone you walk past say's hello or good morning etc. Internet connection was a bit hit and miss but otherwise the whole experience was fantastic.

reviews.author: 11KarenM22
reviews.title: Distributor Event-South American Distributors
reviews.text:
This was the second event that our company planned at the Paradisus Punta Cana.  Our customers came to the resort from all over South America. The resort was to capacity and we were moved to the front of the resort to stay in The Reserve.  The Reserve has all suite rooms. This worked well since most of our customers traveled with their spouse.  The pool area and buffet were just as good here as in the Royal Service.  It is a bit of a walk to the beach, but there is a tram that takes you all over the resort and a walking path that has no vehicles.
 I worked with Yohanna  to plan this second event and again she was wonderful to work with while planning. She worked tirelessly on our event and was always prompt with an answer to any questions that I had for our group.  Whenever she wasn't available on days off, her superior Alexander was there to answer any questions and work with me. During our time at the resort, Yohanna was always at our receptions/dinners to make sure that everything ran smoothly.  I would highly recommend this resort for business or pleasure!

reviews.author: adollinger
reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: The reviews about this Resort were less than accurate.  The food was some of the worst I have encountered at a "5 star resort," and the whole place was antiquated.  The bathrooms in the suites have glass doors, so privacy in unavailable.  Electrician's tape was abundant in the wiring behind the bed where all the plugs and master fuse were located.  And room service was regularly taking upwards of an hour for simple orders on non-busy times.  Will NOT be returning, and suggest you find other options if the D.R. is a must-visit destination.

reviews.author: Edwin Lamarche
reviews.title: Todo cerca
reviews.text: Es un hotel de de lo tienes todo a la mano, y el personal es muy amable.  No me gusto que tienen áreas privadas en el mismo centro de las instalaciones.  Si quieres tener áreas VIP considero más elegante tenerlos en un área externa.  Como estuve de negocios, no se porque no nos ofertaron esos servicios.  Aunque siendo sincero el hotel te ofrece un servicio de calidad.

reviews.author: jen s
reviews.title: Romance Department
reviews.text:
The Romance Department at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana is amazing. I can't speak highly enough of Sahoni! I am a wedding coordinator in the Philadelphia area and I was apprehensive about the logistics of the wedding. My clients and I were so grateful for all of the help the team gave us and how beautiful everything was. 
I would highly recommend having your destination wedding at the Palma Real. 

Thank you, Sahoni and Laura!!!!

reviews.author: Bryant D
reviews.title: fernando geronimo the best room service
reviews.text: estuvimos aqui en este hermoso resort y lo que mas nos encanto fue el servicio de habitacion de fernando geronimo muy amigable el chico siempre atento rapido con nuestro servicio sobrepaso nuestras expectativas tambien un saludo a su jefe beltodo que nos hizo  llegar todo bn por via de el tambien a nicolas de la rosa, juan gonzales y sergio un cordial saludo a todos.....

reviews.author: Francis  G
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Un saludo muy cordial ami amigo fernando geronimo de room service que nos trajo nuestra cena todas las noches siempre puntual y muy amable gracias fernando por tu buen trato nos hiciste sentir com en nuestra propia casa

reviews.author: frac1978
reviews.title: Un paradiso in un paradiso
reviews.text:
Sono stato al Paradisus Palma Real oltre una settimana, per una convention.
Durante il mio soggiorno ho potuto, quindi, apprezzare un po' tutti i servizi della struttura.
Partiamo dalla camera, in realtà un mini appartamento dotato di ogni comfort: doccia enorme, con getti idromassaggio, bagno spazioso, vasca idromassaggio, letto matrimoniale molto confortevole, cucina e terrazzino.

Passiamo al cibo: il "problema" di queste strutture è che si mangia sempre! E, al Paradisus, si mangia anche bene. Numerosi i ristoranti, ognuno dei quali con specialità diverse. Ho mangiato spesso al Naos, sia a colazione che a pranzo. E' un self service con cucina internazionale, con alimenti sempre freschi, preparati al momento. 
Degno di nota il ristorante italiano Palazzo. Nonostante il mio scetticismo, ho trovato ottima qualità, soprattutto nella carne.
Molto buono il Gabi Beach dove ho mangiato delle ottime aragoste grigliate.
Da non dimenticare, infine, il Market Grill, con hamburger grigliati e salsine d'ogni tipo.
E poi i tanti bar, dove bere ottimo rum e cocktail d'ogni tipo.

Molto bella la Yhi Spa. Sembra di entrare in un altro mondo, fatto di relax, con piscina caldissima, idromassaggio e possibilità di fare massaggi d'ogni tipo (extra).

Fantastica la spiaggia, enorme, con sabbia finissima. Un po' meno bello il mare, sempre mosso e ricco d'alghe.

Bene gli uffici, spaziosi e con wireless velocissima.
Ancor meglio le sale conferenze, con personale attentissimo e dotazioni tecniche di alta qualità.

La struttura, in sintesi, è smisurata. Dati gli impegni lavorativi non ho potuto viverla a pieno, ma ho comunque apprezzato buona parte dei servizi. 
Prima di concludere devo fare un plauso a Marta Cabrera, dello staff del Paradisus, che ci ha seguito per tutta la durata del nostro soggiorno, aiutandoci e supportandoci a qualunque ora, accondiscendendo a tutte le nostre richieste.

reviews.author: CHensler27
reviews.title: They don't call it Paradise for nothing
reviews.text: Stunning entrance and a very friendly staff. The accommodations were lovely and romantic. 2 miles of beautiful beaches; soft sand, no shells or rocks,  You can do everything or nothing at all. Loved the coconut farmer coming by every morning on the beach - *Triptip*: you have to catch him early, before 10:30. "Cesare" the groundskeeper was a doll and he and my husband became fast friends as he enjoys landscaping as well. The ladies at the Real Spa Salon were so accommodating, taking me in last minute (twice) to straighten my unmanageable humidified hair. Our only critique regards our assigned personal butler, Alvaro Fernandez, who told us upon arriving that his pager wasn't working but that he would come by later with a replacement. He never did, and we never heard from him again. Reservations for the beds by the pool had to be made well in advance, as they go quickly. "Alvaro" never took the initiative to come by to inquire if he could do anything for us, AT ALL. He was a pleasant young man, but we joked that "Alvaro" was too busy scoping chicks to be bothered with work. The last time we saw him was at check out in the lobby and at the drive whereby he stood by our airport transport for 20 minutes, undoubtedly waiting for a fat tip. Fat chance.

reviews.author: Ken P
reviews.title: Great Property, Good Staff, Good Food
reviews.text: Amazing location and amazing property.  It actually took us half an hour to find our room the place is so big.  Our first impression was not great as we went to the buffet at the far left as you walk towards the ocean.  The service and food was both average.  However once you realize there is a better buffet by the ocean in the middle of the resort (get the fajitas at lunch!) and once you get to know the staff at the pool bar by the ocean, it was GREAT.  You just have to joke around with and get to know them.  Starky Valoy at the Sky Bar by the good buffet was AWESOME.  He makes the BEST dirty monkeys you'll ever have!

reviews.author: Màximo V
reviews.title: Maxima Excelencia
reviews.text: Es este resort un paraiso en el caribe, con excelentes y delicadas atenciones, con un personal muy competente, amables y esforzados a brindar um servicio de maxima excelencia, gracias por su acogida y que el Señor Dios toppderoso me los bemdiga siempre en especial debo de hacer mención a Anabel Gonzalez por sus atencipnes unica y excelentes. Gracias de todo corazón Att. Dr. Maximo Vasquez.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Getaway with my wife
reviews.text: This is a very nice resort.  They were still in the process of some major repairs after a fire ruined one of the restaurants.  I am not sure that this would be the best place to bring teenagers.  I think they may be bored.  However, this was great for my wife and I.

reviews.author: Víctor Raúl B
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia
reviews.text:
El hotel magnifico y muy cómodo, el personal muy servicial y sobre todo el Business Center, demasiado atento el Señor Omar Hernandez.
Se recomienda que la señal de Wifi la mejoren en el entorno del hotel.

reviews.author: Heidi D
reviews.title: Terrible Service at a Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real, Royal Service the first week of May 2014. My husband won the trip from the company he sells for. I am usually pretty laid back when it comes to traveling; I do not consider myself a picky person when it comes to food, service etc. but the “Cons” outweigh the “Pros” when it comes to this resort. Unfortunately, I do not think we would ever go back unless it was for another free trip. 
I will start with the Pros. The grounds are absolutely beautiful and very well kept by the staff. The beach is amazing and the view from our room breathtaking. We had the Royal Service Imperial Romance Ocean Front Whirlpool Suite, 2nd floor. 
Our butler Alvaro was awesome to work with. He helped with dinner reservations and was always available when needed. We were able to get reservations at every restaurant, and the food was good. Melvin at the Market Grill went out of his way to take care of our table one rainy afternoon when there was nothing else to do. He made sure our drinks were always full and brought out made to order guacamole for our table. We ate breakfast at the Palazzo every morning, and it was always delicious. The girl that greeted us every morning was very welcoming; I wish I would have got her name. She was one of the few that offered exceptional customer service

The Cons: 
Our shower did not have hot water during the week we were there. We had to take baths if we wanted hot water. Apparently there was an issue the staff was working on, but it was never fixed while we were there. 
The resort lost power several times during our stay. One night it was out during our dinner at the Market Grill, no one could see to order and we had to pull out our phones and use the flashlight just to see the menu. 
As a Royal Service guest, I do not feel the bar service was any better. There was not one bartender that stood out as being exceptional. There was talk around the resort that you must have money in your hand to get better service at the bar. I do not tip until the end of my stay and only to those that made the extra effort. The liquor seemed watered down; you are better off making your own drinks from the liquor in the rooms. We drank a lot of rum and cokes and a lot of Presidente. Disappointed that there was no Corona at this resort!
No one ever came to get our drink order while we were sitting in the Royal Service area of the beach. Again, maybe if we tipped first we would have had drink service? This seems backwards to me and shame on the staff if that’s the only way to get good service there. 
The lunch buffet was the same every day. We had friends that were not Royal Service so they could not eat at the Palazzo with us. We ended up at the Market Grill every day for lunch and got bored of the same food every day. Most of the time, we would have to ask to have coffee/water refilled.  At the buffets, several of the staff stood around and waited until we gestured that something was needed. For example: coffee/water refills.  I have been to other resort where you never needed to ask, it was there before it was needed. 
I was VERY upset with the girls that work in the resort gift shop. They were rude and not helpful at all. I was in the gift shop twice during our stay. Both times, the girls were gathered at the counter laughing and chatting with complete disregard to customers needing help. I stood at the jewelry counter for several minutes before finally walking to the front and asking for help from one of them.  They then started laughing, and chatting amongst themselves. Needless to say, I left without buying anything although I would have if I was treated differently. You are better off walking down the beach to the local vendors…they are more than happy to help you and are not rude in the process.

It’s unfortunate that such a beautiful place, with such great potential was so un-impressive when it comes to service. You only have one chance to impress a first time guest. Sorry, but we would never pay that kind of money for this level of service, regardless of how beautiful the grounds are. There are plenty of other resorts along that same stretch of beach that wouldn't have to go very far to provide better service than was provided to us by most of the staff at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: peter m
reviews.title: staff was excellent
reviews.text:
The staff was excellent throughout. two noteworthy individuals were Ramon and Starky at the Star bar. they were always busy but always attentive and remembered who I was and what I preferred after a single visit.
Our butler, Bienvenido Vasquez was always available and made sure we had no wants that were not attended to.

reviews.author: Laura Lee
reviews.title: GROUP & CONVENTIONS BUSINESS CENTER FANTASTIC SERVICE
reviews.text: We received very excellent service from start to finish during our Conventions Program at the Beautiful Paradisus Palma Real, Omar Hernandez was especially helpful with all of the details needed to facilitate our activities. Thank you Omar for your amazing service and pleasant attitude, we are looking forward to come back soon to Punta Cana!!!!

reviews.author: Karen R
reviews.title: Great Get Away ~ Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real.  We had a great time enjoying a beautiful resort, great food, and exceptional service.  We stayed in the Royal Service accommodations, which we would highly recommend.  Our room was beautiful and the setting was very private.  As part of the Royal Service experience, you have a personal butler. Our butler was Jonfi Rivera.  He was exceptional.  We met him just moments after arriving at the resort, where he took us on a tour and made reservations for us for dinner for all of the nights we would be at the resort at a wide variety of restaurants.  Jonfi made a point to find us each day of our stay to see how we were doing and to find out if there was anything that we needed and to find out how we enjoyed our experience the day before. Although he had other clients besides us, he always made us feel special and gave us his undivided attention when we were together.
The resort was beautiful, as was the beach locale.  The private beach was full of comfortable palapas and shaded lounge chairs as well as waiters serving fresh fruit juice and cocktails.  Our favorite waiter was Martin Tineo, who went out of his way to make the resort guests comfortable on the beach.  We surprised Martin by giving him some baseball gear that we brought from home, which he was very appreciative of. 
Our favorite restaurant was the Palazzo.  Our favorite waiter there was Alexander.  He was very personable and helped to make our dining experience very pleasurable.  The hostess, Clara Nunez, was also exceptional, making sure that we got, in our opinion, the best dining table outside, even though we made reservations very late in the day during one of the last days of our stay.
This resort was the perfect place for us to just relax and rejuvinate, which is exactly what we did.  There were also opportunities for water sports on the property, however we didn't use any of them.

reviews.author: Ana A
reviews.title: Group & Convenciones Business Lounge
reviews.text: I'm very grateful and satisfied with the service and kindness received from Omar Hernandez during our stay in Paradisus. Everybody was very helpful and diligent, but some of them, like Omar,went above and beyond. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: CLAUDIO476
reviews.title: EXCELLENCE HUMAN SERVICE
reviews.text:
this is my 7 th time that I go to this resort and day by day the experience is more incredible, the personal attention is excellent and the resort is incredible, I really suggest again.
enjoy the paradisus like me.

reviews.author: Dariodos87
reviews.title: Excelencia y Grandeza
reviews.text:
Grandeza, definido por RAE  magnitud - majestuosidad - majestuoso, Este hotel entra en esta definición, no solo por su estructura, si no aun mas importante por sus colaboradores, el servicio, la dedicación de cada una de las personas que trabaja en el hotel, restaurantes, barras, playa, seguridad, es un lugar sin dudas único en el mundo. Se nos había extraviado un elemento personal y pensando que ya no podía recuperarlo estaba en recepción, siempre había un personal atento y dispuesto a servir y sin dudarlo agradezco todo el servicio. En especial quería agradecer a Ramón Fuego y Fueguito que nos atendieron en forma excelente en la barra del Skar Bar al lado del Market Grill, INCREIBLE! RAMONN FERNET CON COCA!!! BANANAMAMA!!! Y EL EXCLUSIVO COCO LOCO!!!!!!!! sin dudas lo mejor!!! Buena vida para todos!!! Nos volveremos a encontrar!!!! 

ME LLEVO UNA FRASE DE UNO DE LOS CHICOS! EN PALMA TODO ES POSIBLE! 

Saludos!

Dario 
Mendoza Argentina!

reviews.author: x_needles
reviews.title: Relax and unwind….
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the beach second to none - definitely recommend spending the morning on the beach to catch the cool winds and beautiful water.  We went here to relax and rejuvenate and thats just what we did.  All of the restaurants were very nice and would recommend the dine around program so that you can try them. We were especially well taken care of at the restaurant buffet by Juan Suarez.  We were greeted each day with a smile and a cheerful "my people!" Juan made sure we had everything we wanted, even if it wasn't a usual request.    The spa was a wonderful experience, except for the rocks, our guides there were friendly and allowed us to stay and enjoy the attributes long after our massages.  Great place to go to kick back and enjoy the quiet.

reviews.author: Savina T
reviews.title: Great Resort- Terrible WiFi service
reviews.text:
We stayed 2 night at the hotel. Very impressive property, super friendly staff who speak excellent English and who also are patient when you butcher the Spanish language.

The food was excellent both buffet and the restaurants. The drinks served at the bar beside where they have the buffet was amazing. I had a strawberry martini, the bartender, crushed fresh strawberries used to shelf booze and the result was Amazeballs. 

The room was huge, looked like a Suite. The let down for this hotel was the WiFi was so unreliable it was hard to get things done. We were there on business.

reviews.author: Tom F
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Visiting this resort was a great experience.  We were in the Royal Service area of the resort and our butler, Johnfi, was excellent and attentive in everyway.  I highly recommend this particular service offered by this resort an appreciate the service offered by their quality staff.

reviews.author: Joelia R
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: There are two activity employees at the resort that I want to recognize, Francisco & Reyna. WOW!!  They are amazing, they made my time there so memorable.  The live entertainment was awesome, all of the employees were always willing to serve. The resort is beautiful, clean and so much fun. Amazing how every morning the whole resort was back in reset position and ready to be used to the fullest once again.  All of the employees work so hard and should be appreciated and recognized. They are the ones that make the stay such a pleasure.

reviews.author: Juan F
reviews.title: Group and Conventions - Business Center
reviews.text: I used the business center for various meetings and other purposes during our annual sales convention and was impressed with the facilities and in particular with Omar Hernandez courteous and helpful approach. The facilities are excellent for business conventions, sales events and a perfect venue for family  vacations. They have special areas for children and can make families traveling with children avoid most of the stress associated with travel. If you end up visiting the business center look up Omar Hernandez. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Tammi T
reviews.title: Paradisus says it all!
reviews.text:
Beautiful ambiance everywhere you look... courteous resort and bar staff are there for very question or to help with anything. although there is sometimes a bit  of a language barrier, if you just keep trying, you will both 'get it' .. Wonderful staff to help with excursions and restaurant reservs. Wonderful businss center with terrific helpful staff~ 

Stunning views from every corner of the resort
The only thing that could be a little better is wi-fi. The connection is very hit and miss. To be sure youre going to do what you need to, go to the business center on the lower level fo the resort.

reviews.author: Morissette D
reviews.title: extraordinaire
reviews.text: Super hotel (si vous avez les moyens $) : super jardin, super plage, super animation, super beau, super bouffe, super service, super activites, mais....super cher. La clientele de la section " reguliere " est une clientele corporative.

reviews.author: Felixolivarez
reviews.title: Group & Convention Business Center excellent servive
reviews.text: Business center was great help for my business thanks to Omar Hernandez and his great costumer service. Being at paradises it had been a great experience, I recommended thanks to all the staff for their great service and attitude and dedication to their work!,

reviews.author: carl p
reviews.title: Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
What a beautiful place.  Experienced the "Royal Service"  and it is worthwhile.
My Butler Francis was the best part of my stay.  He is awesome! Beautiful grounds, awesome restaurants, wonderful staff.  I would definitely return here.
Great nightlife.

reviews.author: DrewScoot
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach - Horrible Service
reviews.text: Staff showed no concern toward service.  I was shocked at how little they seemed to care.  If I were the manager, I would bring the employees together and reemphasize service as being the only defining difference in a customers experience. The food was average at best and sanitation was not the greatest.  Room service was very poor.  As an example, I called for coffee and cream and 2 hours later I finally got it.  Communication with the staff is very difficult unless you are fluent in Spanish.  I am very happy that I got to see Punta Cana but it will be the last time.  If you are going, make sure to do your due diligence before going and don't be shy for demanding better service if needed.  The question is will they listen.  I hope management at the Paradisus is listening!

reviews.author: Stuart M
reviews.title: Tropical Paradise
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our first trip to the Dominican! Excellent service from Luis Diaz @ the pool bar and Warner Ramirez @ Gabi beach Grill! Property was gorgeous, staff hospitable, food overall was ordinary to fair. Very relaxing, internet service was slow and limited.

reviews.author: Cordie
reviews.title: business center
reviews.text: The resort was very nice and friendly. This was a business convention and Omar in the business center was Awesome at getting our devices connected to the internet, which was very important to stay connected to the states. Thank you sooo much for all your help and patience.

reviews.author: Jim G
reviews.title: Royal Service is a Joke
reviews.text: If you want Sushi and want to be treated like crap by your hostess Keniaa...all you have to do is wait 3 hours and still not get a seat.  I just left the resort and had a horrible time.   Although I was listed as royal status and I got a gold wristband....which costs extra....do not think you will be acknowledged.  The WIFI only worked a few hours in the week that I was there.  I was with a group of over 50 people and everyone of us had something broken in our Suites.  If you can get this trip for around 50 bucks then do it...if not run.

reviews.author: Sandy W
reviews.title: 3 AMAZING employees
reviews.text:
I want to let you know we were quests at your hotel from 4/22 to 4/27 with a group called Great Western.  We had the fortune of being served by 3 outstanding employees who made an enormous difference in our experience at your hotel.  Alta gracia Martinez is a massage therapist at your spa who I was lucky enough to have gotten the first time I visited your spa 4/23/14.  She is an amazing therapist who has the skill and knowledge to be an excellent massager and goes beyond that to notice problems and give the extra time and effort to help with problem areas. Because of her expertise I went back 3 times!  Awesome!  

Martin at your Royal service pool was also OUTSTANDING!  He was constantly on the move making sure everyone was being well served and completely went out of his way to see to it mine and my husbands needs were met the entire time we were there!  Even on his days off he left our name and information with his co-worker Francisco Cabrera, who in Martins' absence, saw to it every need was met just like Martin had asked him to.  What amazing team work and responsibility!  They made everyday WONDERFULL!
'
Also Juan Suavez (or Svavez, rest-Buffet)  our waiter who after the first day kept us informed as to where he would be so we could enjoy the same excellent service at each meal was a JOY!  he came to the door and welcomed us at each meal, seated us, and then gave OUTSTANDING service!

We felt, at the end of our trip, we were leaving 3 old friends who, shined SO brightly in their service!  Your resort is so fortunate to have these three, (actually 4) staff members!  I can't tell you the wonderful difference it made in our experience at your resort!

I am an employer in Illinois, USA and am constantly looking for staff of their quality.  I know from years of experience they are an extremely "rare" find!  My husband and I thank them for their exceptional attention to service!

reviews.author: Melinda M
reviews.title: Feeling Pampered
reviews.text:
A wonderful resort full of friendly people! 
This is the resort to go to!
It is the best one I have been to yet in Punta Cana.
Everyone goes above and beyond to make sure you have a great experience.
I was there for work but want to go back for a vacation next time!

reviews.author: Carmelo Padilla
reviews.title: Excelente propiedad, servicio y atenciones
reviews.text:
Es un excelente hotel Tranquilo y Familiar, muy buena comida y bebida, grandes áreas comunes y muy buena ubicación. 
Mejorar un poco el servicio de camareros en los restaurantes ya sea por agotamiento o alta ocupación se tardaban mucho en atender.

reviews.author: Jeffrey K
reviews.title: Thank You!
reviews.text:
Special Thanks to our butler --- Luis
Special Thanks to "Big Mac"
 Both were exceptional!!     
 The resort was outstanding, clean and the service was excellent!
Thank you for your wonderful service and for a great and memorable vacation!

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: WOW A GREAT TRIP
reviews.text: I stayed in the royal area, The butler "ALONZO" was fantastic, seeing to our every need. He really works hard. The beach, pools and bars were all fantastic. The food was OK not fantastic. I would stay there again

reviews.author: Holly K
reviews.title: Pedro Cedano - Beach Butler extraordinaire!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a business conference that my husband attended and had a fabulous time!  We stayed on the Royal Service side of the hotel and my favorite hotel employee was Pedro Cedano on the beach.  He is happy, obviously loves serving the guests and is ready to help you in any way possible.  There is a lovely fruit stand on that side of the hotel and you can get fresh fruit smoothies all day - served with a smile by Diego. This is a lovely hotel and the all-inclusive is very convenient and top notch quality.  My husband and I enjoyed the delicious paella at the Market Grill at lunch everyday.  

On the Royal Service side you are supposed to receive the services of a butler during your stay.  Although our personal butler was not attentive to us, there were other couples in our group that had wonderful personal attention by their butlers - most notably, Luis - small, but powerful!  He actually took over the duties for our butler to complete our stay.  

The resort is clean and activities are numerous to choose from both day and night.  We also took an off-site excursion with ZipLine Adventures and it was terrific!  Although they indicated it would be a 3 hour outing and it actually turned out to be 6 hours, but wouldn't trade the experience - it was excellent.

reviews.author: Keith R
reviews.title: The Beach & Pool Service Saved the Trip
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, the rooms are very nice, The Royal Service area was great...much more private.  The food was average.  The communication challenge was surprising.  I speak english and very few of the staff sould communicate with me effectively.  The butler service was disappointing.  Only asked for something a times but they didn't get done.  I would have been very disappoined withthe entire stay had it not been for Super Billy Leo.  They are the pool butler and bartender.  They were very attentive and made up for quite a few problems we experienced elsewhwere.  Thanks Leo and Super Billy for saving the trip!

reviews.author: ColoHiwayBuilder
reviews.title: WOW!!! Royal Service was Awesome!!!!!!
reviews.text:
We recently spent 5 days at the Paradisus Palma Real in the Royal Service side of the resort and the experience was excellent. Our butler (Fermin Moto) made our stay absolutely perfect. He was on top of his game and tended to every request that we had, from making dinner reservations to handling tee times and spa appointments. He went above and beyond the normal call of duty to ensure that our stay was absolutely "First Class". If we were not around our phone, he would find us on the beach to make sure that we did not need anything, and to find out what else he could do to make our stay more enjoyable. 

 There are two other individuals who also went above and beyond to make sure our stay was first rate; Leonardo Mota (Royal Service Pool Bartender) and Pedro (beach and pool waiter). Leonardo was always very friendly and willing to mix up any type of cocktail that you would request, including his "Leonardo's Special". He was very engaging and made everyone feel right at home while doing an excellent job of manning the bar. Pedro also went out of his way to ensure that we were well taken care of during our lazy days on the beach. After our first day, he knew our preferences and was waiting for my wife the following day with our beach towels and chairs already set up. He was a true pleasure to be around and was always  friendly and smiling. These three individuals made our trip truly memorable.

Although this was probably the nicest resort property that we have ever had the pleasure of staying at, there were some items that could be done better to make this a truly "one of a kind" resort. The main issue was the food was merely average. I realize that this is typically the case at all inclusives, but with such a nice resort, I guess our expectations were somewhat higher. Although the food was not terrible, there were often times that the meals were not hot when they arrived, and the choices were limited. 
The property itself was in great shape and the rooms were very nice and well appointed. It appeared that the maintenance on the property was well taken care of, as we saw many people tending to the grounds, as well as performing other functions around the resort to ensure that the property maintained such a high quality.
I would not hesitate to recommend this resort to anyone who is thinking about Punta Cana for their next vacation.

reviews.author: Disappointed Pl... D
reviews.title: DO NOT VACATION HERE - Absolutely Horrible Experience
reviews.text: To say that I had a bad experience would be an understatement. While the hotel grounds were lovely, my room smelled musty and had flies, mosquitos and visible mold spots on the walls. We were there for a corporate event and Camilo Pache was out hotel liaison. ABSOLUTELY AWFUL SERVICE!!! There was clearly a language barrier and instead of trying to understand what we needed, he would just say "yes" and our requests were never fulfilled. Due to his negligence and poor communication we never received our boxes with gifts for our attendees. There was also a massive fire that burned down the main restaurant area of the resort during our stay. The fire was caused by fireworks that were set off on the beach way too close to the restaurant buildings. I personally witnessed a piece of the fireworks land on one of the thatched roofs of Naos Buffet and start the fire. We were beyond disappointed with our experience at Paradisus and would NEVER return. In fact, we will NEVER return to the Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: TLC121212
reviews.title: a great get away, relaxing with pristine views of the beach
reviews.text: We were fortunate to enjoy this trip as part of an awards program through my husband's company.  We haven't been to the caribbean together, but will say we look forward to going back.  The Reserve was wonderful.  We loved Steeve Phillipe our Butler.  He had a great personality, was very accommodating, and addressed our needs.  We really enjoyed the Reserve only restaurant for breakfast and lunch.  The breakfast offerings were healthy with the green juice and loved the mango gazpacho - yum!! The opportunity to find lounge chairs on the beach and have wonderful servers come out frequently was such an indulgence. The whole trip was really an indulgence.  Well worth it!!  We loved the Reserve lounge as well, a great spot to do some work if needed, get a snack or drink, and to hang out out of the sun.  Only critique would be that the rooms are a bit worn, they could use some updating - e.g. we had to hip check the door open, but hey we are in Caribbean paradise so we'll take it.  Wonderful location for a relaxing get away.

reviews.author: SpaceCoastDave
reviews.title: Geat group property
reviews.text:
I am a meeting planner, and just had the pleasure of staying for 3 weeks with 2 different corporate groups.  The staff was amazing, and the food was great.  My butler, Juan de Leon was so great the first time, I requested him for me and some of the executives.  He was always there helping us out with everything, and was awesome.
I will be coming back with my wife to enjoy this property for our personal vacation.

reviews.author: Karen A
reviews.title: Wonderful resort!
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort with amazing beach (white sands and turquoise water) as well as pools.  The rooms were lovely as well.  Juan de Leon was our butler for the time we were there and he did an exceptional job -- he was very responsive to our requests and attentive to what we might need. The spa was so serene and beautiful, with all the amenities -- had a great massage and spa pedicure. We had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: Sherryann S
reviews.title: Business visit and i did not know until i got there not good
reviews.text: We had the opportunity of visiting this resort was good the food was good we were invited to see the hotel we thought that was cool so we went only to find out they were trying to get us to buy shares that was not cool I wasted half of my first day hearing about shares when I could have spent it relaxing my problem was them not telling me the truth don't lie don't go around the bush let me choose because if I knew this was about shares I would not have gone.

reviews.author: Teambibi
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: This was my first visit to an all inclusive resort. Upon arrival, we found our room smelled of cigarettes and the front desk staff immediately changed our room. Was pleased to see that our luggage had been transferred and it was a very nice room. The grounds, pool area and beach were beautiful; however, the food was not so great.  What made my stay memorable was the staff. Everyone went out of their way to be accommodating and were very friendly. Ramon Fuego at the pool bar was very entertaining and made the best drinks.   On our last night, after a company banquet, there was a fire in one of the restaurants, caused by fireworks from a wedding. Although there was no alarm, the staff tried to get everyone off the property as quickly and safely as possible. Our rooms were not affected by the fire; however some of our friends had to have their rooms moved due to smoke damage.  Next day, it was business as usual.

reviews.author: michael f
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego is fantastic
reviews.text: Great weather, incredible service by poolside bartender/entertainer Ramon Fuego.  Great place to relax.  Rooms were comfortable and fridge always stocked with water/coke/beer.  The only knock is the quality of food was not to our tastes, but it might just be us.  Other than that an excellent relaxing experience.

reviews.author: Stefano Di Nardo
reviews.title: Un struttura come dice il nome  paradisiaca!!
reviews.text: Una vacanza lavoro stupenda !! 10 giorni trascorsi veramente stupendo!! Animazione - cucina- bar !! Tutto al top ! Simpatia !!! Amore per il proprio lavoro !! Questo fa del personale delle persone stupende !!!!  In particolare all'acqua bar ed i suoi barman il signore Ramon Fuego la signora Gloria Rodriguez veramente bravissimi!!! Voglio ringraziare il direttore Rafael Torres ! Per aver scelto questi lavoratori veramente speciali!! Grazie a loro ho dimenticato l'Italia ed i suoi problemi!!! Immensamente grazie a tutti dj Stefano di nardo !!

reviews.author: albertodao
reviews.title: Un paraiso
reviews.text: El hotel es grande,bonito y bastante bien cuidado,las habitaciones comodas,grandes ,les falta un poco de retoque,ya acusan el paso del tiempo, en la reserve es espectacular todo y el bar de la piscina los barman son de lujo, y especiales ,siempre para complacer, si por algun motivo tienes una queja,la resuelven de inmediato,sin dilacion, la gerente general del hotel es la persona mas eficiente y diligente que conozco, la comida debe mejorar en los restaurantes del hotel principal, es un hotel para volver mil veces

reviews.author: polancomariel
reviews.title: Beautiful property with over the top service
reviews.text:
