This hotel is just beautiful! the white sand beaches and crital clear water obviously helps it, but the pool is also just awesome :) what I first noticed was the 5 star service, starting at the security gate. Everyone is so curteous and seems genuin which makes it even better. 
Everyone seems always eagered to help and make the best of your stay. The rooms are wonderfull, nothing wrng with it. I satyed at a double room with 2 beds, but the beds were big and comfortable. I was not a fan of the pillow since they were a bit hard for my liking.

The food did not impress me. the buffet has lots of choices but nothing really blew my mind even though they had flavor. The grilled meat was hard and lacked flavor and the ice cream quality could improve. This was the only think that could really use improvement but thats just me being picky because of the category the hotel has. I did not get a chance to visit the well known martin aristegy restaurant, Passion but hopefully i get the change in the future.

Overall the hotel is beautiful and the service will make the best of your stay guaranteed, Although i went for business, it´s great for families and couples as well.

reviews.author: Julie S
reviews.title: Fabulous stay!
reviews.text: Our first time at an all inclusive resort. We were in the Royal Service area of the hotel, so we had access to a nicer restaurant and a personal butler to make any reservations for dinner or activities. The staff is super friendly, but for us, the standout is Luis Diaz. You will find him daily at the pool bar. Makes everyone feel like a lifelong friend and entertains us all with his dancing and balancing of drinks on his head. All in all, the place is beautiful, memorable and relaxing.

reviews.author: Isabel S
reviews.title: Humbling Staff
reviews.text: The staff is what makes this place SO amazing!  from Juan Suarez and Kelvin in the buffet, to Pablo at Passion, to the waiter at the business center who remembered how I liked my coffee from the previous day.  Our housekeeper was also very attentive, and satisfied our every request.

reviews.author: William N
reviews.title: Outstanding Bech Property!
reviews.text: Your property is beautiful! Everywhere you look & wander on the property you find beauty & whimsicalness. The outstanding feature is your Service Personnel. You can have it all, but if your Service Personnel fall short, the experience is not memorable at all. We found 5 star service at all of the restaurants & bars, the front desk, the beach service. the Butlers, just everyone you employ at your hotel were only concerned about our well being & comfort. The were friendly, upbeat, efficient, classy & just perfect! We wanted for nothing during our stay. We wish that we had gotten everyone's name to applaud them, but we did not. We want to mention Pedro Cedano, the Beach Manager at The Grand Reserve, Leonardo Moto, the Bartender from The Sunset Bar & Gloria from The Sunset Bar were awesome! They do their job with grace & style & are always happy & upbeat. They took care of us & made us laugh! We also want to mention Anabellis OZuna, Allagracia Pio & Luis Moitinez at The Lobby were also terrific when we had our night caps every evening. We travel to 4 & 5 star properties when we travel & you are number one in our book. My Wife also used to work in Corporate Group Travel & she is a tough critic, but you most definitely have her won over. Your Hotel is wonderful! By the way, did you plan on that beautiful full moon while we were there? :) Thank you for a wonderfully memorable experience & we will be back for sure!!

reviews.author: Shailesh S
reviews.title: My Stay at the Palma Real - Bad Experience
reviews.text:
I came to the Palma real hotel as a part of our annual company trip in Punta Cana from Feb 26 to Mar 2, 2014. We were a group of around 70 people.

My brother  accompanied me on this trip and he lost his cellphone in the hotel. And now it looks like the phone was stolen by one of the cleaning staff in the Palma Real resort. I have the picture of the lady who has the phone. I recognize this person as she once came to clean our room. She is currently using this phone and we got her information through Whatsapp. She has posted her display picture on whatapp on my brother's phone. Therefore, the attached image is showing against my brother's contact. 

I am very disappointed with this incident and would expect our cellphone to be returned to us at the earliest. I reported this matter to the concerned people at the hotel but havent really heard back yet.

I am sure your hotel doesnt encourage these practices but some of your staff members are giving a bad name to your hotel. We came on our annual company trip and Mastech is planning to come back to your hotel next year as well. However, this incident will really force us to reconsider our decision.

reviews.author: laRousse428
reviews.title: Amazing service in the business center!
reviews.text: I just arrived for a week long conference, was walking the property (gorgeous by the way) and I was having trouble getting the wifi to work on my iPad. So I stopped in to the business center to see if I could retrieve emails on their computers.  Omar Hernandez said he could help, and voila, he fixed it in 3 seconds! I highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: Sue R
reviews.title: Francis Castillo A Name You Must Remember!
reviews.text: We had the time of our lives at Paradisus and this was all due to the best Butler and Hero Francis Castillo. For anyone who is looking for a professional that really cares about the customer experience ask for him!  The hotel and food was outrageously amazing.  You must go and get some fun and sun but remember.. ask for Francis!!! :)

reviews.author: Gianni T
reviews.title: Truly amazing experience
reviews.text: Truly amazing experience!!!. this hotel not to be missed. Stayed in the Royal Service section of the hotel it's worth the extra £. Truly amazing experience!!!. Truly amazing experience!!!. Truly amazing experience!!!.

reviews.author: KKOHLER2014
reviews.title: Thank You to Royal Service Staff for a Wonderful Experieince!
reviews.text: My husband and I were fortunate to experience Royal Service on this, our second trip to this fabulous destination. Excellent food, wine and top shelf liquor! Beautiful pools with great service and a beach that brings all the comforts you could desire! Don't be too surprised when the "gardner" brings you the FRESH coconut from the tree he just groomed and chops that top right off in front you. He even goes to get you a straw so you can enjoy your coconut water! Who does that!!!!!!!!!!Amazing! The staff is unmatched! Our Butler, Jose couldn't do enough for us and our beach guy PEDRO was unmatched! Entertainment every night. Polite, friendly staff! To the staff at PALAZZO, you were the best! Stay at this hotel! Meet these wonderful people and expect to be pampered! They will not disappoint! See you all again very soon!

reviews.author: Kjencon
reviews.title: "Paradise" after a Snowy Cold Winter!
reviews.text: Just returned from a 6 day trip with my husband. Absolute paradise. Sparkling clean, friendly staff, delicious variety of food and restaurants, (Hector Serrano at Bana was a wonder at the Hibachi Table - entertaining and fabulous chef.) pools and beaches with tons of great servers especially Pedro in the Royal Service section, nightly entertainment for all ages to enjoy, dance club, and more. There are many activities/water sports to part take or just relax on beach or in pools as we did! Looking into a return trip next year already!

reviews.author: Jeff H
reviews.title: Safety Beware
reviews.text:
While eatting breakfast at the buffet a cat was walking around. This cat had been there for the past few days. Like any normal child my son put his hand down to rub the cat, it bit him. I asked the Staff for some peroxide, benadryl, to place on the bite because it had started to swell pretty big. They brought us a band aid. Really??

The next night my son was taking a shower, he is 19 and weights about 140, his foot went through the shower floor. Luckily he did not get cut by the sharp edges from the broken shower floor. We called maintenance after 1 hour no one had shown up. I went to the front desk, explained what had happened, was told to go back to our room and wait. After 2 hours no one had shown up. By this time it was 9:30 pm. After going down to the front desk again, they moved us to another room.

The night before check out we went to the front desk to make sure everything was in order for check out. They said we needed to pay for an extra night, which was not right. After 1 hour, they found their mistake and said everything was fine.

On our morning of departure, we went to the front desk to check out. AGAIN they said we needed to pay for an extra night. We explained we went through this last night and we do not owe for another night. The girl that helped us the night before was at the front counter but didnt seem to remember anything about it, even though she worked with us for over 1 hour the night before. Our bus for the airport was leaving and if we didnt get on it, We might miss our flight. The front desk still insisted we owed for another night even though we had the papers that said we didnt. At these resorts, if the hotel does not release you, they will not take you to the airport. After the situation got pretty loud and ugly, they determined it was their error and released us from the resort.

WE had gone with a group of 100 other people. After returning home, this exact thing had happened to a few others.

BEWARE....of this scam! They know that you have to be released from the resort before the shuttles will take you to the airport and if they hold you long enough you will take a chance of missing your flight. 

Other than the problems we had it was a pretty resort.

reviews.author: M H
reviews.title: Luxurious Stay
reviews.text: They constantly had things you could do if you wanted but if not, you were able to relax without any bother.  It was a beautiful resort - pictures dont show the best qualities.  Romone in the pool bar was amazing!

reviews.author: Christy W
reviews.title: Friendly staff beautiful views
reviews.text: The resort is incredibly beautiful & a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere. I had nothing less than incredible service from all of the staff. I only rated this 4 because I feel the food left a little to be desired. It was good but not great. The Presidente was always cold & views are stunning.

reviews.author: alex r
reviews.title: Great Rooms & Staff
reviews.text:
The facilities are beautiful and well kept.  The staff are ALL friendly... "hola, que pasa" with big smiles on their faces.  They truly appreciate having you there.  The food is good during the day, much better if you get a reservation in one of the restaurants.  You generally can't get into a restaurant without a reservation (even if they aren't very busy).  
The pool is great for couples and families.  The swim-up bar is also great for adults and kids.  The bartenders are fun and nice to the kids that come up for a virgin daquiri and a bag of chips.  I found that if you tip the bartenders they will remember you when they get busy.
The beach is definitely the best beach we've enjoyed.  A short walk up the beach, however, will lead you into a gauntlet of local salespeople asking if you want a massage, or to parasail, or to see their shop.  
We went to Gabi for dinner and had a very good meal.  We also ate at Aqua (at the Reserve) and had an excellent meal with truly outstanding service.  
If you are a wine connoisseur, look out!  The house wine is Gato Negro ($4.00 at Trader Joes) and the wine for purchase selection is very pricey (roughly $45-300).
Our room was a basic jr deluxe, and it was great.  We looked at the other room types and didn't see the value.  I mean, truly, it's an all-inclusive do you really need a kitchen?  I can't speak to the butler service, but the pool and beach ammenities for the VIPs wasn't really any different than the general beach and pool, maybe a few more day beds.
We went on the free snorkel trip.  It isn't run by the resort, but it's right next door.  We could definitely tell we were 'off the reservation'.  They weren't quite as friendly and I'm not confident that if we weren't paying close attention, that we wouldn't be finding another boat to bring us back.  Our "captain" was seriously distracted.  Maybe he just had a bad day :)
Overall, we absolutely loved Palma Real and have already booked another trip in June!

reviews.author: ishkasister
reviews.title: True Paradise!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this lovely resort from Feb. 27 to March 6, 2014. We have previously stayed at the Iberostar Bavaro. We would definitely choose this resort over the Iberostar. We stayed in a Master suite with neither pool nor ocean view on the ground floor. The room was huge and spotless, with the best stocked fridge we have ever seen in an all-inclusive. The bed was comfortable and there were two bathroom sinks which was a bonus.  The only drawback was the room backed onto an outer driveway which had service vehicles and bus trams using it 24 hours a day. So through the large sliding doors and windows, voices and vehicle noise could be heard at all times.If it hadn't been for this issue the room would have been perfect. The extensive grounds were stunning and immaculately maintained. The beach was beautiful, clean white sand and also very well kept. Beach towels were in abundance, clean, and always available. We had no problems finding beach or pool chairs. Covered huts were more difficult to acquire, but could usually be found in the later afternoon, either by beach or pool.

The food was definitely up scaled in comparison to the Iberostar. There was always something great at all the buffets, and the cleanliness and presentation of the items was fantastic. The cappuccinos are delicious! It seemed that there were only very late bookings available at the restaurants but we were fine with this as we were on our second honeymoon and wished to avoid children! However, even at 10:00pm at night there were still crying kids in the restaurants. They have tried very hard to make the dining an upscale experience, the presentation, and lovely white tablecloths, candles, and server etiquette all help to enhance the meals.

The public washrooms are beyond immaculate and are cleaned constantly. The staff are so helpful and sweet, they go above and beyond to help you. Please, please , tip them generously, the average wage for them is only $175 American per month!!

The open air poolside food hut  called the Hydro Grill was absolutely amazing! Gourmet burgers, salads, and the best potato wedges ever are served here! We loved this little place and the great people working here:  Jose Reinso, Valentin Caminero, Ramon Simbert, Melvon Brizon, and F. Martinez deserve the highest accolades for their outstanding service. Celso Peralta that worked in the Vento restaurant was also an amazing server.

With regards to the pool, the two whirlpool enclosures with the pillars were not working. There was a light that appeared disconnected floating within the water that looked a little sketchy. We informed them of this issue at the the front desk and hopefully this will be addressed. The concierge Annabel was very pleasant and accommodating. The sweetest, most helpful member of the staff was by far Bianka Vargas, a hostess who rotates throughout the day at the different eating venues. We will miss her greatly! All the employees have obviously been very well trained in the art of customer service. We appreciated them very, very much. They try so hard even with their limited English and we had no trouble communicating with them.
It is too bad that smoking is allowed in the open air restaurants, we had to leave a reserved booking one evening as there was a couple smoking a few feet away as we were about to eat. We were able to enjoy our meal at another reserved restaurant called Aqua.  If there was no smoking allowed, the eating experiences would have been perfect.
All in all, we had a wonderful , relaxing time at this resort and didn’t want to leave. This resort is almost close to perfect, just needs a few tweaks , and it will become idyllic. It  has risen from number 39 on trip advisor to number 3 or 4! Keep it up Paradisus Punta Cana!

reviews.author: KANDPO O
reviews.title: Great work vacation!
reviews.text: My husband and I were treated to his hard year of work with a trip to this all-inclusive hotel.   The rooms were beautiful and the hotel had spectacular views from the moment you walk into the lobby.  There were a lot of activities to enjoy but our favorite one was sitting at the swim up bar with our amazing bartenders!  We had almost 400 people traveling with his work and most of us knew them by name.   They always had smiles for us and treated us to our drinks in creative ways (Ramón).  The beaches were beautiful and so was the water!  Everything was great but I would say the food was okay.  I didn't gain weight at an all-inclusive is all I am saying.   It left room for the swim-up bar.:)   If you go, you should definitely belly-up to that swim-up bar and say hello to Ramón, Fuego, Luis & Gustavo!  They were wonderful!  If we get back there someday we will go to more of the entertainment shows.   They all sounded great but we didn't make it to any this time.

reviews.author: k7868
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Awesome all inclusive resort. Especially exceptional service provided by George at Gabi beach. Look him up. He had our chairs set up with towels on the beach prior to our arrival each day and went out of his way to look after us. Beautiful resort. Mole restaurant was our favorite.

reviews.author: Russell R
reviews.title: Great Experience - Royal Service
reviews.text: Went with a group for a recognition trip. Stayed in the Royal Services area. Accommodations were great. Wished the bathroom had a double sink! All of the staff was super nice. Special shout out to our beach/pool concierge Super Billy, who made sure we were set every day with a spot and continuous drinks. Our butler, Francis Castillo, was top notch. Really went the extra mile with reservations for dinner, dry cleaning, newspaper and much more. Ask for Francis!!! Property is beautiful and super clean.

reviews.author: robbnjess
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay at Pardisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We were very happy with our recent stay at Paradisus Palma Real.  We did not choose this resort but enjoyed our stay.  Our room was on the second floor.  We did not have the musty smells that some referred too.  We did bring candles with us and air freshners but didn't end up needing them.  Staff was very courteous to our needs.  We chose not to pay the extra for the Royal Service.  Some in our group did and weren't sure they would again.  I think it is really up to the individual traveler.  I don't need someone to run a bath for me.  I am happy to do that myself.  Also, when we were around the pool and beach areas lounging, there were plenty of staff that were more than willing to get drinks for us.  We made sure to tip everyone and they were always checking on us to see if we needed anything.  One thing to keep in mind is this is an island and island time is completely different than main land time.  That said, they were always courteous and genuine, but sometimes it took a little while to get coffee or other beverages.  I don't think that is specific to this resort though. :)  The food at Aqua was amazing.  It was our best meal by far.  Market Grill was great at lunch but just ok at dinner. Their pork tacos were so good.  Once we discovered them we had them three straight days for lunch.  We also ate at Bano Bistro and Bano Tapanyaki.  Both were yum!   Friends of ours ate at Passion and said it was amazing. We had quite a few friends eat at Mole and said it was not good (some even got sick).  There was a wedding held there while we were there and it was beautiful.  Held by the Tortuga pond over a little bridge - stunning.  Pool was amazing.  We spent a lot of time there and loved every minute.  I was able to get a lot of reading done and loved that they would keep bringing me iced teas. :)  

My husband and I did not have any issues with getting sick or feeling ill from food or water but we were careful to not drink the tap water.  We left a tip for our house keeping staff every morning before we left our room.  We also left packs of gum, candies, chapstick, etc.  It was a little odd to us that sometimes our supplies were replenished and sometimes not.  We also got the feeling that some of these supplies (shampoos, etc.) were just refilled.  

The resort has kayaks and boats and boards that are free to use.  A great service and lots of fun. 

Although there were children at the resort, we would not bring our children to anywhere in this area, not just this resort.  It did not seem to be kid friendly to us - a lot of drinking and half naked people.  This is of course our personal opinion.  We found it to be much more conducive to couples, singles or groups of friends rather than family oriented.  If we wanted to take our family on a trip in this neck of the woods we would go to Puerto Rico instead and not a resort in Punta Cana.  That said, there were many children there of all ages. In fact, more than we anticipated we would see.

reviews.author: Marty H
reviews.title: This is Paradisus
reviews.text: I am not sure where to begin. I took my wife to Paradisus for her 50th B-day. It was a beautiful well kept facility with some of the best service we have ever received at any resort in our life. Alvaro Fernandez made sure everything was taken care of and he did special decorations for her B-Day in our room-Cake, balloons and a Happy B-day sign. The B-day started with what she described as an ":excellent"  massage form Altagracia Martinez. The Royal Service was well worth it. Every day we were treated to the best Beach Service from Martin Tineo, Pedro Cedano and Nelson at the Bar. It was 6 days of fun in a beautiful place!  Thanks for a great stay!

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Amazing Home Away From Home
reviews.text: We visited the Paradisus the last week of January 2014. We stayed for a week and absolutely loved it! It was part of a business trip but everything was amazing from our room to the food and our excursion. We had our room facing the gardens and it was beautiful to wake up to each morning.. try to get a room on the third floor as other people had not enjoyed the mosquitos on the first floor and the noise from guests. We had private events to attend for dinners but we did get to try the NAOS buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner throughout the week. The food was great and delicious. We tried the Market Grill - I would prefer to eat at NAOS, the food at the Market Grill wasn't as good. We had dinner at Gabi Beach - the shrimp and steak is amazing, but the desserts aren't what you think - I would avoid it. We also went to Mole for Mexican, it was pretty good too. The resort is beautiful and has everything you could possibly want including a swim up bar, beachfront, activities, etc. We took the shuttle to the shopping mall - it was great for souvenirs, but I wouldn't recommend purchasing anything else as it was overpriced. If you can, go on an excursion and try ziplining if you are adventurous! It was absolutely amazing! Thank you to Ramone, Luis, Big Mac, Nicholas and everyone for making our trip so memorable and amazing! ZIP, ZIP... LINE, LINE!!!

reviews.author: MrsS71159
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at Paradisus on their 'Royal Service' package.   Our room was spacious and lovely.  The resort is well maintained and the constantly available food was good, and often great.  The pool area is terrific, especially the pupalas, which are huge bali beds with thatched roofs over them.  (They have them on the beach too.)  

The best part of royal service is the butler that comes with it--ours was Jose.  He drew me a bubble bath with flower petals every evening, reserved me a pupala everyday, and when I needed it made reservations for dining etc. for me.  We had a cell phone that we used to stay in touch with him, and he checked on us a couple of times a day just to make sure we were happy.

I'm not usually a fan of the Caribbean because I like to run around and sight see when I go on vacation, but with the polar vortex this winter, I needed the break!  If you are going to the area and want a deluxe, pampered, stress free vacation, the Paradisus in Punta Cana is the place!

reviews.author: H. Luiz Martinez
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana/Palma Real Hospitality in NYC!
reviews.text: I'm here at the New York Times TRAVEL Show and of course I make a beeline for one of my favorite Hotel establishments: Melia Hotels International, Paradisus Palma Real and Paradisus Punta Cana. Leticia Del Rosario is as warm and welcoming expert, that I didn't mind that it was 12 Degrees Fahrenheit (-11.1111 Celsius) outside today in NYC. I've received the amazing treatment I come to expect of the "Dominican" Brand. I felt a sense of Pride knowing someone was there to take FULL care of me, just like Eduardo Perera, Gemma, Rondon,and Enmanuel Sanchez does every time we go to the Dominican Republic Paradisus Punta Cana. After seeing Leticia Del Rosario, I've decided that we're going back yet again - possibly in May!!

reviews.author: Gary M
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was nothing less that fantastic!  When you go there, you are treated like royalty.  While everyone when came into contact were more than gracious to assist us three in particular stood out -  Leonardo, Super Billy, and Martim Timeo.  All were at the poolside bar in the Royal Service area... My wife and I are certainly planning to come back again... We have been to many places around the world and this resort, by far, has been the best!
Thanks for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Pauline R
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Great Service and great time.  The rooms and the entire property were clean.  All of the staff was great.  The food was the best I've had at an all inclusive. They gym was very clean.  We all enjoyed the theater and finger painting.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: Overall Great Experience
reviews.text:
Let me qualify this review:  I am 'not' an all-inclusive type person BUT this was a 'business' trip with my husband's vendor so we go every year to a different resort.

I would say this one was great EXCEPT for the food - it was marginal.......Gabi Beach was best bet for lunch and dinner - the lobster was actually really good and I am a Florida girl so know my lobster.  I am a 'foodie' and organic so food just did not appeal to me.

The rooms were great - no funkie smells, very clean and we had an amazing view of the ocean.

We had the Royal Service and it was great - our butler, Adelso was so sweet and accommodating.   The Royal Service includes a nice lounge and great cheeses and relaxing.   

The beaches are one of the best.....plenty of room to walk and enjoy.   The Royal Service pool a bit small but just tip the people taking care of chairs and they will set you up everyday where you want to be and bring you drinks.

Speaking of TIPS - DO IT!!!  It is very much appreciated and the service is great.

Our butler, Adelso Reyes - he was great and he made sure we had everything we needed.  He would recognize us and just check to see if everything was OK.  May be you just want ice and he would be sure you got it.   There was an issue on check in with power in the room, clocks not working, special pillows and customized our beers - only advice is figure out what you need at first and he will take care of it.  After that, I just wanted to enjoy the beaches, tennis and golf.

The golf course was fun - no great ocean views but a nice course and well maintained.  About $110 each for cart fees and golf rentals.  We enjoyed it.

We did pay for the Passion Restaurant - you know - I say don't do it.  VERY AMAZING service and make you feel special but the food - well, no biggie.  But if want a nice dining experience and want to pay for some upgraded wine - then go for it.

We did enjoy the tennis  AND A MUST IS THE SPA.   Even if you just do the water treatment for free with the Royal Service.  ONLY HINT - go to the Reserve Spa (go to lobby and they will bring you but also a beautiful walk if know where going)  and NOT the Royal Service Spa which is smaller and not the same experience.   I had a wonderful 80 minute massage but really the water experience was one I will remember.  I got my husband to do with me and he hates this stuff and he enjoyed.  TIP them as the service people really make it a good experience.  And GO for the COLD (very cold) bath.  

Go check out the grounds - if like to walk it really is beautiful - the beaches are amazing but the grounds and landscaping are just beautiful and loved walking around.  Had to burn of calories some way.  

Another piece of advice for you woman - bring comfortable shoes as it is a hike from rooms to restaurants and VERY large resort.  

SO.......go enjoy......really a nice resort and if you get Adelso for your butler even a better bonus!

reviews.author: 17Dinosaur
reviews.title: Full Service with Wonderful Attitude
reviews.text:
Came for a business meeting and enjoyed many of the amenities as well 
Staff well trained, attentive and willing to do whatever to try to be of help.I had an emergency early morning and they couldn't have been more helpful. Hope I can return for a vacation...(Business office outstanding)

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Hosted a work event at this location and they staff did a wonderful Job.  Special shout out to Pedro working the Royal Service Bar and Alejandro for a great event.        We experienced a major snowstorm that stranded over 20 of our guests, the hotel worked wonders to accommodate our group and ensure everyone was taken care of with special care.

reviews.author: Diane K
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: We had a great time at paradisus recently. We had a lovely suite; clean, comfy and well stocked. The facilities were wonderful; clean pools, fresh, well prepared food and the staff was fast,efficient and friendly. We would highly recommend Paradisus in Punta Cana if you're looking for a great all inclusive getaway-they treat you like royalty!

reviews.author: Harry K
reviews.title: Great trip for work and fun.
reviews.text:
The Paradisus was great.  Being a big group it was a challenge for the staff at the bar, pool and beach on the adult only side as we were constantly making sure everyone was taken care of.  It turned out to be no problem for the staff; Leo made sure everyone had a cool drink in a timely fashion, Super Billy, Martin and Pedro kept the beach crowd happy and the folks at the bar entertained while they waited.

Fermin was our butler and never let a request go by without his full attention.

Thanks to all.  And Martin, thanks for keeping our wives comfortable and cool at the beach. 

Anyone who goes to the Paradisus will do themselves well to find one of these folks to make their stay easy and enjoyable.

HK

reviews.author: C_Simonson
reviews.title: Paradisus raises the bar
reviews.text: I travel 2-3 weeks every month. I am in the service business. I found the service my wife and I received this past week to be simply incredible. Yes, the property  and weather were ideal, but it was the staff that made it magical. The management team should all pat themselves on the back for what they have created. I must point out as well two employees (butlers), Jose Salvador and  Juan DeLeon. These guys "get it" and will invariably be very successful in life. Paradisus should do what ever they can to keep these guys. They make the property more valuable with their presence.

reviews.author: Noah_Webster
reviews.title: Friendly people, musty rooms, faulty printers and stingy showerheads
reviews.text:
The friendliness of the staff is almost enough to offset an underachieving luxury resort experience.  You cannot say enough about the pleasant demeanor and helpful attitude of the staff.  My guess is that if you are in your twenties or thirties and looking for sun, beach, pool and a "vibrant" nightlife, this resort will be just fine for you.

The physical plant, though, fits somewhere between annoying and difficult to live with.  My room was quite musty. I am not that sensitive but my wife, were she here, would have been in agony. While my room was air conditioned that didn't keep my clothes and other materials from wicking up a lot of moisture. 

To get a boarding pass you need to go down to the business center, bring up your pass and then e-mail the pass to the supervisor of the business center.  The computers that guests can use are not hooked up to printers.  The shower is quite elaborate, with sprays in all sorts of directions.  The main shower from above however emits only a thin stream of water with any sort of force.

The resort comes with eight different restaurants.  One, Passion, is fit for the foodie.  The rest are only so so based on my own experience and the members of my group.  In some ways you may be best off going to the buffet, Naos, for most of your meals rather than getting your hopes up for good sushi or Italian at the correspondingly themed restaurants.

The beach in front of the resort is quite nice as is the beach slightly to the north.  Walking along the beach beyond these points is a bit of an experience.  If you travel as a couple you are liable to be offered the opportunity to take a look at a time share.  Traveling as a single male will allow you to get multiple offers for a massage.

reviews.author: pm123va
reviews.title: Alluring relaxation
reviews.text: I went to the Paradisus Palma Real with a work junket.  The place is beautiful, spotless, and the staff was courteous, helpful, kind and responsive.  Our room was large, relaxing, had a fantastic ocean view and the bathroom was luxurious.  The bathtub was large enough to float in with my arms extended! I highly recommend this all inclusive. Some of the food was less than 5 star, but none was below average.  Take the time to book some of the exclusive restaurants.  They are worth it!

reviews.author: Rebekah H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
This is one gorgeous resort! The grounds are well maintained, the beach is clean and oh so pretty! There are a few restaurants on site to chose from and the service was very friendly. My only complaint is that the resort is so widespread it can be a bit of a pain (especially when your friends are on the other side of the resort!) The pathways from the main building/restaurants are VERY poorly lit, and the stairwells up to the rooms are very dark at night too. This was a big drawback for me as I didn't feel comfortable walking back to my room in the dark.

Oh yeah, and watch out for the slippery marble floors! My friend broke her foot when she slipped on the wet flooring.

reviews.author: BpDianeBruce
reviews.title: Beautiful week
reviews.text: The people couldn't have been more friendly. As we were with a rather large group reservations at the various restaurants were made for us in advance with no problems. PASSIONS restaurant was amazing! The room was comfortable and the staff friendly and accommodating. The pool was huge and people enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Stella H
reviews.title: company trip
reviews.text: I would recommend this resort to anyone considering a trip to the Dominican.  The grounds are beautiful.  The resort top tier. The rooms gorgeous.  Food was flavorful and delicious. Fresh ingredients used in concocting the drinks. Staff friendly and helpful. The Sky bar became our favorite retreat. Tucked away in a corner away from the hustle and bustle...There are two bartenders I recommend.  Rosa who comes in at 3 is one of them. Best mojitos I've ever tasted anywhere. All fresh ingredients are used at this bar as with others. However she gives the experience a little something extra. Her personality and smile make you feel like you are the most important person at that moment. I prefer this to bartenders who look like your bothering them when you ask for a drink. So if you go..When you come back from the beach or the pool or before dinner plant yourself here.  Overall one of the best vacations I've ever had.

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: El mejor hotel que he conocido
reviews.text: Es difícil definir con palabras tan linda experiencia, este resort es una experiencia increíble desde que uno ingresa, todos los detalles están perfectamente cuidados y todo el personal del hotel esta comprometido a que los huéspedes se sientan muy bien. Las instalaciones son hermosas, sin duda volvería. Es el hotel mas hermoso en el que me he hospedado.

reviews.author: Natasha R
reviews.title: Very good resort
reviews.text:
This is a 5 star property and they try their best to maintain the rating. The food and rooms are very good, grounds, beach are very well maintained.The only thing I was not impressed about were artificial ponds on the resort that looks like help mosquitoes grow. They provided entertainment throughout the day. Some rooms were a little too far from the main resort area and people had to take shuttle golf carts. Some waiters had difficulty understanding English, knowledge of basic Spanish will definitely help. The ocean was nice and refreshing, a little bit of sea weed, 
but it did not bother me at all, plenty of chairs and umbrellas available.
Recommendation: keep valuables in the safe and check ALL drawers and closets and under your bed before you leave.I personally had no issues but my colleagues were surprised to find their things in some unusual spots in the room where they did not leave them. 
Overall, it was a very enjoyable stay, will readily return.

reviews.author: D M
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience in the Dominican Republic!
reviews.text:
First impressions of the hotel, beautiful, well-maintained and attention to detail taken seriously at this resort. From the delicious fruit juice drink offered upon arrival, matching color-coded uniforms, to the consistent smiling and helpful faces around the hotel, I felt pampered by beauty and luxury as well as safe and secure, always able to get assistance of any kind, at any hour.

The resort offered all different types of foods and options for dining, as long as you take advantage of exploring the options that there is at and around the resort. The beach and surroundings are kept very clean, friendly staff, many opportunities for sports and activities by the water as well. The staff was consistently dedicated to making the guests feel comfortable and keeping them happy, treating them well and making sure that they are enjoying their stay as much as possible.

Avenue bar area typically had music and dance performances in the evenings which were always entertaining and a lot  of fun with the interactive life enrichment staff who made sure that the guests enjoyed themselves! Very much enjoyed learning how to dance from the staff, who were welcoming and helped teach Bachata and more. Staff members Angel and Wilfredo were wonderful in engaging the guests, and encouraging people of all ages to come out onto the dance floor and enjoy the music and good company!

reviews.author: txcook
reviews.title: Beautiful but disappointing!!
reviews.text:
Beautiful views!! The resort is very spread out and if attending with a group I would prefer a resort that isn't stretched out parallel to the beach but more depth so the rooms can be closer together. 

We arrived at night and it was very hard to see the signage for the rooms and we walked around in the dark trying to find our rooms. Some rooms are so far from the main building that you literally waited for pick up in a golf cart. 

- Beds were very comfortable and rooms were clean. 
- Food was okay, nothing amazing at all and comparable to a stand buffet. Arrived on Friday and Saturday I had stomach virus affects that has now lasted 8 days. Came home and went to the doctor to confirm a stomach virus. A few others in our group had stomach issues too, so I would recommend bringing tums and be prepared! 
- Cocktail drinks were very weak and would recommend ordering a shot on the side if you want to taste any alcohol at all. 
- Massage that was amazing and would recommend that and can say that was the best part of this trip! 

We left an iPhone behind at the bar and actually found the person that turned it in to the Front Desk.  When I went to the Front Desk to claim it within 10 minutes of realizing I left it behind no one at the Front Desk new anything about the phone.  I spoke with Security who said he would follow up and never heard from anyone.  I had to keep asking with Guest Services too.  How does a iPhone disappear so fast wen turned in and no one knows anything?? Disappointed in the dishonesty there, so I would also recommend using the in-room safe! 

Beverage selection was good, but drinks were VERY weak!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Royal Srvice
reviews.text: Great experience at the Royal ServicePool  Bar. Be sure to find Leanardo and order his especial---nothing better. Great service from the giant/gental Pedro---remebers you everytime he sees you around the resort.

reviews.author: Olga N
reviews.title: Mejor que un todo incluído
reviews.text:
Hotel muy bonito, con suficientes espacios para no hacerse aburrido, excelente gastronomía. Increíble el Royal Service, me dieron un teléfono móvil para estar en contacto con mi mayordomo en cualquier momento (pidan siempre por Narciso Green, de todos los butlers es sin duda el mejor).
Gracias al equipo del hotel por hacerme sentir mimada y cuidada en todo momento.

reviews.author: Judy H
reviews.title: Excellent trip
reviews.text: We just got back Monday night from Paradisus Palma real .It was excellent.the food,room,the beach,restaurants were excellent.the entertainment staff were great,Madonna,Francisco,Wilfredo,angel,Nayeli,famel.the waiters on the beach had  your drinks for you,every half hour awesome.we have been to DR twice before,this had to be the best.resort.

reviews.author: Babs B
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.text: This was a wonderful trip and total experience.  Our butler's name was Agustin Nunez and he was simply amazing.  He was always there to help with our every need and usually there when we didn't even have a need.  Highly recommend the resort but suggest you request Agustin as your butler!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Don-Clementino N
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: I enjoyed my trip and stay at the Paradisus Palma Real especially in the evening when I went to the bar and had the pleasure of Roberto's service and politeness at the bar. I also enjoy very excellent room service from Jonathan and enjoyed going to the Buffet, which was like a five star restaurant because of all the excellent choices night in night out. The food was always fresh and my sever Juan Bautista made it his mission to inform the cook if I required any extra service. You feel like you are the only one being served. Great!!!!

reviews.author: Georgene G
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful resort. I thoroughly enjoyed my trip. Super Billy took great care of me on the beach - he's the best! Narcisso Green was my butler and was fabulous as well. I will definitely be going back!

reviews.author: jkwd71
reviews.title: Mixed Review
reviews.text:
We recently returned (a day early) from Paradisus and honestly have mixed reviews.  The property is quite beautiful and very large.  We stayed in the Royal Service area and I don't feel it provided a different service than any other hotel concierge service would provide.  The rooms themselves were spacious and clean, albeit a bit dated. They like to push 2 doubles together to make a huge king, but one person only has half a sheet and the pillows fall between the headboards.   Our room was "ocean view" and you could see a small slice of it, but we were also over a service area which was quite noisy. To us, beach was not relaxing. Tour helicopters are constantly flying over, catamarans jamming loud music, kids playing at the resort area next door.  There is no food service on the beach, although there is a bar. It's very crowded and we were bothered by all of the cigarette smoke.  On a positive note, the beach staff are extremely nice and attentive.  
If you are looking for gourmet food, this is not the place.  Most of the food was tasteless (a consensus with our group) and I was lucky enough to watch some kids pick up food and return it to the buffet. 
That being said, if you are looking for a place to go with a group or children, this may be your place. They have a huge pool with a bar, activities for kids, a nice disco and a casino.  I just would not call it a very relaxing resort. Beautiful, friendly, lively, but not relaxing in the sense of finding peace and quiet.  I know this review is all over the place, but liking or not liking the resort really depends on what your looking for in your vacation. This was our first experience with an all inclusive and we just didn't enjoy it.

reviews.author: Matt Renee V
reviews.title: 1st Trip to the Dominican Republic/Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: One of my customers hosts an annual meeting every year.  We've been to Jamaica twice, Puerto Rico twice and Cabo once.  This was our first trip to Punta Cana and the Paradisus resort.  We had the Royal Service package which gave us our own "butler" who tended to our every need.  Eduard Mendez was very good and attentive to whatever we wanted.  The overall accommodations of the resort were the best of any Carribean resort that we've been to and the beach was the best we've ever seen.  The only negatives I have to report is that the internet service was very poor and I only got a signal about 1/2 of the time.  Despite being "somewhere warm" the work doesn't stop and I needed to periodically check in on the job and that was hard to do.  The only other complaint is the overall food quality was average at best.  It wasn't bad, but at a 5 Star resort we expected excellent food.  Our meal at the Palazzo was the best of the week, but the portions were extremely small so everyone at our table ended up ordering two entrees to fill us up.  None of our other meals were anything to brag about.

reviews.author: Bob R
reviews.title: January getaway
reviews.text:
Resort is close to airport, about 20 minute ride. Check-in went very smoothly, we were with a large group (over 100), they were organized and had us checked in within minutes of arrival. Resort rooms are clean - and housekeeping comes twice a day. Beach is great, long sandy beach. There is security on beach to make sure hawkers don't bother you. Food is typical of all inclusive, though the lunch buffet had fresh fish grilled daily.
Beach service was excellent, Junior Ramirez got to know us during the week and would go out his way to get whatever we needed, very attentive. 
We had good meals at specialty restaurants, except one night, server rushed the dinner and got most meals wrong. The management quickly stepped in an corrected the problem.
It is a great place to get away for adults.

reviews.author: JIMROBIE
reviews.title: wonderful people, perfect weather, well maintained
reviews.text: The people are what make lasting impressions for me.  I will remember the 5 days of perfect weather, the well maintain grounds and buildings, the beautiful resort and the countless friendly, great people who worked at the resort.  I will remember the cute and smart Marleny Guerrero from Naos restaurant.  I had the pleasure of getting to know Edison, Maria and Angela at the Reserve Gym.  I got to watch Wendy (a guy) who manages the gym, expertly deflected an irate and obnoxious Russian away from Maria and on to himself and then diffuse the situation perfectly.  Maria who had done absolutely nothing wrong also handled the situation equally well. Management should be proud to have staff like that. I would have been proud if they worked for me in the U.S.  Angela thank you for graciously translating so I could converse with Maria. Edison you are a class act and you know you and your girlfriend have an open invitation to visit anytime. Maria you are a stunning beauty both inside and out and you will forever have a piece of my heart - wonderful person.

reviews.author: dave s
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: Sandy Gil provided amazing room service for our stay at the resort.   He would check up on us to make sure we were comfortable and take care of our every need.   Sandy was always very cheerful to be around and made our stay so relaxing. I've never had a resort experience like it before.

reviews.author: TravelWithChrissy
reviews.title: Best spa in the world!!
reviews.text: If you love spas this is the place for you!!It is a dream.Upon walking in you will  love it.A very natural and zen feel.I got a massage followed by a coffee and rice scrub with a body wrap.When I was done the attendant told me it was time for me to shower and remove the scrub.She opened these large curtains and a glass door that were in my massage room and there was a beautiful outdoor shower filled with plants and a shower head that look like a frog with water coming out its mouth.It was a dream!!I felt like a princess! I came here for work but brought my son and he had so much fun in the kids club.They had video games,large flat screen TV, and fed them lunch[whatever they wanted].The staff was so sweet.At the grill by the pool they would make my husband a steak with fried tostones even though it was not on the menu,but that's what he likes.We will come back and this time not for work.Remeber to go to the Spa you will love it!!This is coming from a person who always tries out every spa in hotel and resorts on my trips.

reviews.author: KBirdAtlanta
reviews.title: Business Trip for my Husband, Vacation for me!
reviews.text: I joined my husband on a business trip to this beautiful resort.  We had the "Royal Reserve" package and it was awesome.  Accommodations were amazing, comfortable, spacious…top notch.  The service was amazing.  Super Billy was very attentive and took great care of me out at the beach and pool.  We had the Butler service but I didn't really know how to take advantage of it and really didn't see our Butler till the end when he did have a beautifully prepared jacuzzi bath waiting for me…with rose petals, wine etc.  My only negative was the food.  We had 3 organized dinners (one of which was a buffet) and the food was only average.  The breakfast in the Palazza was fabulous.  Lunches at the buffet and Cabi Beach were really just OK.  I'd love to return but would adjust my expectations on what to expect food wise.  I highly recommend.

reviews.author: RenatoDDS
reviews.title: Excelente hotel! Muito conforto!!
reviews.text:
Hotel com um excelente ambiente externo e inteno. Muita área verde, palmeiras, quartos amplos e limpos. Fiquei hospedado no The Reserve e achei que realmente vale a pena estar naquela área exclusiva. Fora o fato de ter uma ampla piscina privativa, restaurante e uma área na praia para quem está no The Reserve.

O staff é muito gentil e estão sempre dispostos a nos ajudar com o que é necessário. Nos restaurantes, desde o café da manhã até o jantar temos diversas opções. 

Usei também o Room Service e fiquei satisfeito. Recomendo muito este hotel principalmente para quem quer relaxar e passar alguns dias com muito conforto.

O hotel dispõe de diversas atrações que valem a pena. Não me decepcionou em nada.

reviews.author: GAIL H
reviews.title: "Best Butler Customer Service by Jose Lugo"
reviews.text: I would like to compliment one of your employees, Jose Lugo, for the most excellent service he provided me during my company business trip for Kumho Tire USA during 12-4 thru 12-10. Jose's professionalism and service maid my stay amazing and I truly appreciated it. As a manager for Inside Sales/Customer Serive, Jose's commitment to great customer service is to be commended.  He was very attentive and checked on me without me every having to ask for anything. Royal Servies lives up to the meaning, he suprised me one night when I had retruned back to my room at 3:00a.m.after dancing at the club. Jose arranged a nice bubble bath jacuzzi with flowers, candles, insense, and a bottle of champange without me requesting any of the above services before he left to go home after his long work shift. I felt this was very thoughful of him, and I sure did enjoy coming home to a relaxing room after a long night.(Funny thing is the bath water was still nice and perfect) I wish my husband could have been able to have joined my travel experience and stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. I would also like to Thank all the staff for there smiles and the Hola's(hello's) which made this trip fantastic.  From the first day I arrived at Paradisus Palma Real until the day flew home, I can say I am very fortunate to have had the best Butler with great personality and would recommend anyone to request for him should they stay and experience the Royal Services.  I felt like a Queen :)  I hope all management whom reads these reviews Thanks every staff member, as there are too many names of great employees. I would recommend this place to friends, family, couples, and anyone just looking for a great place to get away. I will be back soon someday for my Anniversary and wish the best to everyone. Happy Holiday!

reviews.author: Mara A
reviews.title: Wonderful experience..
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort for a business trip, and it exceeded my expectations in so many ways.  The staff was so friendly and attentive, especially our butler, Agustin Nunez.  He made me feel very welcomed and cared for.  All of the Royal Service staff were really great, especially our server at the Palazzo, Pasquel, and our chef, Carlos C. who prepared the most amazing dish especially for me, since I have dietary restrictions.  The best part is, I didn't request it, he just took it upon himself to make my stay extra special. This type of service is hard to come by. Thank you all at the Paradisus Palma Real for making my stay such a memorable experience.  I will be sure to come back and bring my friends and family.

reviews.author: pushincushin
reviews.title: All good but the robbery!
reviews.text:
Took $1000 in cash for our vacation to Paradise. Decided to leave $800 in the safe along with other valuables. Left room for day and came back to find cash stolen. Tried unsuccessfully for almost one month to get resolution, but nobody at resort wants to take any responsibility for employing a thief.

Beware that even the room safes are not secure from "inside help".  Be very careful with your valuables as they hotel staff and management are not concerned.

reviews.author: Lori5674_19
reviews.title: fabulous resort
reviews.text: Went for business / pleasure. Resort was impecibly maintained. service was excellent. Ramon Fulgo made sure we were taken care of at the pool bar daily. always ready and entertaining. Would return on own again.

reviews.author: julesje
reviews.title: All around A+ !!!
reviews.text:
Had a great time ... royal service was a plus ... always courteous.

Best part was the entertainment at the beach volleyball, people were great but the staff, especially Anyeli Angel (see photo) was fun, adorable and very serviceable !!!

Thanks !

The 'tall guy'

reviews.author: Lue M
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: I booked this hotel as I was attending a fantastic conference, which would have been just as good if it was hosted in a jungle. Yes, the grounds were beautiful and the rooms were lovely and the staff very pleasant. The food was quite decent by all-inclusive standards. Admittedly, I haven't stay at many AI's, as they are not my first accommodation choice, however, I do appreciate good service. This hotel didn't have terrible service, but they did drop the ball a few times for myself and other fellow conference attendees. I was underwhelmed for the price I paid. I have stayed at three stars with far more outstanding service than at this property. More often than not, I would not receive my drink order at meals, and the lobby bar service was extremely slow - I waited 15 minutes for one drink and the bar wasn't even busy. I consider myself a very patient and forgiving customer, having worked in the hospitality industry for numerous years in another life, I do cut alot of slack. I regret to say, I was less than impressed overall, unless you count the ceviche. The ceviche was outstanding and you had no less than two to choose from every lunch time.

reviews.author: CTB63
reviews.title: Best Service is at the Swim up bar! You must visit my friend Ramon.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at this beautiful resort but the best part was meeting Ramon the most Amazing bartender at the swim up bar. He was so sweet to me and my friends, always had a beautiful smile and he always went out of his way to take of me. The morning I was checking out I happen to run into him as he was on his way to the bar, he stopped and graciously said goodby to me, I told him how much I appreciated his kindness and wonderful service. You just don't meet special people like him. When you visit Paradisus Palma Real you MUST visit my friend Ramon. You won't be disappointed. I will miss him. Celine B.

reviews.author: Isabel L
reviews.title: The most gentle spirit
reviews.text: My name is Isabel Lopez and I had the most amazing and wonderful experience here.The hotel was great the food really good lots to offer.The staff is excellent and always have smiles on them.The pool is magnificent and lots of places to sit under a hut and take a nap with the comfortable almost like beds to relax.The beach sand is so soft and white and the blues water is beautiful.I was staying on The Royal Service side and had the Most Amazing soul as a butler.His smile lit up my day and was such a gentle soul.He always was asking me if I needed anything or if he needed to make a reservation for me.He would walk me everywhere I needed to go.I cant say enough about the hotel and especially Jean Pierre thats his name.Jean Pierre thank you so much for your kindness!!

reviews.author: Miguel D
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Me hospedei no Paradisus The reserve no periodo de 03 a 08 de novembro. 

O hotel é imenso. Toda a área do hotel, tanto área de lazer como quartos foram construidas a pouco tempo, logo as instalações são bem modernas. Toda a equipe do hotel prestou um bom atendimento em todas as áreas. O quarto é imenso com varanda, sala, banheira e banheiro. O hotel se preocupa com os mínimos detalhes do cliente, toda dia a camareira perguntava se gostaria que preparasse a cama para entrar para dormir, ou seja, a cama sempre esta pronta mas eles se preocupam em preparar o espaço para deitar na cama sem ter que abrir o lençol. O serviço realmente foi excepcional.  

Alguns restaurantes precisam fazer reserva, recomendo fazer as reservas na chegada do hotel para aproveitar os restaurantes do hotel. Todos são ótimos nenhum deixou a desejar..

Bebidas do hotel são de qualidade ( whisky 12 anos, vodca importada....)

A praia na frente do hotel é a praia de bávaro, praia calma com poucas ondas e a estrutura de praia do hotel é bem moderna com espreguiçadeiras e camas para o hóspede.

reviews.author: Tami H
reviews.title: Beautiful but service not so bueno
reviews.text: The facilities are beautiful & clean. Internet & hair dryer did not work. Room not serviced everyday. No pool towels in room each day or available at pool. At checkout, they miscalculated my bill by double- after 30 minutes it was finally rectified!! Grrr... Would not stay again...

reviews.author: Cperf
reviews.title: Almost perfect.
reviews.text:
This resort takes "all inclusive" to a new level.  There is no reason to leave since every wish is granted.  Treat yourself to a bubble bath staged by your butler, or savor a memorable dinner crafted by a Michelin chef.  
Don't bother with those free cell phones to contact your butler though. They rarely work except out by the main pool.

reviews.author: Bill P
reviews.title: A romantic resort with huge beach
reviews.text: My wife and I had the opportunity to spend two nights at the resort during our trip to Punta Cana.  It is easy to see why the resort is rated so high on tripadvisor.   On check in we were escorted to the VIP check in room where we were provided a cocktail.   We were told that we could use the room for free internet plus each day there would be a continental breakfast if we wished or snacks later in the day.  Completing the check in we were escorted by a bellman to our room which while "standard" in price is much more in service.  Our room was huge with a great balcony and garden view.   There was a double jacuzzi in the room and a bottle of wine on the dresser as our welcomming gift.  We were also told that as a VIP we qualified to use the Gabi Beach area and pool.   However the pool with swim up bar is one of the largest we have experienced in the Caribbean.   We had a quick lunch at "The Market" and sat at a table overlooking the beach.    Later we donned our swimsuits and could not believe how extensive the beach is.   In no time we were relaxing on the very confortable lounge chairs while ordering a cocktail from the beachside beverage servers.   At this resort just about all the restaurants are next to each other which is very convenient.   They also have a large "Reserve area" for families with their own kids club and restaurants.    I wish we could have stayed longer as we were spoiled by the fine bartenders and staff.   The food was excellent (especially the lobster tails) we had at the Gabi Beach Restaurant.   During the evening they had entertainment which ranged from a DJ to a guitar player and singer or a jazz group.   While at the resort there was a large convention group in house which showed us how the resort can accommodate large groups for private dinners on the beach or at the pool without interferring with other guests.  By the way they also have a large convention center.   this resort is great for honeymooners and destination weddings in my opinion and you get all the same service regardless of room category.   We will definitely return and stay longer.  Did I mention that they also have a great spa

reviews.author: Sara O
reviews.title: Most amazing experience
reviews.text: I visited this resort for a "site inspection" as a potential option to host a company retreat. The service I received may have been above average because they were trying to impress me in order for my group to commit, but it was above and beyond amazing! The grounds are spectacular - felt that I was at a palace. The food was great along with the service. My group will be going back for our retreat and I hope to visit on leisure one day as well.

reviews.author: Luiz J
reviews.title: RESORT
reviews.text: Recepção maravilhosa, piscina espetacular, apartamentos parecem uma residência , com cozinha, sala, banheiro e banheira de hidro , parece um apartamento do jardins amplo e bem decorado , produtos de banho renomado! Para negócios ou férias, recomendo com louvor!

reviews.author: Scott K
reviews.title: Great beach / Awful drink pours / Mediocre Food
reviews.text: Staff has no knowledge of the ingredients that should be used in mixed drinks, no knowledge of the amount of liquor that should be in the drink, and the food is similar to a Barnhill's Buffet. The butler service seems like a great thing when you arrive, but don't let that fool you. You will be cussing the idea later.

reviews.author: Robert P
reviews.title: What not to expect
reviews.text: The distinguishing factor at this resort property was the staff.  Most of them, 99%, went out of their way to anticipate your questions and needs.  The staff was determined to make your stay a memorable one.  You did not want for anything and the service was immaculate.  As the saying went, "if you are not having a good time it is your own dam fault.

reviews.author: BP32013
reviews.title: Great resort but it was the butler service that made special
reviews.text:
I've stayed at a lot of nice resorts in the US and the Caribbean, this one included.   What made this trip especially memorable was was my butler.  His name was Nicolas Maracallo.  He was awesome.  He was very personable, attentive to my needs, and provided passionate service.

I will definitely consider coming back with my family next time to enjoy the resort and will no doubt request Nicolas to be our butler.

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: Truly a beautiful paradise
reviews.text: This was truly a beautiful paradise for us. I have to mention 3 workers who were so unbelievably helpful. Luis Romeriz, not our butler but treated us as if he was,  Fish, extremely helpful& so very nice & Ramion, our bartender who was so nice and always had a smile on his face. These three guys were just incredible workers who seemed to enjoy their jobs and enjoyed serving us any way they could. We ate at Palozzo for breakfast & dinner. Breakfast was good but the dinner was excellent. We ate at Gabi Beach, the grilled lobster was excellent. Naos breakfast was just ok. Market grill lunch buffet was very good.This is a first class resort. We were lucky to stay in the Royal Service area of the resort. The hardest part for us was the language barrier, we wish we knew more Spanish to communicate easier with the staff.

reviews.author: flametamer911
reviews.title: Working in Paradise
reviews.text: The hotel was astounding. The views from the lobby looking out over the fountains, the endless beach and then the greeny/blue water of the ocean. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. A large soaker tub in the open bathroom concept. Food at the various restaurants went from great to fantastic. The local fresh fruit and seafood was abundant. There was a great swim up bar. Even watched a guy climb a tree to pick coconuts and bring them to you to enjoy fresh coconut milk. We had a great meeting room with all the AV equipment needed. Free WiFi. An overview of the staff was great. They were always there to help you. Fantastic spa facilities. A warning though, bring a really good sun screen as the sun is extremely warm and can burn. Come and enjoy paradise but remember,you still have to get you work done.

reviews.author: SA L
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: For the area, one of the best properties.  Superb beach, great pools, and outstanding service.  Our butler, Nicolas Maracallo was excellent.  Also, received incredible service beach-side from "Super Billy".  Since the trip was free, can't give an accurate assessment of value, but the staff on the whole was extremely friendly and always willing to find out how to serve their guests.

reviews.author: C H
reviews.title: Outstanding Service!
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived at Paridisus Palma Real in Punta Cana the service was outstanding and I was gald I chose the Royal Services. The service attendant, Byron, took my luggage and escorted me to the VIP check in area while giving me a tour and history of the resort. I remember his name was Byron because he continued to check in with me through out my stay to see how I was doing. My particular package came with a personal Butler (yes I know cool right?). He gave me a cell phone and was at my beck in call. His name was Juan De Leon. His service was impeccable and he was extremely attentive to anything I needed to have for an enjoyable stay. I was there on business but got in early and had some down time which Juan encouraged me to maximize. I even take a tour to Santo Domingo. I recommend him, and the butler service to anyone that wants to have a smooth, relaxing, event packed vacation or like me, great service while attending a conference that allows you some down time (I came in a few days early and I am so gald I did!). Juan booked my meals, scheduled trips, reserved pool side amenities and recommeneded all the great local spots. He new all the historical areas, great sights, and hidden secrets. He definitely new the lay of the land. And his ability to cater to, joke with and please the consumer is what every profitable orginazation strives for from its service group. Even at Pizzazio a premium restaurant exclusive to the Royal Services on the property, (where I had breakfast everyday, the waiter, Alexander, I remember his name because he has the same name as my son) , every morning remembered how I wanted my coffee, eggs and tomatoes and was queing them up as I was being seated. Unbelievable! Alex's energy and fun attitude made me a repeat customer every morning even with other options for breakfast.The property is well maintained, two gyms, Juan, even escorted me to the other gym one day to make sure I did not get lost. I could go on and on, everyone was attentive, pleasant, smiling, and on their A game. I am an executive that travels worldwide and even though my trip was 1/2 business and 1/2 pleasure I will no doubt be back and recommend this all-inclusive get-away to all my colleagues. Of yes, did I fail to mention all-inclusive? From the mini bar, premium liquor, to the many resteraunts , lobster, steak an great seafood dishes, this is one resort the money is well spent!! A must and well need experience in my opinion.

reviews.author: brooklyn
reviews.title: Great Property, Terrible Food, So-So Service
reviews.text:
I visited for four days and overall had a great visit. The property and grounds are beautiful and very well kept. I stayed in the Royal Service area, and while the room was huge, clean and comfortable, the service was not as advertised. While everyone on the property is really nice and friendly, actual service is lacking. I saw my "butler" once during my stay and I couldn't reach him whenever I actually needed anything. Also, the check in and check out of Royal Service was about an hour wait each. So not worth the extra money. 
And the wifi did not work in my room. 

The greatest miss was the food. The food ran from average to inedible. Food was either bland, soggy, cold (when it should have been hot), overcooked or all of the above. The buffet was probably the best of the options, as you could probably find one or two things that you could eat.

Despite the misses, I enjoyed my time. But I would not return.

reviews.author: Icebull1906
reviews.title: Paradidus Palma Real
reviews.text:
I stayed Oct 15 to 19, 2013.  The hotel is beautiful, the grounds are very well maintained, and the staff was very nice.  Save your money and do not get the Royal service.  I paid the extra money and not sure why.  I saw my butler one time.  The internet went down every 20 minutes in the room and I am not exaggerating.  In addition, the cell phone they give you does not work in the rooms and drops everywhere else.  What I did think was super tacky was that during the week they had the vsop and grey goose included in the AI.  However, when Thursday rolled around you had to pay US prices for the goose and any normal drink.  Bad form when its supposed to be all inclusive.  Finally, dont get suckered on room.  

The room was nice and air worked great.  However, I asked for a king bed and they gave me two doubles.  When I went and asked for a king they said hotel was overbooked although the place was empty. I pointed out online that they were still showing availability for all rooms but the said it was wrong.  Later I met people who were sharing rooms and had been given a king with a pull out.  

Overall the food was good.  Vento was Great as was the steakhouse although it took 2 hours to get our food at the steakhouse.

Overall I will go back but will make sure to avoid Royal service and will ensure I get the right room from the start.

reviews.author: LLMalone
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for a business function, but arrived a few days early to enjoy paradise.  Upon check-in we upgraded to Royal Service.  What a wonderful experience!  We truly were treated royally by all we came in contact with, especially our butler, Juan Castillo.  Our favorite waiter, Wisly Fortune, was so helpful and made us feel welcome from the first day forward.  We opted for morning room service and Cesar Lafl was terrific at calling us ahead and delivering our breakfast exactly when we anticipated it!  The grounds were lovely, the beach was heavenly.  We walked the property every morning and felt extremely safe.  We enjoyed all of our meals.  The attention to detail from table service to food presentation was incredible.  I would recommend this resort to anyone considering a vacation in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: MAOMOPE17
reviews.title: Excelente Fin de Semana at The Reserve!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Excelente fin de semana en The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana!!!!! Maravilloso el servicio y la comida espectacular!!! Saludos y especial agradecimiento al Sr. Silvio Lantigua (guest service manager) por su dedicacion y excelente actitud. Grandioso el staff, muy amigables y serviciales.

reviews.author: CH27516
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal stay, I would highly recommend the Royal Service. We have amazing service 95% of our stay, Martin Tineo took exceptional care of us on the beach and Pasquel Rodriguez was an awesome waiter!  We had great food, a wonderful room (except for the glass door in front of the toilet) and the grounds were breathtaking. The only part we didn’t care for was the butler service. We rarely used it and when we did we were always let down. We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: cgomide
reviews.title: Great Experience and Highly Recommended
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that this was a business trip and unfortunately I did not have the opportunity to take advantage of all the benefits of being a "Royal" guest. However, my family joined me afterwards and we moved to The Reseve, but I will provide a separate review for that. Only one comment, if you are coming with your family and can afford the upgrade, The Reserve if the right option for you. This is a hotel within the hotel...

Basically, this hotel is located within a very large property that is subdivided into three areas. The regular hotel, the royal service and the reserve. The benefit of staying in the royal area is the fact that you have a butler, exclusive access to some of the restaurants, some of the offerings in the SPA and the best drinks (a few exclusions). Unfortunately being on a business trip I was not able to take advantage of all the services, but it was certainly a nice experience.

The restaurants that offered a buffet were okay. They offered good food, but I have had better experiences at other all inclusive hotels. On the other hand, the a la-carte restaurants were awesome. I did not go to the Passion, a restaurant you need to pay $50 per person, but other people in the group did and liked it a lot. The interesting thing is that reading about the Michelin rating, I learned that it goes from 1 to 3 stars, but they claim this restaurant to e 7-star. How can that be?

My butler was okay. He claims to be from New York, which he is clearly not and it almost too force. It is all about how great he is, etc, but as I said earlier, I did not take advance of his services and cannot fairly rate it. I just wished he had been a little more customer focused and less about him and him knowing it all...

The only draw back that is hard to ignore at this hotel is the very poor wireless internet connection. I know this is a vacation resort, but these days a quality internet access is a must have. In our case, we needed it for the business meeting and it did not go all.

Other than that, everything was great. All other issues were minor and nothing to be concerned about. 

I would certainly recommend the royal service if you can afford it, but it is for adults only. If you have kids, you will need to go to the "regular" hotel or the reserve. Look for my review on The Reserve portion.

reviews.author: Janna P
reviews.title: Bueno, pero podría ser mejor...
reviews.text:
Estuve hospedada en este hotel durante 4 días en una convención de trabajo. El hotel es precioso, las instalaciones muy completas y hay muchas actividades por hacer. 

Pero considero que para el nivel de hotel y el precio del mismo hay algunas cosas que pudieran mejorar:

Internet: hay señal de internet en todo el hotel pero la señal es PÉSIMA. Solamente en la recepción del hotel hay buena señal, y ni siquiera todo el tiempo. En los cuartos es donde peor se recibe y en muchos de los salones no llega ni un poco. Creo que deberían mejorar eso, sobre todo con tantos eventos con personas de negocios que necesitan estar conectados 24/7

Comida: como la mayoría de los hoteles "todo incluido" la comida es aceptable pero nada del otro mundo. En los bufés se repite mucho la comida y los postres no son muy ricos. Sólo tuve oportunidad de probar uno de los restaurantes de reserva (tepanyaki y sushi) y este sí estaba muy bien. 

Servicio: a gente sumamente educada y amable, pero en varias ocasiones en las tardes después de las 6pm no habían hecho el cuarto! O lo hacían y no se llevaban la basura de los basureros. 

Es un hotel que para mi criterio no llega a las 5 estrellas por lo antes mencionado, pero la playa y el hotel son preciosos u no hay necesidad de salir del mismo.

reviews.author: Michelle V
reviews.title: Great food and night attractions!
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus Palma Real for a company convention in July.  I must say that they had full occupancy.  The service was variable, some employees were rushing, others were very welcoming and nice and helpful.  Bedroom was great.. clean, with a Jacuzzi.  The thing that most impressed me was the food, they have plenty restaurants, different types, and ALL... ALL the food was great!.. also my colleagues were very happy, since we could spend almost a week and could try the different restaurants.  The night shows were impressive, mostly the one like Cirque du Soleil .. I think those guys deserve recognition, I have seen CDS and this was not far from there... it was tremendous, extraordinary, I have not seen a hotel show at that magnitude, also the night shows at the bar, great music, excellent beverages, nice attentions from the attractions team. Some downsides: I had some issues with the internet, towels, hairdryer .. which I think for a luxury hotel it should be taken care of before any visitor complain.  But besides that the hotel takes the prize!

reviews.author: Carync6
reviews.title: Horrible Service!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled to this resort as part of a large group.   We would not normally go to the large all inclusive resorts as you will typically find the food to be very average. This resort did not disappoint!   With the exception of the food at the Palazzo, which is only accessible through royal service, the food was not good.   When we arrived, it took over 90 mins for them to deliver our luggage to our room.  We were introduced to our Butler for our royal service room and given a phone so that he could be at our fingertips.  Well, he was not!  We called right away and he didn't answer twice.
