Two times I called the Royal Service main number and once was cut off and the other I was put on hold.  I asked for ice, it never came.  The butler showed up once to put hot water in our tub (which we didn't ask for).  I wouldn't have used it anyway but it was lukewarm when we arrived.  Wouldn't you think they would find out when you planned to return to the room if they were trying to provide a nice surprise?   The only other time our butler appeared was the last night.  He came delivering a plate of fruit but you could tell his only purpose was to get a tip.  We did not give him one as he had done nothing to earn it.
The royal service rooms were ok.  The privacy into the bathroom is awful.  There is a wood frame barrier with see through posts. The doors to the shower and toilet are faintly frosted but you can see through them.  The sound carries!   They pushed two double beds together and made them appear to be a super king sized bed.   We might as well have slept in two separate beds because there was a big him in the middle where they were shoved together and you could not lay on it.   Furthermore, the light switches were in the middle between the two beds, so since the beds were pushed together, you had to crawl onto the bed to get to many of the switches.   Many of the couples in our group experienced the same issues.

The beach itself was pretty but the water is not!  It is filled with sea grass.   It feels like pine straw in the water and isn't clear so not really nice to hang out in.  The pools were nice enough.  The royal service pool is tiny so we hung out at the end of the main pool that is designated for royal service.  The downside to this is that the staff NEVER waits on you if you are there.  We always had to go to the bar ourselves.

Our worst service came at the Palazzo one evening.  My husband and I were hungry at 6:15 pm but our group dinner wasn't until 8pm. We thought we would stop by the restaurant and eat an appetizer.  When we arrived, we were asked if we had reservations and we said no and explained we just wanted to eat an appetizer.  We asked if we could sit at the bar so we did.  They asked what we wanted but only took my order.  A few minutes later they came and moved us to a table.  It was 6:20 when we sat down.  They said they couldn't take our order (which we thought they already had) because it wasn't 6:30.  We said no problem, we can wait 10 mins.   5 mins later my food came (my husband's didn't).  It was the wrong order.  I explained this to the waiter and his response was "well, we have  a problem.  You don't have reservations and then he pointed to my husband and said you don't have the right shoes on!  Unbelievable!   If this was an issue, they should have politely asked him to change shoes when we arrived.  However, they were not happy about having us there and then getting the order wrong so then they turned the tables on us.   We got up and left.    This type of service was consistent throughout the resort.  If you wanted to charge something to your room at the store, it took 5 or more minutes for them to verify that you could do that and then they were very put off by the request.  We were not the only ones that experienced this.   Anytime we asked for help on something, the staff just said they couldn't answer, we should go see someone else.   I would never return here because the staff really is horrible!  They do not care for anyone who speaks English.  There were a few exceptions and these were all in the NON royal service area.  I would not waste your money on the RS and these folks are the rudest and want tips only.

My husband and I have traveled around the world and stayed at luxury resorts around the world and this is certainly NOT  a place I would return.

reviews.author: P F
reviews.title: Beautiful setting directly on the beach
reviews.text:
Pro: The property was beautifully landscaped and maintained. All the restaurants and my lovely room were very clean. I was directly on the beach with the Royal Service package which afforded me a Bali beach cabana and butler service in my room. My butler, Juan deLeon and remainder of  staff were professional and helpful. Waiters were especially accommodating.
      The gym was clean with up to date machines and had an attendant present.
Con: The menu was varied but the quality was inconsistent. One day lunch was great and the next day the same  item was mediocre. 
       There was not enough signage along the paths to help me navigate the property.

reviews.author: toomanynouns
reviews.title: Underwhelming...
reviews.text:
The resort itself was very pretty with a lovely beach and facilities. 

Our check in was late, so unfortunately we spent our first few hours wandering around miserably with our luggage in the clothes we had travelled in.

Our room was nice looking. The bed was comfortable enough and having AC was heavenly.  However, I'm not really sure how having a kitchen is useful at an all-inclusive resort. The plug in the bath tub was also mysteriously difficult to open and close (not a huge complaint, but annoying when you want to relax).

Don't expect to use the WiFi anywhere but the lobby, and don't expect it to be a good signal.

There wasn't a lot to do at the resort at night, as the beach & pool closed at 7pm. Your options are mostly the casino and drinking, which may suite some people just fine. However, the performance we saw by Le Cirque one night was quite impressive and I would certainly recommend it.

The service at the hotel was very uneven. While probably the majority of staff was friendly and helpful, there were still many times when we found ourselves being ignored or brushed off. The ladies at the gift shop next to Bana seemed particularly rude.

The food was generally very disappointing. The buffets were sometimes okay, but other times attempting to cater to "American" tastes and doing so poorly. The room service food was abysmal and resembled really cheap cafeteria food. The food at Bana was okay, but the chef was obviously not actually trained in Teppanyaki style cooking. The one exception we saw was Molé which was very good and seemed more authentic.

There wasn't very much information available to guests and it was at times difficult and awkward to figure out how to do things like book restaurants for meals and arrange to do activities. Many of the desks have no helpful signs. This was particularly noticeable when we tried to book a restaurant for supper. The desk where you do this is tucked in a corner with no indication of it's purpose. It was also difficult to figure out when things were open and sometimes even where they were (such as the midnight buffet and Molé). It was also surprisingly difficult to find the beach towels as they were all tucked out of sight under a counter.

I suspect that the resort is all right with things like this being difficult because it encourages people to pay for the Royal Service package and have someone else deal with it (which is nice, but shouldn't be a necessity to have a good experience).

One other note I have is about the bracelets they attach to you when you arrive. I understand that they need some way to keep track of guests, but having it permanently attached to one feels more like being a tagged animal than a guest.

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from 6 nights in the Paradisus Palma Real where I attended a business conference. Overall, we had a very nice experience despite some minor issues that were immediately addressed. For example, our luggage was misplaced after we got off the bus and went downstairs to check in, but it was delivered to our room 5 minutes after we got to it.  Our hot water went out one afternoon but a repair man was in our unit in less than 5 minutes and by the time we got back from dinner it was working fine. Here is some information that might be helpful to others going to this resort. First, some context.  We have been to 5 Caribbean islands in the last 13 years but this is only the second all-inclusive we have stayed at (Sandals in St. Lucia was the other).  We also stayed at smaller resorts in Grand Cayman, Aruba and Turks and Caicos.  So we have some places to compare.  Here are thoughts on a variety of topics:
Beautiful scenery - The is a gorgeous resort with lots of landscaping and beautiful flowers.  The distinctive feature here is the VERY tall palm trees.  There is really only one pool for the masses but it is huge. Everything is well lit at night and very pleasing to the eye,
Accommodations - Our room was comfortable with a king bed, a jacuzzi tub and a separate sitting room (with a couch that was not comfortable so that room was worthless). We had a patio and you could almost see the water in the far distance (we were on the top floor - 3rd). No elevator but not a problem for us. 2 TV's but after we found on the first day that most of the channels were in Spanish, we never turned them on again! The internet did not work in our room or on the patio which was a little annoying, but we were trying to unplug anyway.
Language - This resort is so big that they need so much help and only some could speak English (not the housekeepers). I know we are in their country and we can't expect everything, but this is the only place we have gone in the Caribbean where sometimes communication was a little difficult.  But it would be a great place to practice conversational Spanish!
Layout - This was our only real source of frustration.  Everywhere else we have stayed, the entire resort was not restricted in any way - every pool, bar, beach area, etc. was open to any guest.  Here, the resort is divided into areas that are restricted for the "Royal Treatment" guests, and another area that is restricted for the "Melia" timeshare guests.  And it takes a while to figure out where you can and cannot go (we are still not sure about everything!) And some of the restaurants are not included in the "all-inclusive" and this was just weird. We didn't like this, but dealt with it.
Food - We are NOT foodies.  So we did not make any reservations at any of the formal restaurants.  Instead we had all our dinners at the NEOS beachside buffet restaurant and our lunches at the Market Grill.  And unless you have 5 star standards, we could always find a great meal.  Lots of salads, cheese and meat, soup, bread, a wide variety of entrees, fresh grilled fish and meat, lots of fruit and a desert bar. Some waiters speak more English than others and some are more attentive than others but all they are really doing for you is bringing you water and whatever you want from the bar. I got the impression that most people don't tip so the staff know they will get nothing for attentive service, but we always tipped anyway because it is the right thing to do. When there is so much food and so much variety (different things each day) it was fun trying all the local dishes.  We didn't always like everything, but the good news was that we just got up and tried something else. If you are wanting traditional American food - steaks, fried foods, pizza, etc., stay in America!  This is the DR - eat like the locals!  We had no digestive issues.  They say just to not drink the tap water in your room.  Everything else - juice, coffee, drinks, etc. was perfectly safe.
Activities - I spent a lot of my time in the conference so we only left the resort once with a group activity (a boat ride - booze cruise).  We did do the snorkeling trip from the resort and it was just OK.  The reef is about a quarter mile offshore from the resort and their were 4 other party boats docked there.  The vis was OK but the coral was not good and the fish were not plentiful.  I wanted to scuba dive but the only trips they ran were in the morning when I was in class.  They have small Hobiecats you can take out and sea kayaks when it is not too windy (and it was pretty windy when we were there).  They did have lot of staff to help you book external tours.
Area - You can go to the right when you get to the beach about .5 miles but then you will get to a sketchy area where the locals will approach you to sell things and provide "services".  Just don't go to far. The other direction is about the same.  So enjoy the mile or so you can walk.  There is lots of security on property to make sure the beachfront is safe. We didn't explore any outside shopping.    Anything in the gift shop or airport is super expensive.
Overall we had a very nice trip and have some great pictures and memories.

reviews.author: Aaron A
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text:
If I could give it 4.5, I would. 
Our only big gripe was that we were told we could get our room around 1pm and it was nearly 4pm before we were finally told it was ready. After very long flights we just needed a nap and we couldn't get one because of the delay.

Beyond that the resort was amazing as you see in the photos. Some resorts do not quite live up to the photos. My company shelled out for the extra "Royal Service" which provides you with a number of extra amenities including a separate building with nicer roomes, private RS pool, bar and beach, free rentals and most notably a butler service and cell phone. The butler service can be absolutely wonderful but it depends on who you get. There are some great ones and bad ones. We had Jean-Marie Pierre who was fantastic. Not only could he speak 4 or 5 languages well, he was thoughtful, and humorous.

The food was also very good! Some restaurants were definitely just average, but they offered nicer options also. Just be sure to pack at least one "resort formal" and closed toed shoes or you will be limited to only a very few restaurants. 

Since I did not pay, I cannot speak for value

But, overall it was a grand experience!

reviews.author: ChristopherB30
reviews.title: From yuck to yabba dabba dooo!
reviews.text:
On May 5th of 2013 I was a part of the clipper magazine reward trip to Punta Cana where hundreds of us stayed at Palma Real.  Our first day was a real challenge where as after several hours of plane, taxi, and bus travels, landing in our "first room"  was a bit of a jaunt.  The room was so far away from everything that we almost needed a shuttle to just get there.  This was remedied quite quickly and we were politely moved to another room closer to the center of things.  The only problem was that our room number 2, had a very moldy smell and the a/c would never manage to get any lower than 82 degrees.  After several calls, it was suggested to do a little upgrade to royal services, after all the trip was a reward trip so why not really kick things up a notch and just vacation like celebrities.  This upgrade includes the best of the best, private amenities for all royal services members, and our own personal butler. We got to choose from a pillow menu, premium upgrades to drink and food, and an amazing, friendly, Cute, and professional staff.

Our first butler was a dud, our third room turned into a fourth room, and by the time we actually got a chance to enjoy anything, it was 12:30 am.  With messages to the management on voicemail and handwritten notes, our big mess of YUCK took a really great turn on day 2 when my bestie and I took a personal trip to meet the royal services manager Sarah.  Our eyes met and her smile and compassion to us as guest lit up the room as I think I heard the sounding of soothing trumpets calling out to us as a reassurance that things would get better.  Sarah asked us to give her a bit of time to fix things as she said we deserved a turn of events which she would make sure would occur, and it did.

I'm not sure what that amazing woman did, but we went from feeling like no bodies, to celebrities of Palma Real for the rest of our stay.  Everywhere we turned people were calling us by name, asking if they could get anything us, do anything for us.  Our new butler was on top of everything including getting us a fabulous upgrade in the restaurant passion.  Our new butler Juan Deleon was incredible and needs to be commended.  The chef at the palazzo was outstanding as he made my guest and I a fabulous crab and lobster lunch, made special for us. 

The staff at Passion Carolos Feliciano, Laura Castillo, Miguel Guerrero, and Yeris Sanchez gave us 5 star services.  The tasting menus was outrageously amazing and was kicked up with such attentive services.  The explanation of each course was top notch by the staff.

So in closing?  It was a big YUCK but by the time we were on our way back to the Punta Cana Airport we were wheeling away with a Big YABBA DABBA DOOO!

A most special thank you to Sarah, for really going out of your way to turn a bad start into an amazingly paradisus experiencia.  This would have been a 1 star rating, Sarah and your staff turned it into a 5 star rating across the board.

reviews.author: C6969joec
reviews.title: Great Place, Great Food, Great Spa, Great People
reviews.text:
We cannot come up with enough superlatives to describe this place, and its most accommodating staff.  We were impressed with the well kept grounds, and the pools, and the clean beaches from our very our first day. The first staff we met was Yomalin, Kathia, and especially Rosy who made us feel welcome and at home when she checked us in to Royal Service Section for our 7 day stay.  
Our butler was unbelievable, and so were the beaches and pools.  Francisco and Billy always found us the perfect spot, where my wife could stay in the shade most of the day, while I was sitting beside her in the sun, (whenever I wasn't in the warm beautiful water!.)  They have so many straw roofed cabanas. Every meal was incredibly delicious. They have every type of cuisine and style of dining you could wish for.  This place is truly paradise.

We were with a small convention, and I have to mention the wonderful job done by Marisol of Connect Travel.  Our shuttles ran on time, and Marisol was always easy to find on the Palma Real grounds, where she handled a change to my wife's return to the airport. 

With this great staff,  there were no issues, only fun in the sun.

reviews.author: Josien79
reviews.title: Fantastisch
reviews.text:
Ruime kamer met Jetstream bad, enige minpuntje was dat de stop van het bad niet goed werkte en het water dus meteen weer weg liep.
Heerlijk gegeten en ruime keuze uit restaurants.
De kamers lagen aan een tropische tuin en via de tuin kom je bij het gigantische zwembad. Heerlijk gezwommen. En na het zwemmen kun je zo naar de bar zwemmen voor een drankje.
Vriendelijk personeel en goede service.
Helaas was ik er maar voor een paar dagen voor een congres. Maar ik kan het families met kinderen en stellen die een romantische reis willen maken zeker aanraden.

reviews.author: bigguy203
reviews.title: Great Serivce
reviews.text: I have stayed at this resort for the the last 4 years and even though the resort is beautiful and the grounds are well maintained, I enjoy the beach service that Maiker (Mikey) Ramirez  provides.He is the most friendly person that I have met there, always with a smile and doing what he can to make your beach time enjoyable. There are lots of choices of places to stay, but we go back to the Paradisus Punta Cana because of Mikey. He is great!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Cindy G
reviews.title: Very Impressive Resort!
reviews.text:
This trip was an incentive trip for our Top Sales People. A majority of our responses from our attendees were... "this was the best place that we have been to date. The food was great! The resort and restaurants on site were incredible! The beach and water were amazing! The pre-coordination and during our event with our onsite event coordinator could have been better. There were expectations that we had for the set up of our meetings and dinners and several times our expectations were not met. If you choose this location for a Business trip I would recommend that you request the manager for your event coordinator. 

Overall we were satisfied with this resort and would recommend this for personal vacations for sure.

reviews.author: willi e
reviews.title: great resort
reviews.text:
excellent resort, nice area, love the gym and how close it was to my room. food gets better over the weekend. my favorite place was the gym, they have an instructor that works with you all day.
I believe his name was Mr. Dickinson, anyways he was very nice and helpful with everybody. The lobby is awesome it has the nicest and most comfortable furnitures plus it has a bar where you can drink anything you want.

reviews.author: gloria55138
reviews.title: Love the Dominican
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and resort grounds are wonderful well taken care of.  Gloria & Lewis in the pool bar were wonderful, really know how to take care of you and make your trip a good experience.  Rosa in the Sky bar just as great and helpful. Edison in the spa has great classes in the relaxing grounds.Room service as our best food with Johnathon serving us with charm and promtness.  Overall food disapointing especially in the reservation only restaurants.  The only beer was presidenta --not good, no other selections unless you were a cold member. Experience as good but not the best al-linclusive

reviews.author: bfchef
reviews.title: Really Nice Resort But Slow Service & Average Food
reviews.text:
Absolutely love the beach and pools and the rooms are fantastic but the food is just o.k.  Granted we didn't get to all of the restaurants so there could be some good ones but for dinner what we experienced was just o.k.  Breakfast and lunch were fine.

We never used the butler service but anytime we needed something other than food, it took forever.  Our safe never worked properly and we called four times along with having a butler call and no one ever came to fix it.  Check everything out before the butler leaves your room initially and do not accept it until you feel it is correct.

The Reserve looked like a great place for families so keep that in mind.

reviews.author: Dale R
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but poor service
reviews.text: We leave tomorrow after a weeks stay. We are here for a conference of about 120 people attending. This resort is just beautiful. Nice beaches & amazing pool. Room is very nice. It is just too bad that the service was so poor for us. One day we did not get our room cleaned until 9:30pm. I made 3 calls to housekeeping and was told we will send someone. I finall had to go to the front desk to get towels & toilet paper. The next day they cleaned the room about 10am & said they would be right back with towels. They never returned & we were using toilet paper to dry our hands. At 3pm I went to the front desk to complain. During the conference we were given a 1 hour lunch break. That morning before I left I ordered room service for lunch service at noon. At 12:40 I call as no lunch. I was told it was not yet ready. This left me no time to get lunch at their buffet. A call to advise of a late delivery would have been nice. I complained to the desk. The kitchen manager did come to our room to apologize & that was nice. I would not stay here again & recommended to our conference to not return here next year. Too bad as the staff is nice & a beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Anonymous371
reviews.title: Wouldn't pay to stay here
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a company incentive trip. It was a free vacation for my wife and I. Will try to be objective:

Positives:
1. Most beautiful ground I've ever seen at a resort. Stunning.
2. Both SPAs were nice and relaxing. They do a nice job there. 
3. Alexander Jose (one of the beach activities guys) was pleasent, energetic, and went out of his way to accomodate everyone he came into contact with. He's a nice kid who works real hard to make your stay enjoyable. Thanks Alexander!

Negatives:
1. **Service was down right aweful** It took forever to get anything (even when you were the only one at the bar or restaurant), The staff was visibly annoyed if you asked for 'anything'. (which kind of defeats the purpose of an all inclusive). They simply have no motivation to help you, even when you tip well.

Note: the one exception is if you tip the guys on the beach serving drinks ahead of time, they will go out of their way to take care of you.

2. Minibar in room and room service selection were sub par compared to other resorts.
3. With some exception the restaurant food was not good (Other reviews are accurate)
4. Beach and Ocean were beautiful, but sea weed everywhere. Didn't make it enjoyable swimming in the ocean. It was all over you. 
5. Different levels of inclusivity annoying and confusing at times.

To sum up: I personally would not pay money to stay at this resort. It's a shame, because the proprty is truly amazing. If hotel managment would train the staff to give even 'a little' effort, people would be clamoring to come back here. Hope this helps.

TIP: Whatever you do...REFUSE to let them deliver your bags upon check in. They will push back and insist. We gave in, and 3 hours later, received our bags. (Result: by the time our bags were delivered, it was too late to go to the beach/pool). What a waste. Also, some of our friends had their stuff stolen.

reviews.author: aliast
reviews.title: Indifferent service creates disappointing experience
reviews.text:
We came here as part of a business/pleasure trip; although we hadn't picked the resort, we had high hopes, which were sadly dashed upon arrival.  First, the room wasn't ready (which happens); then the keys to the room didn't work; then it took them over 2 hours to figure out where they put our luggage (delivered to the wrong room!!!!).  The room itself was nice, although the vast majority of rooms have tiny balconies on an interior courtyard... in other words, noisy and without breezes.  Our room was often not cleaned until after 5P, when we wanted to be showering/resting before dinner. One day we had no towels (our friends experienced this repeatedly). The last day it rained; we woke in the middle of the night to water dripping in our faces -- the bed was soaked; the desk staff gave an indifferent "oh, yeah, we'll look into it" without writing the room number down.  Maintenance overall was poor; handles were missing from two of our dressers; nails were sticking out of the central bridge; towels weren't always available at the beach; power was lost for 10-15 minutes every day -- one night the entire outdoor area by our room was blacked out (no emergency lights at the exits) and we had to feel our way in the dark.  On the other hand, it may have been THE most comfortable bed we have ever slept in.

Dinners were difficult.  Reservations had to be made before 3P the day before; since they were done BY HAND, they were not easily modified or cancelled.  Several of the available restaurants weren't even listed in hotel information (ex: Mole), so almost everyone requested tables in the 3 restaurants that did not require a surcharge... which of course meant limited availability unless you wanted to eat at 6P or at 9:45P.  Yet throughout the evening, up to half the tables would be empty. Although the food in several of the restaurants was excellent (Mole, Aqua & Bana), others were mediocre (Venta).  In the buffet (which was good), all drinks -- including water -- had to be served; getting that service could be challenging. 

It seems that those who paid more for "Royal" service fared better, but although a 5-star resort should definitely have special amenities and pampering for upgrade, they should still provide 5-star service to "regular" guests. This is one resort that does not seem to grasp that concept.

reviews.author: James N
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort and amazing service
reviews.text: The resort was gorgeous and far exceeded my expectations.  The restaurants were very nice, the food selections were good and the inclusion of alchohol was a big surprise.  Our room was huge and since we were in the Reserve section we had our own pool and butler. I would reccomend this to anyone looking for a getaway.

reviews.author: Alison827
reviews.title: Business Incentive Trip-"Excellent Location to take a Group"
reviews.text: We went here in April for a business incentive trip. Exceptional service from the check-in to the checking out process. Carlos Nunze, Zuleka Guzmah, Alexis Guzmom, Dhoralix Polanco, Angelica Abluerme and Sendy Reyes went above and beyond to make sure our 7 days were incredible. Our concierge group did an excellent job with our guest restaurant reservations as well as we had booked dine around reservations for small groups each night we were there. The upper management team each day was checking to see if there was more they could do. Our group of 51 was so pleased with the location some of them have decided to return with friends and for private vacations. The Junior Deluxe rooms were very spacious and clean. The beach is gorgous. The many different varieties of food was great. This is a very relaxing atmosphere. If you wanted to have fun Alexander did water aroebics which was fun for our group to let loose and enjoy themselves. The staff is exceptional, the resort is very well maintained and very clean. The spa services in paticular the facials and messages were excellent and very well priced. For those of  you looking for a place to take a group I highly encourage you to stay at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana you will love it as much as we did. I also encourgage you to hook up with Connect travel and ask for Julia she is excellent and they do a great job with the airport transportation to and from the resort.

reviews.author: Margaret
reviews.title: Bad Food, Bad Service... No Thanks
reviews.text:
Yes, the grounds and rooms are nice but most Caribbean resorts are.  If you’ve been to one you’ve been to them all, so what it comes down to is good food and good service and this place is way below par in both of those categories.

I’m not sure what the deal is with this place but the service and friendliness of the workers was horrible during our stay.  We were part of a large group and most people we ran into said the same thing so we know it wasn’t just us.  To get any information, restaurant reservations, etc is difficult. No one is willing to help with anything or make your stay easy.

The food is absolutely disgusting.  Everything is served cold and the quality is inedible.  We ate at both buffets, the Mediterranean, the Asian, Mole, and Aqua.  At Aqua we had a table of 10 people, and half of our food came out under cooked, raw grouper. We sent it back and asked them to cook it more and when it came back out it was still under cooked.  At other restaurants, my husband had bones/cartilage/unknown hard pieces in a couple of his meat dishes. I can go on and on about the food but will stop, you get the point. 

Ohhh and bring some super glue for your resort bracelet, if it falls off be prepared to pay $250 or be told that security will be called to take you off property. Yep, $250 for a piece of string.  Also, when you let the front desk know it fell of be prepared for attitude, eye rolling and a finger point at you saying it’s your fault.  Your fault that the resort didn’t tie it tight enough, yes that is correct. If you need to speak to a manger about this matter there is none there on Saturday night so hope that this scenario doesn’t happen on a Saturday.  True story.

Another thing to point out is that the resorts wi-fi only works in certain parts of the lobby, well on the days that it works at least.  There is no wi-fi in the rooms.  

Also, on two of the days there were no beach towels.  I spend an hour wandering around the resort looking for a couple clean towels to use. Of course no employee of the resort was willing to help me with this.

I do not recommend this place to anyone. Again, we were part of a large group and everyone we talked to had the same experience we did.

reviews.author: RicDexter
reviews.title: A great resort
reviews.text: After arriving at around 11:00am to find my Royal room wasn't ready on time, I waited at the pool bar to be notified. Six cocktails later and no news so I went hunting. The butler took to me to my room which was very pleasant and good views over the pool and ocean. The bed was extremely comfortable, the room quiet, and the bathroom large and clean. The all inclusive food and drink plan is sensational but perhaps not that profitable for the hotel when hosting a lone traveling Aussie with a large thirst  and appetite:-)

reviews.author: kahweeteng
reviews.title: Big rooms, amazing service
reviews.text: Was there for a company conference and the rooms are so huge it feels lonely. Staff are responsive and are helpful in most cases. Service is delightful. Food, however, is alright. It could have been better!

reviews.author: sparkledallas
reviews.title: Great People & Love Elvis Hidalgo
reviews.text: Just returned from our trip and have to say it was fantastic!  It is a beautiful place with warm, smiling, helpful staff everywhere you go on the grounds.  Great white beaches, incredible pools, food.  The spa was fabulous and I especially liked the signature massage by Diana.  She was amazing and so was the experience.  The best was our butler, Elvis Hidalgo!!!  He was so accomodating, surprising, fun, easy to talk to, helpful.  Just a really sweet and amazing guy who I highly recommend!!!  Hope the hotel takes good care of him!!!!!!  Very relaxing trip with a really nice room.  Everything from the food, drinks, shows, casino, shops and mostly the people made our trip really great.  I highly recommend you go and enjoy!!!!

reviews.author: TracyG455
reviews.title: Service ....it really makes a trip!!
reviews.text:
Earlier this month, I had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus Punta Cana where I was impressed with the customer service. Knowing 2 weeks later, I would staying at the Palma Real, I was not sure that this sister resort could live up to the high standard set at the Punta Cana Paradisus.  Well, pleasantly surprised, it did!!

The rooms were beautliful and clean...and it was lovely to be wrapped up in nice soft sheets.

The food never dissappointed. It was fresh with alot of variety!

The beach was lovely and we were always able to find chairs with sun or shade at any time of the day.

The only thing I think can be fixed was the WiFi access points....though not really the point of being on vacation and checking work emails.... :)  It did make we relax.

Due to some techincal issues, our Royal Service cell phone never worked unfortunately but it did not impact my vacation in any way....

I would return for sure...but tough to decide whether its to the Punta Cana site or the Pamla Real....

reviews.author: Alvarovilla
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en una convención de la compañía donde trabajo. La experiencia fue espectacular. Las instalaciones, el personal, la alimentación y sus playas...espectaculares.
El personal fue amable en todo momento. La alimentación a la altura de este hotel

reviews.author: Patrick L
reviews.title: Fantastico!!
reviews.text: I've been to quite a few places and must admit that my visit to Paradisus Palma Real has thusly been the greatest visit of them all. The housing was tremendous, the food was great, and the service was excellent. My butlerae, Kharollys Siri, went far and above the call of duty to see to it that I was satisfied. I would reccommend this place as a definite vacation site to anyone. Kudos to the entire staff.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Beautiful, world class resort.
reviews.text:
I attended a company awards trip to this resort and was pleasantly surprised how beautiful this hotel is.  The beach is awesome, the pools are great, They have thatched covered beach huts for 2 people that are the best.  We stayed at the Reserve portion of the resort, but I would suggest staying in the main building, because the main pools and beach are closer.

The spa is awesome, one of the best massages I have ever had.

The food is okay, just not great great.  But everything else is wonderful including the swim up bars.

I was there for 5 days and never left the compound.  Maybe I missed something in town, but I never had a reason to leave.

reviews.author: MaggieH545
reviews.title: Palazo & Richard Ortiz
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real over February 25 - 27 as a site visit for a group. We dined at Palazo for lunch on February 27 and Richard Ortiz waited on us. He was wonderful! He went way above and beyond the call of duty and really treated us like "royalty". In fact, when my friend requested another glass of wine and he knew we were headed upstairs to the Royal Service Lounge he put the wine in a different glass and carried it upstairs for her. Terrific service! 

We had terrific service all over the property but Richard Ortize in Palazo really stole the show!

reviews.author: Daniel B
reviews.title: I would go again...
reviews.text: Stayed from the 18-23 of March for business conference.  I reserved a Jr Suite which was not ready when I arrived at 9PM...  They upgraded me and the suite was very nice, although quite a long walk every day back and forth to the conference.  Internet was horrible....  Even my ATT aircard could not get much speed.  The hotels WiFi was availabnle, but the rooms are so far away from wherever the WiFi Hotspot is.. it prioved to be useless from my room.  Other than that, the hotel was nicely kept, clean, staff was very friendly and overall a nice stay as long as you have no need for internet.

reviews.author: felipe c
reviews.title: Fabuloso, femonenal
reviews.text: hola a mi las personas de republica,  solo le escribo a  para agredecerles a  todos los equipo  del hotel, en especial al staff de Royal Services, todo fueron de una gran  ayuda, agradezco por ser tan gentil a mi gran amigo  Gustavo  Santana , gracias por su  ayuda y dedicación, y también a los los staff del restaurante naos... desde Colombia un gran saludo, afecto son los mejores.

reviews.author: Cliffster1162
reviews.title: Amazing location and hotel, but poor service
reviews.text: Really nice upscale all-inclusive with a great beach.  Food was above average for an all-inclusive.  The hotel service was poor however, reducing a five star rating to and average rating.  The hotel overbooked its rooms the day I arrived. They told me I've been upgraded to a room at their upscale resort The Reserve.  They then proceeded to tell me the upgrade was not free, but at a price that was $100/nt higher.  It took me over an hour of discussion with three managers before I finally received my room at the originally booked price.  Also, all-inclusive is not all-inclusive here.  The staff created many awkward moments when it was clear they were looking for tips.

reviews.author: yudelka s
reviews.title: Excelente servicios ofrecidos de Pedro Reyes y Fred Marte
reviews.text: Me senti muy bien con el servicios de todos los empleados del hotel y muy agradecida de Pedro Reyes y Fred Marte   Realmente este hotel es un paraiso es que la playa son hermosa, la comida excelente y que hablar sobre el servicio. me encanto todo, desde que tenga la oportunidad vuelvo a pasar mis vacaciones en el Hotel en compania de mi familia y amigos.

reviews.author: joosborn
reviews.title: Thanks for the awesome stay
reviews.text:
I'm writing this note to say thank you to Fres Martes and Luis Fermin. We arrived late to the hotel and had missed dinner and our room had not yet been stocked. Fres brought us food and had someone restock our mini-bar. During the days that were there, Fres also checked in every day to make sure that we were comfortable and didn't need anything. On Mon evening, Fres found out that I was not feeling well and had chicken soup and bread sent to the room. The morning of our departure, Fres made sure we had box lunches to take with us since we were leaving so early. It was a true pleasure staying in your hotel and it is because of the "extra attention", the professionalism and the thoughtfulness of Fres. Linda and I look forward to returning to the Paradisus Palma Real in the near future. 
John & Linda Osborne

reviews.author: laurel l
reviews.title: Stolen items
reviews.text:
During my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort, belongings from my room were stolen- my cell phone that was charging on the desk, my ipod touch, and all of my cash thatw as in my wallet. when I brought this to the attention of the management they claimed that it was my fault since items were not in the lock box.

They also told me that they found no violation in my room and that nobody had entered it during the time things were stolen. I.e. they were basically telling me I was lying. I would stay far away from this place if you want to keep your belongings.

reviews.author: mariamemec
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: The employees are always kind, smiling and willing to help.  They recommend you restaurants to have dinner at and whenever you are lost they take you to the place you want to go.  The beach is beautiful and the food is Delicious, I went there for business but spent the downtime enjoying the resort, will definitely go back again on vacation.

reviews.author: Auburn123
reviews.title: Just returned from an incentive trip to this resort
reviews.text:
OK I am in the hotel business and have been for 30 plus years. This is a great resort to relax and enjoy the beach and the wonderful landscaping they offer at this property!
We stayed in the Reserve and the room was very nice 4/5 in my opinion. The private pool and restaurant for the Reserve are both very nice and it is a true upgrade to book the Reserve.
The food is OK (some much better than other options) We truly enjoyed The Grill (get the skirt steak) it was a very nice restaurant. 
Best advise book your restaurant reservations as soon as you arrive they fill up fast! 
Overall...we would definitly return (and will) just stick with the restaurant that take reservations
and skip the upcharge restaurants we did not think it was worth the upcharges

reviews.author: stefano s
reviews.title: Buena experencia
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el Parla Real para un evento corporativo. 
recibimos muy buen trato y en el complejo el resort es bueno, con habitaciones bien estructuradas y buena comida.
A nivel del evento el staff local nos atend;io de forma profesional. 
Puntos a mejorar: tintorería y salas de meeting, un poco "retró" si comparadas con el elevado estandar del hotel mismo.

reviews.author: Martack3
reviews.title: Best Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I have been to other resorts including the Paradisus Punta Cana  - Reserve.Which is perfectly fabulous in its own way. However,  Paradisus Palma Real is the rela deal. Service and Food was excellent, as good as I hace had at aby 5 star resort. 
A few specfic names to mention: Christian Ortiz - Room Service - Delivered breakfast everyday / same time without issue. Butler: Carmen was amazing ! 
Palazzo Restaurant - Alexaner and Smerlyn Olea were simply wonderful. 
And, Franscisco Cabrera, Pedro, Martin, Nelson and all the great guys that took great care of us at the pool and beach. Whatever we needed - it was handled. Cant wait to go back.!

reviews.author: The-Seattle-Traveler
reviews.title: Not worth it!
reviews.text:
For this being a 4 star resort and at the price you pay, the food is so bad that you'll be spending your vacation with Pepto Bismol. There are many restaurants in the hotel. The first night we ate at Bana sushi and it was decent. The second night we had a sit down dinner as we were there for a work/vacation trip. We had steak and lobster the second night. The lobster was so overcooked and the steak looked gray. Needless to say-mediocre. Third night everyone in our group-there were about 10 of us ate at Bana Tapanyaki and all got sick. My husband has been paying the price still after 2 days!
The pool was nice, the accommodations were nice, but wouldn't go to this all inclusive if the food stays the same!

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: Great week!
reviews.text: My company brought a group of customers on a rewards trip to the Paradisus Palma Real this past week.  Their entire staff worked to ensure that our events and the client experience went well.   They were available for all of our requests and made them happen, morning or night.   Great place to hold your business conference.

reviews.author: Cjdm_13
reviews.title: Nicolas made our stay special
reviews.text:
We attended a business conference and experienced the Royal Service. Ask for Nicolas in room service if you want excellent service with a smile. He really out did himself in making our stay fun and comfortable!
We enjoyed the resort. The food was great at Palazzo. The beach is the nicest we have experienced ....you can walk for miles and the breeze is lovely. The butler service varied with butlers. Some of our fiends experienced exceptional service whilst others hardly saw theirs. The beach beds were awesome and so was the beach service(Francisco and Martin were awesome). Our room was quiet, clean, and well appointed.
A couple of negatives were:The golf course is mediocre and rentals were pretty sad. The Hotel must lose the terrible music played along the walkways...it is the same tape all day long...drives you crazy but this is a minor detail.
The spa services were first class.....be sure to book a massage.
We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: david p
reviews.title: Best trip ever!!!
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 5 days here and fell in love with the place. The service was excellent and the hotel rooms are the amazing. Great people, especially Jose Mateo at the restaurant MOLE. He was a joy to have around. He went to him for any questions, even though he worked in the restaurant, he helped make our stay even more pleasant. We promised our kids to take them there this year so they can enjoy a nice vacation. We actually invested in a time share there we loved it so much.

reviews.author: PAUL
reviews.title: NO More Buffets!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week long vacation.  My review is mixed because the resort had numerous positive items with a few drawbacks we personally didn't care for.  You must remember you are in another country, so 5 stars in the Dominican would not be the same 5 star experience in the states.  I believe it is one of the nicer resorts in the Dominican area based on appearance alone.  "We also walked several miles in each direction".  The grounds are immaculate and cared for on a daily basis.  The units are spaced well and the entire complex is very walk-able.  The golf cart shuttle was never used by us.  The beach was also nice in appearance and very clean.  However, the constant distractions took away from the beauty.  The resort sits in the middle of everything.  This includes para-sailing,  boats, vendors, day trips, boose-cruises, and like 50-60 helicopters flying just above the resort each day.  This created a lot of constant distraction!
     The service was on the most part very good.  The restaurant service was generally excellent.  Certain bartenders will go out of their way for you while others hardly recognize you.  It felt like tipping would get you better service and recognition.  Reservation times varied, and we are not planners, so towards the end of the trip it was difficult to get in at  a good time.  This is when we had to go to the buffet.  Nothing special here, yet not entirely bad.  Always something different, just not the greatest taste.  
     The spa was the best part of our trip.  While somewhat pricey, it felt good to be able to utilize the therapy pools throughout the day of your service.  Very tranquil experience both times we went.  Our room was nicely kept with turn down service nightly.  The fridge was stocked daily with soda, beer, water, and juice @ two of each.  The negative with the room was the power.  We easily spent 50% of our vacation without power.  The air conditioning ALWAYS worked, but the remaining power would go out at different times daily!  AND yes, I realize their is a main switch on the wall by the door that serves as a main switch!  That seemed to be their reason every time we called.  We just got used to it as long as the A.C. kept working!  The rooms seemed to have a slight musty smell to them, but not uncommon for a resort such as this.  
     Would we go back?  probably not as we like to try different resorts.  I would recommend this resort and feel they tried to go out of their way to make it special.  It was just a little to hectic on the beach scene for me.  I like something more reserved and quite.  They need to create a more authentic food option as the buffet seemed to lack towards the end.  I believe most people would be more than happy with the accommodations at this resort and appreciate the effort made by all the employees during our stay..

reviews.author: Vbchaz
reviews.title: Asleep at the wheel
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful resort and the staff did their best.  We were in the "Royal Service" section which has many privileges, without these the rating would have been lower. 

Starting with the good.   The beach, the pool awesome.  If I wanted to go somewhere and be pampered and just lay around.  This is hard to beat.  The beach guy worked his butt off to make you happy he was overworked but always smiled.  The Royal Service had it's own bar and restaurant,   We learned just to eat most our meals there.  The gym was very good.  Several bikes, treadmills, and weights.   And I must mention, only premium booze, no second tier stuff.

The not so good.  Hair dryer did not work, TV had no picture, electricity goes out a lot so the clock was useless.  Nice booze in the room, no glasses so we used coffee cups. No internet in the rooms unless you are close to lobby or bar.

Most the bars around the pools are under staffed and during our week we were never asked if we needed a drink (except by the over worked guy setting up chairs.)  Food was average outside of the Royal Service.  The food was so bad at the Thai restaurant that we just walked out.  It was obvious that there was a buffet in the kitchen and you were just "plated" .  We heard the same from several guests.  

Compared to other resorts, activities were minimal.  It appears that this place caters to corp events, several evenings there were corp events going on that occupied most of the venue so your choice was to sneak in with them or go sit at the bar.  Again, if you just wanted to "hang" it was not so bad.  Lot's of things were not available because they were being "repaired".  Also, only 2 bathrooms for the entire beach and pools.  For 2 days one of them was closed for painting, really?  That should have been done during the evening.

Now I don't mind getting my own drinks and making things right myself and being in charge of my schedule so we had a great time.  But it is the little things that add up.  This place has the potential to be great it needs better management.

reviews.author: Jamie F
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
This was our first real vacation, and it couldn't have been at a better place.  We were there for a convention, but it was amazing none the less.  Everyone was more than helpful and super friendly.  Even the gentleman who showed up at midnight with cheeseburgers for some out of place feeling Americans!  

The food!  Wow is not even enough to describe it.  Everything was so fresh and so delicious.  Naos was a perfect place to start your day, offering not only those foods that make you feel at home, like scrambled eggs, but so many different fruits, breads, meats, cheeses, and the best plantains on the planet!  Their lunch buffet was also amazing.  But if you wanted something to grab and sit on the beach, the wraps and sandwiches at the Grab and Go next to the Market Grill were perfect.  Gabi Beach and Vento were our 2 choices for supper while we were there, and they were both great!  The beach was beautiful, the pools looked amazing although we didn't have time to get in.  

The room was spectacular!  Although you could hear a bit in the morning when some folks were  opening the closets, it really wasn't too bad.  The best part had to be waking up to the sounds of the birds and the rain outside our door!

Back to the people.  Not once were we ever met with a frown or an unpleasant person.  Angel Pacheco has to be one of the best hospitality hosts we have ever met!  He was always helpful and we never saw him without a smile.

All summed up, I recommend this resort to anyone who needs to feel relaxed and pampered.  We WILL be back!  So absolutely perfect!  A PARADISE!!!!

reviews.author: Jason J
reviews.title: Best Resort in Punta Cana!!!
reviews.text: How this resort is ranked 18th is a mystery!! When you get out of the taxi and take a few steps into the lobby the WOW factor hits you looking out to the ocean. This resort is amazing....beautiful, spacious with lots of loungers by the pool and beach and great spots to sit and relax. Huge pool and rooms are good and clean. Food is good .....Passion restaurant is the best. The staff are great and attentive. The beach is so clean.....water and sand.....you cannot go wrong with the resort. Loved it and the Flamingos on the property were such a nice added touch!!! We so hope to go back one day again!!

reviews.author: Steve and Kerri S
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is beautiful! The staff was very helpful and friendly. The food was wonderful! We really enjoyed our dinner at Vento and our lunches at the Grill. Our room was always cleaned and our towels restocked without us ever having to ask. 
We had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: Ezequiel A
reviews.title: An outstanding place to go
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing hotel. The food was excellent and in all the "a la carte" restaurants we tried the service was pretty good. We received an exceptional service everywhere in the hotel, and I can say without mistakes that is the best hotel in the whole east area of the Dominican Republic. I give a well done earned: Two thumbs up!

reviews.author: marikillian
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - Great Property for Corporate Events
reviews.text: We've just completed our third program at the Paradisus Palma Real and just as past events, this one was another home run.  The attention to our guests by the resort staff was second-to-none; the accommodations still pristine and the location and water ... perfection.  A special note - AMSTAR, the DMC, is the right choice to help with ground and excursion transfers, as they are detail oriented and eager to make each event successful.

reviews.author: Luvstotravel T
reviews.title: 3 Words....O...M...G!
reviews.text:
I spent a week with a large business group. From the time we arrived, the staff was very accommodating and friendly. They whisked our luggage away while we continued to check in and settle in. The beaches were wonderful, the room was clean and fresh. The restaurants offered a large variety, Passions Restaurant and the Asian restaurant were the best places to eat. When we did order room service, it was never more than 30 minutes of the 35 minute wait time. The best activities were the parties (80's party was a blast)! Joangel was a great party host and hot dancer! The dance classes were also fun as well as the nightly singing and dancing in the piano bar. Did anyone say disco? Check out the Red Lounge, awesome! My only regret was that we waited until the day before we left to check out the spa. The spa was simply amazing! Go early during your visit, you WILL want to visit again. Willy, the restaurant host (he was always in various restaurants), was very friendly, helpful, and just a sweet person. Make sure you find Luis at the pool bar, he makes the best drinks (tip him, please)! I had a great time, can't wait to go back!
Tips to remember:
-ask for a room close to the main areas of the resort (lobby, restaurants, beach) otherwise you could end up on the far end
-if you get a room in the villas away from the hotel, ask for the first or second floor if you have physical needs that need to be met, or if you have a large baby stroller; there are no elevators in the villas.
-bring extra money (single US dollars) to tip staff who go out of their way, they will treat you like they have known you for years, plus they deserve it!
-there is a mall around the corner, ask for a shuttle driver in the lobby to take you there. They will also pick you up!
-ask for a list off all shows and activities, there is always something happening on the resort!
-there will be staff to sell you excursions, don't get put off by them, that's their job. Just politely decline if you're not interested. We did the coral reef and lagoon excursion by Marinarium and had so much fun, we did it twice!
-don't forget to try the island drink Mommajuana!

reviews.author: Alain M
reviews.title: paradisus plus tout à fait royal !
reviews.text: séjour du 07 /01 AU 21/01 2013 au SERVICE ROYAL . Les chambres sont vieillissantes mais le prix du séjour est d'actualité .Les lits sont d'anciens lit s jumeaux qui ont été bricolés pour faire un énorme lit , de plus , ils sont montés sur roulettes , ce qui fait que lorsque l'on s'adosse au mur , on se retrouve au milieu de la chambre : agréable ! L'installation électrique est rafistolée derrière les lits.  Le service du majordome est chaotique ; nous en avons changé trois fois en 15 jours . Le service en chambre n'est pas digne d'un service qui se veut royal ;il faut toujours demander pour etre servi ( serviettes ,gants etc ) parfois même la chambre n'etait pas faite à 17 h ! Le service au bord de la piscine est bien, mais difficile pour avoir une cabanette à l'ombre . Les pourboires en dollar font alors avancer les choses !! Les restaurants sont bien et l'on y mange bien . Dans l'ensemble , nous qui allons chaque année en R D ,nous pouvons trouver mieux au même prix

reviews.author: rhonda9156340
reviews.title: great trip
reviews.text: just got back from paradisus palma real. the place is gorgeous. one of the nicest ai ive been in. the photos do it no justice. you have to see it in person. the workers were exstremely friendly and cant do enough for you. the  food was fine we found what to eat as always in ai. would definately  hope to return there soon., the rooms are also very nice.

reviews.author: Agostinacf
reviews.title: Un sueño
reviews.text:
Hermoso Hotel, con muy buena atención haciendote sentir exclusivos.
La comida excelente, increible probar la Langosta en el Gabi.
El spa es muy bueno!!
Sueño con ese hotel .
El staff de Entretinimiento y los encargados de las Relaciones Publicas son para destacar

reviews.author: Kimg10
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, below average service
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in November for a business trip.  The hotel is stunning, but the service is lacking.  The food and beverages are very average.  We sent a ton of drinks back because we couldn't even drink them & I am not the slightest bit picky with alcohol.  Finally started drinking champagne because I knew that would be good.  Everyone morning at breakfast, I would have to hunt down someone to bring coffee to the table.  One night we did go to the Japanese restaurant and had a great dinner.  The drinks at that bar were great!

The common areas and beach were beautiful at this resort.  The room was very spacious and clean.  We did not have Royal Service, so I think that may have impacted our experience.  I would probably not stay at this resort again, as there are many more options on the island.

reviews.author: Elaine W
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Am excited about taking a group to Paradisus!   Beautiful property - lots of natural landscapes throughout.    The people are super nice.   Five star service!    Several pools, lots of bars and restaurants.   Beach area was very deep and clean.   Lots of seating.    Great place for families as well.   The golf course was nice and so convenient to take the trolley over.     Love the idea of separate pool for families.   The Reserve was well worth it.   Very, very attentive - but the whole resort staff really was.   The grill at the pool area did keep running out of food......not sure why.    But all in all - highly recommend the resort!   Had already recommended to a friend before I went and she took family on spring break.   They usually stay in 5 star hotels - had a great, great time.

reviews.author: MKDesiree
reviews.title: Our second time staying at this great place.
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort the year if first opened six years ago. We were very impressed the first time and very excited to go back. The staff is very friendly. The gardens and resort itself are beautiful. Our room did not smell and was very nice. Room service was excellent. All in all, we really liked it here.

reviews.author: Luz maria E
reviews.title: Agradable estadía! Altamente recomendable
reviews.text:
Muy agradable la estadía en Palma Real. El personal que trabaja en el hotel destaca por su amabilidad y profesionalismo, quiero mencionar al chef y administrador del restaurante fuego, pese a que tuvimos un inconveniente con la reserva, nos entregaron una rápida solución. Los recepcionistas del hotel muy amables, los animadores simpáticos y alegres, destacando a José animador, todo nuestro grupo motivado en participarar en las distintas actividades. Respecto a los shows la fiesta fuego dance buenísima, también el show de MIchael Jackson. Finalmente, destaco a los encargados de la música del hotel, muy buena la selección,cuanto con destacar los shows del lobby.
Esta es la segunda vez que visito un hotel Paradisus y los recomiendo absolutamente.  Me gustaría que las agencias de turismo tuvieran un poco mas de información para recomendar el concepto ROYAL para contratarlo.

reviews.author: agerremedia
reviews.title: excelente hotel con mejor servicio
reviews.text: he disfrutado del hotel por sus instalaciones y muy positivo el servicio por eficacia y calidad humana especialmente por Ramon Fuego que hace del bar de la piscina un lugar de encuentro divertido y muy agradable

reviews.author: Carlosolague
reviews.title: Excelente camarero y persona. Ramón fuego
reviews.text:
Muy simpático y eficiente. Cualquier cosa que le pidas le falta tiempo pra responderte con la mejor de las sonrisas. Una persona que a todo el mundo le gustaría tener en su equipo.
El hotel también es maravilloso.

reviews.author: DANIEL HORACIO B
reviews.title: Agradecimiento
reviews.text: Especial a  María Cecilia Arias Reyes...Nuestra estadia fue espectacular gracias a ella que se deshizo en atenciones y se bailó todo. También Ramón Bonilla trayéndonos las cervezas sobre su cabeza a toda velocidad en el bar de la Piscina "Aqua Bar". Ambos una maravilla!!.

reviews.author: Fuentesjl
reviews.title: ES UN HOTEL PARA EL RELAX TOTAL
reviews.text: Es simplemente excelente, la comida, las instalaciones, las habitaciones, buena disco, buena diversión, buena playa y deportes acuaticos, la atencion y las bebidas pudieran mejorar, pero de verdad es un hotel excelente para el descanso...

reviews.author: Se M
reviews.title: Gracias República Dominicana
reviews.text: Fuimos de Convención un grupo de mas de cien personas, lo que más me gusto fue el grupo de animación liderado por María Cecilia y José, muy atentos en todo momento animandonos a disfrutar de todas las instalaciones disponibles y poniendonos en ambiente caribeño, como todos los hoteles;  pequeños detalles negativos al momento de solicitar bebidas a los meseros en el restaurante naos, buenas instalaciones, muy romántico por aquello de la luz tenue en todas partes, gente muy cálida y amable. El único detalle es que deberían alentar a los huespedes para poder comprar artesanía a las orillas de la playa donde evidentemente encuentras precios mucho más accesibles y con personas que de verdad necesitan las ventas para sobrevivir.

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Beautiful place, but service was horrible
reviews.text: We went to this resort for a short trip and left feeling bitter and jilted. The service stunk. We never received our "credits" and didn't find out until the day before we left that we have to ask for them, people who don't know to ask don't get them. The lights in our room repeatedly went out and were slow to come back on. The smoke alarm in our room was low on batteries so it beeped every 5 minutes. We asked for assistance in taking care of that over and over again. When we left it was still beeping. They never fixed it. Many of the employees there were very nice, but most were rude and treated us like a bother. On the plus side, it was quiet, there weren't very many people or crowds, it was gorgeous, and had plenty of good food. But overall, I'm pretty sure I won't be returning to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: erniecan
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: I recently spent 3 nights here for a business meeting where I  also had ample time for pleasure, and was very pleased with the accommodations and service. I recommend taking the Royal Service package, where they cater to your every need. It is a very well maintained resort, perfect for couples, families or business.

reviews.author: mlrl1965
reviews.title: Very Good to a Point
reviews.text:
I was at a business conference by myself from 7/8 until 7/11.  The resort is very clean and bright.  The room was a junior suite, which was very large very nicely appointed.  The bathroom had a huge jacuzzi tub and a separate shower with full body nozzles.  Separate room for a toilet.  Nice closet with a modern safe.  Flat screen television.  A nice size veranda.  
The food was good not great.  Maybe one step up from a luxury cruise.  There are buffets as well as very nice sit down restaurants.  One restaurant was extra at $40.00.  The bars served premium alcohol.  The golf course which I played twice was very well maintained.  All this was inclusive in the price.  The pool was dramatically laid out with built in whirlpools and swim up bars.  This was cruise ship with room.  I think they give a lot for the charge.  Airport only 20 minutes away.

reviews.author: Raul V
reviews.title: In my personal experience one of the worst I have ever had
reviews.text: If you ever go to this Hotel place make sure they advise you everything, and they treat you for what you pay. If I can rate this Hotel, except for certain things I will surely make a 2 star hotel , but with a price of a 5 Start Hotel , I don't recommend anyone to go to this Hotel, but If you have to go before confirming your reservation make sure everything is totally clear.

reviews.author: Sandra E
reviews.title: Increible restaurante y SPA
reviews.text:
Increíble el restaurante del chef español Berazategui. Realmente un placer  !
El SPA, con un servicio y ciclos de agua excepcionales.

reviews.author: Jeroen2012
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego
reviews.text:
Ramon Fuego ofrece servicio de muy alta clase. Es un individuo quien tiene charla para todo cliente. Crea y entrega bebidas al lado de la piscina con un caracter inolvidable.

Muchas gracias por hacer la estancia muy amena.

reviews.author: Victor O
reviews.title: Un lujo, gracias Movie City & Fox
reviews.text: Excelente de punta a punta, supero ampliamente las expectativas. Mucho personal de servicio, las mejores habitaciones y comodidades, la playa es un sueño y magnifica gastronomia. Espectacular el bar de piscina principal, Ramon es un showman que divierte a viajeros de todo el globo. 100% satisfecho. Fuego!!!!

reviews.author: jean a
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful!  The entire staff was friendly and helpful.  Everyone went above and beyond to make our stay great.  Our favorite time to spend the afternoons was at the Pool Bar.  Ramon "Fuego" Bonilla, Louis, and Bianca are EXCELLENT!!!!  They consistently treated us like royalty!  We will definetly come back - to see the resort as well as spend time with Ramon, Louis, and Bianca!!!

reviews.author: Flag-OnYour-Knapsack
reviews.title: Outstanding Service from Luis (Activities Group)
reviews.text: After hearing a couple of hours of great Dominican music on the beach, I asked Luis from the Activities Group where I could buy a cd to take home.  He ended up taking his personal memory stick over to the DJs and asked them save all the songs they were playing on to his device.  He then gave me his memory stick to take home.  There must be over 100 songs saved.  This is a nice example of going the extra mile for a hotel guest.  Jose and Gabriel from the same Activities Group also stood out a great hotel ambassadors.

reviews.author: moppiesue
reviews.title: awesome vacation!
reviews.text: We went on a business trip, we had a fabulous time.  You need to look past the small things in order to have a good time.  Diving wasn't so good but the  equipment was very safe. Excursions were very touristy but all in all they were alright. The boats for deep sea fishing were a little decrepit and worn but we caught a ton of large fish, whoo and ma I ma I. The food was very plentiful but you had to spend 2 hours for dinner. Are most enjoyable moments were at thebar outside with fuego.  I would personally suggest the spa the massage was amazing and probably the best I've ever had.  I would go back but change my room to an upper floor.  We also had a wonderful time crashing other peoples parties and weddings:-) have fun.. watch out for the glitter people the stuff doesn't come off for about 2 weeks.

reviews.author: ParksloperBrooklyn
reviews.title: Best meal of my life
reviews.text: The hotel houses a 5-star reataurant entitled Passion that provides a tasting menu for an addiitonal $40 fee over the all-inclusive rate and it is well worth it. It was the best meal I ever had.

reviews.author: Verinagra
reviews.title: Comfortable, Spacious, Friendly
reviews.text: We were part of a conference group of about 60 people. Group check in was fast and smooth. All facilities provided were good. It was high season and I think, the resort was full, yet no facility was over crowded. Plenty of space and privacy in the pools. Lots of comfortable and shady gazebos. The rooms, restaurants etc are air conditioned. The lobbies are well designed to catch lots of breeze and have thatched roof, so are a very good green initiative (as is the Punta Cana airport). Kudos to the people of Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Guillermo Lagos S
reviews.title: El Mejor en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Para los que nos gusta un hotel Tranquilo, no masivo, no extremadamente grande, donde hay que caminar muchisssssimo o tomar carrito hasta para tomar agua, Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana de la cadena Melia es el Hotel:
El servicio Real es estupendo, te asignan un mayordomo y te dan un celular para uso interno, te preparan el jacuzzi de la habitacion con agua tibia, espuma y sales, la neverita tiene bebidas Premiun y todo esta incluido, tienes cafetera en la nevera, TV de LCD de 42 Pulgadas y mas de 100 canales, los ammenities del baño todos de buena calidad, algunas habitaciones con vista al Mar o al Jardin, varias restaurante y muchos a la carta y buffet, veneto excelente para las 3 comidas, el japones un espectaculo con los malabarismos de los cocineros, el Gabi excelentes productos del mar al aire libre y lo mejor de todo el Rest. Passion de un Chef 3 estrellas michelin, te dan una degustacion de 5 platos, solo que no esta incluido pero el costo con vino es de aprox. USD 80 p/pax que no es alto. Las actividades de playa y piscina, normales nada del otro mundo, pero el hotel tiene gimnasio y SPA, el acceso a este ultimo es gratis a las areas humedas, pero cualquier tratamiento o masaje es aparte, el gimnasio tambien sin costo, con clases de Spinning y yoga. Los Shows Nocturnos son bastante buenos y ademas tiene casino, pequeño pero completo, con maquinitas, Black Jack y Ruleta. Es la mejor precio valor de Punta Cana. >Una noche escapate a la discoteca Imagine toda una experiencia.

reviews.author: recruiterca2011
reviews.title: Excellent time at this resort....
reviews.text:
I recently returned from 4 days at this Palma Real Paradisus resort and I had an incredible time! My friends and I were stunned at their beautiful grounds, the location to the beach was perfection,  our experience at the Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort was fantastic. 
Our room was clean, (and yes we had to ask for towels but so what ?), the beds were great and extremely comfortable in our room , and our experience was stellar. 

Nothing is without its imperfections ( it is  unrealistic to think so ) .......If we had any issues we called the front desk and the issue was fixed immediatley!  All in all, I would most definitely recommend this resort to anyone who would like what felt like a 5 star vacation.   

I am planning to return at the end of the year!

reviews.author: Maely U
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: The buffet and restaurant of this hotel are fantastic...Excellent service highly recommended I really enjoyed this restaurant the food was excellent and the service was great very good quality food...the new A&B helped a lot to get everything perfect...

reviews.author: kwtraveller22
reviews.title: Bring your own Toiletries!
reviews.text:
My recent stay at the resort was very relaxing and pleasant, with two exceptions:  Service in the buffet restaurant and the toiletries provided.  I was part of a business group staying at the resort for 7 days, and found the resort to be beautiful, and the beach very nice. However, the service at every meal we ate at the buffet was terrible, even after we tipped generously. It appears that if you want good service, you have to sit on the side of the restaurant with fabric covered chairs, which looks like it is set up for a wedding reception or something.  There are 4 times as many servers on that side of the restaurant as on the normal side.  The servers rarely sepak english and will nod and smile, and then not bring you what you asked for.  
the other negative is the toiletries provided.  I have stayed at many all inclusive resorts, both in Mexico, Jamaica and the Dominican, and the ones provided by the Paradisus Palma Real are the cheapest, poorest quality shampoo and other products I have ever seen.  I would have been much better off to have brought products from a dollar store at home.  They did not provide any conditioner at all, which seems odd when people are swimming and getting salt water in their hair daily.  The shampoo was really poor quality and the soap and lotion were cheap and awful.  
The only other comment I would like to make is that the front desk staff need better training and maybe some english language classes - they didn't seem to understand or care about any issues or concerns expressed on check in, or later.  In at least one case, they refused to call a manager even when the guest insisted, because they said they would get in trouble if they did!   When we asked for a ground floor room, because we were initially placed in a 3rd floor walkup suite, and were travelling with our infant in a large stroller, they didn't seem to comprehend what the issue was, and kept telling us to go to our assigned room and wait for a bellman to come and help us move to something else.  We literally could not get to the assigned room with the stroller, since the third floor does not have elevator access, and we were not about to try and carry the stroller, car seat, carryon and baby up three flights of stairs!

reviews.author: johoallen
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text:
We were at the resort as part of a business sales incentive award.  As many have mentioned, the grounds are spectacular and the beach the deepest we've ever seen - plenty of room for everyone.  The posted photos are accurate representations. 

The service and the food are below standard.  Our Royal Service butler, Jose, took a group of us to our building and took each couple to their floor and told us our room was thataway, never checking back the rest of the day (nor did the maid perform turndown service the first night).  He did show up with a cheese plate and a bottle of wine the second night and set up the romantic Jacuzzi bath the third night without our asking.  As some have mentioned, the maids are relentless - they will clean your room on their schedule.  Even if you tell them no, they come back in five minutes and if you succeed in running them off, you'll never get fresh towels. 

The food is poor.  Hot food is cold and cold food is lukewarm.  We splurged on the cost plus restaurant "Passion," and I had the worst meal I have had in a very long time.  The scallops were cold and gummy, as was the sea bass, when the main dishes finally arrived (three apology trips by the manager for the delay).  I sent the fish back and it was returned warmer and still undercooked.  The manager came back with the chef, who did not understand English, so I am sure he had no idea what was wrong.   We did get reports that Gabi was better; however, it is located at the far end of the resort and I never saw it. 

This was our first experience with an all-inclusive.  I will definitely go into the next all-inclusive with lowered expectations.

reviews.author: UnSpontaneousCanuck
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text:
This is going to be a very lengthy review as I always like to get all the details before I go somewhere.  If you are already booked in to the Palma Real, don’t worry, you will have a decent trip however it does not quite measure up to some other 5 stars we have stayed at or even some 3 star cruises we’ve been on.  There are areas that need improvement and seem fairly simple to fix but after 7 days these areas can get downright annoying.  I’ve tried to provide you enough info so you can avoid some of the frustration and have the best time possible.

Prepare yourself for the Punta Cana Airport – all I can say is it was total chaos!  I believe 3 or 4 planes arrived at the same time that we did and this apparently overwhelmed the whole place.  I was shocked to step off the plane carrying my baby and be out on a tarmac in the full sun and heat where we remained in a line up for at least 45 minutes before our line made its way into the shade under the thatched roof of the airport.  Even under the roof it was complete chaos, no line-ups just a sea of people trying to push forward to clear customs.  At some point a kind fellow passenger from our flight notified someone that we had a baby and should not be standing in this crushing crowd so some airport employee found us and escorted us to the front of the group so we could clear customs more quickly and proceed to retrieving our baggage.  
The ride from the airport to the Palma Real was approximately 20 minutes.  
We were travelling with a large group and had a special area for checking in.  We were informed upon check-in that despite our advance notice that we would be travelling with an infant, we were placed in a room far away from the main building on the third floor in a building that had no elevator.  As we had a stroller and intended to use it throughout our stay we complained and were told we should go check in to our room and then wait a couple of hours and then come back to the front desk (not where our group was being checked in) when it wasn’t as busy and they would see if they could change our room.
